diff --git a/apps/api/prisma/backfill-product-configurations.ts b/apps/api/prisma/backfill-product-configurations.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8ae928d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/prisma/backfill-product-configurations.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,113 @@
+import { appendFile, readFile, rename, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { resolve } from "node:path";
+import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import {
+  BackfillProgress,
+  runProductConfigurationBackfill
+} from "./product-configuration-backfill";
+
+type CliOptions = {
+  execute: boolean;
+  batchSize: number;
+  maxProducts?: number;
+  resumeAfter?: string;
+  confirmDatabase?: string;
+  checkpointFile?: string;
+  quarantineFile?: string;
+};
+
+function valueAfter(args: string[], flag: string) {
+  const index = args.indexOf(flag);
+  if (index < 0) return undefined;
+  const value = args[index + 1];
+  if (!value || value.startsWith("--")) throw new Error(`${flag} requires a value`);
+  return value;
+}
+
+function positiveInteger(value: string | undefined, fallback?: number) {
+  if (value === undefined) return fallback;
+  const parsed = Number(value);
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed < 1) throw new Error(`Invalid positive integer: ${value}`);
+  return parsed;
+}
+
+function parseOptions(args: string[]): CliOptions {
+  const execute = args.includes("--execute");
+  const batchSize = positiveInteger(valueAfter(args, "--batch-size"), 100)!;
+  if (batchSize > 1000) throw new Error("--batch-size cannot exceed 1000");
+  const options = {
+    execute,
+    batchSize,
+    maxProducts: positiveInteger(valueAfter(args, "--max-products")),
+    resumeAfter: valueAfter(args, "--resume-after"),
+    confirmDatabase: valueAfter(args, "--confirm-database"),
+    checkpointFile: valueAfter(args, "--checkpoint-file"),
+    quarantineFile: valueAfter(args, "--quarantine-file")
+  };
+  if (execute && (!options.checkpointFile || !options.quarantineFile)) {
+    throw new Error("--execute requires both --checkpoint-file and --quarantine-file");
+  }
+  return options;
+}
+
+async function readCheckpoint(path: string | undefined) {
+  if (!path) return undefined;
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(await readFile(resolve(path), "utf8")) as BackfillProgress;
+  } catch (error) {
+    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return undefined;
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+async function writeCheckpoint(path: string | undefined, progress: BackfillProgress) {
+  if (!path) return;
+  const target = resolve(path);
+  const temporary = `${target}.tmp`;
+  await writeFile(temporary, `${JSON.stringify(progress, null, 2)}\n`, { encoding: "utf8", mode: 0o600 });
+  await rename(temporary, target);
+}
+
+async function appendOperationalRecord(path: string | undefined, record: unknown) {
+  if (!path) return;
+  await appendFile(resolve(path), `${JSON.stringify(record)}\n`, {
+    encoding: "utf8",
+    mode: 0o600
+  });
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  const options = parseOptions(process.argv.slice(2));
+  const checkpoint = await readCheckpoint(options.checkpointFile);
+  if (checkpoint && options.confirmDatabase && checkpoint.database !== options.confirmDatabase) {
+    throw new Error("Checkpoint database does not match --confirm-database");
+  }
+  const resumeAfter = options.resumeAfter ?? checkpoint?.lastCursor ?? undefined;
+  const prisma = new PrismaClient();
+
+  try {
+    const result = await runProductConfigurationBackfill(prisma, {
+      batchSize: options.batchSize,
+      maxProducts: options.maxProducts,
+      resumeAfter,
+      execute: options.execute,
+      confirmDatabase: options.confirmDatabase,
+      initialProgress: checkpoint,
+      onQuarantine: async (record) => appendOperationalRecord(options.quarantineFile, record),
+      onConflict: async (record) => appendOperationalRecord(options.quarantineFile, record),
+      onBatchComplete: async (progress) => {
+        await writeCheckpoint(options.checkpointFile, progress);
+        process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ event: "batch", ...progress })}\n`);
+      }
+    });
+    await writeCheckpoint(options.checkpointFile, result);
+    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ event: "complete", dryRun: !options.execute, ...result }, null, 2)}\n`);
+  } finally {
+    await prisma.$disconnect();
+  }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => {
+  process.stderr.write(`${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}\n`);
+  process.exitCode = 1;
+});

@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+-- OrderSawa Product Configuration Network.
+-- This migration is intentionally schema-only: legacy option backfill is a
+-- separately invoked, resumable command after deployment verification.
+
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
+SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5min';
+
+CREATE TYPE "LinkedProductMode" AS ENUM ('ORIGINAL', 'CUSTOM');
+
+ALTER TABLE "Product"
+  ALTER COLUMN "basePrice" TYPE DECIMAL(24, 6)
+    USING "basePrice"::DECIMAL(24, 6),
+  ALTER COLUMN "basePrice" DROP NOT NULL,
+  ADD COLUMN "configurationTree" JSONB,
+  ADD COLUMN "configurationVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
+
+ALTER TABLE "Order"
+  ALTER COLUMN "totalAmount" TYPE DECIMAL(24, 6)
+    USING "totalAmount"::DECIMAL(24, 6);
+
+ALTER TABLE "OrderItem"
+  ALTER COLUMN "unitPrice" TYPE DECIMAL(24, 6)
+    USING "unitPrice"::DECIMAL(24, 6),
+  ALTER COLUMN "totalPrice" TYPE DECIMAL(24, 6)
+    USING "totalPrice"::DECIMAL(24, 6);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Product_restaurantId_id_key"
+  ON "Product"("restaurantId", "id");
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Product_restaurantId_id_configurationVersion_key"
+  ON "Product"("restaurantId", "id", "configurationVersion");
+
+ALTER TABLE "Product"
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_configurationVersion_nonnegative_check"
+    CHECK ("configurationVersion" >= 0) NOT VALID,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_basePrice_nonnegative_check"
+    CHECK ("basePrice" IS NULL OR "basePrice" >= 0) NOT VALID,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_legacy_state_check"
+    CHECK (
+      ("configurationTree" IS NULL AND "configurationVersion" = 0 AND "basePrice" IS NOT NULL)
+      OR
+      ("configurationTree" IS NOT NULL AND "configurationVersion" >= 1)
+    ) NOT VALID,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_shape_check"
+    CHECK (
+      "configurationTree" IS NULL
+      OR (
+        jsonb_typeof("configurationTree") = 'object'
+        AND "configurationTree" ?& ARRAY['schemaVersion', 'productId', 'revision', 'basePrice', 'groups']
+        AND "configurationTree" @> '{"schemaVersion":1}'::jsonb
+        AND "configurationTree" ->> 'productId' = "id"
+        AND "configurationTree" ->> 'revision' = "configurationVersion"::text
+        AND jsonb_typeof("configurationTree" -> 'groups') = 'array'
+      )
+    ) NOT VALID,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_basePrice_match_check"
+    CHECK (
+      "configurationTree" IS NULL
+      OR CASE
+        WHEN "configurationTree" -> 'basePrice' = 'null'::jsonb
+          THEN "basePrice" IS NULL
+        WHEN jsonb_typeof("configurationTree" -> 'basePrice') = 'string'
+          AND ("configurationTree" ->> 'basePrice') ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})(\.[0-9]{1,6})?$'
+          THEN "basePrice" = ("configurationTree" ->> 'basePrice')::DECIMAL(24, 6)
+        ELSE false
+      END
+    ) NOT VALID;
+
+CREATE TABLE "ProductConfigurationDependency" (
+  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
+  "restaurantId" TEXT NOT NULL,
+  "productId" TEXT NOT NULL,
+  "sourceProductId" TEXT NOT NULL,
+  "optionId" TEXT NOT NULL,
+  "path" TEXT NOT NULL,
+  "mode" "LinkedProductMode" NOT NULL,
+  "configurationVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL,
+  "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
+
+  CONSTRAINT "ProductConfigurationDependency_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
+  CONSTRAINT "ProductConfigurationDependency_not_self_check"
+    CHECK ("productId" <> "sourceProductId"),
+  CONSTRAINT "ProductConfigurationDependency_version_positive_check"
+    CHECK ("configurationVersion" >= 1),
+  CONSTRAINT "ProductConfigurationDependency_optionId_not_blank_check"
+    CHECK (length(trim("optionId")) > 0),
+  CONSTRAINT "ProductConfigurationDependency_path_not_blank_check"
+    CHECK (length(trim("path")) > 0),
+  CONSTRAINT "ProductConfigurationDependency_owner_fkey"
+    FOREIGN KEY ("restaurantId", "productId", "configurationVersion")
+    REFERENCES "Product"("restaurantId", "id", "configurationVersion")
+    ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
+  CONSTRAINT "ProductConfigurationDependency_source_fkey"
+    FOREIGN KEY ("restaurantId", "sourceProductId")
+    REFERENCES "Product"("restaurantId", "id")
+    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
+);
+
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ProductConfigDependency_product_path_key"
+  ON "ProductConfigurationDependency"("productId", "path");
+
+CREATE INDEX "ProductConfigDependency_restaurant_source_idx"
+  ON "ProductConfigurationDependency"("restaurantId", "sourceProductId");
+
+CREATE INDEX "ProductConfigDependency_product_version_idx"
+  ON "ProductConfigurationDependency"("productId", "configurationVersion");
+
+-- Existing products remain in the legacy state. Validation does not backfill
+-- or rewrite any restaurant data.
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_configurationVersion_nonnegative_check";
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_basePrice_nonnegative_check";
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_legacy_state_check";
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_shape_check";
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_basePrice_match_check";
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261013000000_network_order_test_snapshot/migration.sql b/apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261013000000_network_order_test_snapshot/migration.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..de2e26c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261013000000_network_order_test_snapshot/migration.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+-- Stage 6C is additive. The new status and source are test-only until a later activation decision.
+ALTER TYPE "OrderStatus" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'VALIDATED_TEST';
+
+ALTER TABLE "Order" ADD COLUMN "idempotencyKey" TEXT;
+ALTER TABLE "Order" ADD COLUMN "requestHash" TEXT;
+ALTER TABLE "Order" ADD COLUMN "acceptanceTokenHash" TEXT;
+ALTER TABLE "Order" ADD COLUMN "networkSnapshotSealedAt" TIMESTAMP(3);
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Order_restaurantId_idempotencyKey_key"
+  ON "Order"("restaurantId", "idempotencyKey");
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "Order_restaurantId_acceptanceTokenHash_key"
+  ON "Order"("restaurantId", "acceptanceTokenHash");
+
+ALTER TABLE "Order" ADD CONSTRAINT "Order_network_test_idempotency_check"
+  CHECK ("source" <> 'NETWORK_TEST' OR
+    ("idempotencyKey" IS NOT NULL AND "requestHash" IS NOT NULL AND "acceptanceTokenHash" IS NOT NULL));
+
+-- Freeze financial and descriptive evidence while allowing a future status transition.
+CREATE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_snapshot_update"() RETURNS trigger AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF OLD."source" = 'NETWORK_TEST' AND (
+    NEW."id" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."id" OR
+    NEW."restaurantId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."restaurantId" OR
+    NEW."branchId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."branchId" OR
+    NEW."customerName" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."customerName" OR
+    NEW."customerPhone" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."customerPhone" OR
+    NEW."totalAmount" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."totalAmount" OR
+    NEW."currency" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."currency" OR
+    NEW."cartSnapshot" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."cartSnapshot" OR
+    NEW."whatsappMessage" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."whatsappMessage" OR
+    NEW."createdAt" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."createdAt" OR
+    NEW."source" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."source" OR
+    NEW."idempotencyKey" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."idempotencyKey" OR
+    NEW."requestHash" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."requestHash"
+    OR NEW."acceptanceTokenHash" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."acceptanceTokenHash"
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NETWORK_TEST order snapshot is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  IF OLD."source" = 'NETWORK_TEST' AND NEW."networkSnapshotSealedAt" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."networkSnapshotSealedAt"
+    AND (OLD."networkSnapshotSealedAt" IS NOT NULL OR NEW."networkSnapshotSealedAt" IS NULL) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NETWORK_TEST snapshot seal cannot be changed' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER "Order_network_snapshot_immutable"
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON "Order" FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_snapshot_update"();
+
+CREATE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_delete"() RETURNS trigger AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF OLD."source" = 'NETWORK_TEST' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NETWORK_TEST order snapshot cannot be deleted' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN OLD;
+END;
+$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER "Order_network_snapshot_no_delete"
+  BEFORE DELETE ON "Order" FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_delete"();
+
+CREATE FUNCTION "require_network_order_snapshot_seal"() RETURNS trigger AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Order" WHERE "id" = NEW."id" AND "source" = 'NETWORK_TEST' AND "networkSnapshotSealedAt" IS NULL) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NETWORK_TEST order must be sealed before commit' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NULL;
+END;
+$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+
+CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER "Order_network_snapshot_seal_required"
+  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON "Order" DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION "require_network_order_snapshot_seal"();
+
+CREATE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_item_snapshot_update"() RETURNS trigger AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Order" WHERE "id" = OLD."orderId" AND "source" = 'NETWORK_TEST') AND (
+    NEW."id" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."id" OR
+    NEW."orderId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."orderId" OR
+    NEW."productId" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."productId" OR
+    NEW."name" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."name" OR
+    NEW."quantity" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."quantity" OR
+    NEW."unitPrice" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."unitPrice" OR
+    NEW."totalPrice" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."totalPrice" OR
+    NEW."options" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."options" OR
+    NEW."note" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."note"
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NETWORK_TEST order item snapshot is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER "OrderItem_network_snapshot_immutable"
+  BEFORE UPDATE ON "OrderItem" FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_item_snapshot_update"();
+
+CREATE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_item_structural_change"() RETURNS trigger AS $$
+BEGIN
+  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Order" WHERE "id" = NEW."orderId" AND "source" = 'NETWORK_TEST' AND "networkSnapshotSealedAt" IS NOT NULL) THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'NETWORK_TEST order item is sealed' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Order" WHERE "id" = OLD."orderId" AND "source" = 'NETWORK_TEST') THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'NETWORK_TEST order item cannot be deleted' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN OLD;
+END;
+$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER "OrderItem_network_snapshot_no_late_insert"
+  BEFORE INSERT ON "OrderItem" FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_item_structural_change"();
+CREATE TRIGGER "OrderItem_network_snapshot_no_delete"
+  BEFORE DELETE ON "OrderItem" FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION "prevent_network_order_item_structural_change"();

@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import {
+  convertLegacyProduct,
+  LegacyProduct
+} from "./product-configuration-backfill";
+
+function legacyProduct(overrides: Partial<LegacyProduct> = {}): LegacyProduct {
+  return {
+    id: "legacy-product",
+    restaurantId: "restaurant-1",
+    categoryId: null,
+    name: "Legacy product",
+    slug: "legacy-product",
+    description: null,
+    basePrice: new Prisma.Decimal("100.12"),
+    configurationTree: null,
+    configurationVersion: 0,
+    currency: "TEST",
+    isActive: true,
+    isAvailable: true,
+    isFeatured: false,
+    isNew: false,
+    isPopular: false,
+    moodKey: null,
+    ingredients: null,
+    nutrition: null,
+    sortOrder: 0,
+    deletedAt: null,
+    createdAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"),
+    updatedAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"),
+    options: [{
+      id: "group-1",
+      productId: "legacy-product",
+      name: "Add-ons",
+      type: "SINGLE",
+      required: true,
+      minSelect: null,
+      maxSelect: 1,
+      sortOrder: 0,
+      options: [{
+        id: "option-1",
+        groupId: "group-1",
+        name: "Cheese",
+        priceDelta: new Prisma.Decimal("10.25"),
+        isActive: true,
+        sortOrder: 0
+      }]
+    }],
+    ...overrides
+  };
+}
+
+describe("legacy product configuration conversion", () => {
+  it("creates a validated revision-one configuration without changing price semantics", () => {
+    const result = convertLegacyProduct(legacyProduct());
+    expect(result.status).toBe("ELIGIBLE");
+    if (result.status !== "ELIGIBLE") return;
+    expect(result.configuration.basePrice).toBe("100.120000");
+    expect(result.configuration.groups[0]).toMatchObject({
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      min: 1,
+      max: 1,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{ price: "10.250000", maxQuantity: 1 }]
+    });
+    expect(result.minimumPrice).toBe("110.37");
+  });
+
+  it("quarantines an ambiguous legacy SINGLE max", () => {
+    const product = legacyProduct();
+    product.options[0].maxSelect = 2;
+    const result = convertLegacyProduct(product);
+    expect(result).toEqual({
+      status: "QUARANTINE",
+      reasons: ["group-1: SINGLE maxSelect must be 1 or null"]
+    });
+  });
+
+  it("skips products without legacy option groups", () => {
+    expect(convertLegacyProduct(legacyProduct({ options: [] }))).toEqual({
+      status: "SKIP",
+      reason: "NO_LEGACY_GROUPS"
+    });
+  });
+});

+import {
+  calculateMinimumPrice,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  validateConfiguration
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import {
+  persistProductConfiguration,
+  ProductConfigurationConflictError
+} from "../src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence";
+
+export type LegacyProduct = Prisma.ProductGetPayload<{
+  include: { options: { include: { options: true } } };
+}>;
+
+export type BackfillQuarantineRecord = {
+  kind: "INVALID_LEGACY";
+  productId: string;
+  restaurantId: string;
+  reasons: string[];
+};
+
+export type BackfillConflictRecord = {
+  kind: "CONFLICT";
+  productId: string;
+  reason: string;
+};
+
+export type BackfillProgress = {
+  database: string;
+  mode: "DRY_RUN" | "EXECUTE";
+  lastCursor: string | null;
+  scanned: number;
+  eligible: number;
+  migrated: number;
+  quarantined: number;
+  conflicts: number;
+};
+
+export type BackfillOptions = {
+  batchSize: number;
+  resumeAfter?: string;
+  maxProducts?: number;
+  execute: boolean;
+  confirmDatabase?: string;
+  initialProgress?: BackfillProgress;
+  onQuarantine?: (record: BackfillQuarantineRecord) => Promise<void> | void;
+  onConflict?: (record: BackfillConflictRecord) => Promise<void> | void;
+  onBatchComplete?: (progress: BackfillProgress) => Promise<void> | void;
+};
+
+export type LegacyConversion =
+  | { status: "ELIGIBLE"; configuration: ProductConfigurationV1; minimumPrice: string | null }
+  | { status: "SKIP"; reason: string }
+  | { status: "QUARANTINE"; reasons: string[] };
+
+function money(value: Prisma.Decimal | null) {
+  return value === null ? null : value.toFixed(6);
+}
+
+export function convertLegacyProduct(product: LegacyProduct): LegacyConversion {
+  if (!product.options.length) return { status: "SKIP", reason: "NO_LEGACY_GROUPS" };
+
+  const reasons: string[] = [];
+  const basePrice = money(product.basePrice);
+  if (basePrice === null) reasons.push("Legacy product has null basePrice");
+
+  let nodeCount = 0;
+  const groups = product.options.map((group) => {
+    nodeCount += 1 + group.options.length;
+    const effectiveMin = Math.max(group.minSelect ?? 0, group.required ? 1 : 0);
+    const effectiveMax = group.type === "SINGLE" ? 1 : (group.maxSelect ?? 100);
+
+    if (!group.name.trim()) reasons.push(`${group.id}: blank group name`);
+    if (group.minSelect !== null && group.minSelect < 0) reasons.push(`${group.id}: negative minSelect`);
+    if (group.maxSelect !== null && group.maxSelect < 0) reasons.push(`${group.id}: negative maxSelect`);
+    if (effectiveMin > effectiveMax) reasons.push(`${group.id}: min exceeds effective max`);
+    if (group.type === "SINGLE" && group.maxSelect !== null && group.maxSelect !== 1) {
+      reasons.push(`${group.id}: SINGLE maxSelect must be 1 or null`);
+    }
+    if (group.options.length < 1 || group.options.length > 100) {
+      reasons.push(`${group.id}: option count must be between 1 and 100`);
+    }
+    if (effectiveMin > 0 && !group.options.some((option) => option.isActive)) {
+      reasons.push(`${group.id}: required group has no active option`);
+    }
+
+    return {
+      type: "OPTIONS" as const,
+      id: group.id,
+      label: group.name,
+      min: effectiveMin,
+      max: group.type === "SINGLE" ? 1 : group.maxSelect,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: group.options.map((option) => {
+        if (!option.name.trim()) reasons.push(`${option.id}: blank option name`);
+        if (option.priceDelta.isNegative()) reasons.push(`${option.id}: negative priceDelta`);
+        return {
+          id: option.id,
+          label: option.name,
+          price: option.priceDelta.toFixed(6),
+          maxQuantity: effectiveMax,
+          available: option.isActive
+        };
+      })
+    };
+  });
+
+  if (nodeCount > 1000) reasons.push("Product node count exceeds 1000");
+  if (reasons.length || basePrice === null) return { status: "QUARANTINE", reasons };
+
+  const configuration: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId: product.id,
+    revision: 1,
+    basePrice,
+    groups
+  };
+  const validationIssues = validateConfiguration(configuration);
+  if (validationIssues.length) {
+    return {
+      status: "QUARANTINE",
+      reasons: validationIssues.map((issue) => `${issue.path}: ${issue.code}`)
+    };
+  }
+
+  const minimum = calculateMinimumPrice(configuration, { catalogId: product.restaurantId });
+  if (!minimum.orderable) {
+    return {
+      status: "QUARANTINE",
+      reasons: minimum.issues.map((issue) => `${issue.path}: ${issue.code}`)
+    };
+  }
+  return { status: "ELIGIBLE", configuration, minimumPrice: minimum.minimum };
+}
+
+function validateOptions(options: BackfillOptions) {
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(options.batchSize) || options.batchSize < 1 || options.batchSize > 1000) {
+    throw new Error("batchSize must be an integer between 1 and 1000");
+  }
+  if (options.maxProducts !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(options.maxProducts) || options.maxProducts < 1)) {
+    throw new Error("maxProducts must be a positive integer");
+  }
+}
+
+export async function runProductConfigurationBackfill(
+  prisma: PrismaClient,
+  options: BackfillOptions
+): Promise<BackfillProgress> {
+  validateOptions(options);
+  const [identity] = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ database: string }>>`
+    SELECT current_database() AS database
+  `;
+  if (!identity?.database) throw new Error("Could not determine database identity");
+  if (options.execute && options.confirmDatabase !== identity.database) {
+    throw new Error(
+      `Write refused: --confirm-database must exactly equal '${identity.database}'`
+    );
+  }
+  if (options.initialProgress && options.initialProgress.database !== identity.database) {
+    throw new Error("Checkpoint database does not match the connected database");
+  }
+  const mode = options.execute ? "EXECUTE" : "DRY_RUN";
+  if (options.initialProgress && options.initialProgress.mode !== mode) {
+    throw new Error("Checkpoint mode does not match this run; use separate dry-run and execute checkpoints");
+  }
+
+  const progress: BackfillProgress = {
+    database: identity.database,
+    mode,
+    lastCursor: options.resumeAfter ?? options.initialProgress?.lastCursor ?? null,
+    scanned: options.initialProgress?.scanned ?? 0,
+    eligible: options.initialProgress?.eligible ?? 0,
+    migrated: options.initialProgress?.migrated ?? 0,
+    quarantined: options.initialProgress?.quarantined ?? 0,
+    conflicts: options.initialProgress?.conflicts ?? 0
+  };
+  let scannedThisRun = 0;
+
+  while (options.maxProducts === undefined || scannedThisRun < options.maxProducts) {
+    const remaining = options.maxProducts === undefined
+      ? options.batchSize
+      : Math.min(options.batchSize, options.maxProducts - scannedThisRun);
+    const cursor = progress.lastCursor ?? "";
+    const idRows = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ id: string }>>(Prisma.sql`
+      SELECT p."id"
+      FROM "Product" p
+      WHERE p."configurationTree" IS NULL
+        AND p."configurationVersion" = 0
+        AND p."deletedAt" IS NULL
+        AND p."id" > ${cursor}
+        AND EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1 FROM "ProductOptionGroup" g WHERE g."productId" = p."id"
+        )
+      ORDER BY p."id"
+      LIMIT ${remaining}
+    `);
+    if (!idRows.length) break;
+
+    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
+      where: { id: { in: idRows.map((row) => row.id) } },
+      include: {
+        options: {
+          orderBy: [{ sortOrder: "asc" }, { id: "asc" }],
+          include: { options: { orderBy: [{ sortOrder: "asc" }, { id: "asc" }] } }
+        }
+      }
+    });
+    const productsById = new Map(products.map((product) => [product.id, product]));
+
+    for (const row of idRows) {
+      progress.lastCursor = row.id;
+      progress.scanned += 1;
+      scannedThisRun += 1;
+      const product = productsById.get(row.id);
+      if (!product) {
+        progress.conflicts += 1;
+        await options.onConflict?.({
+          kind: "CONFLICT",
+          productId: row.id,
+          reason: "Product disappeared after the batch candidate query"
+        });
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const conversion = convertLegacyProduct(product);
+      if (conversion.status === "SKIP") continue;
+      if (conversion.status === "QUARANTINE") {
+        progress.quarantined += 1;
+        await options.onQuarantine?.({
+          kind: "INVALID_LEGACY",
+          productId: product.id,
+          restaurantId: product.restaurantId,
+          reasons: conversion.reasons
+        });
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      progress.eligible += 1;
+      if (!options.execute) continue;
+      try {
+        await persistProductConfiguration(prisma, {
+          restaurantId: product.restaurantId,
+          productId: product.id,
+          expectedVersion: 0,
+          configuration: conversion.configuration
+        });
+        progress.migrated += 1;
+      } catch (error) {
+        if (error instanceof ProductConfigurationConflictError) {
+          progress.conflicts += 1;
+          await options.onConflict?.({
+            kind: "CONFLICT",
+            productId: product.id,
+            reason: error.message
+          });
+          continue;
+        }
+        throw error;
+      }
+    }
+
+    await options.onBatchComplete?.({ ...progress });
+    if (idRows.length < remaining) break;
+  }
+
+  return progress;
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/prisma/product-configuration-guarded-rollback.sql b/apps/api/prisma/product-configuration-guarded-rollback.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..43c76d9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/prisma/product-configuration-guarded-rollback.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+-- MANUAL EMERGENCY ROLLBACK ONLY.
+-- Prefer application rollback plus a forward fix after configuration data exists.
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
+SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5min';
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Product" WHERE "configurationTree" IS NOT NULL) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rollback blocked: configurationTree contains data; export and review first';
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ProductConfigurationDependency") THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rollback blocked: dependency index contains data';
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Product" WHERE "basePrice" IS NULL) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rollback blocked: null basePrice cannot be restored to NOT NULL safely';
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM "Product"
+    WHERE "basePrice" > 99999999.99 OR "basePrice" <> round("basePrice", 2)
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rollback blocked: basePrice no longer fits DECIMAL(10,2)';
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM "Order"
+    WHERE "totalAmount" > 99999999.99 OR "totalAmount" <> round("totalAmount", 2)
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rollback blocked: Order.totalAmount no longer fits DECIMAL(10,2)';
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM "OrderItem"
+    WHERE "unitPrice" > 99999999.99
+       OR "unitPrice" <> round("unitPrice", 2)
+       OR "totalPrice" > 99999999.99
+       OR "totalPrice" <> round("totalPrice", 2)
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rollback blocked: OrderItem money no longer fits DECIMAL(10,2)';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+
+DROP TABLE "ProductConfigurationDependency";
+
+ALTER TABLE "Product"
+  DROP CONSTRAINT "Product_configurationVersion_nonnegative_check",
+  DROP CONSTRAINT "Product_basePrice_nonnegative_check",
+  DROP CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_legacy_state_check",
+  DROP CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_shape_check",
+  DROP CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_basePrice_match_check";
+
+DROP INDEX "Product_restaurantId_id_configurationVersion_key";
+DROP INDEX "Product_restaurantId_id_key";
+
+ALTER TABLE "Product"
+  DROP COLUMN "configurationTree",
+  DROP COLUMN "configurationVersion",
+  ALTER COLUMN "basePrice" TYPE DECIMAL(10, 2)
+    USING "basePrice"::DECIMAL(10, 2),
+  ALTER COLUMN "basePrice" SET NOT NULL;
+
+ALTER TABLE "Order"
+  ALTER COLUMN "totalAmount" TYPE DECIMAL(10, 2)
+    USING "totalAmount"::DECIMAL(10, 2);
+
+ALTER TABLE "OrderItem"
+  ALTER COLUMN "unitPrice" TYPE DECIMAL(10, 2)
+    USING "unitPrice"::DECIMAL(10, 2),
+  ALTER COLUMN "totalPrice" TYPE DECIMAL(10, 2)
+    USING "totalPrice"::DECIMAL(10, 2);
+
+DROP TYPE "LinkedProductMode";
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/apps/api/prisma/product-configuration-history-audit.sql b/apps/api/prisma/product-configuration-history-audit.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2db5a18
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/prisma/product-configuration-history-audit.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+-- READ ONLY. Run with psql only after separate approval for the target database.
+-- Do not pass credentials on the command line; use an approved secret provider.
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
+
+SELECT
+  current_database() AS database_name,
+  current_user AS database_user,
+  current_setting('server_version') AS postgres_version,
+  inet_server_addr()::text AS server_address,
+  inet_server_port() AS server_port,
+  pg_is_in_recovery() AS is_replica,
+  to_regclass('public."_prisma_migrations"') AS prisma_migrations_table,
+  to_regclass('public."Product"') AS product_table,
+  to_regclass('public."ProductOptionGroup"') AS legacy_group_table,
+  to_regclass('public."ProductOption"') AS legacy_option_table,
+  to_regclass('public."ProductConfigurationDependency"') AS dependency_table;
+
+SELECT (to_regclass('public."_prisma_migrations"') IS NOT NULL)::text AS has_history \gset
+
+\if :has_history
+  SELECT
+    "migration_name",
+    "checksum",
+    "started_at",
+    "finished_at",
+    "rolled_back_at",
+    "applied_steps_count",
+    left(COALESCE("logs", ''), 500) AS logs_preview
+  FROM "_prisma_migrations"
+  ORDER BY "started_at", "migration_name";
+
+  SELECT
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE "finished_at" IS NULL AND "rolled_back_at" IS NULL) AS unfinished,
+    count(*) FILTER (WHERE "rolled_back_at" IS NOT NULL) AS rolled_back,
+    count(*) AS total_history_rows
+  FROM "_prisma_migrations";
+\else
+  \echo '_prisma_migrations is absent; do not run migrate deploy until an explicit baseline plan is approved.'
+\endif
+
+SELECT
+  table_name,
+  column_name,
+  data_type,
+  udt_name,
+  is_nullable,
+  column_default,
+  numeric_precision,
+  numeric_scale
+FROM information_schema.columns
+WHERE table_schema = 'public'
+  AND table_name IN ('Product', 'Order', 'OrderItem', 'ProductOptionGroup', 'ProductOption')
+ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;
+
+SELECT
+  c.conrelid::regclass::text AS table_name,
+  c.conname AS constraint_name,
+  c.contype AS constraint_type,
+  c.convalidated,
+  pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition
+FROM pg_constraint c
+WHERE c.connamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
+  AND c.conrelid IN (
+    'public."Product"'::regclass,
+    'public."Order"'::regclass,
+    'public."OrderItem"'::regclass,
+    'public."ProductOptionGroup"'::regclass,
+    'public."ProductOption"'::regclass
+  )
+ORDER BY table_name, constraint_name;
+
+SELECT
+  schemaname,
+  tablename,
+  indexname,
+  indexdef
+FROM pg_indexes
+WHERE schemaname = 'public'
+  AND tablename IN ('Product', 'Order', 'OrderItem', 'ProductOptionGroup', 'ProductOption')
+ORDER BY tablename, indexname;
+
+SELECT
+  (SELECT count(*) FROM "Product") AS products,
+  (SELECT count(*) FROM "Product" WHERE "deletedAt" IS NULL) AS live_products,
+  (SELECT count(*) FROM "ProductOptionGroup") AS legacy_groups,
+  (SELECT count(*) FROM "ProductOption") AS legacy_options,
+  (SELECT count(DISTINCT "productId") FROM "ProductOptionGroup") AS products_with_legacy_groups;
+
+COMMIT;

diff --git a/apps/api/prisma/seed-stage5-public-demo.ts b/apps/api/prisma/seed-stage5-public-demo.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2cf926c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/prisma/seed-stage5-public-demo.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import { ABO_MALEK_THEME } from "@menu/shared";
+import { persistProductConfiguration } from "../src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence";
+import {
+  comboDemo,
+  includedQuantityDemo,
+  pizzaMargheritaDemo
+} from "../../web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/demos";
+
+const connection = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
+if (!connection || !process.env.DIRECT_URL || connection !== process.env.DIRECT_URL) {
+  throw new Error("Set matching DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL for a disposable Stage 5 database only.");
+}
+const target = new URL(connection);
+if (
+  !["127.0.0.1", "localhost"].includes(target.hostname)
+  || target.port !== "55440"
+  || !/^\/ordersawa_stage3_stage5_[a-z0-9_]+$/.test(target.pathname)
+) {
+  throw new Error("Stage 5 demo seed refuses non-disposable PostgreSQL targets.");
+}
+
+const restaurantId = "stage5-demo-restaurant";
+const restaurantSlug = "stage5-demo";
+const planId = "stage5-demo-plan";
+const categoryId = "stage5-demo-category";
+const pizzaId = "stage5-demo-pizza";
+const comboId = "stage5-demo-combo";
+const includedId = "stage5-demo-included";
+const legacyId = "stage5-demo-legacy";
+const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: connection });
+
+async function ensureProduct(id: string, slug: string, name: string, basePrice: string | null) {
+  const existing = await prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id } });
+  if (existing) {
+    if (existing.restaurantId !== restaurantId || existing.slug !== slug) {
+      throw new Error(`Demo fixture ID collision: ${id}`);
+    }
+    return existing;
+  }
+  return prisma.product.create({
+    data: { id, restaurantId, categoryId, name, slug, basePrice, currency: "ل.س" }
+  });
+}
+
+async function ensureConfiguration(id: string, configuration: ReturnType<typeof pizzaMargheritaDemo>) {
+  const product = await prisma.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
+  if (product.configurationVersion > 0) return;
+  await persistProductConfiguration(prisma, {
+    restaurantId,
+    productId: id,
+    expectedVersion: 0,
+    configuration,
+    requiredCapabilityKey: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION"
+  });
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  await prisma.$connect();
+  const existingRestaurant = await prisma.restaurant.findUnique({ where: { id: restaurantId } });
+  if (existingRestaurant && existingRestaurant.slug !== restaurantSlug) {
+    throw new Error("Demo restaurant ID collision");
+  }
+  if (!existingRestaurant) {
+    await prisma.restaurant.create({ data: {
+      id: restaurantId, slug: restaurantSlug, name: "Stage 5 Demo", currency: "ل.س",
+      whatsappPhone: "0000000000"
+    } });
+  }
+  if (!(await prisma.restaurantThemeSettings.findUnique({ where: { restaurantId } }))) {
+    await prisma.restaurantThemeSettings.create({ data: {
+      id: "stage5-demo-theme", restaurantId,
+      settings: ABO_MALEK_THEME as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue
+    } });
+  }
+
+  const existingPlan = await prisma.subscriptionPlan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } });
+  if (existingPlan && existingPlan.key !== "STAGE5_DEMO_ONLY") throw new Error("Demo plan ID collision");
+  if (!existingPlan) {
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.create({ data: {
+      id: planId, key: "STAGE5_DEMO_ONLY", name: "Stage 5 disposable fixture"
+    } });
+  }
+  await prisma.subscriptionFeature.upsert({
+    where: { planId_key: { planId, key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION" } },
+    create: { id: "stage5-demo-capability", planId, key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true },
+    update: { enabled: true }
+  });
+  await prisma.restaurantSubscription.upsert({
+    where: { restaurantId },
+    create: {
+      id: "stage5-demo-subscription", restaurantId, planId,
+      status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z")
+    },
+    update: { planId, status: "ACTIVE" }
+  });
+  const existingCategory = await prisma.category.findUnique({ where: { id: categoryId } });
+  if (existingCategory && existingCategory.restaurantId !== restaurantId) throw new Error("Demo category ID collision");
+  if (!existingCategory) {
+    await prisma.category.create({ data: {
+      id: categoryId, restaurantId, slug: "stage5-examples", name: "أمثلة شبكة الأصناف"
+    } });
+  }
+
+  await ensureProduct(pizzaId, "pizza-margherita-demo", "Pizza Margherita — DEMO", null);
+  await ensureProduct(comboId, "combo-demo", "Combo ORIGINAL / CUSTOM — DEMO", "0");
+  await ensureProduct(includedId, "included-quantity-demo", "Included Quantity — DEMO", "100");
+  await ensureProduct(legacyId, "legacy-custom-source-demo", "Legacy CUSTOM Source — DEMO", "20");
+
+  const pizza = pizzaMargheritaDemo(pizzaId, 1);
+  await ensureConfiguration(pizzaId, pizza);
+  await ensureConfiguration(includedId, includedQuantityDemo(includedId, 1));
+  const demoCapability = { key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION" as const, assigned: true, canRead: true, canWrite: true };
+  const combo = comboDemo(comboId, 1, {
+    product: { id: pizzaId, name: "Pizza Margherita — DEMO", basePrice: null, currency: "ل.س", isAvailable: true, configurationMode: "NETWORK", configurationVersion: 1 },
+    envelope: { productId: pizzaId, mode: "NETWORK", configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: pizza, basePrice: null, isAvailable: true, capability: demoCapability, orderabilityState: "PUBLIC_INTEGRATION_PENDING" }
+  }, {
+    product: { id: legacyId, name: "Legacy CUSTOM Source — DEMO", basePrice: 20, currency: "ل.س", isAvailable: true, configurationMode: "LEGACY", configurationVersion: 0 },
+    envelope: { productId: legacyId, mode: "LEGACY", configurationVersion: 0, configurationTree: null, basePrice: "20", isAvailable: true, capability: demoCapability, orderabilityState: "LEGACY" }
+  });
+  await ensureConfiguration(comboId, combo);
+
+  process.stdout.write(`Stage 5 disposable demo ready: http://localhost:3000/m/${restaurantSlug}/menu\n`);
+}
+
+void main().catch((error: unknown) => {
+  process.stderr.write(`${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}\n`);
+  process.exitCode = 1;
+}).finally(async () => {
+  await prisma.$disconnect();
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/prisma/seed-stage6d2b-network-order-demo.ts b/apps/api/prisma/seed-stage6d2b-network-order-demo.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..64adfbd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/prisma/seed-stage6d2b-network-order-demo.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import { ABO_MALEK_THEME } from "@menu/shared";
+import { persistProductConfiguration } from "../src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence";
+import { pizzaMargheritaDemo, comboDemo } from "../../web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/demos";
+
+const connection = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
+if (!connection || connection !== process.env.DIRECT_URL) throw new Error("Matching disposable DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL are required.");
+const target = new URL(connection);
+if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" || process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS !== "1"
+  || target.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || target.port !== "55440"
+  || !/^\/ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d(?:2b|3a)_[a-z0-9_]+$/.test(target.pathname)) {
+  throw new Error("Stage 6D.2B seed refuses any non-disposable target.");
+}
+
+const db = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: connection });
+const restaurantId = "s6d2b-demo-restaurant";
+const slug = "s6d2b-demo";
+const pizzaId = "s6d2b-pizza";
+const comboId = "s6d2b-combo";
+const legacyId = "s6d2b-legacy";
+const planId = "s6d2b-plan";
+
+async function main() {
+  await db.$connect();
+  const existing = await db.restaurant.findUnique({ where: { id: restaurantId } });
+  if (existing && existing.slug !== slug) throw new Error("Demo restaurant ID collision");
+  if (!existing) await db.restaurant.create({ data: {
+    id: restaurantId, slug, name: "OrderSawa Local Demo", currency: "EGP", whatsappPhone: "0000000000"
+  } });
+  await db.restaurantThemeSettings.upsert({ where: { restaurantId },
+    create: { id: "s6d2b-theme", restaurantId, settings: ABO_MALEK_THEME as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue },
+    update: {} });
+  await db.subscriptionPlan.upsert({ where: { key: "S6D2B_DISPOSABLE_ONLY" },
+    create: { id: planId, key: "S6D2B_DISPOSABLE_ONLY", name: "Isolated test plan" }, update: {} });
+  for (const key of ["PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", "CART_ORDERING", "WHATSAPP_ORDERING"] as const) {
+    await db.subscriptionFeature.upsert({ where: { planId_key: { planId, key } },
+      create: { id: `s6d2b-${key}`, planId, key, enabled: true }, update: { enabled: true } });
+  }
+  await db.restaurantSubscription.upsert({ where: { restaurantId },
+    create: { id: "s6d2b-sub", restaurantId, planId, status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2020-01-01T00:00:00Z") },
+    update: { planId, status: "ACTIVE" } });
+  await db.category.upsert({ where: { id: "s6d2b-category" },
+    create: { id: "s6d2b-category", restaurantId, slug: "demo", name: "Demo Menu" }, update: {} });
+  if (!await db.category.findFirst({ where: { restaurantId, slug: "all", deletedAt: null } })) {
+    await db.category.create({ data: { id: "s6d2b-all-category", restaurantId, slug: "all", name: "الكل", sortOrder: 0 } });
+  }
+  const products = [
+    { id: pizzaId, slug: "pizza", name: "Pizza Margherita", basePrice: null },
+    { id: comboId, slug: "combo", name: "Family Combo", basePrice: "0" },
+    { id: legacyId, slug: "legacy", name: "Legacy Demo", basePrice: "20" }
+  ];
+  for (const product of products) {
+    const found = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { id: product.id } });
+    if (found && (found.restaurantId !== restaurantId || found.slug !== product.slug)) throw new Error("Demo Product ID collision");
+    if (!found) await db.product.create({ data: { ...product, restaurantId, categoryId: "s6d2b-category", currency: "EGP" } });
+  }
+  const pizza = pizzaMargheritaDemo(pizzaId, 1);
+  const capability = { key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION" as const, assigned: true, canRead: true, canWrite: true };
+  const combo = comboDemo(comboId, 1, {
+    product: { id: pizzaId, name: "Pizza Margherita", basePrice: null, currency: "EGP", isAvailable: true, configurationMode: "NETWORK", configurationVersion: 1 },
+    envelope: { productId: pizzaId, mode: "NETWORK", configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: pizza, basePrice: null,
+      isAvailable: true, capability, orderabilityState: "PUBLIC_INTEGRATION_PENDING" }
+  }, {
+    product: { id: legacyId, name: "Legacy Demo", basePrice: 20, currency: "EGP", isAvailable: true, configurationMode: "LEGACY", configurationVersion: 0 },
+    envelope: { productId: legacyId, mode: "LEGACY", configurationVersion: 0, configurationTree: null, basePrice: "20",
+      isAvailable: true, capability, orderabilityState: "LEGACY" }
+  });
+  for (const [id, tree] of [[pizzaId, pizza], [comboId, combo]] as const) {
+    if ((await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } })).configurationVersion === 0) {
+      await persistProductConfiguration(db, { restaurantId, productId: id, expectedVersion: 0,
+        configuration: tree, requiredCapabilityKey: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION" });
+    }
+  }
+  process.stdout.write(`Disposable demo ready: http://localhost:3000/m/${slug}/menu\n`);
+}
+
+void main().catch((error: unknown) => { process.stderr.write(`${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}\n`); process.exitCode = 1; })
+  .finally(async () => db.$disconnect());
diff --git a/apps/api/prisma/stage6f0-readonly-preflight.sql b/apps/api/prisma/stage6f0-readonly-preflight.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5d9f831
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/prisma/stage6f0-readonly-preflight.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+-- Stage 6F.0: review-only PostgreSQL schema/history inventory.
+-- NEVER run against an existing/Production database without separate explicit approval.
+-- Use an approved read-only role/secret provider; do not put connection details in Git.
+-- No customer, order, product, phone, credential, or migration-log rows are selected.
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+\pset pager off
+
+BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
+SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s';
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '2s';
+
+-- Database identity and engine version; no host address or credential value.
+SELECT current_database() AS database_name,
+       current_setting('server_version') AS postgresql_version,
+       current_setting('server_version_num') AS postgresql_version_num,
+       pg_is_in_recovery() AS is_replica;
+
+-- Table presence. This is metadata only, not a table-data scan.
+SELECT required.table_name,
+       to_regclass(format('public.%I', required.table_name)) IS NOT NULL AS exists_in_public
+FROM (VALUES
+  ('Restaurant'), ('Branch'), ('Category'), ('Product'),
+  ('ProductOptionGroup'), ('ProductOption'), ('ProductConfigurationDependency'),
+  ('SubscriptionPlan'), ('RestaurantSubscription'), ('SubscriptionFeature'),
+  ('RestaurantThemeSettings'), ('Order'), ('OrderItem'), ('AnalyticsEvent'),
+  ('_prisma_migrations')
+) AS required(table_name)
+ORDER BY required.table_name;
+
+-- Exact formatted type (including decimal precision/scale), nullability and
+-- default presence. pg_catalog avoids information_schema privilege filtering.
+SELECT t.relname AS table_name, a.attnum AS ordinal_position,
+       a.attname AS column_name, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS data_type,
+       a.attnotnull AS not_null, a.atthasdef AS has_default,
+       a.attidentity AS identity_kind, a.attgenerated AS generated_kind
+FROM pg_attribute AS a
+JOIN pg_class AS t ON t.oid = a.attrelid
+JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
+WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
+  AND t.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND t.relname IN (
+    'Restaurant', 'Branch', 'Category', 'Product', 'ProductOptionGroup',
+    'ProductOption', 'ProductConfigurationDependency', 'SubscriptionPlan',
+    'RestaurantSubscription', 'SubscriptionFeature', 'RestaurantThemeSettings',
+    'Order', 'OrderItem', 'AnalyticsEvent'
+  )
+ORDER BY t.relname, a.attnum;
+
+-- Constraints: definition is schema text, not row data. convalidated matters for Stage 2C.
+SELECT t.relname AS table_name, c.conname AS constraint_name,
+       c.contype AS constraint_type, c.convalidated AS validated,
+       c.condeferrable AS deferrable, c.condeferred AS initially_deferred,
+       pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition
+FROM pg_constraint AS c
+JOIN pg_class AS t ON t.oid = c.conrelid
+JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
+WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+  AND t.relname IN ('Product', 'ProductConfigurationDependency', 'Order', 'OrderItem')
+ORDER BY t.relname, c.conname;
+
+-- Index uniqueness, validity and key definitions for the affected tables.
+SELECT t.relname AS table_name, i.relname AS index_name,
+       x.indisunique AS is_unique, x.indisvalid AS is_valid,
+       pg_get_indexdef(i.oid) AS definition
+FROM pg_index AS x
+JOIN pg_class AS t ON t.oid = x.indrelid
+JOIN pg_class AS i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid
+JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
+WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+  AND t.relname IN ('Product', 'ProductConfigurationDependency', 'Order', 'OrderItem')
+ORDER BY t.relname, i.relname;
+
+-- Required enum labels. No table rows are read.
+SELECT ty.typname AS enum_name, e.enumsortorder, e.enumlabel
+FROM pg_type AS ty
+JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = ty.typnamespace
+JOIN pg_enum AS e ON e.enumtypid = ty.oid
+WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+  AND ty.typname IN ('LinkedProductMode', 'OrderStatus')
+ORDER BY ty.typname, e.enumsortorder;
+
+-- Trigger identity/status only. SQL function bodies are deliberately not exported.
+SELECT t.relname AS table_name, g.tgname AS trigger_name,
+       g.tgenabled AS enabled_mode, g.tgdeferrable AS deferrable,
+       g.tginitdeferred AS initially_deferred, p.proname AS function_name
+FROM pg_trigger AS g
+JOIN pg_class AS t ON t.oid = g.tgrelid
+JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace
+JOIN pg_proc AS p ON p.oid = g.tgfoid
+WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT g.tgisinternal
+  AND t.relname IN ('Product', 'ProductConfigurationDependency', 'Order', 'OrderItem')
+ORDER BY t.relname, g.tgname;
+
+-- Prisma history is queried only if present. Never expose its logs column.
+SELECT (to_regclass('public."_prisma_migrations"') IS NOT NULL)::text AS has_history \gset
+\if :has_history
+  SELECT migration_name, checksum, started_at, finished_at, rolled_back_at,
+         applied_steps_count
+  FROM public."_prisma_migrations"
+  ORDER BY started_at, migration_name;
+\else
+  \echo '_prisma_migrations absent: stop; do not run migrate deploy or invent a baseline.'
+\endif
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/apps/api/prisma/stage6f4-readonly-data-prechecks.sql b/apps/api/prisma/stage6f4-readonly-data-prechecks.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5cc159c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/prisma/stage6f4-readonly-data-prechecks.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+-- REVIEW ONLY. Never run on Production without explicit, separate read-only approval.
+-- Aggregate counts only: no names, individual prices, customer fields, credentials or migration logs.
+-- Designed for the documented PRE-Stage-2C Restaurant schema; STOP if columns differ.
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+\pset pager off
+BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
+SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '30s';
+SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '2s';
+
+-- Exact numeric typmods omitted by the supplied schema.json-derived report.
+SELECT c.relname AS table_name, a.attname AS column_name,
+       format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS exact_type, a.attnotnull AS not_null
+FROM pg_attribute a
+JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid
+JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
+  AND (c.relname, a.attname) IN (
+    ('Product','basePrice'), ('ProductOption','priceDelta'),
+    ('Order','totalAmount'), ('OrderItem','unitPrice'), ('OrderItem','totalPrice'))
+ORDER BY c.relname, a.attname;
+
+SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "Restaurant") AS restaurants,
+       (SELECT count(*) FROM "Category") AS categories,
+       (SELECT count(*) FROM "Product") AS products,
+       (SELECT count(*) FROM "ProductOptionGroup") AS option_groups,
+       (SELECT count(*) FROM "ProductOption") AS options,
+       (SELECT count(*) FROM "Order") AS orders,
+       (SELECT count(*) FROM "OrderItem") AS order_items,
+       (SELECT count(*) FROM "AnalyticsEvent") AS analytics_events;
+
+-- A DECIMAL(24,6) cast may silently round values with more than six meaningful
+-- places; values rounding to >=10^18 cannot fit. No individual values are shown.
+SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "basePrice" < 0) AS negative_base,
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE "basePrice" <> round("basePrice", 6)) AS base_over_six_places,
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(round("basePrice", 6)) >= 1000000000000000000::numeric) AS base_overflow,
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE "currency" IN ('SYP','ل.س')
+                           AND "basePrice" <> trunc("basePrice")) AS fractional_syp_base
+FROM "Product";
+
+SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "totalAmount" < 0) AS negative_order_total,
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE "totalAmount" <> round("totalAmount", 6)) AS order_over_six_places,
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(round("totalAmount", 6)) >= 1000000000000000000::numeric) AS order_overflow,
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE "currency" IN ('SYP','ل.س')
+                           AND "totalAmount" <> trunc("totalAmount")) AS fractional_syp_order
+FROM "Order";
+
+SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "unitPrice" <> round("unitPrice", 6)
+                         OR "totalPrice" <> round("totalPrice", 6)) AS item_over_six_places,
+       count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(round("unitPrice", 6)) >= 1000000000000000000::numeric
+                         OR abs(round("totalPrice", 6)) >= 1000000000000000000::numeric) AS item_overflow
+FROM "OrderItem";
+
+-- Legacy option prices are not converted by Stage 2C but fractional SYP values
+-- can still make a historical product unorderable under the approved policy.
+SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE p."currency" IN ('SYP','ل.س')
+                           AND o."priceDelta" <> trunc(o."priceDelta")) AS fractional_syp_legacy_options
+FROM "ProductOption" o
+JOIN "ProductOptionGroup" g ON g.id = o."groupId"
+JOIN "Product" p ON p.id = g."productId";
+
+COMMIT;

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import { ForbiddenException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import { FeatureFlagsService } from "./feature-flags.service";
+
+describe("FeatureFlagsService assigned package capabilities", () => {
+  it("separates assigned entitlement from billing-cycle status", async () => {
+    const prisma = {
+      restaurantSubscription: {
+        findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
+          status: "CANCELED",
+          plan: { features: [{ key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true, limit: null }] }
+        })
+      }
+    };
+    const service = new FeatureFlagsService(prisma as any);
+
+    await expect(service.canUseAssignedFeature("restaurant-1", "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION")).resolves.toBe(true);
+    await expect(service.canUseFeature("restaurant-1", "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION")).resolves.toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it("denies writes when the capability is not assigned", async () => {
+    const prisma = {
+      restaurantSubscription: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null) }
+    };
+    const service = new FeatureFlagsService(prisma as any);
+
+    await expect(service.assertAssignedFeature("restaurant-1", "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION"))
+      .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ForbiddenException);
+  });
+});
