+  /**
+   * Product Configuration is an assigned package capability, not a billing-cycle switch.
+   * The current schema stores the assigned plan on RestaurantSubscription, so this lookup
+   * intentionally ignores subscription status while still requiring an enabled plan feature.
+   */
+  async canUseAssignedFeature(restaurantId: string, key: FeatureKey): Promise<boolean> {
+    const feature = await this.getAssignedFeature(restaurantId, key);
+    return Boolean(feature?.enabled);
+  }
+
+  async assertAssignedFeature(restaurantId: string, key: FeatureKey): Promise<void> {
+    if (!(await this.canUseAssignedFeature(restaurantId, key))) {
+      throw new ForbiddenException({
+        statusCode: 403,
+        error: "FEATURE_LOCKED",
+        message: "This capability is not assigned to the current restaurant package",
+        featureKey: key
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
   async listFeatures(restaurantId: string) {
     const subscription = await this.prisma.restaurantSubscription.findUnique({
       where: { restaurantId },
@@ -74,4 +95,21 @@ export class FeatureFlagsService {
 
     return subscription.plan.features[0] ?? null;
   }
+
+  private async getAssignedFeature(restaurantId: string, key: FeatureKey) {
+    const subscription = await this.prisma.restaurantSubscription.findUnique({
+      where: { restaurantId },
+      include: {
+        plan: {
+          include: {
+            features: {
+              where: { key }
+            }
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    });
+
+    return subscription?.plan.features[0] ?? null;
+  }
 }
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-contract.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-contract.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..485958a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-contract.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { issueAcceptanceToken, parseNetworkOrderRequest, sha256, verifyAcceptanceToken } from "./network-order-contract";
+import { NetworkOrdersService } from "./network-orders.service";
+import { NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard } from "./network-orders.controller";
+
+const selection = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "pizza", configurationRevision: 1,
+  groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" }] };
+const draft = { locale: "ar", items: [{ productId: "pizza", quantity: 2, selection }] };
+
+describe("Stage 6C test-only order contract", () => {
+  it("canonicalizes optional Legacy-compatible details and independent item notes", () => {
+    const parsed = parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, customerName: "  Demo customer  ",
+      customerPhone: "0000000000", fulfillmentType: "delivery", deliveryArea: "District",
+      deliveryNear: "Park", deliveryBeside: "Gate", orderNote: "Pack separately",
+      items: [{ ...draft.items[0], note: "  No onion  " }] }, false);
+    expect(parsed.customerName).toBe("Demo customer");
+    expect(parsed.items[0].note).toBe("No onion");
+    expect(parsed.deliveryArea).toBe("District");
+  });
+
+  it("matches current pickup and delivery field rules and rejects unsafe details", () => {
+    expect(parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, fulfillmentType: "pickup", pickupTime: "6 PM" }, false).pickupTime).toBe("6 PM");
+    expect(parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, fulfillmentType: "delivery", deliveryArea: "District", deliveryNear: "Park" }, false).deliveryBeside).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, fulfillmentType: "delivery", deliveryArea: "District" }, false)).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, fulfillmentType: "pickup", deliveryArea: "District" }, false)).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, pickupTime: "6 PM" }, false)).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, customerName: "A\nForged line" }, false)).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, customerPhone: 123 }, false)).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, items: [{ ...draft.items[0], note: "A".repeat(501) }] }, false)).toThrow();
+  });
+  it("accepts selections and quantities, but rejects client prices at every depth", () => {
+    expect(parseNetworkOrderRequest(draft, false)).toMatchObject(draft);
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, totalAmount: "1" }, false)).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, items: [{ ...draft.items[0], unitPrice: "1" }] }, false)).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, items: [{ ...draft.items[0], selection: { ...selection, trustedTotal: "1" } }] }, false)).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseNetworkOrderRequest({ ...draft, items: [{ ...draft.items[0], quantity: 101 }] }, false)).toThrow();
+  });
+
+  it("binds acceptance to the restaurant, exact draft, and expiry", () => {
+    const digest = sha256(draft);
+    const token = issueAcceptanceToken("restaurant-a", digest, 1_000);
+    expect(verifyAcceptanceToken(token, "restaurant-a", digest, 2_000)).toBe(true);
+    expect(verifyAcceptanceToken(token, "restaurant-b", digest, 2_000)).toBe(false);
+    expect(verifyAcceptanceToken(token, "restaurant-a", sha256({ ...draft, total: "2" }), 2_000)).toBe(false);
+    expect(verifyAcceptanceToken(token, "restaurant-a", digest, 602_000)).toBe(false);
+    expect(verifyAcceptanceToken(`${token}x`, "restaurant-a", digest, 2_000)).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it("canonicalizes object keys for an idempotent payload digest", () => {
+    expect(sha256({ a: 1, b: { x: 2, y: 3 } })).toBe(sha256({ b: { y: 3, x: 2 }, a: 1 }));
+  });
+
+  it("rejects production mode, non-disposable databases and non-loopback HTTP clients", async () => {
+    const oldNodeEnv = process.env.NODE_ENV;
+    const oldFlag = process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS;
+    const service = new NetworkOrdersService({
+      $queryRaw: async () => [{ name: "production", address: "127.0.0.1", port: 55440 }]
+    } as any);
+    try {
+      process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS = "1";
+      process.env.NODE_ENV = "production";
+      await expect(service.prepare("r", draft)).rejects.toThrow();
+      process.env.NODE_ENV = "test";
+      await expect(service.prepare("r", draft)).rejects.toThrow();
+      const guard = new NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard();
+      expect(() => guard.canActivate({ switchToHttp: () => ({ getRequest: () => ({ socket: { remoteAddress: "198.51.100.8" } }) }) } as any)).toThrow();
+    } finally {
+      if (oldFlag === undefined) delete process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS;
+      else process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS = oldFlag;
+      if (oldNodeEnv === undefined) delete process.env.NODE_ENV;
+      else process.env.NODE_ENV = oldNodeEnv;
+    }
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-contract.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-contract.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a68f5c2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-contract.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,163 @@
+import { createHash, createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
+import { BadRequestException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { parsePublicQuoteSelection } from "../public-menu/public-product-quote";
+import type { ProductSelectionV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+
+export type NetworkOrderLineRequest = {
+  productId: string;
+  quantity: number;
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1;
+  note?: string;
+};
+
+/** Optional Legacy-compatible fields; delivery address parts follow the existing public Checkout UI rule. */
+export type NetworkOrderDetails = {
+  customerName?: string;
+  customerPhone?: string;
+  fulfillmentType?: "pickup" | "delivery";
+  deliveryArea?: string;
+  deliveryNear?: string;
+  deliveryBeside?: string;
+  pickupTime?: string;
+  orderNote?: string;
+};
+
+/** Historical display details sealed alongside the Stage 6C order snapshot. */
+export type NetworkOrderSnapshotDetails = NetworkOrderDetails & { restaurantName: string };
+
+export type NetworkOrderDraftRequest = {
+  locale: "ar" | "en";
+  items: NetworkOrderLineRequest[];
+} & NetworkOrderDetails;
+
+export type NetworkOrderCreateRequest = NetworkOrderDraftRequest & {
+  idempotencyKey: string;
+  acceptanceToken: string;
+};
+
+const signingKey = randomBytes(32);
+const ID_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/;
+const IDEMPOTENCY_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$/;
+
+function object(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
+}
+
+function fail(code: string, message: string): never {
+  throw new BadRequestException({ error: code, message, issues: [{ code, path: "$request", message }] });
+}
+
+function optionalText(value: unknown, field: string, maxLength: number): string | undefined {
+  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") return undefined;
+  if (typeof value !== "string") fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_DETAILS", `${field} must be text.`);
+  const trimmed = value.trim();
+  if (!trimmed) return undefined;
+  if (trimmed.length > maxLength || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/u.test(trimmed)) {
+    fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_DETAILS", `${field} contains unsafe text or exceeds its safety limit.`);
+  }
+  return trimmed;
+}
+
+function parseDetails(body: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkOrderDetails {
+  const details: NetworkOrderDetails = {};
+  const fields = [
+    ["customerName", 120], ["customerPhone", 40], ["deliveryArea", 160],
+    ["deliveryNear", 160], ["deliveryBeside", 160], ["pickupTime", 80], ["orderNote", 500]
+  ] as const;
+  for (const [field, limit] of fields) {
+    const value = optionalText(body[field], field, limit);
+    if (value !== undefined) details[field] = value;
+  }
+  if (body.fulfillmentType !== undefined && body.fulfillmentType !== null) {
+    if (body.fulfillmentType !== "pickup" && body.fulfillmentType !== "delivery") {
+      fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_DETAILS", "fulfillmentType must be pickup or delivery.");
+    }
+    details.fulfillmentType = body.fulfillmentType;
+  }
+  if (details.fulfillmentType === "delivery") {
+    if (!details.deliveryArea || !details.deliveryNear || details.pickupTime) {
+      fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_DETAILS", "Delivery requires area and near; pickupTime is not applicable.");
+    }
+  } else if (details.deliveryArea || details.deliveryNear || details.deliveryBeside
+    || (details.pickupTime && details.fulfillmentType !== "pickup")) {
+    fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_DETAILS", "Address requires delivery; pickupTime requires pickup.");
+  }
+  return details;
+}
+
+export function parseNetworkOrderDetails(body: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkOrderDetails {
+  return parseDetails(body);
+}
+
+export function parseNetworkOrderRequest(body: unknown, create: false): NetworkOrderDraftRequest;
+export function parseNetworkOrderRequest(body: unknown, create: true): NetworkOrderCreateRequest;
+export function parseNetworkOrderRequest(body: unknown, create: boolean): NetworkOrderDraftRequest | NetworkOrderCreateRequest {
+  if (!object(body)) fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_REQUEST", "Expected an object.");
+  const detailFields = ["customerName", "customerPhone", "fulfillmentType", "deliveryArea", "deliveryNear", "deliveryBeside", "pickupTime", "orderNote"];
+  const allowed = create ? ["locale", "items", ...detailFields, "idempotencyKey", "acceptanceToken"] : ["locale", "items", ...detailFields];
+  if (Object.keys(body).some((key) => !allowed.includes(key))) {
+    fail("UNEXPECTED_NETWORK_ORDER_FIELD", "Client totals, prices, or unknown fields are not accepted.");
+  }
+  if ((body.locale !== "ar" && body.locale !== "en") || !Array.isArray(body.items)
+    || body.items.length < 1 || body.items.length > 50) {
+    fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_REQUEST", "Expected locale and 1–50 order lines.");
+  }
+  let units = 0;
+  const items = body.items.map((raw, index): NetworkOrderLineRequest => {
+    if (!object(raw) || Object.keys(raw).some((key) => !["productId", "quantity", "selection", "note"].includes(key))
+      || typeof raw.productId !== "string" || !ID_PATTERN.test(raw.productId)
+      || !Number.isSafeInteger(raw.quantity) || Number(raw.quantity) < 1 || Number(raw.quantity) > 100) {
+      fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_LINE", `Invalid order line ${index}.`);
+    }
+    units += Number(raw.quantity);
+    const parsed = parsePublicQuoteSelection(raw.selection);
+    if (!parsed.selection || parsed.selection.productId !== raw.productId) {
+      throw new BadRequestException({ error: "INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_SELECTION", message: "Invalid or mismatched selection.", issues: parsed.issues });
+    }
+    const note = optionalText(raw.note, `items[${index}].note`, 500);
+    return { productId: raw.productId, quantity: raw.quantity as number, selection: parsed.selection,
+      ...(note === undefined ? {} : { note }) };
+  });
+  if (units > 100) fail("NETWORK_ORDER_UNIT_LIMIT", "Order unit safety limit exceeded.");
+  const draft: NetworkOrderDraftRequest = { locale: body.locale as "ar" | "en", items, ...parseDetails(body) };
+  if (!create) return draft;
+  if (typeof body.idempotencyKey !== "string" || !IDEMPOTENCY_PATTERN.test(body.idempotencyKey)
+    || typeof body.acceptanceToken !== "string" || body.acceptanceToken.length > 4096) {
+    fail("INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_ACCEPTANCE", "Idempotency key and acceptance token are required.");
+  }
+  return { ...draft, idempotencyKey: body.idempotencyKey as string, acceptanceToken: body.acceptanceToken as string };
+}
+
+export function stableJson(value: unknown): string {
+  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(stableJson).join(",")}]`;
+  if (object(value)) return `{${Object.keys(value).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${stableJson(value[key])}`).join(",")}}`;
+  return JSON.stringify(value);
+}
+
+export function sha256(value: unknown): string {
+  return createHash("sha256").update(stableJson(value)).digest("hex");
+}
+
+type AcceptancePayload = { v: 1; restaurantId: string; digest: string; expiresAt: number };
+
+export function issueAcceptanceToken(restaurantId: string, digest: string, now = Date.now()): string {
+  const payload: AcceptancePayload = { v: 1, restaurantId, digest, expiresAt: now + 10 * 60_000 };
+  const encoded = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)).toString("base64url");
+  const signature = createHmac("sha256", signingKey).update(`v1.${encoded}`).digest("base64url");
+  return `v1.${encoded}.${signature}`;
+}
+
+export function verifyAcceptanceToken(token: string, restaurantId: string, digest: string, now = Date.now()): boolean {
+  const parts = token.split(".");
+  if (parts.length !== 3 || parts[0] !== "v1") return false;
+  try {
+    const expected = createHmac("sha256", signingKey).update(`v1.${parts[1]}`).digest();
+    const received = Buffer.from(parts[2], "base64url");
+    if (received.length !== expected.length || !timingSafeEqual(received, expected)) return false;
+    const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(parts[1], "base64url").toString("utf8")) as AcceptancePayload;
+    return payload.v === 1 && payload.restaurantId === restaurantId && payload.digest === digest
+      && Number.isSafeInteger(payload.expiresAt) && payload.expiresAt >= now;
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-db-guard.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-db-guard.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8385252
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-db-guard.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+import { ServiceUnavailableException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
+
+// Fingerprints of the PostgreSQL 16 definitions in the disposable-only Stage 6D.3C3E candidate.
+// A trigger name alone is not evidence that the required commit guard is installed.
+const EXPECTED = {
+  trigger: "45aee35f2ba9ffa3dad765de5bb22edabd4d334559483726a9ec3fac72ef5a45",
+  guard: "7a3e6ffd54bfd096a64e5b3c530facdd366d649354d4296d7c1b03df170e8936",
+  money: "0a84da4aa22b4e0c6079d4bcb2fd5a7c907295a30fa3efe1128b95dc0a2780bf"
+} as const;
+
+export const NETWORK_ORDER_COMPLETENESS_CONSTRAINT = '"Order_network_test_completeness_guard"';
+
+type GuardState = {
+  databaseName: string;
+  address: string | null;
+  port: number | null;
+  serverVersion: number;
+  triggerCount: number;
+  triggerHash: string | null;
+  triggerType: number | null;
+  deferrable: boolean | null;
+  initiallyDeferred: boolean | null;
+  triggerEnabled: string | null;
+  sourceColumnMatches: boolean | null;
+  guardFunctionHash: string | null;
+  guardFunctionConfig: string[] | null;
+  guardFunctionArgs: number | null;
+  moneyFunctionHash: string | null;
+  moneyFunctionConfig: string[] | null;
+  moneyFunctionImmutable: boolean | null;
+  moneyFunctionSignature: string | null;
+  stage6cTriggerCount: number;
+};
+
+/** Fail closed before any NETWORK_TEST Order INSERT; this does not install or migrate a guard. */
+export async function assertNetworkOrderCompletenessGuard(transaction: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<void> {
+  let state: GuardState;
+  try {
+    const rows = await transaction.$queryRaw<GuardState[]>`
+      SELECT current_database() AS "databaseName", host(inet_server_addr()) AS address,
+        inet_server_port() AS port, current_setting('server_version_num')::int AS "serverVersion",
+        count(t.oid)::int AS "triggerCount",
+        max(encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid), 'UTF8')), 'hex')) AS "triggerHash",
+        max(t.tgtype::int) AS "triggerType", bool_and(t.tgdeferrable) AS deferrable,
+        bool_and(t.tginitdeferred) AS "initiallyDeferred", max(t.tgenabled::text) AS "triggerEnabled",
+        bool_and(t.tgattr::text = a.attnum::text) AS "sourceColumnMatches",
+        max(encode(sha256(convert_to(g.prosrc, 'UTF8')), 'hex')) AS "guardFunctionHash",
+        max(g.proconfig) AS "guardFunctionConfig", max(g.pronargs::int) AS "guardFunctionArgs",
+        (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(m.prosrc, 'UTF8')), 'hex') FROM pg_proc m
+          WHERE m.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND m.proname = 'network_order_guard_money'
+            AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(m.oid) = 'value jsonb') AS "moneyFunctionHash",
+        (SELECT m.proconfig FROM pg_proc m
+          WHERE m.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND m.proname = 'network_order_guard_money'
+            AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(m.oid) = 'value jsonb') AS "moneyFunctionConfig",
+        (SELECT m.provolatile = 'i' AND m.proparallel = 's' FROM pg_proc m
+          WHERE m.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND m.proname = 'network_order_guard_money'
+            AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(m.oid) = 'value jsonb') AS "moneyFunctionImmutable",
+        (SELECT pg_get_function_identity_arguments(m.oid) FROM pg_proc m
+          WHERE m.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND m.proname = 'network_order_guard_money'
+            AND pg_get_function_identity_arguments(m.oid) = 'value jsonb') AS "moneyFunctionSignature",
+        (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger old
+          WHERE old.tgrelid IN ('public."Order"'::regclass, 'public."OrderItem"'::regclass)
+            AND old.tgenabled = 'O' AND old.tgname IN (
+              'Order_network_snapshot_immutable', 'Order_network_snapshot_no_delete',
+              'Order_network_snapshot_seal_required', 'OrderItem_network_snapshot_immutable',
+              'OrderItem_network_snapshot_no_late_insert', 'OrderItem_network_snapshot_no_delete')) AS "stage6cTriggerCount"
+      FROM pg_trigger t
+      LEFT JOIN pg_proc g ON g.oid = t.tgfoid AND g.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
+        AND g.proname = 'require_complete_network_test_order'
+      LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = 'public."Order"'::regclass AND a.attname = 'source'
+      WHERE t.tgrelid = 'public."Order"'::regclass
+        AND t.tgname = 'Order_network_test_completeness_guard'
+    `;
+    state = rows[0];
+  } catch {
+    throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_DB_GUARD_UNAVAILABLE", message: "Test order storage guard could not be verified." });
+  }
+  if (!state || !state.databaseName.startsWith("ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_")
+    || state.address !== "127.0.0.1" || state.port !== 55440
+    || state.serverVersion < 160000 || state.serverVersion >= 170000
+    || state.triggerCount !== 1 || state.triggerHash !== EXPECTED.trigger
+    || state.triggerType !== 21 || state.deferrable !== true || state.initiallyDeferred !== true
+    || state.triggerEnabled !== "O" || state.sourceColumnMatches !== true
+    || state.guardFunctionHash !== EXPECTED.guard || state.guardFunctionArgs !== 0
+    || state.guardFunctionConfig?.join("|") !== "search_path=pg_catalog, public"
+    || state.moneyFunctionHash !== EXPECTED.money
+    || state.moneyFunctionConfig?.join("|") !== "search_path=pg_catalog"
+    || state.moneyFunctionImmutable !== true || state.moneyFunctionSignature !== "value jsonb"
+    || state.stage6cTriggerCount !== 6) {
+    throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_DB_GUARD_UNAVAILABLE", message: "The expected test order storage guard is not installed." });
+  }
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-prepare-conflict.integration.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-prepare-conflict.integration.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6379ba2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-prepare-conflict.integration.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,204 @@
+import { INestApplication, Module } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import { NestFactory } from "@nestjs/core";
+import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { PrismaService } from "../prisma/prisma.service";
+import { NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard, NetworkOrdersController } from "./network-orders.controller";
+import { NetworkOrdersService } from "./network-orders.service";
+
+const databaseUrl = process.env.NETWORK_ORDER_PREPARE_CONFLICT_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
+const expectedDatabase = "ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c2_conflict";
+if (databaseUrl) {
+  const parsed = new URL(databaseUrl);
+  if (parsed.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || parsed.port !== "55440" || parsed.pathname !== `/${expectedDatabase}`) {
+    throw new Error("Stage 6D.3C2 tests refuse a non-disposable database URL");
+  }
+}
+const integration = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;
+
+const restaurantId = "s6d3c2-restaurant";
+const productId = "s6d3c2-pizza";
+const configuration = { schemaVersion: 1, productId, revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [{ id: "medium", label: "Medium", price: "12.000001" }] }
+] };
+const request = { locale: "en", items: [{ productId, quantity: 1, selection: {
+  schemaVersion: 1, productId, configurationRevision: 1,
+  groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" }]
+} }] };
+
+function prismaFailure(code: string, meta?: Record<string, string>) {
+  return new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError("private SQL and connection details must not reach HTTP", {
+    code, clientVersion: "5.22.0", meta
+  });
+}
+
+integration("Stage 6D.3C2 Prepare Serializable conflict HTTP regression", () => {
+  const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: databaseUrl });
+  const previousFlag = process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS;
+  let app: INestApplication;
+  let origin: string;
+  let attempts = 0;
+  let fault: { remaining: number; error: Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError } | null = null;
+
+  async function post(path: string, body: unknown) {
+    const response = await fetch(`${origin}/public/menus/s6d3c2/orders/network-test${path}`, {
+      method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body)
+    });
+    return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() as Record<string, any> };
+  }
+  const prepare = () => post("/prepare", request);
+  const create = (acceptanceToken: string, idempotencyKey: string) => post("", { ...request, acceptanceToken, idempotencyKey });
+  const markerCount = () => prisma.category.count({ where: { restaurantId, slug: { startsWith: "injected-rollback-" } } });
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS = "1";
+    await prisma.$connect();
+    const [target] = await prisma.$queryRaw<{ name: string; address: string | null; port: number | null }[]>`
+      SELECT current_database() AS name, host(inet_server_addr()) AS address, inet_server_port() AS port
+    `;
+    if (target?.name !== expectedDatabase || target.address !== "127.0.0.1" || target.port !== 55440) {
+      throw new Error("Stage 6D.3C2 requires its dedicated disposable PostgreSQL database");
+    }
+    // Reset only this suite's fixtures after verifying the actual disposable database target.
+    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('TRUNCATE "OrderItem", "Order" RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE');
+    await prisma.product.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.category.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionFeature.deleteMany({ where: { planId: "s6d3c2-plan" } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.deleteMany({ where: { id: "s6d3c2-plan" } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.deleteMany({ where: { id: restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.create({ data: { id: restaurantId, slug: "s6d3c2", name: "Disposable restaurant", currency: "EGP" } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.create({ data: { id: "s6d3c2-plan", key: "S6D3C2_TEST", name: "Disposable plan",
+      features: { create: { id: "s6d3c2-feature", key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true } } } });
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.create({ data: { id: "s6d3c2-sub", restaurantId, planId: "s6d3c2-plan",
+      status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") } });
+    await prisma.product.create({ data: { id: productId, restaurantId, slug: "pizza", name: "Test Pizza", currency: "EGP",
+      basePrice: null, configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: configuration } });
+
+    const db = new Proxy(prisma, { get(target, key) {
+      if (key === "$transaction") return async (work: (transaction: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<unknown>,
+        options: { isolationLevel?: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel; maxWait?: number; timeout?: number }) => {
+        attempts += 1;
+        if (fault && fault.remaining > 0) {
+          const injected = fault.error;
+          fault.remaining -= 1;
+          return target.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
+            // Run the real Prepare/Create callback, then fail inside its real PG transaction.
+            await work(transaction);
+            await transaction.category.create({ data: { restaurantId, slug: `injected-rollback-${attempts}`, name: "rollback marker" } });
+            throw injected;
+          }, options);
+        }
+        return target.$transaction(work, options);
+      };
+      const value = Reflect.get(target, key, target);
+      return typeof value === "function" ? value.bind(target) : value;
+    } });
+    @Module({ controllers: [NetworkOrdersController], providers: [NetworkOrdersService, NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard,
+      { provide: PrismaService, useValue: db }] })
+    class TestModule {}
+    app = await NestFactory.create(TestModule, { logger: false });
+    await app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1");
+    origin = await app.getUrl();
+  });
+
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    fault = null;
+    attempts = 0;
+    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('TRUNCATE "OrderItem", "Order" RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE');
+    expect(await markerCount()).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    if (app) await app.close();
+    await prisma.$disconnect();
+    if (previousFlag === undefined) delete process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS;
+    else process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS = previousFlag;
+  });
+
+  it("prepares a trusted draft without a conflict or an Order write", async () => {
+    const response = await prepare();
+    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
+    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ draft: { totalAmount: "12.000001", orderingEnabled: false },
+      requiresExplicitAcceptance: true, orderingEnabled: false });
+    expect(typeof response.body.acceptanceToken).toBe("string");
+    expect(attempts).toBe(1);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it("retries a transient P2034 once and returns a successful trusted draft", async () => {
+    fault = { remaining: 1, error: prismaFailure("P2034") };
+    const response = await prepare();
+    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
+    expect(response.body.draft.totalAmount).toBe("12.000001");
+    expect(attempts).toBe(2);
+    expect(await markerCount()).toBe(0);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it.each([
+    ["P2034", undefined],
+    ["P2010 / 40001", { code: "40001", message: "private SQL 40001" }],
+    ["P2010 / 40P01", { code: "40P01", message: "private SQL 40P01" }]
+  ])("returns a safe structured 409 after three %s conflicts", async (label, meta) => {
+    fault = { remaining: 3, error: prismaFailure(label === "P2034" ? "P2034" : "P2010", meta) };
+    const response = await prepare();
+    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
+    expect(response.body).toEqual({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE",
+      message: "Catalog changed concurrently; retry with a new quote." });
+    expect(JSON.stringify(response.body)).not.toMatch(/Prisma|private SQL|P2034|P2010|40001|40P01|stack|connection/i);
+    expect(attempts).toBe(3);
+    expect(await markerCount()).toBe(0);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it("does not map an unrelated database error to HTTP 409 or retry it", async () => {
+    fault = { remaining: 1, error: prismaFailure("P2003") };
+    const response = await prepare();
+    expect(response.status).toBe(500);
+    expect(response.body.error).not.toBe("NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE");
+    expect(attempts).toBe(1);
+    expect(await markerCount()).toBe(0);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps Create's existing conflict mapping and transaction rollback", async () => {
+    const prepared = await prepare();
+    expect(prepared.status).toBe(200);
+    attempts = 0;
+    fault = { remaining: 3, error: prismaFailure("P2034") };
+    const response = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, randomUUID());
+    expect(response.status).toBe(409);
+    expect(response.body).toEqual({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE",
+      message: "Catalog changed concurrently; retry with a new quote." });
+    expect(attempts).toBe(3);
+    expect(await markerCount()).toBe(0);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps Create's acceptance token and idempotent replay unchanged", async () => {
+    const prepared = await prepare();
+    expect(prepared.status).toBe(200);
+    const key = randomUUID();
+    const first = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key);
+    const replay = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key);
+    expect(first.status).toBe(201);
+    expect(replay.status).toBe(201);
+    expect(replay.body).toMatchObject({ orderId: first.body.orderId, replayed: true, orderingEnabled: false });
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects test-only Prepare when the disposable-order flag is absent", async () => {
+    delete process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS;
+    try {
+      const response = await prepare();
+      expect(response.status).toBe(403);
+      expect(response.body.error).toBe("NETWORK_ORDERING_DISABLED");
+      expect(attempts).toBe(0);
+      expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(0);
+    } finally {
+      process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS = "1";
+    }
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-demo.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-demo.ts

@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+import { calculatePrice, multiplyMoney, type ProductConfigurationV1, type ProductSelectionV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+
+type Locale = "ar" | "en";
+
+/** In-memory Stage 6C-shaped snapshots. Never seeds a database or contacts WhatsApp. */
+export function buildNetworkWhatsappDemo(kind: "pizza" | "combo", locale: Locale) {
+  const ar = locale === "ar";
+  const source: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "demo-source", revision: 4, basePrice: null,
+    groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "source-sizes", label: ar ? "أحجام البيتزا" : "Pizza sizes", sizes: [
+      { id: "source-small", label: ar ? "وسط" : "Medium", price: "100" },
+      { id: "source-large", label: ar ? "كبير" : "Large", price: "200" }
+    ] }]
+  };
+  const pizza: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "demo-pizza", revision: 3, basePrice: null,
+    groups: [
+      { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: ar ? "الأحجام" : "Sizes", sizes: [
+        { id: "small", label: ar ? "صغير" : "Small", price: "100" },
+        { id: "large", label: ar ? "كبير" : "Large", price: "200.000001" }
+      ] },
+      { type: "OPTIONS", id: "toppings", label: ar ? "الإضافات" : "Toppings", min: 0, max: 5, includedQuantity: 1,
+        options: [
+          { id: "cheese", label: ar ? "جبنة إضافية" : "Extra cheese", price: "20", maxQuantity: 3,
+            priceOverrides: [{ sizeChoiceId: "large", price: "30.000001" }],
+            children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "sauces", label: ar ? "الصوصات" : "Sauces", min: 0, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0,
+              options: [{ id: "bbq", label: ar ? "صوص حار" : "Hot sauce", price: "5.000001", maxQuantity: 1 }] }] },
+          { id: "olives", label: ar ? "زيتون" : "Olives", price: "0", maxQuantity: 2 }
+        ] }
+    ]
+  };
+  const combo: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "demo-combo", revision: 2, basePrice: "0",
+    groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: ar ? "اختيار البيتزا" : "Choose pizzas", min: 3, max: 3, includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [
+        { id: "original", label: ar ? "بيتزا أولى" : "First pizza", price: "10", maxQuantity: 2,
+          linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "demo-source", mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: { "source-small": "5", "source-large": "8" } } },
+        { id: "custom", label: ar ? "بيتزا إضافية" : "Extra pizza", price: "3", maxQuantity: 1,
+          linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "demo-source", mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: {
+            schemaVersion: 1, productId: "demo-source", revision: 4, basePrice: null,
+            groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "custom-sizes", label: ar ? "حجم الكومبو" : "Combo size", sizes: [
+              { id: "custom-one", label: ar ? "حجم وسط" : "Medium", price: "7" }
+            ] }]
+          } } }
+      ] }]
+  };
+  const pizzaSelection: ProductSelectionV1 = {
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "demo-pizza", configurationRevision: 3, groups: [
+      { type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "large" },
+      { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "toppings", instances: [
+        { instanceId: "cheese-1", optionId: "cheese", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "sauces", instances: [
+          { instanceId: "sauce-1", optionId: "bbq" }
+        ] }] },
+        { instanceId: "cheese-2", optionId: "cheese" },
+        { instanceId: "cheese-3", optionId: "cheese" },
+        { instanceId: "olive-1", optionId: "olives" }
+      ] }
+    ]
+  };
+  const linkedSelection = (sizeChoiceId: string): ProductSelectionV1 => ({
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "demo-source", configurationRevision: 4,
+    groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId }]
+  });
+  const comboSelection: ProductSelectionV1 = {
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "demo-combo", configurationRevision: 2,
+    groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "slots", instances: [
+      { instanceId: "pizza-1", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: linkedSelection("source-large") },
+      { instanceId: "pizza-2", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: linkedSelection("source-small") },
+      { instanceId: "pizza-3", optionId: "custom", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "demo-source", configurationRevision: 4,
+        groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "custom-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "custom-one" }] } }
+    ] }]
+  };
+  const configuration = kind === "pizza" ? pizza : combo;
+  const selection = kind === "pizza" ? pizzaSelection : comboSelection;
+  const context = { catalogId: "demo-restaurant", linkedProducts: new Map([[
+    "demo-source", { productId: "demo-source", catalogId: "demo-restaurant", configuration: source, available: true, orderable: true }
+  ]]) };
+  const result = calculatePrice(configuration, selection, context);
+  if (!result.valid || result.total === null) throw new Error(`Invalid demo fixture: ${JSON.stringify(result.issues)}`);
+  const quantity = kind === "pizza" ? 2 : 1;
+  const item = {
+    snapshotVersion: 1, mode: "NETWORK", locale, currency: "EGP", productId: configuration.productId,
+    productSlug: kind, productName: kind === "pizza" ? (ar ? "بيتزا مارغريتا" : "Pizza Margherita") : (ar ? "كومبو عائلي" : "Family combo"),
+    quantity, configurationRevision: configuration.revision, canonicalSelection: selection,
+    selectionKey: "demo-only", linkedSourceRevisions: kind === "combo" ? [{ sourceProductId: "demo-source", mode: "NETWORK", configurationRevision: 4 }] : [],
+    unitPrice: result.total, lineTotal: multiplyMoney(result.total, quantity), priceBreakdown: result.lines,
+    baseIgnored: result.baseIgnored, configurationTree: configuration,
+    linkedSources: kind === "combo" ? [{ productId: "demo-source", productName: ar ? "بيتزا المصدر" : "Source pizza",
+      mode: "NETWORK", configurationRevision: 4, configurationTree: source }] : [],
+    createdAt: "2026-10-13T00:00:00.000Z"
+  };
+  return { snapshotVersion: 1, mode: "NETWORK", locale, currency: "EGP", totalAmount: item.lineTotal,
+    orderDetails: kind === "pizza" ? {
+      restaurantName: ar ? "مطعم التجربة" : "Demo restaurant",
+      customerName: ar ? "زبون تجريبي" : "Demo customer", customerPhone: "0000000000",
+      fulfillmentType: "delivery", deliveryArea: ar ? "حي التجربة" : "Demo district",
+      deliveryNear: ar ? "الحديقة" : "Park", deliveryBeside: ar ? "البوابة" : "Gate",
+      orderNote: ar ? "يرجى فصل الصوص" : "Please pack sauce separately"
+    } : {
+      restaurantName: ar ? "مطعم التجربة" : "Demo restaurant",
+      customerName: ar ? "زبون تجريبي" : "Demo customer", fulfillmentType: "pickup",
+      pickupTime: ar ? "الساعة السادسة" : "6 PM"
+    },
+    items: [item], createdAt: "2026-10-13T00:00:00.000Z" };
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-formatter.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-formatter.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1a85811
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-formatter.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,244 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { multiplyMoney, sumMoney } from "@menu/shared";
+import { buildNetworkWhatsappDemo } from "./network-order-whatsapp-demo";
+import { buildNetworkWhatsappPreviewUrl, formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage, NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError } from "./network-order-whatsapp-formatter";
+
+const copy = <T>(value: T): T => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as T;
+
+describe("Stage 6D.1 immutable-snapshot WhatsApp formatter", () => {
+  it("renders customer, delivery, address and notes from the saved Arabic snapshot", () => {
+    const snapshot = copy(buildNetworkWhatsappDemo("pizza", "ar")) as any;
+    snapshot.items[0].note = "بدون بصل";
+    const message = formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage(snapshot);
+    expect(message).toContain("زبون تجريبي");
+    expect(message).toContain("حي التجربة");
+    expect(message).toContain("يرجى فصل الصوص");
+    expect(message).toContain("بدون بصل");

diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-formatter.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-formatter.ts

index 0000000..f923206
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-formatter.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,415 @@
+import { compareMoney, currencyDisplayReconciliation, formatCurrencyAmount, multiplyMoney, normalizeMoney, sumMoney, validateMoneyString, DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS } from "@menu/shared";
+import type {
+  ConfigurationGroup, GroupSelection, OptionChoice, OptionSelectionInstance,
+  PriceLine, ProductConfigurationV1, ProductSelectionV1
+} from "@menu/shared";
+
+type Locale = "ar" | "en";
+type JsonObject = Record<string, unknown>;
+
+export class NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError extends Error {
+  constructor(public readonly code: string, public readonly path: string, detail: string) {
+    super(`${code} at ${path}: ${detail}`);
+    this.name = "NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError";
+  }
+}
+
+function object(value: unknown, path: string): JsonObject {
+  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_OBJECT", path, "Expected an object.");
+  }
+  return value as JsonObject;
+}
+
+function array(value: unknown, path: string): unknown[] {
+  if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_ARRAY", path, "Expected an array.");
+  return value;
+}
+
+function nonempty(value: unknown, path: string): string {
+  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("MISSING_SNAPSHOT_TEXT", path, "Historical display text is missing.");
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function money(value: unknown, path: string): string {
+  const issues = validateMoneyString(value, path, DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS);
+  if (issues.length) throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_MONEY", path, issues[0].message);
+  return normalizeMoney(value as string);
+}
+
+function quantity(value: unknown, path: string): number {
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || (value as number) < 1 || (value as number) > 100) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_QUANTITY", path, "Quantity must be 1–100.");
+  }
+  return value as number;
+}
+
+/** Keep historical text legible, but never let a name add a forged line or WhatsApp formatting. */
+function display(value: string, path: string, maxLength = 200): string {
+  const cleaned = value
+    .replace(/[\r\n\u2028\u2029\t]+/g, " ")
+    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f\u200e\u200f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/g, "")
+    .replace(/\*/g, "＊").replace(/_/g, "＿").replace(/~/g, "～").replace(/`/g, "ˋ")
+    .replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
+  if (!cleaned || cleaned.length > maxLength) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_DISPLAY_TEXT", path, "Display text is empty or too long; it was not truncated.");
+  }
+  return `\u2068${cleaned}\u2069`;
+}
+
+const words = {
+  ar: { title: "🧾 طلب OrderSawa",
+    unit: "سعر الوحدة", each: "للوحدة", line: "إجمالي الصنف", total: "إجمالي الطلب", base: "السعر الأساسي",
+    restaurant: "المطعم", customer: "اسم الزبون", phone: "هاتف الزبون", fulfillment: "طريقة الاستلام",
+    pickup: "🍽️ استلام من المطعم", delivery: "🛵 توصيل دليفري", area: "المنطقة", near: "قريب من", beside: "العنوان",
+    pickupTime: "موعد الاستلام", orderNote: "ملاحظات الطلب", itemNote: "ملاحظة الصنف" },
+  en: { title: "🧾 OrderSawa order",
+    unit: "Unit price", each: "each", line: "Line total", total: "Order total", base: "Base price",
+    restaurant: "Restaurant", customer: "Customer", phone: "Customer phone", fulfillment: "Fulfillment",
+    pickup: "🍽️ Pickup", delivery: "🛵 Delivery", area: "Area", near: "Near", beside: "Beside",
+    pickupTime: "Pickup time", orderNote: "Order note", itemNote: "Item note" }
+} as const;
+
+type StoredSource = { productId: string; productName: string; mode: "NETWORK" | "LEGACY"; configurationTree: ProductConfigurationV1 };
+
+class LineRenderer {
+  readonly rendered: string[] = [];
+  private readonly usedLines = new Set<number>();
+
+  constructor(
+    private readonly locale: Locale,
+    private readonly priceLines: PriceLine[],
+    private readonly sources: StoredSource[]
+  ) {}
+
+  private price(path: string, kind: PriceLine["kind"], nodeId: string, sourceProductId?: string): PriceLine {
+    const matches = this.priceLines.map((line, index) => ({ line, index })).filter(({ line }) =>
+      line.path === path && line.kind === kind && line.nodeId === nodeId);
+    if (matches.length !== 1 || this.usedLines.has(matches[0].index)) {
+      throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("MISSING_OR_DUPLICATE_PRICE_LINE", path, "Expected one historical price line.");
+    }
+    const { line, index } = matches[0];
+    money(line.amount, `${path}.amount`);
+    money(line.chargedAmount, `${path}.chargedAmount`);
+    if (line.included && compareMoney(line.chargedAmount, "0") !== 0) {
+      throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_INCLUDED_PRICE_LINE", path, "Included units must have zero charged amount.");
+    }
+    if (!line.included && compareMoney(line.amount, line.chargedAmount) !== 0) {
+      throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("PRICE_LINE_AMOUNT_MISMATCH", path, "Non-included amount differs from its saved charge.");
+    }
+    if (kind === "OPTION" && line.sourceProductId !== sourceProductId) {
+      throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("LINKED_SOURCE_PRICE_MISMATCH", path, "Linked source identity differs from the price line.");
+    }
+    this.usedLines.add(index);
+    return line;
+  }
+
+  render(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, selection: ProductSelectionV1, headingSizeGroupId?: string) {
+    if (configuration.productId !== selection.productId || configuration.revision !== selection.configurationRevision) {
+      throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("SNAPSHOT_REVISION_MISMATCH", "$selection", "Configuration and selection differ.");
+    }
+    const base = this.priceLines.find((line) => line.kind === "BASE");
+    if (base) {
+      this.price("$configuration.basePrice", "BASE", configuration.productId);
+    }
+    this.groups(configuration.groups, selection.groups, "$selection.groups", 0, headingSizeGroupId);
+    if (this.usedLines.size !== this.priceLines.length) {
+      throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("UNUSED_PRICE_LINE", "$priceBreakdown", "Historical price lines do not match selected nodes.");
+    }
+    return this.rendered;
+  }
+
+  private groups(groupsValue: unknown, selectionsValue: unknown, prefix: string, depth: number,
+    headingSizeGroupId?: string, headingSizeDepth = 0) {
+    if (depth > 24) throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("SNAPSHOT_DEPTH_LIMIT", prefix, "Nested selection is too deep.");
+    const groups = array(groupsValue, `${prefix}.configuration`) as ConfigurationGroup[];
+    const selections = array(selectionsValue, prefix) as GroupSelection[];
+    const chosen = new Map<string, GroupSelection>();
+    for (const selection of selections) {
+      const node = object(selection, prefix);
+      const id = nonempty(node.groupId, `${prefix}.groupId`);
+      if (chosen.has(id) || !groups.some((group) => group.id === id)) {
+        throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("UNKNOWN_OR_DUPLICATE_GROUP", prefix, id);
+      }
+      chosen.set(id, selection);
+    }
+    for (const group of groups) {
+      const groupNode = object(group, `${prefix}.configuration`);
+      const groupId = nonempty(groupNode.id, `${prefix}.groupId`);
+      const groupLabel = display(nonempty(groupNode.label, `${prefix}.${groupId}.label`), `${prefix}.${groupId}.label`);
+      const groupSelection = chosen.get(groupId);
+      const groupPath = `${prefix}.${groupId}`;
+      const pad = "  ".repeat(depth);
+      if (groupNode.type === "SIZE") {
+        if (!groupSelection || groupSelection.type !== "SIZE") {
+          throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("MISSING_SIZE_SELECTION", groupPath, "Selected size is absent.");
+        }
+        const sizes = array(groupNode.sizes, `${groupPath}.sizes`) as Array<{ id: string; label: string; children?: ConfigurationGroup[] }>;
+        const size = sizes.find((entry) => entry.id === groupSelection.sizeChoiceId);
+        if (!size) throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("UNKNOWN_SIZE", groupPath, "Selected size has no historical label.");
+        this.price(groupPath, "SIZE", size.id);
+        const sizeLabel = display(nonempty(size.label, `${groupPath}.${size.id}.label`), `${groupPath}.${size.id}.label`);
+        if (!(depth === headingSizeDepth && groupId === headingSizeGroupId)) {
+          this.rendered.push(`${pad}📏 ${groupLabel} — ${sizeLabel}`);
+        }
+        this.groups(size.children ?? [], groupSelection.children ?? [], `${groupPath}.${size.id}`, depth + 1);
+      } else if (groupNode.type === "OPTIONS") {
+        if (groupSelection && groupSelection.type !== "OPTIONS") {
+          throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("GROUP_TYPE_MISMATCH", groupPath, "Selection type differs from historical group.");
+        }
+        const options = array(groupNode.options, `${groupPath}.options`) as OptionChoice[];
+        const instances = groupSelection?.instances ?? [];
+        array(instances, `${groupPath}.instances`);
+        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(groupNode.min) || Number(groupNode.min) < 0
+          || (groupNode.max !== null && (!Number.isSafeInteger(groupNode.max) || Number(groupNode.max) < Number(groupNode.min)))
+          || instances.length < Number(groupNode.min) || instances.length > 100
+          || (groupNode.max !== null && instances.length > Number(groupNode.max))) {
+          throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_GROUP_QUANTITY", groupPath, "Historical group bounds and selected quantity differ.");
+        }
+        if (!instances.length) {
+          if (typeof groupNode.min !== "number" || groupNode.min > 0) {
+            throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("MISSING_REQUIRED_GROUP", groupPath, "Required historical choices are missing.");
+          }
+          continue;
+        }
+        this.rendered.push(`${pad}➕ ${groupLabel}:`);
+        const instanceIds = new Set<string>();
+        const optionCounts = new Map<string, number>();
+        const leafUnits = new Map<string, { label: string; count: number }>();
+        const flushLeafUnits = () => {
+          for (const unit of leafUnits.values()) this.rendered.push(`${pad}  • ${unit.count} × ${unit.label}`);
+          leafUnits.clear();
+        };
+        // Canonical selections are sorted by technical instanceId for signatures.
+        // Presentation follows the historical option order instead, without
+        // changing the signed selection, paths, or monetary breakdown.
+        const displayInstances = [...instances].sort((left, right) =>
+          options.findIndex((option) => option.id === left.optionId)
+          - options.findIndex((option) => option.id === right.optionId));
+        for (const [index, instance] of displayInstances.entries()) {
+          const record = object(instance, `${groupPath}.instances[${index}]`) as OptionSelectionInstance;
+          const instanceId = nonempty(record.instanceId, `${groupPath}.instances[${index}].instanceId`);
+          if (instanceIds.has(instanceId)) throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("DUPLICATE_INSTANCE", groupPath, instanceId);
+          instanceIds.add(instanceId);
+          const option = options.find((candidate) => candidate.id === record.optionId);
+          if (!option) throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("UNKNOWN_OPTION", groupPath, "Selected option has no historical label.");
+          const optionCount = (optionCounts.get(option.id) ?? 0) + 1;
+          optionCounts.set(option.id, optionCount);
+          if (!Number.isSafeInteger(option.maxQuantity) || optionCount > option.maxQuantity) {
+            throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_OPTION_QUANTITY", groupPath, "Selected option exceeds its historical quantity bound.");
+          }
+          const instancePath = `${groupPath}.${instanceId}`;
+          const entry = this.price(instancePath, "OPTION", option.id, option.linkedProduct?.sourceProductId);
+          const label = display(nonempty(option.label, `${instancePath}.label`), `${instancePath}.label`);
+          const hasBranches = Boolean((record.children?.length ?? 0) || option.linkedProduct);
+          if (!hasBranches) {
+            const key = `${option.id}\u0000${entry.included}\u0000${entry.chargedAmount}\u0000${entry.amount}`;
+            const prior = leafUnits.get(key);
+            if (prior) prior.count += 1;
+            else leafUnits.set(key, { label, count: 1 });
+            continue;
+          }
+          flushLeafUnits();
+          if (option.linkedProduct) {
+            const sourceId = option.linkedProduct.sourceProductId;
+            const source = this.sources.find((candidate) => candidate.productId === sourceId);
+            if (!source || !record.linkedSelection || record.linkedSelection.productId !== sourceId) {
+              throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("MISSING_LINKED_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT", instancePath, "Historical linked source or selection is absent.");
+            }
+            const mode = option.linkedProduct.mode;
+            const linkedConfiguration = mode === "CUSTOM" ? option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration : source.configurationTree;
+            if (!linkedConfiguration || (mode !== "ORIGINAL" && mode !== "CUSTOM")) {
+              throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("MISSING_LINKED_CONFIGURATION", instancePath, "Historical linked configuration is absent.");
+            }
+            if (linkedConfiguration.productId !== sourceId
+              || linkedConfiguration.revision !== record.linkedSelection.configurationRevision
+              || (mode === "ORIGINAL" && source.mode !== "NETWORK")) {
+              throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("LINKED_SNAPSHOT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH", instancePath, "Linked snapshot identity or revision differs.");
+            }
+            const linkedName = display(nonempty(source.productName, `${instancePath}.linkedName`), `${instancePath}.linkedName`);
+            const linkedSizes = linkedConfiguration.groups.filter((group) => group.type === "SIZE");
+            const linkedSize = linkedSizes.length === 1
+              ? linkedSizes[0].sizes.find((size) => record.linkedSelection?.groups.some((selection) =>
+                selection.type === "SIZE" && selection.groupId === linkedSizes[0].id && selection.sizeChoiceId === size.id))
+              : undefined;
+            const sizeLabel = linkedSize
+              ? display(nonempty(linkedSize.label, `${instancePath}.linkedSize`), `${instancePath}.linkedSize`) : undefined;
+            const visibleLabel = label.slice(1, -1);
+            const visibleSource = linkedName.slice(1, -1);
+            const sourceSuffix = visibleLabel === visibleSource || visibleLabel.endsWith(` — ${visibleSource}`)
+              ? "" : ` — ${linkedName}`;
+            this.rendered.push(`${pad}  • 1 × ${label}${sourceSuffix}${sizeLabel ? ` — ${sizeLabel}` : ""}`);
+            this.groups(option.children ?? [], record.children ?? [], `${instancePath}.children`, depth + 2);
+            this.groups(linkedConfiguration.groups, record.linkedSelection.groups, `${instancePath}.linked`, depth + 3,
+              sizeLabel ? linkedSizes[0].id : undefined, depth + 3);
+          } else if (record.linkedSelection) {
+            throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("UNEXPECTED_LINKED_SELECTION", instancePath, "Non-linked option has a linked selection.");
+          } else {
+            this.rendered.push(`${pad}  • 1 × ${label}`);
+            this.groups(option.children ?? [], record.children ?? [], `${instancePath}.children`, depth + 2);
+          }
+        }
+        flushLeafUnits();
+      } else {
+        throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("UNKNOWN_GROUP_TYPE", groupPath, "Unsupported historical group type.");
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+function optionalSnapshotText(details: JsonObject, key: string, path: string, maxLength = 200): string | undefined {
+  const value = details[key];
+  if (value === undefined || value === null) return undefined;
+  return display(nonempty(value, `${path}.${key}`), `${path}.${key}`, maxLength);
+}
+
+function renderOrderDetails(value: unknown, locale: Locale): { header: string[]; footer: string[]; orderNote?: string } {
+  if (value === undefined) return { header: [], footer: [] }; // Stage 6C snapshots predate these fields.
+  const path = "$snapshot.orderDetails";
+  const details = object(value, path);
+  const w = words[locale];
+  const header: string[] = [];
+  const footer: string[] = [];
+  if (details.restaurantName === undefined) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("MISSING_SNAPSHOT_TEXT", `${path}.restaurantName`, "Historical restaurant name is missing.");
+  }
+  const restaurantName = optionalSnapshotText(details, "restaurantName", path);
+  if (restaurantName) header.push(`${w.restaurant}: ${restaurantName}`);
+  const fulfillment = details.fulfillmentType;
+  if (fulfillment !== undefined) {
+    if (fulfillment !== "pickup" && fulfillment !== "delivery") {
+      throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_FULFILLMENT", `${path}.fulfillmentType`, "Expected pickup or delivery.");
+    }
+    header.push(`${w.fulfillment}: ${fulfillment === "pickup" ? w.pickup : w.delivery}`);
+  }
+  const addressFields = [
+    ["deliveryArea", w.area], ["deliveryNear", w.near], ["deliveryBeside", w.beside]
+  ] as const;
+  for (const [key, label] of addressFields) {
+    const value = optionalSnapshotText(details, key, path);
+    if (value) footer.push(`${label}: ${value}`);
+  }
+  const pickupTime = optionalSnapshotText(details, "pickupTime", path);
+  if (fulfillment === "delivery" && (!details.deliveryArea || !details.deliveryNear || pickupTime)) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_FULFILLMENT", path, "Saved delivery address is incomplete.");
+  }
+  if (fulfillment !== "delivery" && (details.deliveryArea || details.deliveryNear || details.deliveryBeside)) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_FULFILLMENT", path, "Saved address has no delivery mode.");
+  }
+  if (fulfillment !== "pickup" && pickupTime) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_SNAPSHOT_FULFILLMENT", path, "Saved pickup time has no pickup mode.");
+  }
+  const customerFields: string[] = [];
+  for (const [key, label] of [["customerName", w.customer], ["customerPhone", w.phone]] as const) {
+    const value = optionalSnapshotText(details, key, path);
+    if (value) customerFields.push(`${label}: ${value}`);
+  }
+  footer.unshift(...customerFields);
+  if (pickupTime) footer.push(`🕒 ${w.pickupTime}: ${pickupTime}`);
+  const orderNote = optionalSnapshotText(details, "orderNote", path, 500);
+  return { header, footer, ...(orderNote ? { orderNote: `*🔸️ ${w.orderNote}: ${orderNote}*` } : {}) };
+}
+
+export function formatWhatsappDisplayText(value: string, path: string, maxLength = 200): string {
+  return display(value, path, maxLength);
+}
+
+export function formatNetworkOrderDetails(value: unknown, locale: Locale) {
+  return renderOrderDetails(value, locale);
+}
+
+/** RLM must precede the content: an outer RLI is ignored when resolving the paragraph's first strong character. */
+export function formatWhatsappMessageLines(lines: (string | null)[], locale: Locale): string {
+  return lines.filter((line): line is string => line !== null).map((line) =>
+    line && locale === "ar" ? `\u200f${line}` : line).join("\n");
+}
+
+export function formatNetworkSnapshotLine(rawItem: unknown, locale: Locale, currency: string, index: number, numbered = true): { lines: string[]; lineTotal: string } {
+  const path = `$snapshot.items[${index}]`;
+  const item = object(rawItem, path);
+  if (item.snapshotVersion !== 1 || item.mode !== "NETWORK" || item.locale !== locale || item.currency !== currency) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("ITEM_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH", path, "Line envelope differs from order snapshot.");
+  }
+  const productId = nonempty(item.productId, `${path}.productId`);
+  const name = display(nonempty(item.productName, `${path}.productName`), `${path}.productName`);
+  const count = quantity(item.quantity, `${path}.quantity`);
+  const unitPrice = money(item.unitPrice, `${path}.unitPrice`);
+  const lineTotal = money(item.lineTotal, `${path}.lineTotal`);
+  if (compareMoney(multiplyMoney(unitPrice, count), lineTotal) !== 0) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("LINE_TOTAL_MISMATCH", `${path}.lineTotal`, "Saved line amount and quantity differ.");
+  }
+  const configuration = object(item.configurationTree, `${path}.configurationTree`) as ProductConfigurationV1;
+  const selection = object(item.canonicalSelection, `${path}.canonicalSelection`) as ProductSelectionV1;
+  if (configuration.productId !== productId || selection.productId !== productId || item.configurationRevision !== configuration.revision) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("PRODUCT_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH", path, "Historical product identity or revision differs.");
+  }
+  const priceLines = array(item.priceBreakdown, `${path}.priceBreakdown`).map((entry, lineIndex) =>
+    object(entry, `${path}.priceBreakdown[${lineIndex}]`) as PriceLine);
+  const sources = array(item.linkedSources, `${path}.linkedSources`).map((entry, sourceIndex) =>
+    object(entry, `${path}.linkedSources[${sourceIndex}]`) as StoredSource);
+  const topLevelSizes = configuration.groups.filter((group) => group.type === "SIZE").flatMap((group) => {
+    const selected = selection.groups.find((choice) => choice.type === "SIZE" && choice.groupId === group.id);
+    const size = selected?.type === "SIZE" ? group.sizes.find((choice) => choice.id === selected.sizeChoiceId) : undefined;
+    return size ? [{ groupId: group.id, label: display(nonempty(size.label, `${path}.size.label`), `${path}.size.label`) }] : [];
+  });
+  const sizeSuffix = topLevelSizes.length === 1 ? ` — ${topLevelSizes[0].label}` : "";
+  const renderer = new LineRenderer(locale, priceLines, sources);
+  const renderedChoices = renderer.render(configuration, selection, topLevelSizes.length === 1 ? topLevelSizes[0].groupId : undefined);
+  const lines = [`${numbered ? `${index + 1}. ` : ""}${count} × ${name}${sizeSuffix}`, ...renderedChoices];
+  if (item.note !== undefined) {
+    lines.push(`*🔸️ ${words[locale].itemNote}: ${display(nonempty(item.note, `${path}.note`), `${path}.note`, 500)}*`);
+  }
+  if (compareMoney(sumMoney(priceLines.map((entry) => money(entry.chargedAmount, `${path}.priceBreakdown.chargedAmount`))), unitPrice) !== 0) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("UNIT_BREAKDOWN_MISMATCH", `${path}.priceBreakdown`, "Saved breakdown differs from the saved unit price.");
+  }
+  const reconciliation = currencyDisplayReconciliation(priceLines.map((entry) => entry.chargedAmount), unitPrice, currency);
+  if (reconciliation) lines.push(`${locale === "ar" ? "فرق عرض التقريب" : "Display rounding difference"}: ${reconciliation}`);
+  lines.push(`${words[locale].line}: ${formatCurrencyAmount(lineTotal, currency)}`);
+  return { lines, lineTotal };
+}
+
+export function formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage(snapshotValue: unknown): string {
+  const snapshot = object(snapshotValue, "$snapshot");
+  if (snapshot.snapshotVersion !== 1 || snapshot.mode !== "NETWORK" || (snapshot.locale !== "ar" && snapshot.locale !== "en")) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_SNAPSHOT", "$snapshot", "Expected a Stage 6C Network snapshot.");
+  }
+  const locale = snapshot.locale;
+  const w = words[locale];
+  const currency = nonempty(snapshot.currency, "$snapshot.currency");
+  if (!/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(currency)) throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_CURRENCY", "$snapshot.currency", "Expected ISO-style currency code.");
+  const total = money(snapshot.totalAmount, "$snapshot.totalAmount");
+  const items = array(snapshot.items, "$snapshot.items");
+  if (!items.length || items.length > 50) throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_ITEM_COUNT", "$snapshot.items", "Expected 1–50 items.");
+  const details = renderOrderDetails(snapshot.orderDetails, locale);
+  const output = [w.title, ...details.header, ""];
+  const lineTotals: string[] = [];
+  for (const [index, rawItem] of items.entries()) {
+    const rendered = formatNetworkSnapshotLine(rawItem, locale, currency, index);
+    output.push(...rendered.lines);
+    output.push("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━", "");
+    lineTotals.push(rendered.lineTotal);
+  }
+  if (compareMoney(sumMoney(lineTotals), total) !== 0) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("ORDER_TOTAL_MISMATCH", "$snapshot.totalAmount", "Saved order total differs from line totals.");
+  }
+  const reconciliation = currencyDisplayReconciliation(lineTotals, total, currency);
+  if (details.orderNote) output.push(details.orderNote, "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━", "");
+  if (reconciliation) output.push(`${locale === "ar" ? "فرق عرض التقريب" : "Display rounding difference"}: ${reconciliation}`);
+  output.push(`💵 ${w.total}: ${formatCurrencyAmount(total, currency)}`);
+  output.push(...details.footer);
+  return formatWhatsappMessageLines(output, locale);
+}
+
+/** Link construction is separate from formatting. It never contacts WhatsApp. */
+export function buildNetworkWhatsappPreviewUrl(phone: string, message: string): string {
+  if (!/^[1-9]\d{6,14}$/.test(phone)) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("INVALID_PREVIEW_PHONE", "$phone", "Expected digits-only international phone.");
+  }
+  const url = `https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`;
+  if (url.length > 8192) {
+    throw new NetworkOrderSnapshotFormatError("WHATSAPP_URL_TOO_LONG", "$message", "The full message exceeds the preview URL safety cap; it was not truncated.");
+  }
+  return url;
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-preview.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-order-whatsapp-preview.ts
