@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { buildNetworkWhatsappDemo } from "./network-order-whatsapp-demo";
+import { formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage } from "./network-order-whatsapp-formatter";
+
+const kind = process.argv[2];
+const locale = process.argv[3];
+if (kind === "snapshot" && locale) {
+  const savedSnapshot: unknown = JSON.parse(readFileSync(locale, "utf8"));
+  process.stdout.write(`${formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage(savedSnapshot)}\n`);
+} else if ((kind === "pizza" || kind === "combo") && (locale === "ar" || locale === "en")) {
+  process.stdout.write(`${formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage(buildNetworkWhatsappDemo(kind, locale))}\n`);
+} else {
+  process.stderr.write("Usage: npm run preview:network-whatsapp -w @menu/api -- pizza|combo ar|en\n");
+  process.stderr.write("   or: npm run preview:network-whatsapp -w @menu/api -- snapshot path-to-local-cartSnapshot.json\n");
+  process.exitCode = 1;
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders-atomic.integration.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders-atomic.integration.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9edf438
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders-atomic.integration.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,367 @@
+import { INestApplication, Module } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { NestFactory } from "@nestjs/core";
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
+import { performance } from "node:perf_hooks";
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard, NetworkOrdersController } from "./network-orders.controller";
+import { NetworkOrdersService } from "./network-orders.service";
+import { PrismaService } from "../prisma/prisma.service";
+
+const baseUrl = process.env.NETWORK_ORDER_ATOMIC_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
+const expectedName = "ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3f_atomic";
+const missingUrl = process.env.NETWORK_ORDER_NO_GUARD_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
+const fakeUrl = process.env.NETWORK_ORDER_FAKE_GUARD_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
+for (const [raw, name] of [[baseUrl, expectedName], [missingUrl, "ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3f_no_guard"],
+  [fakeUrl, "ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3f_fake_guard"]] as const) {
+  if (!raw) continue;
+  const parsed = new URL(raw);
+  if (parsed.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || parsed.port !== "55440" || parsed.pathname !== `/${name}`) {
+    throw new Error("Stage 6D.3C3F refuses a non-disposable test database");
+  }
+}
+const integration = baseUrl && missingUrl && fakeUrl ? describe : describe.skip;
+
+const restaurantId = "c3f-restaurant";
+const productId = "c3f-pizza";
+const otherRestaurantId = "c3f-other-restaurant";
+const otherProductId = "c3f-other-pizza";
+const config = { schemaVersion: 1, productId, revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [{ id: "medium", label: "Medium", price: "12.000001" }] }
+] };
+const request = { locale: "en", items: [{ productId, quantity: 1, selection: {
+  schemaVersion: 1, productId, configurationRevision: 1,
+  groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" }]
+} }] };
+const otherRequest = { locale: "en", items: [{ productId: otherProductId, quantity: 1, selection: {
+  schemaVersion: 1, productId: otherProductId, configurationRevision: 1,
+  groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" }]
+} }] };
+type Fault = "missing_item" | "missing_snapshot" | "missing_seal" | "total_mismatch" | "options_mismatch"
+  | "skip_immediate" | "finalization_failure" | "rollback_before_commit" | "lost_response"
+  | "read_failure" | "serialization" | "serialization_wrapped" | "deadlock" | "unique_unrelated" | "unrelated";
+
+function privatePrismaError(code: string, sqlstate?: string) {
+  return new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError("private SQL and connection details", {
+    code, clientVersion: "5.22.0", meta: sqlstate ? { code: sqlstate } : undefined
+  });
+}
+
+async function appFor(client: PrismaClient | object) {
+  @Module({ controllers: [NetworkOrdersController], providers: [NetworkOrdersService, NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard,
+    { provide: PrismaService, useValue: client }] })
+  class TestModule {}
+  const app = await NestFactory.create(TestModule, { logger: false });
+  await app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1");
+  return { app, origin: await app.getUrl() };
+}
+
+integration("Stage 6D.3C3F guarded atomic HTTP create", () => {
+  const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: baseUrl });
+  const noGuard = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: missingUrl });
+  const fakeGuard = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: fakeUrl });
+  const previousFlag = process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS;
+  let app: INestApplication;
+  let origin: string;
+  let fault: Fault | null = null;
+  let attempts = 0;
+  let failReadOnce = false;
+
+  const injected = new Proxy(prisma, { get(target, key) {
+    if (key === "order") return new Proxy(target.order, { get(delegate, method) {
+      if (method === "findUnique" && failReadOnce) return async () => {
+        failReadOnce = false;
+        throw new Error("private connection unavailable after commit");
+      };
+      const value = Reflect.get(delegate, method, delegate);
+      return typeof value === "function" ? value.bind(delegate) : value;
+    } });
+    if (key === "$transaction") return async (work: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<unknown>, options: unknown) => {
+      attempts += 1;
+      const outcome = await target.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+        const wrapped = new Proxy(tx, { get(transaction, method) {
+          if (method === "order") return new Proxy(transaction.order, { get(delegate, operation) {
+            if (operation === "create") return (args: any) => {
+              if (fault === "missing_item" || fault === "skip_immediate") args = { ...args, data: { ...args.data, items: undefined } };
+              if (fault === "missing_snapshot") args = { ...args, data: { ...args.data, cartSnapshot: Prisma.DbNull } };
+              if (fault === "total_mismatch") args = { ...args, data: { ...args.data, totalAmount: "1" } };
+              if (fault === "options_mismatch") args = { ...args, data: { ...args.data,
+                items: { create: args.data.items.create.map((line: any) => ({ ...line, options: { ...line.options, tampered: true } })) } } };
+              return delegate.create(args);
+            };
+            if (operation === "update" && fault === "missing_seal") return (args: any) => delegate.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: args.where });
+            const value = Reflect.get(delegate, operation, delegate);
+            return typeof value === "function" ? value.bind(delegate) : value;
+          } });
+          if (method === "$executeRawUnsafe") return (...args: unknown[]) => {
+            if (fault === "skip_immediate") return Promise.resolve(0);
+            if (fault === "finalization_failure") throw privatePrismaError("P2010", "23514");
+            const value = transaction.$executeRawUnsafe as (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>;
+            return value.apply(transaction, args);
+          };
+          const value = Reflect.get(transaction, method, transaction);
+          return typeof value === "function" ? value.bind(transaction) : value;
+        } });
+        const result = await work(wrapped);
+        if (fault === "rollback_before_commit") throw new Error("private pre-commit failure");
+        if (fault === "serialization") throw privatePrismaError("P2034");
+        if (fault === "serialization_wrapped") throw privatePrismaError("P2010", "40001");
+        if (fault === "deadlock") throw privatePrismaError("P2010", "40P01");
+        if (fault === "unique_unrelated") throw privatePrismaError("P2002");
+        if (fault === "unrelated") throw privatePrismaError("P2003");
+        return result;
+      }, options as Parameters<PrismaClient["$transaction"]>[1]);
+      if (fault === "lost_response") throw new Error("private response lost after commit");
+      return outcome;
+    };
+    const value = Reflect.get(target, key, target);
+    return typeof value === "function" ? value.bind(target) : value;
+  } });
+
+  async function post(target: string, body: unknown, server = origin, endpoint = "") {
+    const response = await fetch(`${server}/public/menus/${target}/orders/network-test${endpoint}`, {
+      method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body)
+    });
+    return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() as Record<string, any> };
+  }
+  const prepare = () => post("c3f", request, origin, "/prepare");
+  const create = (token: string, key = randomUUID()) => post("c3f", { ...request, acceptanceToken: token, idempotencyKey: key });
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS = "1";
+    await Promise.all([prisma.$connect(), noGuard.$connect(), fakeGuard.$connect()]);
+    const [identity] = await prisma.$queryRaw<{ name: string; address: string | null; port: number | null }[]>`
+      SELECT current_database() AS name, host(inet_server_addr()) AS address, inet_server_port() AS port`;
+    if (identity.name !== expectedName || identity.address !== "127.0.0.1" || identity.port !== 55440) {
+      throw new Error("Atomic test database identity is not disposable");
+    }
+    const priorRestaurants = await prisma.restaurant.findMany({ select: { id: true } });
+    if (priorRestaurants.some((row) => ![restaurantId, otherRestaurantId].includes(row.id))) {
+      throw new Error("Refusing unrelated test fixtures");
+    }
+    // This exact isolated database is reusable for the suite, never a shared or existing OrderSawa DB.
+    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('TRUNCATE "OrderItem", "Order" RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE');
+    await prisma.product.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.product.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId: otherRestaurantId } });
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId: otherRestaurantId } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionFeature.deleteMany({ where: { planId: "c3f-plan" } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.deleteMany({ where: { id: "c3f-plan" } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.deleteMany({ where: { id: restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.deleteMany({ where: { id: otherRestaurantId } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.create({ data: { id: restaurantId, slug: "c3f", name: "Synthetic Restaurant", currency: "EGP" } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.create({ data: { id: otherRestaurantId, slug: "c3f-other", name: "Other Synthetic Restaurant", currency: "EGP" } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.create({ data: { id: "c3f-plan", key: "C3F_TEST", name: "Synthetic plan",
+      features: { create: { id: "c3f-feature", key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true } } } });
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.create({ data: { id: "c3f-sub", restaurantId, planId: "c3f-plan",
+      status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") } });
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.create({ data: { id: "c3f-other-sub", restaurantId: otherRestaurantId,
+      planId: "c3f-plan", status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") } });
+    await prisma.product.create({ data: { id: productId, restaurantId, slug: "pizza", name: "Synthetic Pizza", currency: "EGP",
+      basePrice: null, configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: config } });
+    await prisma.product.create({ data: { id: otherProductId, restaurantId: otherRestaurantId, slug: "pizza",
+      name: "Other Synthetic Pizza", currency: "EGP", basePrice: null, configurationVersion: 1,
+      configurationTree: { ...config, productId: otherProductId } } });
+    const started = await appFor(injected);
+    app = started.app;
+    origin = started.origin;
+  });
+
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    fault = null;
+    attempts = 0;
+    failReadOnce = false;
+    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('TRUNCATE "OrderItem", "Order" RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE');
+  });
+
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    if (app) await app.close();
+    await Promise.all([prisma.$disconnect(), noGuard.$disconnect(), fakeGuard.$disconnect()]);
+    if (previousFlag === undefined) delete process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS;
+    else process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS = previousFlag;
+  });
+
+  it("rejects missing and same-name fake completeness guards before any write", async () => {
+    const prepared = await prepare();
+    expect(prepared.status).toBe(200);
+    for (const client of [noGuard, fakeGuard]) {
+      const started = await appFor(client);
+      try {
+        const result = await post("c3f", { ...request, acceptanceToken: prepared.body.acceptanceToken,
+          idempotencyKey: randomUUID() }, started.origin);
+        expect(result.status).toBe(503);
+        expect(result.body.error).toBe("NETWORK_ORDER_DB_GUARD_UNAVAILABLE");
+        expect(await client.order.count()).toBe(0);
+      } finally { await started.app.close(); }
+    }
+  });
+
+  it.each(["missing_item", "missing_snapshot", "missing_seal", "total_mismatch", "options_mismatch",
+    "skip_immediate", "finalization_failure", "rollback_before_commit"] as Fault[])(
+    "fails closed and rolls back for %s", async (kind) => {
+      const prepared = await prepare();
+      fault = kind;
+      const result = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken);
+      expect(result.status).toBe(503);
+      expect(result.body.error).toMatch(/^NETWORK_ORDER_(PERSISTENCE_FAILED|COMMIT_UNCONFIRMED)$/);
+      expect(JSON.stringify(result.body)).not.toMatch(/Prisma|private SQL|stack|23514|P2010/i);
+      expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(0);
+      fault = null;
+      const retried = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken);
+      expect(retried.status).toBe(201);
+      expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+    }
+  );
+
+  it("replays a committed order after its response is lost", async () => {
+    const prepared = await prepare();
+    const key = randomUUID();
+    fault = "lost_response";
+    const first = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key);
+    expect(first.status).toBe(201);
+    expect(first.body.replayed).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+    fault = null;
+    const replay = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key);
+    expect(replay.status).toBe(201);
+    expect(replay.body.orderId).toBe(first.body.orderId);
+    expect(replay.body.replayed).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it("never returns 201 if independent post-commit confirmation cannot read", async () => {
+    const prepared = await prepare();
+    const key = randomUUID();
+    fault = "read_failure";
+    failReadOnce = true;
+    const result = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key);
+    expect(result.status).toBe(503);
+    expect(result.body.error).toBe("NETWORK_ORDER_COMMIT_UNCONFIRMED");
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+    fault = null;
+    const retry = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key);
+    expect(retry.status).toBe(201);
+    expect(retry.body.replayed).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it.each(["serialization", "serialization_wrapped", "deadlock", "unique_unrelated", "unrelated"] as Fault[])(
+    "maps %s without leaking database internals", async (kind) => {
+    const prepared = await prepare();
+    fault = kind;
+    const result = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken);
+    const unrelated = kind === "unrelated" || kind === "unique_unrelated";
+    expect(result.status).toBe(unrelated ? 503 : 409);
+    expect(result.body.error).toBe(kind === "unrelated" ? "NETWORK_ORDER_PERSISTENCE_FAILED"
+      : kind === "unique_unrelated" ? "NETWORK_ORDER_UNRESOLVED_UNIQUE_CONFLICT" : "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE");
+    expect(attempts).toBe(unrelated ? 2 : 4); // one Prepare plus Create retries
+    expect(JSON.stringify(result.body)).not.toMatch(/Prisma|private SQL|stack|40P01|P2034/i);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects bad acceptance and duplicate token while preserving exact-key replay", async () => {
+    const prepared = await prepare();
+    const key = randomUUID();
+    expect((await create("bad-token", key)).status).toBe(409);
+    const first = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key);
+    expect(first.status).toBe(201);
+    const replay = await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key);
+    expect(replay.status).toBe(201);
+    expect(replay.body.orderId).toBe(first.body.orderId);
+    expect((await create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, randomUUID())).body.error).toBe("ACCEPTANCE_TOKEN_ALREADY_USED");
+    const changed = await post("c3f", { ...request, locale: "ar", acceptanceToken: prepared.body.acceptanceToken,
+      idempotencyKey: key });
+    expect(changed.status).toBe(409);
+    expect(changed.body.error).toBe("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED");
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it.each([1, 5, 10, 25])("keeps %i distinct same-tenant HTTP Creates atomic", async (concurrency) => {
+    const requests = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, async (_, index) => {
+      const body = { ...request, orderNote: `Distinct synthetic ${index}-${randomUUID()}` };
+      const prepared = await post("c3f", body, origin, "/prepare");
+      expect(prepared.status).toBe(200);
+      return { ...body, idempotencyKey: randomUUID(), acceptanceToken: prepared.body.acceptanceToken };
+    }));
+    attempts = 0;
+    const started = performance.now();
+    const responses = await Promise.all(requests.map((body) => post("c3f", body)));
+    const elapsed = performance.now() - started;
+    const success = responses.filter((response) => response.status === 201);
+    const conflicts = responses.filter((response) => response.status === 409);
+    expect(success.length + conflicts.length).toBe(concurrency);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(success.length);
+    const saved = await prisma.order.findMany({ include: { items: true } });
+    expect(saved.every((row) => row.restaurantId === restaurantId && row.networkSnapshotSealedAt
+      && row.totalAmount.toString() === "12.000001" && row.items.length === 1)).toBe(true);
+    process.stdout.write(`C3F_HTTP_WAVE=${JSON.stringify({ type: "distinct_same_tenant", concurrency,
+      success: success.length, conflicts: conflicts.length, transactionAttempts: attempts,
+      elapsedMs: +elapsed.toFixed(2) })}\n`);
+  });
+
+  it.each([5, 10, 25])("isolates %i distinct Creates across two restaurants", async (concurrency) => {
+    const requests = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, async (_, index) => {
+      const other = index % 2 === 1;
+      const slug = other ? "c3f-other" : "c3f";
+      const body = { ...(other ? otherRequest : request), orderNote: `Cross-tenant synthetic ${index}-${randomUUID()}` };
+      const prepared = await post(slug, body, origin, "/prepare");
+      expect(prepared.status).toBe(200);
+      return { slug, body: { ...body, idempotencyKey: randomUUID(), acceptanceToken: prepared.body.acceptanceToken } };
+    }));
+    attempts = 0;
+    const started = performance.now();
+    const responses = await Promise.all(requests.map(({ slug, body }) => post(slug, body)));
+    const elapsed = performance.now() - started;
+    const success = responses.filter((response) => response.status === 201);
+    const conflicts = responses.filter((response) => response.status === 409);
+    expect(success.length + conflicts.length).toBe(concurrency);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(success.length);
+    const saved = await prisma.order.findMany({ include: { items: true } });
+    expect(saved.every((row) => [restaurantId, otherRestaurantId].includes(row.restaurantId)
+      && row.networkSnapshotSealedAt && row.totalAmount.toString() === "12.000001"
+      && row.items.length === 1 && (row.cartSnapshot as any).items[0].productId
+        === (row.restaurantId === restaurantId ? productId : otherProductId))).toBe(true);
+    process.stdout.write(`C3F_HTTP_WAVE=${JSON.stringify({ type: "distinct_two_tenants", concurrency,
+      success: success.length, conflicts: conflicts.length, transactionAttempts: attempts,
+      elapsedMs: +elapsed.toFixed(2) })}\n`);
+  });
+
+  it.each([5, 10, 25])("prevents duplicates for %i same-key and same-token submissions", async (concurrency) => {
+    const prepared = await prepare();
+    expect(prepared.status).toBe(200);
+    const key = randomUUID();
+    attempts = 0;
+    const started = performance.now();
+    const sameKey = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, () =>
+      create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, key)));
+    const sameKeyElapsed = performance.now() - started;
+    expect(sameKey.every((response) => [201, 409].includes(response.status))).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+    expect(new Set(sameKey.filter((response) => response.status === 201).map((response) => response.body.orderId)).size).toBe(1);
+    const tokenResponses = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, () =>
+      create(prepared.body.acceptanceToken, randomUUID())));
+    expect(tokenResponses.every((response) => response.status === 409)).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+    process.stdout.write(`C3F_HTTP_WAVE=${JSON.stringify({ type: "duplicate_key_token", concurrency,
+      sameKeySuccess: sameKey.filter((response) => response.status === 201).length,
+      sameKey409: sameKey.filter((response) => response.status === 409).length,
+      reusedToken409: tokenResponses.length, transactionAttempts: attempts,
+      sameKeyElapsedMs: +sameKeyElapsed.toFixed(2) })}\n`);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects 10 concurrent changed payloads for one idempotency key", async () => {
+    const key = randomUUID();
+    const requests = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 10 }, async (_, index) => {
+      const body = { ...request, orderNote: `Different payload ${index}` };
+      const prepared = await post("c3f", body, origin, "/prepare");
+      expect(prepared.status).toBe(200);
+      return { ...body, idempotencyKey: key, acceptanceToken: prepared.body.acceptanceToken };
+    }));
+    const responses = await Promise.all(requests.map((body) => post("c3f", body)));
+    expect(responses.filter((response) => response.status === 201)).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(responses.filter((response) => response.status === 409)).toHaveLength(9);
+    expect(responses.filter((response) => response.status === 409).every((response) =>
+      ["IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED", "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE"].includes(response.body.error))).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders.controller.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders.controller.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a01ebce
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders.controller.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+import { Body, CanActivate, Controller, ExecutionContext, ForbiddenException, Get, Header, HttpCode, Inject, Injectable, Param, Post, UseGuards } from "@nestjs/common";
+import type { Request } from "express";
+import { NetworkOrdersService } from "./network-orders.service";
+
+@Injectable()
+export class NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard implements CanActivate {
+  canActivate(context: ExecutionContext) {
+    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest<Request>();
+    const address = request.socket.remoteAddress;
+    if (address !== "127.0.0.1" && address !== "::1" && address !== "::ffff:127.0.0.1") {
+      throw new ForbiddenException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_TEST_LOOPBACK_REQUIRED" });
+    }
+    return true;
+  }
+}
+
+/** Test-only endpoints. The service checks the actual disposable DB target before any write. */
+@Controller("public/menus/:restaurantSlug/orders/network-test")
+@UseGuards(NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard)
+export class NetworkOrdersController {
+  constructor(@Inject(NetworkOrdersService) private readonly orders: NetworkOrdersService) {}
+
+  @Post("prepare")
+  @HttpCode(200)
+  @Header("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate")
+  prepare(@Param("restaurantSlug") restaurantSlug: string, @Body() body: unknown) {
+    return this.orders.prepare(restaurantSlug, body);
+  }
+
+  @Post()
+  @HttpCode(201)
+  @Header("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate")
+  create(@Param("restaurantSlug") restaurantSlug: string, @Body() body: unknown) {
+    return this.orders.create(restaurantSlug, body);
+  }
+
+  @Get(":orderId/preview")
+  @Header("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate")
+  preview(@Param("restaurantSlug") restaurantSlug: string, @Param("orderId") orderId: string) {
+    return this.orders.preview(restaurantSlug, orderId);
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,505 @@
+import { INestApplication, Module } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { NestFactory } from "@nestjs/core";
+import { PrismaClient, type Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
+import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard, NetworkOrdersController } from "./network-orders.controller";
+import { NetworkOrdersService } from "./network-orders.service";
+import { PrismaService } from "../prisma/prisma.service";
+import { FeatureFlagsService } from "../feature-flags/feature-flags.service";
+import { PublicMenuService } from "../public-menu/public-menu.service";
+import { formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage } from "./network-order-whatsapp-formatter";
+
+const databaseUrl = process.env.NETWORK_ORDER_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
+if (databaseUrl) {
+  const parsed = new URL(databaseUrl);
+  if (!(["127.0.0.1", "localhost"].includes(parsed.hostname) && parsed.port === "55440"
+    && parsed.pathname.startsWith("/ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_"))) {
+    throw new Error("Stage 6C tests refuse non-disposable database URLs");
+  }
+}
+const integration = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;
+
+const pizza = {
+  schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-pizza", revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+  groups: [
+    { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [
+      { id: "small", label: "Small", price: "100" },
+      { id: "medium", label: "Medium", price: "200.000001" }
+    ] },
+    { type: "OPTIONS", id: "toppings", label: "Toppings", min: 0, max: 3, includedQuantity: 1,
+      options: [{ id: "cheese", label: "Cheese", price: "30.000001", maxQuantity: 3,
+        children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "sauces", label: "Sauces", min: 0, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0,
+          options: [{ id: "bbq", label: "BBQ", price: "5.000001", maxQuantity: 1 }] }] }] }
+  ]
+};
+const source = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-source", revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+  groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "source-sizes", label: "Source sizes", sizes: [
+    { id: "source-small", label: "Small", price: "100" },
+    { id: "source-large", label: "Large", price: "200" }
+  ] }] };
+const combo = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-combo", revision: 1, basePrice: "0",
+  groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: "Slots", min: 3, max: 3, includedQuantity: 0, options: [
+    { id: "original", label: "First pizza", price: "10", maxQuantity: 2,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "s6c-source", mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: { "source-small": "5", "source-large": "8" } } },
+    { id: "custom", label: "Extra pizza", price: "3", maxQuantity: 1,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "s6c-source", mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: {
+        schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-source", revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+        groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "custom-sizes", label: "Pizza sizes", sizes: [{ id: "custom-one", label: "Medium", price: "7" }] }]
+      } } }
+  ] }] };
+
+function pizzaSelection(revision = 1) {
+  return { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-pizza", configurationRevision: revision, groups: [
+    { type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" },
+    { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "toppings", instances: [
+      { instanceId: "cheese-1", optionId: "cheese", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "sauces", instances: [{ instanceId: "sauce-1", optionId: "bbq" }] }] },
+      { instanceId: "cheese-2", optionId: "cheese" },
+      { instanceId: "cheese-3", optionId: "cheese" }
+    ] }
+  ] };
+}
+
+function comboSelection() {
+  return { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-combo", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{
+    type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "slots", instances: [
+      { instanceId: "original-1", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-source", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-small" }] } },
+      { instanceId: "original-2", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-source", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-large" }] } },
+      { instanceId: "custom-1", optionId: "custom", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6c-source", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "custom-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "custom-one" }] } }
+    ]
+  }] };
+}
+
+const pizzaDraft = () => ({ locale: "ar", items: [{ productId: "s6c-pizza", quantity: 2, selection: pizzaSelection() }] });
+const comboDraft = () => ({ locale: "ar", items: [{ productId: "s6c-combo", quantity: 1, selection: comboSelection() }] });
+
+integration("Stage 6C disposable PostgreSQL HTTP and transaction integration", () => {
+  const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: databaseUrl });
+  let app: INestApplication;
+  let origin: string;
+  const previousFlag = process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS;
+
+  async function post(path: string, body: unknown) {
+    const response = await fetch(`${origin}/public/menus/${path}`, {
+      method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body)
+    });
+    return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() as Record<string, any> };
+  }
+  const prepare = (body: unknown = pizzaDraft(), restaurant = "s6c-r1") => post(`${restaurant}/orders/network-test/prepare`, body);
+  const create = (body: unknown, restaurant = "s6c-r1") => post(`${restaurant}/orders/network-test`, body);
+  async function preview(orderId: string, restaurant = "s6c-r1") {
+    const response = await fetch(`${origin}/public/menus/${restaurant}/orders/network-test/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}/preview`);
+    return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() as Record<string, any> };
+  }
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS = "1";
+    await prisma.$connect();
+    await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe('TRUNCATE "OrderItem", "Order" RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE');
+    await prisma.analyticsEvent.deleteMany();
+    await prisma.productConfigurationDependency.deleteMany();
+    await prisma.product.deleteMany();
+    await prisma.category.deleteMany();
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.deleteMany();
+    await prisma.subscriptionFeature.deleteMany();
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.deleteMany();
+    await prisma.restaurant.deleteMany();
+    await prisma.restaurant.createMany({ data: [
+      { id: "s6c-r1", slug: "s6c-r1", name: "Stage 6C Restaurant", currency: "EGP", whatsappPhone: "201000000000" },
+      { id: "s6c-r2", slug: "s6c-r2", name: "Other Restaurant", currency: "EGP" }
+    ] });
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.create({ data: {
+      id: "s6c-plan", key: "S6C_TEST", name: "Stage 6C disposable plan",
+      features: { create: [
+        { id: "s6c-feature", key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true },
+        { id: "s6c-whatsapp-feature", key: "WHATSAPP_ORDERING", enabled: true }
+      ] }

+    const writer = prisma.$transaction(async (transaction) => {

+    release();

+    await expect(legacyService.createWhatsappOrder("s6c-r1", { items: [{ productSlug: "pizza", quantity: 1 }] })).rejects.toThrow();
+    expect(await prisma.order.count()).toBe(1);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders.service.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders.service.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c87ed87
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/orders/network-orders.service.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,420 @@
+import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, ForbiddenException, HttpException, Inject, Injectable, NotFoundException, ServiceUnavailableException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
+import {
+  createConfigurationSnapshot,
+  DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS,
+  multiplyMoney,
+  sumMoney,
+  validateMoneyString,
+  type PriceLine,
+  type ProductConfigurationContext,
+  type ProductSelectionV1
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import { PrismaService } from "../prisma/prisma.service";
+import { formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage } from "./network-order-whatsapp-formatter";
+import { assertNetworkOrderCompletenessGuard, NETWORK_ORDER_COMPLETENESS_CONSTRAINT } from "./network-order-db-guard";
+import { resolvePublicProductConfiguration, type PublicConfigurationProductRecord } from "../public-menu/public-product-configuration";
+import { quotePublicProductConfiguration } from "../public-menu/public-product-quote";
+import {
+  issueAcceptanceToken,
+  parseNetworkOrderRequest,
+  sha256,
+  stableJson,
+  verifyAcceptanceToken,
+  type NetworkOrderSnapshotDetails,
+  type NetworkOrderCreateRequest,
+  type NetworkOrderDraftRequest
+} from "./network-order-contract";
+
+type LockedRestaurant = { id: string; slug: string; name: string; currency: string };
+type DraftLine = {
+  productId: string;
+  productName: string;
+  productSlug: string;
+  note?: string;
+  quantity: number;
+  configurationRevision: number;
+  canonicalSelection: ProductSelectionV1;
+  selectionKey: string;
+  linkedSourceRevisions: { sourceProductId: string; mode: "NETWORK" | "LEGACY"; configurationRevision: number }[];
+  unitPrice: string;
+  lineTotal: string;
+  priceBreakdown: PriceLine[];
+  baseIgnored: boolean;
+  configurationTree: unknown;
+  linkedSources: { productId: string; productName: string; mode: "NETWORK" | "LEGACY"; configurationRevision: number; configurationTree: unknown }[];
+};
+
+type Draft = {
+  schemaVersion: 1;
+  restaurantId: string;
+  restaurantSlug: string;
+  currency: string;
+  locale: "ar" | "en";
+  orderDetails: NetworkOrderSnapshotDetails;
+  items: DraftLine[];
+  totalAmount: string;
+  orderingEnabled: false;
+};
+
+type StoredNetworkOrder = Prisma.OrderGetPayload<{ include: { items: true } }>;
+
+function isSealedStoredOrder(order: StoredNetworkOrder): boolean {
+  const snapshot = order.cartSnapshot;
+  if (order.source !== "NETWORK_TEST" || order.status !== "VALIDATED_TEST"
+    || !order.networkSnapshotSealedAt || !snapshot || typeof snapshot !== "object" || Array.isArray(snapshot)) return false;
+  const saved = snapshot as Record<string, unknown>;
+  if (saved.snapshotVersion !== 1 || saved.mode !== "NETWORK" || saved.currency !== order.currency
+    || saved.totalAmount !== order.totalAmount.toString() || !Array.isArray(saved.items)
+    || saved.items.length < 1 || saved.items.length !== order.items.length) return false;
+  const evidence = new Map<string, number>();
+  for (const item of saved.items) {
+    if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || Array.isArray(item)) return false;
+    const key = stableJson(item);
+    evidence.set(key, (evidence.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
+  }
+  for (const item of order.items) {
+    if (!item.productId || !item.options || typeof item.options !== "object" || Array.isArray(item.options)) return false;
+    const line = item.options as Record<string, unknown>;
+    if (line.productId !== item.productId || line.productName !== item.name
+      || line.quantity !== item.quantity || (line.note ?? null) !== item.note
+      || line.currency !== order.currency || line.unitPrice !== item.unitPrice.toString()
+      || line.lineTotal !== item.totalPrice.toString()) return false;
+    const key = stableJson(line);
+    const count = evidence.get(key) ?? 0;
+    if (count === 0) return false;
+    evidence.set(key, count - 1);
+  }
+  return [...evidence.values()].every((count) => count === 0);
+}
+
+function isGuardError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof ServiceUnavailableException
+    && (error.getResponse() as { error?: string }).error === "NETWORK_ORDER_DB_GUARD_UNAVAILABLE";
+}
+
+function moneyFitsDatabase(value: string, path: string) {
+  const issues = validateMoneyString(value, path, DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS);
+  if (issues.length) {
+    throw new BadRequestException({ error: "ORDER_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_DECIMAL_24_6", message: "Amount does not fit DECIMAL(24,6) without rounding.", issues });
+  }
+}
+
+function isSerializationConflict(error: unknown) {
+  return error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError
+    && (error.code === "P2034" || (error.code === "P2010"
+      && (error.meta?.code === "40001" || error.meta?.code === "40P01")));
+}
+
+@Injectable()
+export class NetworkOrdersService {
+  constructor(@Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}
+
+  private async assertDisposableOnly() {
+    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" || process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS !== "1") {
+      throw new ForbiddenException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDERING_DISABLED", message: "Network order creation is disabled outside isolated tests." });
+    }
+    const rows = await this.prisma.$queryRaw<{ name: string; address: string | null; port: number | null }[]>`
+      SELECT current_database() AS name, host(inet_server_addr()) AS address, inet_server_port() AS port
+    `;
+    const target = rows[0];
+    if (!target || !target.name.startsWith("ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_")
+      || target.address !== "127.0.0.1" || target.port !== 55440) {
+      throw new ForbiddenException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_TEST_DATABASE_REQUIRED", message: "An isolated Stage 6C PostgreSQL database is required." });
+    }
+  }
+
+  private async runSerializable<T>(work: (transaction: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
+    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt += 1) {
+      try {
+        return await this.prisma.$transaction(work, {
+          isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.Serializable,
+          maxWait: 10_000,
+          timeout: 20_000
+        });
+      } catch (error) {
+        if (isSerializationConflict(error) && attempt < 2) continue;
+        throw error;
+      }
+    }
+    throw new ConflictException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE", message: "Please retry after the catalog update completes." });
+  }
+
+  private async lockRestaurant(transaction: Prisma.TransactionClient, restaurantSlug: string): Promise<LockedRestaurant> {
+    const restaurants = await transaction.$queryRaw<LockedRestaurant[]>`
+      SELECT "id", "slug", "name", "currency" FROM "Restaurant"
+      WHERE "slug" = ${restaurantSlug} AND "isActive" = true AND "deletedAt" IS NULL
+      FOR SHARE
+    `;
+    const restaurant = restaurants[0];
+    if (!restaurant) throw new NotFoundException("Restaurant not found");
+    return restaurant;
+  }
+
+  private async lockCatalog(transaction: Prisma.TransactionClient, restaurantId: string): Promise<PublicConfigurationProductRecord[]> {
+    const subscriptions = await transaction.$queryRaw<{ planId: string }[]>`
+      SELECT "planId" FROM "RestaurantSubscription" WHERE "restaurantId" = ${restaurantId} FOR SHARE
+    `;
+    const subscription = subscriptions[0];
+    if (!subscription) throw new ForbiddenException({ error: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE" });
+    const featureRows = await transaction.$queryRaw<{ enabled: boolean }[]>`
+      SELECT "enabled" FROM "SubscriptionFeature"
+      WHERE "planId" = ${subscription.planId} AND "key" = 'PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION' FOR SHARE
+    `;
+    if (!featureRows[0]?.enabled) {
+      throw new ForbiddenException({ error: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE", message: "Product Configuration capability is unavailable." });
+    }
+
+    // Row locks conflict with ordinary UPDATE/DELETE writers, not only Serializable writers.
+    // Lock every possible linked source before reading the pricing catalog snapshot.
+    await transaction.$queryRaw<{ id: string }[]>`
+      SELECT "id" FROM "Product" WHERE "restaurantId" = ${restaurantId} ORDER BY "id" FOR SHARE
+    `;
+    const products = await transaction.product.findMany({
+      where: { restaurantId },
+      select: {
+        id: true, slug: true, name: true, basePrice: true, configurationTree: true,
+        configurationVersion: true, isActive: true, isAvailable: true, deletedAt: true
+      }
+    });
+    return products;
+  }
+
+  private buildDraft(
+    restaurant: LockedRestaurant,
+    products: PublicConfigurationProductRecord[],
+    request: NetworkOrderDraftRequest
+  ): Draft {
+    const items: DraftLine[] = request.items.map((line, index) => {
+      const owner = products.find((product) => product.id === line.productId);
+      if (!owner) throw new NotFoundException("Product is not available in this restaurant");
+      const result = quotePublicProductConfiguration({
+        restaurantId: restaurant.id, owner, catalogProducts: products,
+        capabilityEnabled: true, currency: restaurant.currency, selection: line.selection
+      });
+      if (!result.ok) {
+        const payload = { error: result.error.code, message: result.error.message,
+          issues: result.error.issues, currentRevision: result.error.currentRevision, lineIndex: index };
+        if (result.error.status === 409) throw new ConflictException(payload);
+        throw new BadRequestException(payload);
+      }
+      const resolved = resolvePublicProductConfiguration({
+        restaurantId: restaurant.id, owner, catalogProducts: products, capabilityEnabled: true,
+        currency: restaurant.currency
+      });
+      if (!resolved || !resolved.orderable) {
+        throw new ConflictException({ error: "CONFIGURATION_NOT_ORDERABLE", lineIndex: index });
+      }
+      const context: ProductConfigurationContext = {
+        catalogId: restaurant.id,
+        linkedProducts: new Map(resolved.linkedProducts.map((source) => [source.productId, {
+          productId: source.productId, catalogId: restaurant.id,
+          configuration: source.configuration, available: source.available, orderable: source.orderable
+        }]))
+      };
+      const snapshot = createConfigurationSnapshot({
+        configuration: resolved.configuration, selection: result.quote.canonicalSelection,
+        context, productName: owner.name, currency: restaurant.currency,
+        createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
+      });
+      if (!snapshot.valid || !snapshot.snapshot || snapshot.snapshot.total !== result.quote.trustedTotal) {
+        throw new ConflictException({ error: "ORDER_SNAPSHOT_PRICE_MISMATCH", lineIndex: index });
+      }
+      const unitPrice = result.quote.trustedTotal;
+      const lineTotal = multiplyMoney(unitPrice, line.quantity);
+      moneyFitsDatabase(unitPrice, `$items[${index}].unitPrice`);
+      moneyFitsDatabase(lineTotal, `$items[${index}].lineTotal`);
+      return {
+        productId: owner.id, productSlug: owner.slug, productName: owner.name,
+        ...(line.note ? { note: line.note } : {}),
+        quantity: line.quantity, configurationRevision: result.quote.configurationRevision,
+        canonicalSelection: result.quote.canonicalSelection, selectionKey: result.quote.selectionKey,
+        linkedSourceRevisions: result.quote.linkedSourceRevisions,
+        unitPrice, lineTotal, priceBreakdown: snapshot.snapshot.priceLines,
+        baseIgnored: result.quote.baseIgnored,
+        configurationTree: resolved.configuration,
+        linkedSources: resolved.linkedProducts.map((source) => ({
+          productId: source.productId, productName: source.name, mode: source.mode,
+          configurationRevision: source.configuration.revision, configurationTree: source.configuration
+        }))
+      };
+    });
+    const totalAmount = sumMoney(items.map((item) => item.lineTotal));
+    moneyFitsDatabase(totalAmount, "$order.totalAmount");
+    return {
+      schemaVersion: 1, restaurantId: restaurant.id, restaurantSlug: restaurant.slug,
+      currency: restaurant.currency, locale: request.locale, items, totalAmount,
+      orderDetails: {
+        restaurantName: restaurant.name,
+        ...(request.customerName ? { customerName: request.customerName } : {}),
+        ...(request.customerPhone ? { customerPhone: request.customerPhone } : {}),
+        ...(request.fulfillmentType ? { fulfillmentType: request.fulfillmentType } : {}),
+        ...(request.deliveryArea ? { deliveryArea: request.deliveryArea } : {}),
+        ...(request.deliveryNear ? { deliveryNear: request.deliveryNear } : {}),
+        ...(request.deliveryBeside ? { deliveryBeside: request.deliveryBeside } : {}),
+        ...(request.pickupTime ? { pickupTime: request.pickupTime } : {}),
+        ...(request.orderNote ? { orderNote: request.orderNote } : {})
+      },
+      orderingEnabled: false
+    };
+  }
+
+  async prepare(restaurantSlug: string, body: unknown) {
+    await this.assertDisposableOnly();
+    const request = parseNetworkOrderRequest(body, false);
+    try {
+      return await this.runSerializable(async (transaction) => {
+        const restaurant = await this.lockRestaurant(transaction, restaurantSlug);
+        const products = await this.lockCatalog(transaction, restaurant.id);
+        const draft = this.buildDraft(restaurant, products, request);
+        return { draft, acceptanceToken: issueAcceptanceToken(restaurant.id, sha256(draft)),
+          requiresExplicitAcceptance: true, orderingEnabled: false };
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (isSerializationConflict(error)) {
+        throw new ConflictException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE", message: "Catalog changed concurrently; retry with a new quote." });
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /** Read only after the write transaction has ended; never create a new order from this result. */
+  private async findCommittedOrder(
+    restaurantId: string, request: NetworkOrderCreateRequest, requestHash: string, acceptanceTokenHash: string,
+    expectedSnapshot?: unknown
+  ) {
+    const existing = await this.prisma.order.findUnique({
+      where: { restaurantId_idempotencyKey: { restaurantId, idempotencyKey: request.idempotencyKey } },
+      include: { items: true }
+    });
+    if (existing) {
+      if (existing.restaurantId !== restaurantId || existing.idempotencyKey !== request.idempotencyKey
+        || existing.requestHash !== requestHash || existing.acceptanceTokenHash !== acceptanceTokenHash) {
+        throw new ConflictException({ error: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED", message: "This key belongs to a different request." });
+      }
+      if (!isSealedStoredOrder(existing)
+        || (expectedSnapshot !== undefined && stableJson(existing.cartSnapshot) !== stableJson(expectedSnapshot))) {
+        throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_COMMIT_UNCONFIRMED", message: "The saved test order could not be verified." });
+      }
+      return { orderId: existing.id, totalAmount: existing.totalAmount.toString(), currency: existing.currency,
+        status: existing.status, replayed: true, orderingEnabled: false };
+    }
+    const usedToken = await this.prisma.order.findUnique({
+      where: { restaurantId_acceptanceTokenHash: { restaurantId, acceptanceTokenHash } },
+      select: { id: true }
+    });
+    if (usedToken) throw new ConflictException({ error: "ACCEPTANCE_TOKEN_ALREADY_USED" });
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  private async confirmAfterFailure(
+    restaurantSlug: string, request: NetworkOrderCreateRequest, requestHash: string, acceptanceTokenHash: string
+  ) {
+    try {
+      const restaurant = await this.prisma.restaurant.findFirst({
+        where: { slug: restaurantSlug, isActive: true, deletedAt: null }, select: { id: true }
+      });
+      return restaurant ? this.findCommittedOrder(restaurant.id, request, requestHash, acceptanceTokenHash) : null;
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof HttpException) throw error;
+      throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_COMMIT_UNCONFIRMED", message: "The test order outcome could not be verified." });
+    }
+  }
+
+  async create(restaurantSlug: string, body: unknown) {
+    await this.assertDisposableOnly();
+    const request = parseNetworkOrderRequest(body, true);
+    const requestHash = sha256(request);
+    const acceptanceTokenHash = sha256(request.acceptanceToken);
+    let written: { restaurantId: string; orderId: string; snapshot: Prisma.InputJsonValue };
+    try {
+      written = await this.runSerializable(async (transaction) => {
+        await assertNetworkOrderCompletenessGuard(transaction);
+        const restaurant = await this.lockRestaurant(transaction, restaurantSlug);
+        const products = await this.lockCatalog(transaction, restaurant.id);
+        const draft = this.buildDraft(restaurant, products, request);
+        if (!verifyAcceptanceToken(request.acceptanceToken, restaurant.id, sha256(draft))) {
+          throw new ConflictException({
+            error: "NETWORK_ORDER_REQUIRES_NEW_ACCEPTANCE",
+            message: "The accepted quote expired or current configuration/price changed.",
+            requiresCustomerAcceptance: true,
+            changedQuote: draft,
+            acceptanceToken: issueAcceptanceToken(restaurant.id, sha256(draft))
+          });
+        }
+        const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
+        const snapshots = draft.items.map((item) => ({
+          snapshotVersion: 1, mode: "NETWORK", locale: draft.locale, currency: draft.currency,
+          ...item, createdAt
+        }));
+        const snapshot = { snapshotVersion: 1, mode: "NETWORK", locale: draft.locale,
+          orderDetails: draft.orderDetails, totalAmount: draft.totalAmount, currency: draft.currency,
+          items: snapshots, createdAt } as Prisma.InputJsonValue;
+        const order = await transaction.order.create({
+          data: {
+            restaurantId: restaurant.id, totalAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(draft.totalAmount),
+            customerName: draft.orderDetails.customerName, customerPhone: draft.orderDetails.customerPhone,
+            currency: restaurant.currency, status: "VALIDATED_TEST", source: "NETWORK_TEST",
+            idempotencyKey: request.idempotencyKey, requestHash, acceptanceTokenHash,
+            cartSnapshot: snapshot,
+            items: { create: snapshots.map((item) => ({
+              productId: item.productId, name: item.productName, quantity: item.quantity,
+              note: item.note,
+              unitPrice: new Prisma.Decimal(item.unitPrice), totalPrice: new Prisma.Decimal(item.lineTotal),
+              options: item as Prisma.InputJsonValue
+            })) }
+          }
+        });
+        await transaction.order.update({
+          where: { id: order.id }, data: { networkSnapshotSealedAt: new Date() }
+        });
+        // Prisma 5.22 can resolve the callback despite a deferred COMMIT rollback.
+        await transaction.$executeRawUnsafe(`SET CONSTRAINTS ${NETWORK_ORDER_COMPLETENESS_CONSTRAINT} IMMEDIATE`);
+        return { restaurantId: restaurant.id, orderId: order.id, snapshot };
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (isGuardError(error)) throw error;
+      // A failed write, lost response or stale Draft may still be an exact replay of a committed order.
+      const confirmed = await this.confirmAfterFailure(restaurantSlug, request, requestHash, acceptanceTokenHash);
+      if (confirmed) return confirmed;
+      if (isSerializationConflict(error)) {
+        throw new ConflictException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE", message: "Catalog changed concurrently; retry with a new quote." });
+      }
+      if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === "P2002") {
+        throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_UNRESOLVED_UNIQUE_CONFLICT", message: "The test order conflict could not be verified." });
+      }
+      if (error instanceof HttpException) throw error;
+      throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_PERSISTENCE_FAILED", message: "The test order was not saved or could not be confirmed." });
+    }
+    try {
+      const confirmed = await this.findCommittedOrder(
+        written.restaurantId, request, requestHash, acceptanceTokenHash, written.snapshot
+      );
+      if (!confirmed || confirmed.orderId !== written.orderId) {
+        throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_COMMIT_UNCONFIRMED", message: "The test order commit was not confirmed." });
+      }
+      return { ...confirmed, replayed: false };
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof HttpException) throw error;
+      throw new ServiceUnavailableException({ error: "NETWORK_ORDER_COMMIT_UNCONFIRMED", message: "The test order commit was not confirmed." });
+    }
+  }
+
+  async preview(restaurantSlug: string, orderId: string) {
+    await this.assertDisposableOnly();
+    const restaurant = await this.prisma.restaurant.findFirst({
+      where: { slug: restaurantSlug, isActive: true, deletedAt: null }, select: { id: true }
+    });
+    if (!restaurant) throw new NotFoundException("Restaurant not found");
+    const order = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({
+      where: { id: orderId, restaurantId: restaurant.id, source: "NETWORK_TEST", networkSnapshotSealedAt: { not: null } },
+      select: { id: true, cartSnapshot: true, totalAmount: true, currency: true }
+    });
+    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException("Saved test order not found");
+    return {
+      orderId: order.id, message: formatNetworkOrderWhatsappMessage(order.cartSnapshot),
+      totalAmount: order.totalAmount.toString(), currency: order.currency,
+      fromSealedSnapshot: true, orderingEnabled: false
+    };
+  }
+}

diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/products/dto/update-product-configuration.dto.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/products/dto/update-product-configuration.dto.ts

+
+export class UpdateProductConfigurationDto {

diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/products/import/product-import-parser.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/products/import/product-import-parser.ts
index 3ee7a99..fa38422 100644
--- a/apps/api/src/modules/products/import/product-import-parser.ts
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/products/import/product-import-parser.ts
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 import ExcelJS from "exceljs";
 import JSZip from "jszip";

 export const PRODUCT_IMPORT_COLUMNS = [

@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+import { calculateMinimumPrice, calculatePrice, validateConfiguration } from "@menu/shared";
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { initialNetworkSetupConfiguration, isUnpricedNetworkSetup } from "./network-setup-configuration";
+
+describe("persisted Network setup contract", () => {
+  it("is structurally valid but has no sale price or orderable selection", () => {
+    const configuration = initialNetworkSetupConfiguration("setup-product");
+    expect(validateConfiguration(configuration)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(isUnpricedNetworkSetup(configuration)).toBe(true);
+    const context = { catalogId: "restaurant", linkedProducts: new Map() };
+    expect(calculatePrice(configuration, {
+      schemaVersion: 1, productId: "setup-product", configurationRevision: 1, groups: []
+    }, context)).toMatchObject({ valid: false, total: null, issues: [{ code: "MISSING_PRICE_SOURCE" }] });
+    expect(calculateMinimumPrice(configuration, context)).toMatchObject({ orderable: false, minimum: null });
+    expect(isUnpricedNetworkSetup({ ...configuration, basePrice: "0" })).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/products/network-setup-configuration.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/products/network-setup-configuration.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..24b5453
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/products/network-setup-configuration.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+import { ProductConfigurationV1, validateConfiguration } from "@menu/shared";
+
+/** A real, persisted V1 tree with no price source; Shared pricing rejects a sale. */
+export function initialNetworkSetupConfiguration(productId: string): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  const configuration: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision: 1,
+    basePrice: null,
+    groups: []
+  };
+  const issues = validateConfiguration(configuration);
+  if (issues.length) throw new Error("The Network setup configuration no longer satisfies the shared contract");
+  return configuration;
+}
+
+export function isUnpricedNetworkSetup(value: unknown): boolean {
+  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
+  const configuration = value as Partial<ProductConfigurationV1>;
+  return configuration.schemaVersion === 1
+    && configuration.basePrice === null
+    && Array.isArray(configuration.groups)
+    && configuration.groups.length === 0;
+}

+function baseConfiguration(productId: string, revision = 1, basePrice: string | null = null): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision,
+    basePrice,
+    groups: [{
+      type: "SIZE",
+      id: `${productId}-sizes`,
+      label: "Sizes",
+      sizes: [

+        { id: `${productId}-large`, label: "Large", price: "15.999999" }
+      ]
+    }]
+  };
+}
+
+function linkedConfiguration(
+  productId: string,
+  sourceProductId: string,
+  revision = 1,
+  mode: "ORIGINAL" | "CUSTOM" = "ORIGINAL"
+): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision,
+    basePrice: "0",
+    groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      id: `${productId}-combo`,
+      label: "Combo",
+      min: 1,
+      max: 1,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{
+        id: `${productId}-slot`,
+        label: "Linked",
+        price: "20.123456",
+        maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: mode === "ORIGINAL"
+          ? { sourceProductId, mode, originalPriceOverrides: { [`${sourceProductId}-small`]: "1.000001" } }
+          : { sourceProductId, mode, customConfiguration: baseConfiguration(sourceProductId, 1, "3.000000") }
+      }]
+    }]
+  };
+}
+
+function quotePizzaConfiguration(): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "quote-pizza", revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+    groups: [
+      { type: "SIZE", id: "quote-sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [
+        { id: "quote-small", label: "Small", price: "100" },
+        { id: "quote-medium", label: "Medium", price: "200.000001" }
+      ] },
+      { type: "OPTIONS", id: "quote-toppings", label: "Toppings", min: 0, max: 3, includedQuantity: 1, options: [{
+        id: "quote-cheese", label: "Cheese", price: "30.000001", maxQuantity: 3,
+        children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "quote-sauces", label: "Sauces", min: 0, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0, options: [{ id: "quote-bbq", label: "BBQ", price: "5.000001", maxQuantity: 1 }] }]
+      }] }
+    ]
+  };
+}
+
+function quotePizzaSelection(revision = 1) {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "quote-pizza", configurationRevision: revision,
+    groups: [
+      { type: "SIZE", groupId: "quote-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "quote-medium" },
+      { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "quote-toppings", instances: [
+        { instanceId: "cheese-1", optionId: "quote-cheese", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "quote-sauces", instances: [{ instanceId: "sauce-1", optionId: "quote-bbq" }] }] },

+function quoteComboConfiguration(): ProductConfigurationV1 {

+  return { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "quote-combo", revision: 1, basePrice: "0", groups: [{

+function quoteComboSelection() {

+    expect((await legacyHttpOrder()).status).toBe(400);
