+    await prisma.product.update({ where: { id: "quote-pizza" }, data: {
+      configurationTree: updated, configurationVersion: 2, basePrice: null
+    } });
+
+    const stale = await postQuote("stage3-r1", "quote-pizza", { selection: quotePizzaSelection() });
+    expect(stale.status).toBe(409);
+    expect(await stale.json()).toMatchObject({ error: "CONFIGURATION_REVISION_CHANGED", currentRevision: 2 });
+
+    const current = await postQuote("stage3-r1", "quote-pizza", { selection: quotePizzaSelection(2) });
+    expect(current.status).toBe(200);
+    expect(await current.json()).toMatchObject({ data: { trustedTotal: "275.000004", configurationRevision: 2 } });
+  });
+
+  it("rejects direct fractional SYP create, quick-price and Network writes while preserving null Base", async () => {
+    const headers = { "content-type": "application/json", authorization: `Bearer ${ownerToken}`, "x-restaurant-id": "stage3-r1" };
+    const id = "stage6f1-syp-owner";
+    await prisma.restaurant.update({ where: { id: "stage3-r1" }, data: { currency: "SYP" } });
+    try {
+      const create = await fetch(`${httpOrigin}/dashboard/products`, { method: "POST", headers,
+        body: JSON.stringify({ name: "Fractional SYP", basePrice: 12500.5, currency: "SYP" }) });
+      expect(create.status).toBe(400);
+      expect(JSON.stringify(await create.json())).toContain("SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE");
+
+      const quick = await fetch(`${httpOrigin}/dashboard/products/legacy-null-zero/price`, { method: "PATCH", headers,
+        body: JSON.stringify({ basePrice: 0.5 }) });
+      expect(quick.status).toBe(400);
+
+      await prisma.product.create({ data: { id, restaurantId: "stage3-r1", slug: id, name: "SYP Setup", currency: "SYP", basePrice: "0" } });
+      const tree: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: id, revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+        groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [{ id: "small", label: "Small", price: "12500.50" }] }] };
+      const invalid = await fetch(`${httpOrigin}/dashboard/products/${id}/configuration`, { method: "PUT", headers,
+        body: JSON.stringify({ expectedVersion: 0, configuration: tree }) });
+      expect(invalid.status).toBe(400);
+      expect(JSON.stringify(await invalid.json())).toContain("SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE");
+      expect((await prisma.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } })).configurationTree).toBeNull();
+
+      const valid = await fetch(`${httpOrigin}/dashboard/products/${id}/configuration`, { method: "PUT", headers,
+        body: JSON.stringify({ expectedVersion: 0, configuration: { ...tree,
+          groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [{ id: "small", label: "Small", price: "12500.000000" }] }] } }) });
+      expect(valid.status).toBe(200);
+      const saved = await prisma.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
+      expect(saved.basePrice).toBeNull();
+      expect(saved.configurationVersion).toBe(1);
+    } finally {
+      await prisma.restaurant.update({ where: { id: "stage3-r1" }, data: { currency: "EGP" } });
+    }
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..23a7546
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,219 @@
+import { ProductConfigurationV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import {
+  findDependencyCycle,
+  persistProductConfiguration,
+  ProductConfigurationConflictError,
+  ProductConfigurationValidationError
+} from "./product-configuration.persistence";
+
+function configuration(productId = "owner", revision = 1): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision,
+    basePrice: null,
+    groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      id: "group",
+      label: "Combo",
+      min: 0,
+      max: 1,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{ id: "plain", label: "Plain", price: "0.000001", maxQuantity: 1 }]
+    }]
+  };
+}
+
+function transactionHarness(args?: {
+  currency?: string;
+  ownerVersion?: number;
+  sources?: Array<{ id: string; configurationTree: object | null; configurationVersion: number }>;
+  existingEdges?: Array<{ productId: string; sourceProductId: string }>;
+}) {
+  const transaction = {
+    restaurant: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ currency: args?.currency ?? "EGP" }) },
+    product: {
+      findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ configurationVersion: args?.ownerVersion ?? 0 }),
+      findMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(args?.sources ?? []),
+      updateMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 })
+    },
+    productConfigurationDependency: {
+      findMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(args?.existingEdges ?? []),
+      deleteMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 }),
+      createMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 })
+    }
+  };
+  const prisma = {
+    $transaction: vi.fn(async (callback: (tx: typeof transaction) => unknown) => callback(transaction))
+  };
+  return { prisma, transaction };
+}
+
+describe("product configuration persistence preparation", () => {
+  it("rejects a fractional SYP option in the same transaction before any write", async () => {
+    const { prisma, transaction } = transactionHarness({ currency: "ل.س" });
+    await expect(persistProductConfiguration(prisma as any, {
+      restaurantId: "restaurant-1", productId: "owner", expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: configuration()
+    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ kind: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_VALIDATION",
+      issues: [expect.objectContaining({ code: "SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE" })] });
+    expect(transaction.product.updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+  it("detects a linked-product cycle", () => {
+    expect(findDependencyCycle([
+      { productId: "a", sourceProductId: "b" },
+      { productId: "b", sourceProductId: "c" },
+      { productId: "c", sourceProductId: "a" }
+    ])).toEqual(["a", "b", "c", "a"]);
+  });
+
+  it("accepts an acyclic dependency graph", () => {
+    expect(findDependencyCycle([
+      { productId: "a", sourceProductId: "b" },
+      { productId: "a", sourceProductId: "c" },
+      { productId: "b", sourceProductId: "c" }
+    ])).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it("writes tree, base, version, availability guard, and dependency replacement atomically", async () => {
+    const { prisma, transaction } = transactionHarness();
+    const value = configuration();
+
+    await expect(persistProductConfiguration(prisma as any, {
+      restaurantId: "restaurant-1",
+      productId: "owner",
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: value,
+      disablePublicOrdering: true
+    })).resolves.toEqual({ productId: "owner", configurationVersion: 1, dependencyCount: 0 });
+
+    expect(prisma.$transaction).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(transaction.product.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
+      where: expect.objectContaining({ restaurantId: "restaurant-1", configurationVersion: 0 }),
+      data: expect.objectContaining({ basePrice: null, configurationVersion: 1, isAvailable: false })
+    }));
+    expect(transaction.productConfigurationDependency.deleteMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
+      where: { productId: "owner" }
+    });
+  });
+
+  it("requires a single next revision", async () => {
+    const { prisma } = transactionHarness();
+    await expect(persistProductConfiguration(prisma as any, {
+      restaurantId: "restaurant-1",
+      productId: "owner",
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: configuration("owner", 2)
+    })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ProductConfigurationConflictError);
+    expect(prisma.$transaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("rejects an invalid self-link before opening a transaction", async () => {
+    const { prisma } = transactionHarness();
+    const value = configuration();
+    value.groups = [{
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      id: "links",
+      label: "Links",
+      min: 0,
+      max: 1,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{
+        id: "self",
+        label: "Self",
+        price: "0",
+        maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "owner", mode: "ORIGINAL" }
+      }]
+    }];
+
+    await expect(persistProductConfiguration(prisma as any, {
+      restaurantId: "restaurant-1",
+      productId: "owner",
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: value
+    })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ProductConfigurationValidationError);
+    expect(prisma.$transaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("rejects missing/cross-restaurant sources and unconfigured ORIGINAL sources before update", async () => {
+    const linked = configuration();
+    linked.groups = [{
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      id: "links",
+      label: "Links",
+      min: 0,
+      max: 1,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{
+        id: "slot",
+        label: "Pizza",
+        price: "10",
+        maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "ORIGINAL" }
+      }]
+    }];
+
+    const missing = transactionHarness({ sources: [] });
+    await expect(persistProductConfiguration(missing.prisma as any, {
+      restaurantId: "restaurant-1",
+      productId: "owner",
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: linked
+    })).rejects.toThrow("missing or outside the restaurant");
+    expect(missing.transaction.product.updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+
+    const unconfigured = transactionHarness({
+      sources: [{ id: "source", configurationTree: null, configurationVersion: 0 }]
+    });
+    await expect(persistProductConfiguration(unconfigured.prisma as any, {
+      restaurantId: "restaurant-1",
+      productId: "owner",
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: linked
+    })).rejects.toMatchObject({
+      code: "ORIGINAL_LINKED_SOURCE_REQUIRES_NETWORK_CONFIGURATION",
+      details: {
+        sourceProductIds: ["source"],
+        allowedWithoutSourceConversion: ["CUSTOM"],
+        requiresExplicitSourceConfigurationForOriginal: true
+      }
+    });
+    expect(unconfigured.transaction.product.updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a deep cycle before replacing dependency edges", async () => {
+    const linked = configuration();
+    linked.groups = [{
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      id: "links",
+      label: "Links",
+      min: 0,
+      max: 1,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{
+        id: "slot",
+        label: "B",
+        price: "0",
+        maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "b", mode: "ORIGINAL" }
+      }]
+    }];
+    const { prisma, transaction } = transactionHarness({
+      sources: [{ id: "b", configurationTree: {}, configurationVersion: 1 }],
+      existingEdges: [
+        { productId: "b", sourceProductId: "c" },
+        { productId: "c", sourceProductId: "owner" }
+      ]
+    });
+
+    await expect(persistProductConfiguration(prisma as any, {
+      restaurantId: "restaurant-1",
+      productId: "owner",
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: linked
+    })).rejects.toThrow("cycle detected");
+    expect(transaction.productConfigurationDependency.deleteMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1437a8b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.persistence.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,244 @@
+import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
+import {
+  collectDependencyEdges,
+  type FeatureKey,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  validateConfiguration,
+  validateConfigurationCurrency
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+
+export class ProductConfigurationValidationError extends Error {
+  readonly kind = "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_VALIDATION" as const;
+
+  constructor(readonly issues: ReturnType<typeof validateConfiguration>) {
+    super("Product configuration validation failed");
+  }
+}
+
+export class ProductConfigurationConflictError extends Error {
+  readonly kind = "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT" as const;
+
+  constructor(
+    message: string,
+    readonly code = "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT",
+    readonly details?: Record<string, unknown>
+  ) {
+    super(message);
+  }
+}
+
+export class ProductConfigurationCapabilityError extends Error {
+  readonly kind = "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_DENIED" as const;
+}
+
+export type PersistProductConfigurationInput = {
+  restaurantId: string;
+  productId: string;
+  expectedVersion: number;
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  disablePublicOrdering?: boolean;
+  requiredCapabilityKey?: FeatureKey;
+};
+
+type DependencyPair = {
+  productId: string;
+  sourceProductId: string;
+};
+
+export function findDependencyCycle(edges: readonly DependencyPair[]): string[] | null {
+  const adjacency = new Map<string, string[]>();
+  for (const edge of edges) {
+    const targets = adjacency.get(edge.productId) ?? [];
+    targets.push(edge.sourceProductId);
+    adjacency.set(edge.productId, targets);
+  }
+
+  const state = new Map<string, "VISITING" | "VISITED">();
+  const stack: string[] = [];
+
+  function visit(productId: string): string[] | null {
+    state.set(productId, "VISITING");
+    stack.push(productId);
+    for (const sourceProductId of adjacency.get(productId) ?? []) {
+      if (state.get(sourceProductId) === "VISITING") {
+        const start = stack.indexOf(sourceProductId);
+        return [...stack.slice(start), sourceProductId];
+      }
+      if (!state.has(sourceProductId)) {
+        const cycle = visit(sourceProductId);
+        if (cycle) return cycle;
+      }
+    }
+    stack.pop();
+    state.set(productId, "VISITED");
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  for (const productId of adjacency.keys()) {
+    if (!state.has(productId)) {
+      const cycle = visit(productId);
+      if (cycle) return cycle;
+    }
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+export async function persistProductConfiguration(
+  prisma: PrismaClient,
+  input: PersistProductConfigurationInput
+) {
+  if (input.configuration.productId !== input.productId) {
+    throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError("Configuration productId does not match the target product");
+  }
+  if (input.configuration.revision !== input.expectedVersion + 1) {
+    throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError("Configuration revision must equal expectedVersion + 1");
+  }
+
+  const issues = validateConfiguration(input.configuration);
+  if (issues.length) throw new ProductConfigurationValidationError(issues);
+
+  const configurationTree = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(input.configuration)) as Prisma.InputJsonValue;
+  const edges = collectDependencyEdges(input.configuration);
+  const uniqueSourceIds = [...new Set(edges.map((edge) => edge.sourceProductId))];
+
+  return prisma.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
+    const restaurant = await transaction.restaurant.findUnique({
+      where: { id: input.restaurantId }, select: { currency: true }
+    });
+    if (!restaurant) throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError("Restaurant was not found");
+    const currencyIssues = validateConfigurationCurrency(input.configuration, restaurant.currency);
+    if (currencyIssues.length) throw new ProductConfigurationValidationError(currencyIssues);
+    if (input.requiredCapabilityKey) {
+      const subscription = await transaction.restaurantSubscription.findUnique({
+        where: { restaurantId: input.restaurantId },
+        include: {
+          plan: {
+            include: {
+              features: {
+                where: { key: input.requiredCapabilityKey }
+              }
+            }
+          }
+        }
+      });
+      if (!subscription?.plan.features[0]?.enabled) {
+        throw new ProductConfigurationCapabilityError(
+          "Product Configuration capability is no longer assigned to this restaurant"
+        );
+      }
+    }
+
+    const owner = await transaction.product.findFirst({
+      where: {
+        id: input.productId,
+        restaurantId: input.restaurantId,
+        deletedAt: null
+      },
+      select: { configurationVersion: true }
+    });
+    if (!owner) throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError("Product was not found in the requested restaurant");
+    if (owner.configurationVersion !== input.expectedVersion) {
+      throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError(
+        `Configuration version conflict: expected ${input.expectedVersion}, found ${owner.configurationVersion}`
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (uniqueSourceIds.length) {
+      const sources = await transaction.product.findMany({
+        where: {
+          restaurantId: input.restaurantId,
+          id: { in: uniqueSourceIds },
+          deletedAt: null
+        },
+        select: { id: true, configurationTree: true, configurationVersion: true }
+      });
+      const found = new Set(sources.map((source) => source.id));
+      const missing = uniqueSourceIds.filter((sourceId) => !found.has(sourceId));
+      if (missing.length) {
+        throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError(
+          `Linked products are missing or outside the restaurant: ${missing.join(", ")}`
+        );
+      }
+
+      const originalSourceIds = new Set(
+        edges.filter((edge) => edge.mode === "ORIGINAL").map((edge) => edge.sourceProductId)
+      );
+      const unconfiguredOriginalSources = sources
+        .filter((source) => originalSourceIds.has(source.id))
+        .filter((source) => source.configurationTree === null || source.configurationVersion < 1)
+        .map((source) => source.id);
+      if (unconfiguredOriginalSources.length) {
+        throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError(
+          `ORIGINAL linked products require a saved network configuration: ${unconfiguredOriginalSources.join(", ")}`,
+          "ORIGINAL_LINKED_SOURCE_REQUIRES_NETWORK_CONFIGURATION",
+          {
+            sourceProductIds: unconfiguredOriginalSources,
+            allowedWithoutSourceConversion: ["CUSTOM"],
+            requiresExplicitSourceConfigurationForOriginal: true
+          }
+        );
+      }
+    }
+
+    const existingEdges = await transaction.productConfigurationDependency.findMany({
+      where: {
+        restaurantId: input.restaurantId,
+        productId: { not: input.productId }
+      },
+      select: { productId: true, sourceProductId: true }
+    });
+    const cycle = findDependencyCycle([
+      ...existingEdges,
+      ...edges.map((edge) => ({ productId: input.productId, sourceProductId: edge.sourceProductId }))
+    ]);
+    if (cycle) {
+      throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError(`Linked product cycle detected: ${cycle.join(" -> ")}`);
+    }
+
+    const updated = await transaction.product.updateMany({
+      where: {
+        id: input.productId,
+        restaurantId: input.restaurantId,
+        configurationVersion: input.expectedVersion,
+        deletedAt: null
+      },
+      data: {
+        basePrice:
+          input.configuration.basePrice === null
+            ? null
+            : new Prisma.Decimal(input.configuration.basePrice),
+        configurationTree,
+        configurationVersion: input.configuration.revision,
+        ...(input.disablePublicOrdering ? { isAvailable: false } : {})
+      }
+    });
+    if (updated.count !== 1) {
+      throw new ProductConfigurationConflictError("Configuration changed while the transaction was running");
+    }
+
+    await transaction.productConfigurationDependency.deleteMany({
+      where: { productId: input.productId }
+    });
+    if (edges.length) {
+      await transaction.productConfigurationDependency.createMany({
+        data: edges.map((edge) => ({
+          id: randomUUID(),
+          restaurantId: input.restaurantId,
+          productId: input.productId,
+          sourceProductId: edge.sourceProductId,
+          optionId: edge.optionId,
+          path: edge.path,
+          mode: edge.mode,
+          configurationVersion: input.configuration.revision
+        }))
+      });
+    }
+
+    return {
+      productId: input.productId,
+      configurationVersion: input.configuration.revision,
+      dependencyCount: edges.length
+    };
+  }, { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.Serializable });
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.service.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.service.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8e10ab4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.service.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,239 @@
+import { BadRequestException, ConflictException, ForbiddenException, NotFoundException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { ProductConfigurationV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+
+import { ProductConfigurationService } from "./product-configuration.service";
+
+function configuration(
+  productId = "product-1",
+  revision = 1,
+  basePrice: string | null = "12.345678"
+): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision,
+    basePrice,
+    groups: [
+      {
+        type: "OPTIONS",
+        id: "group-1",
+        label: "Extras",
+        min: 0,
+        max: 3,
+        includedQuantity: 1,
+        options: [{ id: "option-1", label: "Cheese", price: "0.100001", maxQuantity: 3 }]
+      }
+    ]
+  };
+}
+
+function createHarness() {
+  const transaction = {
+    restaurant: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ currency: "EGP" }) },
+    restaurantSubscription: {
+      findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
+        plan: { features: [{ key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true }] }
+      })
+    },
+    product: {
+      findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ configurationVersion: 0 }),
+      findMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
+      updateMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 })
+    },
+    productConfigurationDependency: {
+      findMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
+      deleteMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 }),
+      createMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 })
+    }
+  };
+  const prisma = {
+    product: { findFirst: vi.fn() },
+    $transaction: vi.fn(async (callback: (tx: typeof transaction) => unknown) => callback(transaction))
+  };
+  const featureFlags = {
+    canUseAssignedFeature: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
+    assertAssignedFeature: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
+  };
+  return {
+    prisma,
+    transaction,
+    featureFlags,
+    service: new ProductConfigurationService(prisma as any, featureFlags as any)
+  };
+}
+
+describe("ProductConfigurationService", () => {
+  it("distinguishes a legacy product and preserves a zero base price", async () => {
+    const { service, prisma } = createHarness();
+    prisma.product.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
+      id: "product-1",
+      basePrice: new Prisma.Decimal("0.000000"),
+      configurationTree: null,
+      configurationVersion: 0,
+      isAvailable: true
+    });
+
+    await expect(service.get("restaurant-1", "product-1")).resolves.toMatchObject({
+      mode: "LEGACY",
+      basePrice: "0",
+      configurationVersion: 0,
+      orderabilityState: "LEGACY"
+    });
+  });
+
+  it("preserves null base and exposes configured data after capability loss", async () => {
+    const { service, prisma, featureFlags } = createHarness();
+    featureFlags.canUseAssignedFeature.mockResolvedValue(false);
+    prisma.product.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
+      id: "product-1",
+      basePrice: null,
+      configurationTree: configuration("product-1", 4, null),
+      configurationVersion: 4,
+      isAvailable: false
+    });
+
+    await expect(service.get("restaurant-1", "product-1")).resolves.toMatchObject({
+      mode: "NETWORK",
+      basePrice: null,
+      configurationVersion: 4,
+      capability: { canRead: true, canWrite: false },
+      orderabilityState: "ACTION_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY"
+    });
+  });
+
+  it("does not disclose another tenant's product", async () => {
+    const { service, prisma } = createHarness();
+    prisma.product.findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
+    await expect(service.get("restaurant-other", "product-1")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);
+  });
+
+  it("saves a valid six-decimal configuration with the atomic persistence helper", async () => {
+    const { service, prisma, transaction } = createHarness();
+    prisma.product.findFirst
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: "product-1" })
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce({
+        id: "product-1",
+        basePrice: new Prisma.Decimal("12.345678"),
+        configurationTree: configuration(),
+        configurationVersion: 1,
+        isAvailable: false
+      });
+    await expect(service.save("restaurant-1", "product-1", {
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: configuration()
+    })).resolves.toMatchObject({ mode: "NETWORK", configurationVersion: 1, basePrice: "12.345678" });
+
+    expect(prisma.$transaction).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(transaction.product.updateMany.mock.calls[0][0].data).not.toHaveProperty("isAvailable");
+  });
+
+  it("rejects malformed, self-linked, mismatched, and skipped-revision requests before persistence", async () => {
+    const { service } = createHarness();
+    const selfLinked = configuration();
+    selfLinked.groups = [{
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      id: "links",
+      label: "Links",
+      min: 0,
+      max: 1,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{
+        id: "self",
+        label: "Self",
+        price: "0",
+        maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "product-1", mode: "ORIGINAL" }
+      }]
+    }];
+
+    const cases = [
+      { expectedVersion: 0, configuration: [] as any },
+      { expectedVersion: 0, configuration: selfLinked },
+      { expectedVersion: 0, configuration: configuration("other-product") },
+      { expectedVersion: 0, configuration: configuration("product-1", 2) }
+    ];
+
+    for (const dto of cases) {
+      try {
+        await service.save("restaurant-1", "product-1", dto);
+        throw new Error("Expected validation failure");
+      } catch (error) {
+        expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
+        expect((error as BadRequestException).getResponse()).toMatchObject({
+          error: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_VALIDATION_FAILED"
+        });
+      }
+    }
+    expect((service as any).prisma.$transaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("denies writes when the package capability is absent", async () => {
+    const { service, featureFlags } = createHarness();
+    featureFlags.assertAssignedFeature.mockRejectedValue(new ForbiddenException("locked"));
+    await expect(service.save("restaurant-1", "product-1", {
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: configuration()
+    })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ForbiddenException);
+    expect((service as any).prisma.$transaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("rechecks capability assignment inside the atomic transaction", async () => {
+    const { service, prisma, transaction } = createHarness();
+    prisma.product.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: "product-1" });
+    transaction.restaurantSubscription.findUnique.mockResolvedValue({
+      plan: { features: [{ key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: false }] }
+    });
+
+    await expect(service.save("restaurant-1", "product-1", {
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: configuration()
+    })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ForbiddenException);
+    expect(transaction.product.updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("maps optimistic revision and dependency conflicts to HTTP 409", async () => {
+    const { service, prisma, transaction } = createHarness();
+    prisma.product.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ id: "product-1" });
+    transaction.product.findFirst.mockResolvedValue({ configurationVersion: 2 });
+
+    try {
+      await service.save("restaurant-1", "product-1", {
+        expectedVersion: 0,
+        configuration: configuration()
+      });
+      throw new Error("Expected conflict");
+    } catch (error) {
+      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
+      expect((error as ConflictException).getStatus()).toBe(409);
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("retries serializable transaction conflicts and then succeeds", async () => {
+    const { service, prisma } = createHarness();
+    prisma.product.findFirst
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: "product-1" })
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce({
+        id: "product-1",
+        basePrice: new Prisma.Decimal("12.345678"),
+        configurationTree: configuration(),
+        configurationVersion: 1,
+        isAvailable: false
+      });
+    const serializableError = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError("write conflict", {
+      code: "P2034",
+      clientVersion: "5.22.0"
+    });
+    const transactionImplementation = prisma.$transaction.getMockImplementation()!;
+    prisma.$transaction
+      .mockRejectedValueOnce(serializableError)
+      .mockImplementation(transactionImplementation);
+
+    await service.save("restaurant-1", "product-1", {
+      expectedVersion: 0,
+      configuration: configuration()
+    });
+    expect(prisma.$transaction).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.service.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.service.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..89d4ea5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/products/product-configuration.service.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,216 @@
+import {
+  BadRequestException,
+  ConflictException,
+  ForbiddenException,
+  Inject,
+  Injectable,
+  NotFoundException
+} from "@nestjs/common";
+import { ProductConfigurationV1, validateConfiguration } from "@menu/shared";
+import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
+import { FeatureFlagsService } from "../feature-flags/feature-flags.service";
+import { PrismaService } from "../prisma/prisma.service";
+import { UpdateProductConfigurationDto } from "./dto/update-product-configuration.dto";
+import {
+  persistProductConfiguration,
+  ProductConfigurationCapabilityError,
+  ProductConfigurationConflictError,
+  ProductConfigurationValidationError
+} from "./product-configuration.persistence";
+import { isUnpricedNetworkSetup } from "./network-setup-configuration";
+
+const SERIALIZABLE_RETRY_LIMIT = 3;
+
+@Injectable()
+export class ProductConfigurationService {
+  constructor(
+    @Inject(PrismaService) private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
+    @Inject(FeatureFlagsService) private readonly featureFlags: FeatureFlagsService
+  ) {}
+
+  async get(restaurantId: string, productId: string) {
+    const product = await this.prisma.product.findFirst({
+      where: { id: productId, restaurantId, deletedAt: null },
+      select: {
+        id: true,
+        basePrice: true,
+        configurationTree: true,
+        configurationVersion: true,
+        isAvailable: true
+      }
+    });
+
+    if (!product) throw new NotFoundException("Product not found");
+
+    const capabilityAssigned = await this.featureFlags.canUseAssignedFeature(
+      restaurantId,
+      "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION"
+    );
+    const mode = product.configurationTree !== null && product.configurationVersion > 0 ? "NETWORK" : "LEGACY";
+
+    return {
+      productId: product.id,
+      mode,
+      configurationVersion: product.configurationVersion,
+      configurationTree: product.configurationTree,
+      basePrice: product.basePrice?.toString() ?? null,
+      isAvailable: product.isAvailable,
+      capability: {
+        key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION",
+        assigned: capabilityAssigned,
+        canRead: true,
+        canWrite: capabilityAssigned
+      },
+      orderabilityState:
+        mode === "LEGACY"
+          ? "LEGACY"
+          : !capabilityAssigned
+            ? "ACTION_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY"
+            : isUnpricedNetworkSetup(product.configurationTree)
+              ? "SETUP_INCOMPLETE"
+              : "PUBLIC_INTEGRATION_PENDING"
+    };
+  }
+
+  async save(restaurantId: string, productId: string, dto: UpdateProductConfigurationDto) {
+    await this.featureFlags.assertAssignedFeature(restaurantId, "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION");
+    const configuration = this.validateUntrustedConfiguration(dto.configuration);
+
+    if (configuration.productId !== productId) {
+      throw this.validationException([
+        {
+          code: "CONFIGURATION_PRODUCT_MISMATCH",
+          path: "$configuration.productId",
+          message: "Configuration productId must match the route product ID."
+        }
+      ]);
+    }
+    if (configuration.revision !== dto.expectedVersion + 1) {
+      throw this.validationException([
+        {
+          code: "INVALID_NEXT_REVISION",
+          path: "$configuration.revision",
+          message: "Configuration revision must equal expectedVersion + 1."
+        }
+      ]);
+    }
+
+    const owner = await this.prisma.product.findFirst({
+      where: { id: productId, restaurantId, deletedAt: null },
+      select: { id: true }
+    });
+    if (!owner) throw new NotFoundException("Product not found");
+
+    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= SERIALIZABLE_RETRY_LIMIT; attempt += 1) {
+      try {
+        await persistProductConfiguration(this.prisma, {
+          restaurantId,
+          productId,
+          expectedVersion: dto.expectedVersion,
+          configuration,
+          requiredCapabilityKey: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION"
+        });
+        return this.get(restaurantId, productId);
+      } catch (error) {
+        if (this.isSerializableRetry(error) && attempt < SERIALIZABLE_RETRY_LIMIT) continue;
+        throw this.toHttpException(error);
+      }
+    }
+
+    throw new ConflictException({
+      statusCode: 409,
+      error: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CONCURRENT_UPDATE",
+      message: "The configuration could not be saved after concurrent transaction retries."
+    });
+  }
+
+  private validateUntrustedConfiguration(value: unknown): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+    if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw this.validationException([
+        { code: "INVALID_CONFIGURATION_SHAPE", path: "$configuration", message: "Configuration must be an object." }
+      ]);
+    }
+
+    try {
+      const configuration = value as ProductConfigurationV1;
+      const issues = validateConfiguration(configuration);
+      if (issues.length) throw this.validationException(issues);
+      return configuration;
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof BadRequestException) throw error;
+      throw this.validationException([
+        {
+          code: "INVALID_CONFIGURATION_SHAPE",
+          path: "$configuration",
+          message: "Configuration structure is malformed."
+        }
+      ]);
+    }
+  }
+
+  private validationException(issues: Array<{ code: string; path: string; message: string }>) {
+    return new BadRequestException({
+      statusCode: 400,
+      error: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_VALIDATION_FAILED",
+      message: "Product configuration validation failed",
+      issues
+    });
+  }
+
+  private isSerializableRetry(error: unknown) {
+    return error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === "P2034";
+  }
+
+  private toHttpException(error: unknown): Error {
+    const taggedKind = error && typeof error === "object" && "kind" in error
+      ? error.kind
+      : null;
+    if (
+      error instanceof ProductConfigurationCapabilityError
+      || taggedKind === "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_DENIED"
+    ) {
+      return new ForbiddenException({
+        statusCode: 403,
+        error: "FEATURE_LOCKED",
+        message: "Product Configuration capability is not assigned to the current restaurant package.",
+        featureKey: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION"
+      });
+    }
+    if (
+      error instanceof ProductConfigurationValidationError
+      || taggedKind === "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_VALIDATION"
+    ) {
+      return this.validationException((error as ProductConfigurationValidationError).issues);
+    }
+    if (
+      error instanceof ProductConfigurationConflictError
+      || taggedKind === "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT"
+    ) {
+      return new ConflictException({
+        statusCode: 409,
+        error: error instanceof ProductConfigurationConflictError
+          ? error.code
+          : "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT",
+        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Product configuration conflict",
+        ...(error instanceof ProductConfigurationConflictError && error.details
+          ? { details: error.details }
+          : {})
+      });
+    }
+    if (this.isSerializableRetry(error)) {
+      return new ConflictException({
+        statusCode: 409,
+        error: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CONCURRENT_UPDATE",
+        message: "The configuration changed concurrently; reload and retry."
+      });
+    }
+    if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && error.code === "P2002") {
+      return new ConflictException({
+        statusCode: 409,
+        error: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CONFLICT",
+        message: "The configuration dependency index changed concurrently; reload and retry."
+      });
+    }
+    return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error("Unknown product configuration persistence error");
+  }
+}

+import { ForbiddenException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { ProductConfigurationV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import { ProductsController } from "./products.controller";
+
+const dto = {
+  expectedVersion: 0,
+  configuration: {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId: "product-1",
+    revision: 1,
+    basePrice: "0",
+    groups: []
+  } as ProductConfigurationV1
+};
+
+function request(role: "OWNER" | "MANAGER" | "EDITOR" | "EMPLOYEE") {
+  return { restaurant: { id: "restaurant-1", role } } as any;
+}
+
+describe("ProductsController configuration authorization", () => {
+  it("allows a management role and uses trusted restaurant context", async () => {
+    const configurationService = { save: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({}) };
+    const controller = new ProductsController({} as any, {} as any, configurationService as any);
+
+    await controller.saveConfiguration(request("EDITOR"), "product-1", dto);
+    expect(configurationService.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith("restaurant-1", "product-1", dto);
+  });
+
+  it("denies employees from structural configuration changes", () => {
+    const configurationService = { save: vi.fn() };
+    const controller = new ProductsController({} as any, {} as any, configurationService as any);
+
+    expect(() => controller.saveConfiguration(request("EMPLOYEE"), "product-1", dto))
+      .toThrow(ForbiddenException);
+    expect(configurationService.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});

diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/products/products.service.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/products/products.service.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..53bd453
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/products/products.service.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+import { ConflictException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import { ProductsService } from "./products.service";
+
+function createService(prisma: Record<string, any>) {
+  prisma.restaurant ??= { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ currency: "EGP" }) };
+  return new ProductsService(
+    prisma as any,
+    { getFeatureLimit: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null) } as any,
+    {} as any,
+    { get: vi.fn() } as any
+  );
+}
+
+describe("ProductsService product-configuration compatibility", () => {
+  it("rejects fractional SYP quick prices without mutating a legacy product", async () => {
+    const prisma = { restaurant: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ currency: "SYP" }) },
+      product: { findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: "legacy", configurationTree: null, configurationVersion: 0 }),
+        update: vi.fn() } };
+    await expect(createService(prisma).updatePrice("restaurant-1", "legacy", 12500.5)).rejects.toMatchObject({
+      response: expect.objectContaining({ error: "SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE" })
+    });
+    expect(prisma.product.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+  it("blocks soft deletion when another configuration depends on the product", async () => {
+    const prisma = {
+      product: {
+        findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: "source" }),
+        update: vi.fn()
+      },
+      productConfigurationDependency: {
+        findMany: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([{
+          productId: "owner",
+          optionId: "combo-slot",
+          path: "$configuration.groups[0].options[0]",
+          owner: { name: "Combo" }
+        }])
+      },
+      $transaction: vi.fn(async (callback: (transaction: unknown) => unknown) => callback(prisma))
+    };
+
+    await expect(createService(prisma).delete("restaurant-1", "source")).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
+    expect(prisma.product.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("blocks quick price changes while keeping operational availability independent", async () => {
+    const product = {
+      id: "configured",
+      basePrice: null,
+      configurationTree: { schemaVersion: 1 },
+      configurationVersion: 1,
+      isAvailable: false
+    };
+    const prisma = {
+      product: {
+        findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(product),
+        update: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ...product, isAvailable: true })
+      }
+    };
+    const service = createService(prisma);
+
+    await expect(service.updatePrice("restaurant-1", "configured", 0)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
+    await service.toggleAvailability("restaurant-1", "configured");
+    expect(prisma.product.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
+      where: { id: "configured" },
+      data: { isAvailable: true }
+    });
+  });
+
+  it("keeps legacy quick pricing and preserves null instead of coercing it to zero", async () => {
+    const prisma = {
+      product: {
+        findFirst: vi.fn()
+          .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: "legacy", configurationTree: null, configurationVersion: 0 })
+          .mockResolvedValueOnce({
+            id: "network",
+            slug: "network",
+            name: "Network",
+            basePrice: null,
+            configurationTree: { schemaVersion: 1 },
+            configurationVersion: 1,
+            images: [],
+            options: []
+          }),
+        update: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
+          id: "legacy",
+          slug: "legacy",
+          name: "Legacy",
+          basePrice: new Prisma.Decimal("9.500000"),
+          configurationTree: null,
+          configurationVersion: 0,
+          images: [],
+          options: []
+        })
+      }

+      configurationMode: "NETWORK",
+      configurationVersion: 1
+    });

+

+    await expect(createService(prisma).update("restaurant-1", "configured", {

+      basePrice: 11
+    })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
+    expect(prisma.product.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});

diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/daily-whatsapp-order-number.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/daily-whatsapp-order-number.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..563f31c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/daily-whatsapp-order-number.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+import { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
+
+/** All public WhatsApp order writers must take this restaurant row lock before counting. */
+export async function reserveDailyWhatsappOrderNumber(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, restaurantId: string): Promise<string> {
+  const locked = await tx.$queryRaw<{ id: string }[]>`
+    SELECT "id" FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "id" = ${restaurantId} FOR UPDATE
+  `;
+  if (locked.length !== 1) throw new Error("ORDER_RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE");
+  const start = new Date();
+  start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
+  const end = new Date(start);
+  end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1);
+  const count = await tx.order.count({ where: { restaurantId, createdAt: { gte: start, lt: end } } });
+  return String(count + 1).padStart(3, "0");
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/delivery-fee.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/delivery-fee.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ff666b6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/delivery-fee.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { parseDeliveryFeeInput, readDeliveryFee } from "./delivery-fee";
+
+describe("restaurant delivery fee policy", () => {
+  it("keeps pending, free and fixed fees distinct", () => {
+    expect(parseDeliveryFeeInput(null, "SYP")).toBeNull();
+    expect(parseDeliveryFeeInput("", "SYP")).toBeNull();
+    expect(parseDeliveryFeeInput("0.000000", "SYP")).toBe("0");
+    expect(parseDeliveryFeeInput("12000.000000", "SYP")).toBe("12000");
+    expect(readDeliveryFee({ deliveryFee: "0" }, "SYP")).toBe("0");
+    expect(readDeliveryFee({}, "SYP")).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it("rejects fractional Syrian fees, negatives and malformed stored settings", () => {
+    expect(() => parseDeliveryFeeInput("1.50", "SYP")).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseDeliveryFeeInput("-1", "SYP")).toThrow();
+    expect(() => parseDeliveryFeeInput(5, "SYP")).toThrow();
+    expect(() => readDeliveryFee({ deliveryFee: "2.5" }, "SYP")).toThrow();
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/delivery-fee.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/delivery-fee.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2dc0329
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/delivery-fee.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+import { BadRequestException, ConflictException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { normalizeMoney, validateCurrencyAmount } from "@menu/shared";
+
+/** null means the restaurant will determine the delivery fee by area. */
+export function parseDeliveryFeeInput(value: unknown, currency: string): string | null {
+  if (value === null || value === "") return null;
+  if (typeof value !== "string" || validateCurrencyAmount(value, currency, "$deliveryFee").length) {
+    throw new BadRequestException({ error: "INVALID_DELIVERY_FEE", message: "Delivery fee must be a non-negative amount valid for the restaurant currency." });
+  }
+  return normalizeMoney(value);
+}
+
+export function readDeliveryFee(settings: unknown, currency: string): string | null {
+  const value = settings && typeof settings === "object" && !Array.isArray(settings)
+    ? (settings as Record<string, unknown>).deliveryFee : undefined;
+  if (value === undefined || value === null) return null;
+  if (typeof value !== "string" || validateCurrencyAmount(value, currency, "$deliveryFee").length) {
+    throw new ConflictException({ error: "INVALID_STORED_DELIVERY_FEE", message: "The restaurant delivery fee is not valid for its currency." });
+  }
+  return normalizeMoney(value);
+}

diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/network-readiness.audit.integration.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/network-readiness.audit.integration.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..27dc0a4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/network-readiness.audit.integration.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { NetworkOrdersService } from "../orders/network-orders.service";
+import { PublicMenuService } from "./public-menu.service";
+
+// Audit-only: never point this suite at an existing OrderSawa database.
+const databaseUrl = process.env.NETWORK_READINESS_AUDIT_DATABASE_URL;
+const expectedDatabase = "ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3b_audit";
+if (databaseUrl) {
+  const parsed = new URL(databaseUrl);
+  if (parsed.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || parsed.port !== "55440" || parsed.pathname !== `/${expectedDatabase}`) {
+    throw new Error("Stage 6D.3B audit refuses a non-disposable database URL");
+  }
+}
+const integration = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;
+
+integration("Stage 6D.3B disposable database audit", () => {
+  const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: databaseUrl });
+  const restaurantId = "s6d3b-audit-restaurant";
+  const ownerId = "s6d3b-audit-pizza";
+  const selection = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: ownerId, configurationRevision: 1,
+    groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" }] };
+  const configuration = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: ownerId, revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+    groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [
+      { id: "small", label: "Small", price: "100" },
+      { id: "medium", label: "Medium", price: "120.000001" }
+    ] }] };
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    await prisma.$connect();
+    const [target] = await prisma.$queryRaw<{ name: string; address: string | null; port: number | null }[]>`
+      SELECT current_database() AS name, host(inet_server_addr()) AS address, inet_server_port() AS port
+    `;
+    if (target?.name !== expectedDatabase || target.address !== "127.0.0.1" || target.port !== 55440) {
+      throw new Error("Stage 6D.3B audit is not connected to its dedicated disposable PostgreSQL database");
+    }
+    await prisma.product.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.category.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionFeature.deleteMany({ where: { planId: "s6d3b-audit-plan" } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.deleteMany({ where: { id: "s6d3b-audit-plan" } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.deleteMany({ where: { id: restaurantId } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.create({ data: { id: restaurantId, slug: "s6d3b-audit", name: "Disposable Audit", currency: "EGP" } });
+    await prisma.subscriptionPlan.create({ data: { id: "s6d3b-audit-plan", key: "S6D3B_AUDIT", name: "Disposable audit plan",
+      features: { create: { id: "s6d3b-audit-feature", key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true } } } });
+    await prisma.restaurantSubscription.create({ data: { id: "s6d3b-audit-sub", restaurantId,
+      planId: "s6d3b-audit-plan", status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") } });
+    await prisma.product.create({ data: { id: ownerId, restaurantId, slug: "pizza", name: "Audit Pizza",
+      currency: "EGP", basePrice: null, configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: configuration } });
+  });
+
+  afterAll(async () => { await prisma.$disconnect(); });
+
+  it("keeps both concurrent first-read all-category requests successful after the fix", async () => {
+    await prisma.category.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId, slug: "all" } });
+    let reads = 0;
+    let release!: () => void;
+    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
+    const category = {
+      findUnique: async (args: Parameters<typeof prisma.category.findUnique>[0]) => {
+        const result = await prisma.category.findUnique(args);
+        if (reads < 2) {
+          reads += 1;
+          if (reads === 2) release();
+          await gate; // Both requests observe the missing row before either INSERT.
+        }
+        return result;
+      },
+      create: (args: Parameters<typeof prisma.category.create>[0]) => prisma.category.create(args),
+      update: (args: Parameters<typeof prisma.category.update>[0]) => prisma.category.update(args)
+    };
+    const service = new PublicMenuService({ category } as any, {} as any, {} as any);
+    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
+      (service as any).ensureAllCategory(restaurantId),
+      (service as any).ensureAllCategory(restaurantId)
+    ]);
+    expect(reads).toBe(2);
+    expect(results.filter((result) => result.status === "fulfilled")).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(results.filter((result) => result.status === "rejected")).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(await prisma.category.count({ where: { restaurantId, slug: "all" } })).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it("restores a soft-deleted all category without allocating another ID", async () => {
+    await prisma.category.upsert({
+      where: { restaurantId_slug: { restaurantId, slug: "all" } },
+      create: { restaurantId, slug: "all", name: "الكل" },
+      update: { deletedAt: null }
+    });
+    const original = await prisma.category.findUniqueOrThrow({
+      where: { restaurantId_slug: { restaurantId, slug: "all" } }
+    });
+    await prisma.category.updateMany({ where: { restaurantId, slug: "all" }, data: { deletedAt: new Date() } });
+    const service = new PublicMenuService(prisma as any, {} as any, {} as any);
+    await expect((service as any).ensureAllCategory(restaurantId)).resolves.toBeUndefined();
+    const restored = await prisma.category.findUniqueOrThrow({
+      where: { restaurantId_slug: { restaurantId, slug: "all" } }
+    });
+    expect(restored.id).toBe(original.id);
+    expect(restored.deletedAt).toBeNull();
+    await prisma.category.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId, slug: "all" } });
+  });
+
+  it("maps exhausted Serializable retries in Prepare to a structured conflict", async () => {
+    let attempts = 0;
+    const exhausted = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError("serialization failure", {
+      code: "P2034", clientVersion: "5.22.0"
+    });
+    const service = new NetworkOrdersService({
+      $queryRaw: async () => [{ name: expectedDatabase, address: "127.0.0.1", port: 55440 }],
+      $transaction: async () => { attempts += 1; throw exhausted; }
+    } as any);
+    await expect(service.prepare("s6d3b-audit", { locale: "en", items: [
+      { productId: ownerId, quantity: 1, selection }
+    ] })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 409, response: {
+      error: "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE", message: "Catalog changed concurrently; retry with a new quote."
+    } });
+    expect(attempts).toBe(3);
+  });
+
+  it("measures full-catalog Quote and Serializable Prepare at 10, 100, and 1000 products", async () => {
+    const flags = { canUseAssignedFeature: async () => true };
+    const menu = new PublicMenuService(prisma as any, flags as any, {} as any);
+    const orders = new NetworkOrdersService(prisma as any);
+    const quoteRequest = { selection };
+    const orderRequest = { locale: "en", items: [{ productId: ownerId, quantity: 1, selection }] };
+    let count = 1;
+    const measurements: Array<{ products: number; quoteMedianMs: number; quoteMaxMs: number;
+      prepareMedianMs: number; prepareMaxMs: number; rssMb: number }> = [];
+    for (const target of [10, 100, 1000]) {
+      const batch = Array.from({ length: target - count }, (_, index) => {
+        const id = `s6d3b-legacy-${count + index}`;
+        return { id, restaurantId, slug: id, name: `Legacy ${count + index}`, currency: "EGP", basePrice: "1" };
+      });
+      if (batch.length) await prisma.product.createMany({ data: batch });
+      count = target;
+      const quoteTimes: number[] = [];
+      const prepareTimes: number[] = [];
+      for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 6; iteration += 1) {
+        let start = performance.now();
+        const quote = await menu.productQuote("s6d3b-audit", ownerId, quoteRequest);
+        if (iteration > 0) quoteTimes.push(performance.now() - start);
+        expect(quote.trustedTotal).toBe("120.000001");
+        start = performance.now();
+        const prepared = await orders.prepare("s6d3b-audit", orderRequest);
+        if (iteration > 0) prepareTimes.push(performance.now() - start);
+        expect(prepared.draft.totalAmount).toBe("120.000001");
+      }
+      const median = (values: number[]) => [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(values.length / 2)];
+      measurements.push({ products: target, quoteMedianMs: +median(quoteTimes).toFixed(2),
+        quoteMaxMs: +Math.max(...quoteTimes).toFixed(2), prepareMedianMs: +median(prepareTimes).toFixed(2),
+        prepareMaxMs: +Math.max(...prepareTimes).toFixed(2), rssMb: +(process.memoryUsage().rss / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1) });
+    }
+    console.log("STAGE_6D_3B_BENCHMARK", JSON.stringify(measurements));
+  }, 120_000);
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-legacy-whatsapp-message-format.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-legacy-whatsapp-message-format.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8f826b0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-legacy-whatsapp-message-format.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { PublicMenuService } from "./public-menu.service";
+
+const formatter = (new PublicMenuService({} as never, {} as never, {} as never) as unknown as {
+  buildWhatsappMessage: (input: Record<string, unknown>) => string;
+}).buildWhatsappMessage;
+
+describe("persisted Legacy WhatsApp message presentation", () => {
+  const base = {
+    restaurantName: "مطعم Demo", branchName: "فرع التجربة", orderNumber: "003",
+    fulfillmentType: "pickup", currency: "SYP", showPrices: true,
+    items: [{ name: "بيتزا Demo", quantity: 2, unitPrice: "100", totalPrice: "200",
+      options: ["زيتون"], note: "بدون بصل" }],
+    itemsSubtotal: "200", deliveryFee: null, totalAmount: "200"
+  };
+
+  it("uses the persisted order number, keeps preparation details and puts customer details last", () => {
+    const message = formatter({ ...base, customerName: "خالد", orderNote: "ملاحظة حقيقية" });
+    expect(message).toContain("🧾 طلب جديد رقم 003 — OrderSawa");
+    expect(message).not.toContain("الفرع:");
+    expect(message).toContain("2 × ⁨بيتزا Demo⁩");
+    expect(message).toContain("• ⁨زيتون⁩");
+    expect(message).toContain("*🔸️ ملاحظة الصنف: ⁨بدون بصل⁩*");
+    expect(message.indexOf("مجموع الأصناف")).toBeGreaterThan(message.indexOf("إجمالي الصنف"));
+    expect(message.indexOf("الاسم:")).toBeGreaterThan(message.indexOf("الإجمالي:"));
+    expect(message).toContain("رسوم التوصيل: لا تُضاف للاستلام");
+    expect(message).toContain("*🔸️ ملاحظات الطلب: ⁨ملاحظة حقيقية⁩*");
+    expect(message.indexOf("ملاحظات الطلب")).toBeLessThan(message.indexOf("مجموع الأصناف"));
+    expect(message.replace(/[\u2066-\u2069]/g, "")).not.toMatch(/━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\s+━━━━━━━━━━━━━━/);
+  });
+
+  it("anchors Legacy Arabic lines to RTL and adds only the applicable fulfillment icon", () => {
+    const pickup = formatter({ ...base, pickupTime: "18:30" });
+    expect(pickup.split("\n").filter(Boolean).every((line) => line.startsWith("\u200f"))).toBe(true);
+    expect(pickup).toContain("طريقة الاستلام: 🍽️ استلام من المطعم");
+    expect(pickup).toContain("🕒 وقت الاستلام: ⁨18:30⁩");
+    const delivery = formatter({ ...base, fulfillmentType: "delivery", deliveryArea: "حلب", deliveryNear: "الباسل" });
+    expect(delivery).toContain("طريقة الاستلام: 🛵 توصيل دليفري");
+    expect(delivery).not.toContain("وقت الاستلام:");
+  });
+
+  it("keeps unknown delivery fee explicit and never invents a final amount or address", () => {
+    const message = formatter({ ...base, fulfillmentType: "delivery", deliveryArea: "منطقة أ",
+      deliveryNear: "قرب الحديقة", deliveryFee: null });
+    expect(message).toContain("رسوم التوصيل: تُحدّد حسب المنطقة");
+    expect(message).toContain("الإجمالي: يُحدّد بعد رسوم التوصيل");
+    expect(message).not.toContain("جانب:");
+    expect(message).not.toContain("العنوان:");
+    expect(message).toContain("المنطقة: ⁨منطقة أ⁩");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-menu-race.integration.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-menu-race.integration.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..da29375
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-menu-race.integration.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,198 @@
+import { INestApplication, Module } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import { NestFactory } from "@nestjs/core";
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { FeatureFlagsService } from "../feature-flags/feature-flags.service";
+import { PrismaService } from "../prisma/prisma.service";
+import { PublicMenuController } from "./public-menu.controller";
+import { PublicWhatsappCheckoutService } from "./public-whatsapp-checkout.service";
+import { PublicMenuService } from "./public-menu.service";
+
+const databaseUrl = process.env.PUBLIC_MENU_RACE_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
+const expectedDatabase = "ordersawa_stage3_stage6d3c1_public";
+if (databaseUrl) {
+  const parsed = new URL(databaseUrl);
+  if (parsed.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || parsed.port !== "55440" || parsed.pathname !== `/${expectedDatabase}`) {
+    throw new Error("Stage 6D.3C1 tests refuse a non-disposable database URL");
+  }
+}
+const integration = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;
+
+integration("Stage 6D.3C1 Public Menu all-category HTTP regression", () => {
+  const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: databaseUrl });
+  const firstRestaurant = "s6d3c1-first";
+  const secondRestaurant = "s6d3c1-second";
+  const productId = "s6d3c1-legacy-product";
+  let app: INestApplication;
+  let origin: string;
+  let race: { expected: number; reads: number; wait: Promise<void>; release: () => void } | null = null;
+  let injectForeignKeyFailure = false;
+  let injectUnrelatedUniqueFailure = false;
+  let actualCreateFailureCode: string | undefined;
+
+  function armRace(expected: number) {
+    let release!: () => void;
+    const wait = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
+    race = { expected, reads: 0, wait, release };
+  }
+
+  async function menu(restaurant = "s6d3c1-a") {
+    const response = await fetch(`${origin}/public/menus/${restaurant}?track=0`);
+    return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() as Record<string, any> };
+  }
+
+  async function all(restaurantId = firstRestaurant) {
+    return prisma.category.findUnique({ where: { restaurantId_slug: { restaurantId, slug: "all" } } });
+  }
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    await prisma.$connect();
+    const [target] = await prisma.$queryRaw<{ name: string; address: string | null; port: number | null }[]>`
+      SELECT current_database() AS name, host(inet_server_addr()) AS address, inet_server_port() AS port
+    `;
+    if (target?.name !== expectedDatabase || target.address !== "127.0.0.1" || target.port !== 55440) {
+      throw new Error("Stage 6D.3C1 requires its dedicated disposable PostgreSQL database");
+    }
+    // Only the dedicated disposable database is touched, after verifying its actual identity.
+    await prisma.product.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId: { in: [firstRestaurant, secondRestaurant] } } });
+    await prisma.category.deleteMany({ where: { restaurantId: { in: [firstRestaurant, secondRestaurant] } } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: [firstRestaurant, secondRestaurant] } } });
+    await prisma.restaurant.createMany({ data: [
+      { id: firstRestaurant, slug: "s6d3c1-a", name: "First disposable restaurant", currency: "EGP" },
+      { id: secondRestaurant, slug: "s6d3c1-b", name: "Second disposable restaurant", currency: "EGP" }
+    ] });
+    await prisma.category.create({ data: { id: "s6d3c1-regular", restaurantId: firstRestaurant,
+      slug: "pizza", name: "Pizza", sortOrder: 1 } });
+    await prisma.product.create({ data: { id: productId, restaurantId: firstRestaurant,
+      categoryId: "s6d3c1-regular", slug: "legacy-pizza", name: "Legacy Pizza",
+      currency: "EGP", basePrice: "12" } });
+
+    const category = {
+      findUnique: async (args: Parameters<typeof prisma.category.findUnique>[0]) => {
+        const result = await prisma.category.findUnique(args);
+        if (race && race.reads < race.expected && args.where?.restaurantId_slug?.slug === "all") {
+          const gate = race;
+          gate.reads += 1;
+          if (gate.reads === gate.expected) gate.release();
+          await gate.wait; // Force all HTTP requests to observe the absent row before INSERT.
+        }
+        return result;
+      },
+      create: async (args: Parameters<typeof prisma.category.create>[0]) => {
+        try {
+          if (injectForeignKeyFailure) {
+            return await prisma.category.create({
+              data: { ...(args.data as Prisma.CategoryUncheckedCreateInput), restaurantId: "s6d3c1-missing" }
+            });
+          }
+          if (injectUnrelatedUniqueFailure) {
+            return await prisma.category.create({
+              data: { ...(args.data as Prisma.CategoryUncheckedCreateInput), id: "s6d3c1-regular" }
+            });
+          }
+          return await prisma.category.create(args);
+        } catch (error) {
+          actualCreateFailureCode = (error as { code?: string }).code;
+          throw error;
+        }
+      },
+      update: (args: Parameters<typeof prisma.category.update>[0]) => prisma.category.update(args)
+    };
+    const db = new Proxy(prisma, {
+      get(target, key) { return key === "category" ? category : Reflect.get(target, key, target); }
+    });
+    @Module({ controllers: [PublicMenuController], providers: [PublicMenuService, PublicWhatsappCheckoutService, FeatureFlagsService,
+      { provide: PrismaService, useValue: db }, { provide: ConfigService, useValue: { get: () => undefined } }] })
+    class TestModule {}
+    app = await NestFactory.create(TestModule, { logger: false });
+    await app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1");
+    origin = await app.getUrl();
+  });
+
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    race = null;
+    injectForeignKeyFailure = false;
+    injectUnrelatedUniqueFailure = false;
+    actualCreateFailureCode = undefined;
+    await prisma.product.update({ where: { id: productId }, data: { categoryId: "s6d3c1-regular" } });
+    await prisma.category.deleteMany({ where: { slug: "all", restaurantId: { in: [firstRestaurant, secondRestaurant] } } });
+  });
+
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    if (app) await app.close();
+    await prisma.$disconnect();
+  });
+
+  it("creates all on the first HTTP menu request and keeps the legacy menu usable", async () => {
+    const response = await menu();
+    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
+    expect(response.body.categories.map((entry: { slug: string }) => entry.slug)).toContain("all");
+    expect(response.body.products.some((entry: { id: string }) => entry.id === productId)).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.category.count({ where: { restaurantId: firstRestaurant, slug: "all" } })).toBe(1);
+    expect(await all()).toMatchObject({ name: "الكل", sortOrder: 0, isActive: true, deletedAt: null });
+  });
+
+  it("serves both simultaneous first HTTP requests after both observe no all row", async () => {
+    armRace(2);
+    const responses = await Promise.all([menu(), menu()]);
+    expect(race?.reads).toBe(2);
+    expect(responses.map((response) => response.status)).toEqual([200, 200]);
+    expect(await prisma.category.count({ where: { restaurantId: firstRestaurant, slug: "all" } })).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it("serves eight simultaneous first HTTP requests with one category row", async () => {
+    armRace(8);
+    const responses = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => menu()));
+    expect(race?.reads).toBe(8);
+    expect(responses.every((response) => response.status === 200)).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.category.count({ where: { restaurantId: firstRestaurant, slug: "all" } })).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it("leaves an existing healthy all row and its presentation fields intact", async () => {
+    const existing = await prisma.category.create({ data: { restaurantId: firstRestaurant,
+      slug: "all", name: "الكل", sortOrder: 0, isActive: true, color: "#112233", description: "Saved style" } });
+    expect((await menu()).status).toBe(200);
+    expect(await all()).toMatchObject({ id: existing.id, color: "#112233", description: "Saved style" });
+    expect(await prisma.category.count({ where: { restaurantId: firstRestaurant, slug: "all" } })).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it("restores a soft-deleted all row, preserving ID, product relation, and style", async () => {
+    const existing = await prisma.category.create({ data: { restaurantId: firstRestaurant,
+      slug: "all", name: "Old", sortOrder: 7, isActive: false, deletedAt: new Date(),
+      color: "#123456", description: "Historic presentation" } });
+    await prisma.product.update({ where: { id: productId }, data: { categoryId: existing.id } });
+    const response = await menu();
+    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
+    expect(await all()).toMatchObject({ id: existing.id, name: "الكل", sortOrder: 0,
+      isActive: true, deletedAt: null, color: "#123456", description: "Historic presentation" });
+    expect((await prisma.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } })).categoryId).toBe(existing.id);
+    expect(response.body.categories.some((entry: { id: string }) => entry.id === existing.id)).toBe(true);
+    expect(await prisma.category.count({ where: { restaurantId: firstRestaurant, slug: "all" } })).toBe(1);
+  });
+
+  it("does not create an all row for another restaurant while serving the first", async () => {
+    expect((await menu()).status).toBe(200);
+    expect(await all(firstRestaurant)).not.toBeNull();
+    expect(await all(secondRestaurant)).toBeNull();
+    expect((await menu("s6d3c1-b")).status).toBe(200);
+    expect((await all(secondRestaurant))?.id).not.toBe((await all(firstRestaurant))?.id);
+    expect(await prisma.category.count({ where: { slug: "all" } })).toBe(2);
+  });
+
+  it("does not swallow an unrelated PostgreSQL foreign-key error", async () => {
+    injectForeignKeyFailure = true;
+    const response = await menu();
+    expect(actualCreateFailureCode).toBe("P2003");
+    expect(response.status).toBe(500);
+    expect(await all()).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it("does not swallow an unrelated PostgreSQL primary-key uniqueness error", async () => {
+    injectUnrelatedUniqueFailure = true;
+    const response = await menu();
+    expect(actualCreateFailureCode).toBe("P2002");
+    expect(response.status).toBe(500);
+    expect(await all()).toBeNull();
+  });
+});

+  private async serializeProducts(
+    restaurantId: string,
+    products: any[],
+    features: Array<{ key: string; enabled: boolean }>,
+    currency: string,
+    capabilityEnabled: boolean
+  ) {
+    const hasNetworkCandidates = products.some(
+      (product) => product.configurationVersion > 0 && product.configurationTree !== null
+    );
+    const catalogProducts = capabilityEnabled && hasNetworkCandidates
+      ? await this.configurationCatalogProducts(restaurantId)
+      : [];
+
+    return products.flatMap((product) => {
+      const legacy = product.configurationVersion === 0 && product.configurationTree === null;
+      if (legacy) {
+        if (product.basePrice === null || validateCurrencyAmount(product.basePrice.toString(), currency, "$product.basePrice").length) return [];
+        return [this.serializeProduct(product, features, currency)];
+      }
+      if (!capabilityEnabled) return [];
+
+      const owner = catalogProducts.find((candidate) => candidate.id === product.id);
+      if (!owner) return [];
+      const configuration = resolvePublicProductConfiguration({
+        restaurantId,
+        owner,
+        catalogProducts,
+        capabilityEnabled,
+        currency
+      });
+      if (!configuration) return [];
+
+      return [{
+        ...this.serializeProduct(product, features, currency),
+        basePrice: null,
+        price: configuration.minimumPrice,
+        productConfiguration: this.configurationSummary(configuration)
+      }];
+    });
+  }
+
+  private configurationSummary(configuration: PublicProductConfigurationResponse) {
+    return {
+      mode: "NETWORK" as const,
+      configurationRevision: configuration.configurationRevision,
+      orderable: configuration.orderable,
+      previewOnly: true as const,
+      minimumPrice: configuration.minimumPrice,
+      priceDisplay: configuration.priceDisplay,
+      issueCodes: configuration.issues.map((issue) => issue.code)
+    };
+  }
+
+  private async configurationCatalogProducts(restaurantId: string): Promise<PublicConfigurationProductRecord[]> {
+    return this.prisma.product.findMany({
+      where: { restaurantId },
+      select: {
+        id: true,
+        slug: true,
+        name: true,
+        basePrice: true,
+        configurationTree: true,
+        configurationVersion: true,
+        isActive: true,
+        isAvailable: true,
+        deletedAt: true
+      }
+    });
+  }

diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-configuration.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-configuration.spec.ts
