+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-configuration.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,213 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import type { ProductConfigurationV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import { initialNetworkSetupConfiguration } from "../products/network-setup-configuration";
+import {
+  resolvePublicProductConfiguration,
+  type PublicConfigurationProductRecord
+} from "./public-product-configuration";
+
+function product(
+  id: string,
+  configurationTree: ProductConfigurationV1 | null,
+  overrides: Partial<PublicConfigurationProductRecord> = {}
+): PublicConfigurationProductRecord {
+  return {
+    id,
+    slug: id,
+    name: id,
+    basePrice: configurationTree?.basePrice ?? "20",
+    configurationTree,
+    configurationVersion: configurationTree?.revision ?? 0,
+    isActive: true,
+    isAvailable: true,
+    deletedAt: null,
+    ...overrides
+  };
+}
+
+function pizza(productId = "pizza"): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision: 2,
+    basePrice: null,
+    groups: [{
+      type: "SIZE",
+      id: `${productId}-size`,
+      label: "الحجم",
+      sizes: [
+        { id: `${productId}-small`, label: "صغير", price: "80" },
+        { id: `${productId}-large`, label: "كبير", price: "120" }
+      ]
+    }]
+  };
+}
+
+describe("public product configuration resolver", () => {
+  it("does not treat an unpriced Network setup as an orderable linked source even if availability is forced on", () => {
+    const source = product("source", initialNetworkSetupConfiguration("source"), { basePrice: null });
+    const owner = product("combo", {
+      schemaVersion: 1, productId: "combo", revision: 1, basePrice: "0",
+      groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: "Slots", min: 1, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0, options: [{
+        id: "slot", label: "Source", price: "10", minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "ORIGINAL" }
+      }] }]
+    });
+    const result = resolvePublicProductConfiguration({
+      restaurantId: "r1", owner, catalogProducts: [owner, source], capabilityEnabled: true
+    });
+    expect(result?.linkedProducts).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ productId: "source", orderable: false })]);
+    expect(result?.orderable).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it("returns a decimal-safe minimum and preview-only contract", () => {
+    const owner = product("pizza", pizza());
+    const result = resolvePublicProductConfiguration({
+      restaurantId: "r1",
+      owner,
+      catalogProducts: [owner],
+      capabilityEnabled: true
+    });
+
+    expect(result).toMatchObject({
+      productId: "pizza",
+      configurationRevision: 2,
+      minimumPrice: "80",
+      maximumRequiredPrice: "120",
+      priceDisplay: "STARTING_AT",
+      orderable: true,
+      previewOnly: true,
+      orderAction: "STAGE_6_REQUIRED"
+    });
+  });
+
+  it("preserves configuration but marks capability loss unavailable", () => {
+    const owner = product("pizza", pizza());
+    const result = resolvePublicProductConfiguration({
+      restaurantId: "r1",
+      owner,
+      catalogProducts: [owner],
+      capabilityEnabled: false
+    });
+
+    expect(result?.configuration.groups).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(result?.orderable).toBe(false);
+    expect(result?.minimumPrice).toBeNull();
+    expect(result?.issues.map((issue) => issue.code)).toContain("PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE");
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a missing required linked source without reducing Min", () => {
+    const configuration: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+      schemaVersion: 1,
+      productId: "combo",
+      revision: 1,
+      basePrice: "100",
+      groups: [{
+        type: "OPTIONS",
+        id: "slots",
+        label: "اختيارات الكومبو",
+        min: 1,
+        max: 1,
+        includedQuantity: 0,
+        options: [{
+          id: "slot-one",
+          label: "بيتزا",
+          price: "25",
+          minQuantity: 1,
+          maxQuantity: 1,
+          linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "missing", mode: "ORIGINAL" }
+        }]
+      }]
+    };
+    const owner = product("combo", configuration);
+    const result = resolvePublicProductConfiguration({
+      restaurantId: "r1",
+      owner,
+      catalogProducts: [owner],
+      capabilityEnabled: true
+    });
+
+    expect(result?.orderable).toBe(false);
+    expect(result?.priceDisplay).toBe("UNAVAILABLE");
+    expect(result?.issues.map((issue) => issue.code)).toContain("LINK_TARGET_NOT_FOUND");
+  });
+
+  it("supports a Legacy source only through an explicit CUSTOM snapshot", () => {
+    const custom = pizza("legacy-source");
+    const configuration: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+      schemaVersion: 1,
+      productId: "combo",
+      revision: 1,
+      basePrice: "0",
+      groups: [{
+        type: "OPTIONS",
+        id: "slots",
+        label: "الكومبو",
+        min: 1,
+        max: 2,
+        includedQuantity: 0,
+        options: [{
+          id: "legacy-slot",
+          label: "بيتزا مخصصة",
+          price: "15",
+          minQuantity: 1,
+          maxQuantity: 2,
+          linkedProduct: {
+            sourceProductId: "legacy-source",
+            mode: "CUSTOM",
+            customConfiguration: custom
+          }
+        }]
+      }]
+    };
+    const owner = product("combo", configuration);
+    const legacy = product("legacy-source", null);
+    const result = resolvePublicProductConfiguration({
+      restaurantId: "r1",
+      owner,
+      catalogProducts: [owner, legacy],
+      capabilityEnabled: true
+    });
+
+    expect(result?.orderable).toBe(true);
+    expect(result?.linkedProducts).toEqual([
+      expect.objectContaining({ productId: "legacy-source", mode: "LEGACY", available: true })
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("marks an unavailable linked source unorderable", () => {
+    const source = product("source", pizza("source"), { isAvailable: false });
+    const configuration: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+      schemaVersion: 1,
+      productId: "combo",
+      revision: 1,
+      basePrice: "0",
+      groups: [{
+        type: "OPTIONS",
+        id: "slot",
+        label: "اختيار مطلوب",
+        min: 1,
+        max: 1,
+        includedQuantity: 0,
+        options: [{
+          id: "linked",
+          label: "مرتبط",
+          price: "10",
+          minQuantity: 1,
+          maxQuantity: 1,
+          linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: { "source-small": "30", "source-large": "40" } }
+        }]
+      }]
+    };
+    const owner = product("combo", configuration);
+    const result = resolvePublicProductConfiguration({
+      restaurantId: "r1",
+      owner,
+      catalogProducts: [owner, source],
+      capabilityEnabled: true
+    });
+
+    expect(result?.orderable).toBe(false);
+    expect(result?.issues.map((issue) => issue.code)).toContain("LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-configuration.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-configuration.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0cfd46a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-configuration.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,245 @@
+import {
+  calculateMinimumPrice,
+  collectDependencyEdges,
+  validateConfiguration,
+  validateConfigurationCurrency,
+  type ConfigurationIssue,
+  type LinkedProductCatalogEntry,
+  type ProductConfigurationContext,
+  type ProductConfigurationV1
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import { isUnpricedNetworkSetup } from "../products/network-setup-configuration";
+
+export type PublicConfigurationProductRecord = {
+  id: string;
+  slug: string;
+  name: string;
+  basePrice: { toString(): string } | string | number | null;
+  configurationTree: unknown;
+  configurationVersion: number;
+  isActive: boolean;
+  isAvailable: boolean;
+  deletedAt: Date | null;
+};
+
+export type PublicLinkedConfigurationSource = {
+  productId: string;
+  slug: string;
+  name: string;
+  mode: "NETWORK" | "LEGACY";
+  available: boolean;
+  orderable: boolean;
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+};
+
+export type PublicProductConfigurationResponse = {
+  schemaVersion: 1;
+  productId: string;
+  productSlug: string;
+  productName: string;
+  configurationRevision: number;
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  linkedProducts: PublicLinkedConfigurationSource[];
+  orderable: boolean;
+  previewOnly: true;
+  orderAction: "STAGE_6_REQUIRED";
+  minimumPrice: string | null;
+  maximumRequiredPrice: string | null;
+  priceDisplay: "EXACT" | "STARTING_AT" | "UNAVAILABLE";
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[];
+  runtimeContext: {
+    scope: "RESTAURANT";
+    outletDifferentialApplied: false;
+    serviceModeApplied: false;
+    productScheduleApplied: false;
+  };
+};
+
+function decimalText(value: PublicConfigurationProductRecord["basePrice"]): string | null {
+  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
+  return value.toString();
+}
+
+function isConfiguration(value: unknown): value is ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
+  const candidate = value as Partial<ProductConfigurationV1>;
+  return candidate.schemaVersion === 1
+    && typeof candidate.productId === "string"
+    && Number.isInteger(candidate.revision)
+    && Array.isArray(candidate.groups);
+}
+
+function canonicalConfiguration(product: PublicConfigurationProductRecord) {
+  if (
+    product.configurationVersion > 0
+    && isConfiguration(product.configurationTree)
+    && product.configurationTree.productId === product.id
+    && product.configurationTree.revision === product.configurationVersion
+  ) {
+    return product.configurationTree;
+  }
+
+  return null;
+}
+
+function runtimeConfiguration(product: PublicConfigurationProductRecord): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return canonicalConfiguration(product) ?? {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId: product.id,
+    revision: product.configurationVersion,
+    basePrice: decimalText(product.basePrice),
+    groups: []
+  };
+}
+
+function sourceAvailable(product: PublicConfigurationProductRecord) {
+  return product.deletedAt === null && product.isActive && product.isAvailable;
+}
+
+function uniqueIssues(issues: readonly ConfigurationIssue[]) {
+  const seen = new Set<string>();
+  return issues.filter((issue) => {
+    const key = `${issue.code}\u0000${issue.path}\u0000${issue.message}`;
+    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
+    seen.add(key);
+    return true;
+  });
+}
+
+function reachableSourceIds(
+  owner: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  products: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicConfigurationProductRecord>
+) {
+  const result = new Set<string>();
+  const visitedConfigurations = new Set<string>();
+
+  function visit(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1) {
+    const key = `${configuration.productId}:${configuration.revision}`;
+    if (visitedConfigurations.has(key)) return;
+    visitedConfigurations.add(key);
+
+    for (const edge of collectDependencyEdges(configuration)) {
+      result.add(edge.sourceProductId);
+      if (edge.mode !== "ORIGINAL") continue;
+      const source = products.get(edge.sourceProductId);
+      const sourceConfiguration = source ? canonicalConfiguration(source) : null;
+      if (sourceConfiguration) visit(sourceConfiguration);
+    }
+  }
+
+  visit(owner);
+  return result;
+}
+
+export function resolvePublicProductConfiguration(args: {
+  restaurantId: string;
+  owner: PublicConfigurationProductRecord;
+  catalogProducts: readonly PublicConfigurationProductRecord[];
+  capabilityEnabled: boolean;
+  currency?: string;
+}): PublicProductConfigurationResponse | null {
+  const ownerConfiguration = canonicalConfiguration(args.owner);
+  if (!ownerConfiguration) return null;
+
+  const products = new Map(args.catalogProducts.map((product) => [product.id, product]));
+  const linkedProducts = new Map<string, LinkedProductCatalogEntry>();
+  for (const product of args.catalogProducts) {
+    const configuration = runtimeConfiguration(product);
+    const networkConfiguration = canonicalConfiguration(product);
+    const available = sourceAvailable(product);
+    const structurallyValid = networkConfiguration
+      ? validateConfiguration(networkConfiguration).length === 0
+        && (!args.currency || validateConfigurationCurrency(networkConfiguration, args.currency).length === 0)
+      : true;
+    linkedProducts.set(product.id, {
+      productId: product.id,
+      catalogId: args.restaurantId,
+      configuration,
+      available,
+      orderable: available && structurallyValid
+        && (!args.currency || validateConfigurationCurrency(configuration, args.currency).length === 0)
+        && !isUnpricedNetworkSetup(configuration) && args.capabilityEnabled
+    });
+  }
+
+  const context: ProductConfigurationContext = {
+    catalogId: args.restaurantId,
+    linkedProducts
+  };
+  const issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [...validateConfiguration(ownerConfiguration)];
+  if (args.currency && issues.length === 0) issues.push(...validateConfigurationCurrency(ownerConfiguration, args.currency));
+  for (const edge of collectDependencyEdges(ownerConfiguration)) {
+    const source = products.get(edge.sourceProductId);
+    if (edge.mode === "ORIGINAL" && source && !canonicalConfiguration(source)) {
+      issues.push({
+        code: "ORIGINAL_LINKED_SOURCE_REQUIRES_NETWORK_CONFIGURATION",
+        path: edge.path,
+        message: "Original linked source does not have a live Network configuration."
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  const minimum = calculateMinimumPrice(ownerConfiguration, context);
+  issues.push(...minimum.issues);
+  if (!args.capabilityEnabled) {
+    issues.push({
+      code: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE",
+      path: "$configuration",
+      message: "Product Configuration capability is not currently available."
+    });
+  }
+  if (!sourceAvailable(args.owner)) {
+    issues.push({
+      code: "PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE",
+      path: "$configuration",
+      message: "Product is not currently available."
+    });
+  }
+
+  const reachable = reachableSourceIds(ownerConfiguration, products);
+  const publicSources = [...reachable].flatMap((productId) => {
+    const product = products.get(productId);
+    if (!product) return [];
+    const configuration = runtimeConfiguration(product);
+    const available = sourceAvailable(product);
+    const mode = canonicalConfiguration(product) ? "NETWORK" as const : "LEGACY" as const;
+    return [{
+      productId: product.id,
+      slug: product.slug,
+      name: product.name,
+      mode,
+      available,
+      orderable: available && args.capabilityEnabled
+        && validateConfiguration(configuration).length === 0
+        && (!args.currency || validateConfigurationCurrency(configuration, args.currency).length === 0)
+        && (mode === "LEGACY" || !isUnpricedNetworkSetup(configuration)),
+      configuration
+    }];
+  });
+
+  const finalIssues = uniqueIssues(issues);
+  const orderable = args.capabilityEnabled && sourceAvailable(args.owner) && minimum.orderable && finalIssues.length === 0;
+
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId: args.owner.id,
+    productSlug: args.owner.slug,
+    productName: args.owner.name,
+    configurationRevision: ownerConfiguration.revision,
+    configuration: ownerConfiguration,
+    linkedProducts: publicSources,
+    orderable,
+    previewOnly: true,
+    orderAction: "STAGE_6_REQUIRED",
+    minimumPrice: orderable ? minimum.minimum : null,
+    maximumRequiredPrice: orderable ? minimum.maximumRequired : null,
+    priceDisplay: orderable ? minimum.display : "UNAVAILABLE",
+    issues: finalIssues,
+    runtimeContext: {
+      scope: "RESTAURANT",
+      outletDifferentialApplied: false,
+      serviceModeApplied: false,
+      productScheduleApplied: false
+    }
+  };
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-quote.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-quote.spec.ts

@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import type { ProductConfigurationV1, ProductSelectionV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import { quotePublicProductConfiguration, parsePublicQuoteSelection } from "./public-product-quote";
+import type { PublicConfigurationProductRecord } from "./public-product-configuration";
+
+function product(id: string, configurationTree: ProductConfigurationV1 | null, overrides: Partial<PublicConfigurationProductRecord> = {}): PublicConfigurationProductRecord {
+  return {
+    id, slug: id, name: id, basePrice: configurationTree?.basePrice ?? "0", configurationTree,
+    configurationVersion: configurationTree?.revision ?? 0, isActive: true, isAvailable: true, deletedAt: null,
+    ...overrides
+  };
+}
+
+const pizza: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+  schemaVersion: 1, productId: "pizza", revision: 2, basePrice: null,
+  groups: [
+    { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Size", sizes: [{ id: "small", label: "Small", price: "100" }, { id: "medium", label: "Medium", price: "200.000001" }] },
+    { type: "OPTIONS", id: "toppings", label: "Toppings", min: 0, max: 3, includedQuantity: 1, options: [{
+      id: "cheese", label: "Cheese", price: "30.000001", maxQuantity: 3,
+      children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "sauces", label: "Sauces", min: 0, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0, options: [{ id: "bbq", label: "BBQ", price: "5.000001", maxQuantity: 1 }] }]
+    }] }
+  ]
+};
+
+const pizzaSelection: ProductSelectionV1 = {
+  schemaVersion: 1, productId: "pizza", configurationRevision: 2,
+  groups: [
+    { type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" },
+    { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "toppings", instances: [
+      { instanceId: "c3", optionId: "cheese" },
+      { instanceId: "c2", optionId: "cheese" },
+      { instanceId: "c1", optionId: "cheese", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "sauces", instances: [{ instanceId: "s1", optionId: "bbq" }] }] }
+    ] }
+  ]
+};
+
+function quote(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, selection: unknown, catalogProducts: PublicConfigurationProductRecord[], capabilityEnabled = true) {
+  return quotePublicProductConfiguration({ restaurantId: "restaurant-a", owner: catalogProducts[0], catalogProducts, capabilityEnabled, currency: "EGP", selection });
+}
+
+describe("Stage 6A pure server quote", () => {
+  it("uses Shared size, nested, included-unit and decimal pricing with a canonical selection", () => {
+    const result = quote(pizza, pizzaSelection, [product("pizza", pizza)]);
+    expect(result.ok).toBe(true);
+    if (!result.ok) return;
+    expect(result.quote).toMatchObject({
+      trustedTotal: "265.000004", baseIgnored: true, configurationOrderable: true,
+      previewOnly: true, orderingEnabled: false, orderAction: "STAGE_6_REQUIRED"
+    });
+    expect(result.quote.canonicalSelection.groups[1]).toMatchObject({ type: "OPTIONS", instances: [{ instanceId: "c1" }, { instanceId: "c2" }, { instanceId: "c3" }] });
+    expect(result.quote.priceBreakdown.filter((line) => line.included)).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(result.quote.priceBreakdown.find((line) => line.nodeId === "bbq")?.chargedAmount).toBe("5.000001");
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a stale owner revision and stale linked revisions", () => {
+    const stale = quote(pizza, { ...pizzaSelection, configurationRevision: 1 }, [product("pizza", pizza)]);
+    expect(stale).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { status: 409, code: "CONFIGURATION_REVISION_CHANGED", currentRevision: 2 } });
+
+    const source: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", revision: 3, basePrice: "1", groups: [] };
+    const combo: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "combo", revision: 1, basePrice: "0", groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: "Slots", min: 1, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{ id: "linked", label: "Linked", price: "2", maxQuantity: 1, linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "ORIGINAL" } }]
+    }] };
+    const linkedStale = quote(combo, {
+      schemaVersion: 1, productId: "combo", configurationRevision: 1,
+      groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "slots", instances: [{ instanceId: "slot1", optionId: "linked", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", configurationRevision: 2, groups: [] } }] }]
+    }, [product("combo", combo), product("source", source)]);
+    expect(linkedStale).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { status: 409, code: "LINKED_CONFIGURATION_REVISION_CHANGED" } });
+  });
+
+  it("quotes repeated ORIGINAL instances independently and a CUSTOM instance without source sale price", () => {
+    const source: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", revision: 3, basePrice: null, groups: [{
+      type: "SIZE", id: "source-sizes", label: "Source sizes", sizes: [{ id: "source-small", label: "Small", price: "100" }, { id: "source-large", label: "Large", price: "200" }]
+    }] };
+    const custom: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [{
+      type: "SIZE", id: "custom-sizes", label: "Custom sizes", sizes: [{ id: "custom-one", label: "One", price: "7" }]
+    }] };
+    const combo: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "combo", revision: 1, basePrice: "0", groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: "Slots", min: 3, max: 3, includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [
+        { id: "original", label: "Original", price: "10", maxQuantity: 2, linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: { "source-small": "5", "source-large": "8" } } },
+        { id: "custom", label: "Custom", price: "3", maxQuantity: 1, linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: custom } }
+      ]
+    }] };
+    const selection: ProductSelectionV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "combo", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "slots", instances: [
+        { instanceId: "first", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", configurationRevision: 3, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-small" }] } },
+        { instanceId: "second", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", configurationRevision: 3, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-large" }] } },
+        { instanceId: "third", optionId: "custom", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "custom-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "custom-one" }] } }
+      ]
+    }] };
+    const result = quote(combo, selection, [product("combo", combo), product("source", source)]);
+    expect(result.ok).toBe(true);
+    if (!result.ok) return;
+    expect(result.quote.trustedTotal).toBe("43");
+    expect(result.quote.priceBreakdown.filter((line) => line.sourceProductId === "source")).toHaveLength(3);
+  });
+
+  it("rejects tampered amounts, unknown fields, unavailable sources and capability loss", () => {
+    const tampered = parsePublicQuoteSelection({ ...pizzaSelection, trustedTotal: "1" });
+    expect(tampered.issues).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ code: "UNEXPECTED_SELECTION_FIELD", path: "$selection.trustedTotal" }));
+    const nestedTamper = parsePublicQuoteSelection({ ...pizzaSelection, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium", price: "1" }] });
+    expect(nestedTamper.issues).toContainEqual(expect.objectContaining({ code: "UNEXPECTED_SELECTION_FIELD" }));
+    expect(quote(pizza, pizzaSelection, [product("pizza", pizza)], false)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { code: "CONFIGURATION_NOT_ORDERABLE" } });
+    expect(quote(pizza, pizzaSelection, [product("pizza", pizza, { isAvailable: false })])).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { code: "CONFIGURATION_NOT_ORDERABLE" } });
+  });
+
+  it("signals a selected optional linked source becoming unavailable as a change", () => {
+    const source: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", revision: 1, basePrice: "100", groups: [] };
+    const owner: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "owner", revision: 1, basePrice: "10", groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS", id: "extras", label: "Extras", min: 0, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{ id: "linked", label: "Linked", price: "1", maxQuantity: 1, linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", revision: 1, basePrice: "0", groups: [] } } }]
+    }] };
+    const selection = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "owner", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "extras", instances: [{ instanceId: "unit-1", optionId: "linked" }] }] };
+    const result = quote(owner, selection, [product("owner", owner), product("source", source, { isAvailable: false })]);
+    expect(result).toMatchObject({ ok: false, error: { status: 409, code: "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED", issues: expect.arrayContaining([expect.objectContaining({ code: "LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE" })]) } });
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-quote.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-quote.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9e54298
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-product-quote.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,218 @@
+import {
+  calculatePrice,
+  createSelectionKey,
+  DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS,
+  type ConfigurationIssue,
+  type GroupSelection,
+  type ProductConfigurationContext,
+  type ProductSelectionV1
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import {
+  resolvePublicProductConfiguration,
+  type PublicConfigurationProductRecord
+} from "./public-product-configuration";
+
+export type PublicProductQuoteRequest = { selection: ProductSelectionV1 };
+
+export type PublicQuoteError = {
+  status: 400 | 409;
+  code: string;
+  message: string;
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[];
+  currentRevision?: number;
+};
+
+export type PublicProductQuoteResult =
+  | { ok: false; error: PublicQuoteError }
+  | { ok: true; quote: {
+      schemaVersion: 1;
+      productId: string;
+      configurationRevision: number;
+      selectionKey: string;
+      canonicalSelection: ProductSelectionV1;
+      currency: string;
+      trustedTotal: string;
+      baseIgnored: boolean;
+      priceBreakdown: ReturnType<typeof calculatePrice>["lines"];
+      linkedSourceRevisions: { sourceProductId: string; mode: "NETWORK" | "LEGACY"; configurationRevision: number }[];
+      configurationOrderable: true;
+      previewOnly: true;
+      orderAction: "STAGE_6_REQUIRED";
+      orderingEnabled: false;
+      runtimeContext: { scope: "RESTAURANT"; outletDifferentialApplied: false; serviceModeApplied: false; productScheduleApplied: false };
+    } };
+
+function record(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
+}
+
+/** Reject unknown fields at every level, including client-supplied prices/totals. */
+export function parsePublicQuoteSelection(value: unknown): { selection?: ProductSelectionV1; issues: ConfigurationIssue[] } {
+  const issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [];
+  let nodes = 0;
+  const issue = (code: string, path: string, message: string) => issues.push({ code, path, message });
+  const fields = (input: Record<string, unknown>, allowed: readonly string[], path: string) => {
+    for (const key of Object.keys(input)) {
+      if (!allowed.includes(key)) issue("UNEXPECTED_SELECTION_FIELD", `${path}.${key}`, "Client-provided pricing or unknown selection fields are not accepted.");
+    }
+  };
+  const array = (input: unknown, path: string): unknown[] => {
+    if (!Array.isArray(input)) {
+      issue("INVALID_SELECTION_SHAPE", path, "Expected an array.");
+      return [];
+    }
+    if (input.length > DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxSelectionInstances) {
+      issue("SELECTION_INSTANCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", path, "Selection safety limit exceeded.");
+      return [];
+    }
+    return input;
+  };
+  const string = (input: unknown, path: string) => {
+    if (typeof input !== "string" || !input.trim() || input.length > 256) {
+      issue("INVALID_SELECTION_SHAPE", path, "Expected a nonempty identifier string.");
+      return "";
+    }
+    return input;
+  };
+  function product(input: unknown, path: string, depth: number): ProductSelectionV1 | null {
+    if (!record(input) || depth > DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxDepth * 2 || ++nodes > DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxSelectionInstances) {
+      issue("INVALID_SELECTION_SHAPE", path, "Invalid or excessively deep product selection.");
+      return null;
+    }
+    fields(input, ["schemaVersion", "productId", "configurationRevision", "groups"], path);
+    if (input.schemaVersion !== 1) issue("UNSUPPORTED_SELECTION_VERSION", `${path}.schemaVersion`, "Selection schema version must be 1.");
+    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(input.configurationRevision) || (input.configurationRevision as number) < 0) {
+      issue("INVALID_SELECTION_SHAPE", `${path}.configurationRevision`, "Expected a nonnegative integer revision.");
+    }
+    const productId = string(input.productId, `${path}.productId`);
+    const groups = array(input.groups, `${path}.groups`).map((group, index) => groupSelection(group, `${path}.groups[${index}]`, depth + 1));
+    return { schemaVersion: 1, productId, configurationRevision: input.configurationRevision as number, groups: groups.filter((group): group is GroupSelection => group !== null) };
+  }
+  function groupSelection(input: unknown, path: string, depth: number): GroupSelection | null {
+    if (!record(input) || depth > DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxDepth * 2 || ++nodes > DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxSelectionInstances) {
+      issue("INVALID_SELECTION_SHAPE", path, "Invalid or excessively deep group selection.");
+      return null;
+    }
+    if (input.type === "SIZE") {
+      fields(input, ["type", "groupId", "sizeChoiceId", "children"], path);
+      return {
+        type: "SIZE",
+        groupId: string(input.groupId, `${path}.groupId`),
+        sizeChoiceId: string(input.sizeChoiceId, `${path}.sizeChoiceId`),
+        children: input.children === undefined ? [] : array(input.children, `${path}.children`).map((child, index) => groupSelection(child, `${path}.children[${index}]`, depth + 1)).filter((child): child is GroupSelection => child !== null)
+      };
+    }
+    if (input.type === "OPTIONS") {
+      fields(input, ["type", "groupId", "instances"], path);
+      const instances = array(input.instances, `${path}.instances`).flatMap((raw, index) => {
+        const instancePath = `${path}.instances[${index}]`;
+        if (!record(raw) || depth > DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxDepth * 2 || ++nodes > DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxSelectionInstances) {
+          issue("INVALID_SELECTION_SHAPE", instancePath, "Invalid or excessively deep option instance.");
+          return [];
+        }
+        fields(raw, ["instanceId", "optionId", "children", "linkedSelection"], instancePath);
+        const linkedSelection = raw.linkedSelection === undefined ? undefined : product(raw.linkedSelection, `${instancePath}.linkedSelection`, depth + 1);
+        return [{
+          instanceId: string(raw.instanceId, `${instancePath}.instanceId`),
+          optionId: string(raw.optionId, `${instancePath}.optionId`),
+          children: raw.children === undefined ? [] : array(raw.children, `${instancePath}.children`).map((child, childIndex) => groupSelection(child, `${instancePath}.children[${childIndex}]`, depth + 1)).filter((child): child is GroupSelection => child !== null),
+          ...(linkedSelection ? { linkedSelection } : {})
+        }];
+      });
+      return { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: string(input.groupId, `${path}.groupId`), instances };
+    }
+    issue("INVALID_SELECTION_SHAPE", `${path}.type`, "Group type must be SIZE or OPTIONS.");
+    return null;
+  }
+  const selection = product(value, "$selection", 0);
+  return { selection: issues.length ? undefined : selection ?? undefined, issues };
+}
+
+function canonicalGroups(groups: readonly GroupSelection[]): GroupSelection[] {
+  return groups.map((group) => group.type === "SIZE"
+    ? { ...group, children: canonicalGroups(group.children ?? []) }
+    : {
+      ...group,
+      instances: group.instances.map((instance) => ({
+        ...instance,
+        children: canonicalGroups(instance.children ?? []),
+        ...(instance.linkedSelection ? { linkedSelection: canonicalSelection(instance.linkedSelection) } : {})
+      })).sort((a, b) => a.instanceId.localeCompare(b.instanceId))
+    }).sort((a, b) => a.groupId.localeCompare(b.groupId));
+}
+
+function canonicalSelection(selection: ProductSelectionV1): ProductSelectionV1 {
+  return { ...selection, groups: canonicalGroups(selection.groups) };
+}
+
+export function quotePublicProductConfiguration(args: {
+  restaurantId: string;
+  owner: PublicConfigurationProductRecord;
+  catalogProducts: readonly PublicConfigurationProductRecord[];
+  capabilityEnabled: boolean;
+  currency: string;
+  selection: unknown;
+}): PublicProductQuoteResult {
+  const parsed = parsePublicQuoteSelection(args.selection);
+  if (!parsed.selection) return { ok: false, error: { status: 400, code: "INVALID_QUOTE_SELECTION", message: "Selection payload is invalid.", issues: parsed.issues } };
+
+  const publicConfiguration = resolvePublicProductConfiguration(args);
+  if (!publicConfiguration) return { ok: false, error: { status: 409, code: "CONFIGURATION_UNAVAILABLE", message: "Current Network configuration is unavailable.", issues: [] } };
+  const currentRevision = publicConfiguration.configurationRevision;
+  if (parsed.selection.configurationRevision !== currentRevision) {
+    return { ok: false, error: {
+      status: 409, code: "CONFIGURATION_REVISION_CHANGED", message: "Product configuration has changed; reload before continuing.", currentRevision,
+      issues: [{ code: "STALE_CONFIGURATION_REVISION", path: "$selection.configurationRevision", message: "Selection revision does not match the current configuration." }]
+    } };
+  }
+  if (!publicConfiguration.orderable) {
+    return { ok: false, error: { status: 409, code: "CONFIGURATION_NOT_ORDERABLE", message: "Current configuration cannot be quoted.", currentRevision, issues: publicConfiguration.issues } };
+  }
+
+  const linkedProducts = new Map(publicConfiguration.linkedProducts.map((source) => [source.productId, {
+    productId: source.productId,
+    catalogId: args.restaurantId,
+    configuration: source.configuration,
+    available: source.available,
+    orderable: source.orderable
+  }]));
+  const context: ProductConfigurationContext = { catalogId: args.restaurantId, linkedProducts };
+  const selection = canonicalSelection(parsed.selection);
+  const price = calculatePrice(publicConfiguration.configuration, selection, context);
+  if (!price.valid || price.total === null) {
+    const stale = price.issues.some((issue) => issue.code === "STALE_CONFIGURATION_REVISION");
+    const changed = price.issues.some((issue) => [
+      "LINK_TARGET_NOT_FOUND", "LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE", "SIZE_UNAVAILABLE",
+      "OPTION_UNAVAILABLE", "OPTIONS_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE", "REQUIRED_SIZE_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE",
+      "REQUIRED_OPTIONS_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE"
+    ].includes(issue.code));
+    return { ok: false, error: {
+      status: stale || changed ? 409 : 400,
+      code: stale ? "LINKED_CONFIGURATION_REVISION_CHANGED" : changed ? "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED" : "INVALID_QUOTE_SELECTION",
+      message: stale || changed ? "Configuration availability or revision has changed; reload before continuing." : "Selection does not satisfy the current configuration.",
+      currentRevision,
+      issues: price.issues
+    } };
+  }
+  return { ok: true, quote: {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId: args.owner.id,
+    configurationRevision: currentRevision,
+    selectionKey: createSelectionKey(selection),
+    canonicalSelection: selection,
+    currency: args.currency,
+    trustedTotal: price.total,
+    baseIgnored: price.baseIgnored,
+    priceBreakdown: price.lines,
+    linkedSourceRevisions: publicConfiguration.linkedProducts.map((source) => ({
+      sourceProductId: source.productId,
+      mode: source.mode,
+      configurationRevision: source.configuration.revision
+    })),
+    configurationOrderable: true,
+    previewOnly: true,
+    orderAction: "STAGE_6_REQUIRED",
+    orderingEnabled: false,
+    runtimeContext: publicConfiguration.runtimeContext
+  } };
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-whatsapp-checkout.contract.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-whatsapp-checkout.contract.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..367692b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-whatsapp-checkout.contract.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+import { BadRequestException } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS, validateMoneyString, type ProductSelectionV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import { parseNetworkOrderDetails, type NetworkOrderDetails } from "../orders/network-order-contract";
+import { parsePublicQuoteSelection } from "./public-product-quote";
+
+export type WhatsappCheckoutLine = {
+  mode: "LEGACY" | "NETWORK";
+  lineId: string;
+  productSlug?: string;
+  productId?: string;
+  quantity: number;
+  selection?: ProductSelectionV1;
+  note?: string;
+  expectedUnitPrice?: string;
+  expectedLinkedSourceRevisions?: { sourceProductId: string; mode: "NETWORK" | "LEGACY"; configurationRevision: number }[];
+};
+
+export type WhatsappCheckoutRequest = NetworkOrderDetails & {
+  locale: "ar" | "en";
+  branchSlug?: string;
+  items: WhatsappCheckoutLine[];
+};
+
+function record(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
+}
+
+function fail(code: string, message: string): never {
+  throw new BadRequestException({ error: code, message, issues: [{ code, path: "$request", message }] });
+}
+
+function optionalText(value: unknown, field: string, limit: number): string | undefined {
+  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") return undefined;
+  if (typeof value !== "string") fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_FIELD", `${field} must be text.`);
+  const trimmed = value.trim();
+  if (!trimmed || trimmed.length > limit || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/u.test(trimmed)) {
+    fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_FIELD", `${field} contains unsafe text or exceeds its limit.`);
+  }
+  return trimmed;
+}
+
+export function parseWhatsappCheckoutRequest(value: unknown): WhatsappCheckoutRequest {
+  if (!record(value)) fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_REQUEST", "Expected an object.");
+  const allowed = ["locale", "branchSlug", "items", "customerName", "customerPhone", "fulfillmentType",
+    "deliveryArea", "deliveryNear", "deliveryBeside", "pickupTime", "orderNote"];
+  if (Object.keys(value).some((key) => !allowed.includes(key))) {
+    fail("UNEXPECTED_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_FIELD", "Client totals, prices, and unknown fields are not accepted.");
+  }
+  if ((value.locale !== "ar" && value.locale !== "en") || !Array.isArray(value.items)
+    || value.items.length < 1 || value.items.length > 50) {
+    fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_REQUEST", "Expected locale and 1-50 order lines.");
+  }
+  let units = 0;
+  const ids = new Set<string>();
+  const items = value.items.map((raw, index): WhatsappCheckoutLine => {
+    if (!record(raw) || Object.keys(raw).some((key) => !["mode", "lineId", "productSlug", "productId", "quantity", "selection", "note", "expectedUnitPrice", "expectedLinkedSourceRevisions"].includes(key))
+      || (raw.mode !== "LEGACY" && raw.mode !== "NETWORK")
+      || typeof raw.lineId !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$/.test(raw.lineId)
+      || ids.has(raw.lineId) || !Number.isSafeInteger(raw.quantity) || (raw.quantity as number) < 1 || (raw.quantity as number) > 100) {
+      fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_LINE", `Invalid line ${index}.`);
+    }
+    ids.add(raw.lineId);
+    units += raw.quantity as number;
+    if (units > 100) fail("WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_UNIT_LIMIT", "Order unit safety limit exceeded.");
+    const note = optionalText(raw.note, `items[${index}].note`, 500);
+    if (raw.expectedUnitPrice !== undefined && validateMoneyString(raw.expectedUnitPrice, `$items[${index}].expectedUnitPrice`, DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS).length) {
+      fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_EXPECTED_PRICE", "Expected price must be an exact decimal string.");
+    }
+    if (raw.mode === "LEGACY") {
+      if (typeof raw.productSlug !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/.test(raw.productSlug)
+        || raw.productId !== undefined || raw.selection !== undefined || raw.expectedLinkedSourceRevisions !== undefined) fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_LINE", `Invalid Legacy line ${index}.`);
+      return { mode: "LEGACY", lineId: raw.lineId, productSlug: raw.productSlug, quantity: raw.quantity as number,
+        ...(note ? { note } : {}), ...(raw.expectedUnitPrice !== undefined ? { expectedUnitPrice: raw.expectedUnitPrice as string } : {}) };
+    }
+    if (typeof raw.productId !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/.test(raw.productId) || raw.productSlug !== undefined) {
+      fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_LINE", `Invalid Network line ${index}.`);
+    }
+    const parsed = parsePublicQuoteSelection(raw.selection);
+    if (!parsed.selection || parsed.selection.productId !== raw.productId) {
+      throw new BadRequestException({ error: "INVALID_WHATSAPP_SELECTION", lineId: raw.lineId,
+        message: "Invalid Network selection.", issues: parsed.issues });
+    }
+    if (raw.expectedLinkedSourceRevisions !== undefined && (!Array.isArray(raw.expectedLinkedSourceRevisions)
+      || raw.expectedLinkedSourceRevisions.length > DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxNodes
+      || raw.expectedLinkedSourceRevisions.some((source) => !record(source)
+        || Object.keys(source).some((key) => !["sourceProductId", "mode", "configurationRevision"].includes(key))
+        || typeof source.sourceProductId !== "string" || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/.test(source.sourceProductId)
+        || (source.mode !== "NETWORK" && source.mode !== "LEGACY")
+        || !Number.isSafeInteger(source.configurationRevision) || (source.configurationRevision as number) < 0))) {
+      fail("INVALID_WHATSAPP_SOURCE_REVISIONS", "Linked source revisions are invalid.");
+    }
+    return { mode: "NETWORK", lineId: raw.lineId, productId: raw.productId, quantity: raw.quantity as number,
+      selection: parsed.selection, ...(note ? { note } : {}),
+      ...(raw.expectedUnitPrice !== undefined ? { expectedUnitPrice: raw.expectedUnitPrice as string } : {}),
+      ...(raw.expectedLinkedSourceRevisions !== undefined ? { expectedLinkedSourceRevisions: raw.expectedLinkedSourceRevisions as WhatsappCheckoutLine["expectedLinkedSourceRevisions"] } : {}) };
+  });
+  if (!items.some((line) => line.mode === "NETWORK")) {
+    fail("LEGACY_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED", "Legacy-only carts must use the existing WhatsApp order checkout.");
+  }
+  const branchSlug = optionalText(value.branchSlug, "branchSlug", 128);
+  return { locale: value.locale as "ar" | "en", ...(branchSlug ? { branchSlug } : {}),
+    ...parseNetworkOrderDetails(value), items };
+}
diff --git a/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-whatsapp-checkout.integration.spec.ts b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-whatsapp-checkout.integration.spec.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d8428dd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/api/src/modules/public-menu/public-whatsapp-checkout.integration.spec.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,724 @@
+import { INestApplication, Module } from "@nestjs/common";
+import { ConfigService } from "@nestjs/config";
+import { NestFactory } from "@nestjs/core";
+import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import { ABO_MALEK_THEME } from "@menu/shared";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { FeatureFlagsService } from "../feature-flags/feature-flags.service";
+import { DashboardService } from "../dashboard/dashboard.service";
+import { PrismaService } from "../prisma/prisma.service";
+import { PublicMenuController } from "./public-menu.controller";
+import { PublicMenuService } from "./public-menu.service";
+import { PublicWhatsappCheckoutService } from "./public-whatsapp-checkout.service";
+
+const url = process.env.WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
+const disposableDatabase = url ? new URL(url) : undefined;
+if (url) {
+  const allowed = (disposableDatabase?.port === "55440" && disposableDatabase?.pathname === "/ordersawa_stage3_stage6e2_checkout")
+    || (disposableDatabase?.port === "55447" && disposableDatabase?.pathname === "/ordersawa_stage3_showprices_guard")
+    || (disposableDatabase?.port === "55448" && /^\/ordersawa_demo_release_checkout_[0-9]{14}_[0-9a-f]{6}$/.test(disposableDatabase?.pathname ?? ""));
+  if (disposableDatabase?.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || !allowed) throw new Error("Disposable checkout test database required");
+}
+const integration = url ? describe : describe.skip;
+
+const pizza = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6e2-pizza", revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+  groups: [
+    { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [
+      { id: "small", label: "Small", price: "100" }, { id: "medium", label: "Medium", price: "200.000001" },
+      { id: "large", label: "Large", price: "300" }
+    ] },
+    { type: "OPTIONS", id: "toppings", label: "Toppings", min: 0, max: 3, includedQuantity: 1,
+      options: [{ id: "cheese", label: "Cheese", price: "30.000001", maxQuantity: 3,
+        children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "sauces", label: "Sauces", min: 0, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0,
+          options: [{ id: "bbq", label: "BBQ", price: "5.000001", maxQuantity: 1 }] }] }] }
+  ] };
+const source = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6e2-source", revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+  groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "source-sizes", label: "Source sizes", sizes: [
+    { id: "source-small", label: "Small", price: "100" }, { id: "source-large", label: "Large", price: "200" }
+  ] }] };
+const combo = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6e2-combo", revision: 1, basePrice: "0",
+  groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: "Slots", min: 3, max: 3, includedQuantity: 0, options: [
+    { id: "original", label: "First pizza", price: "10", maxQuantity: 1,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "s6e2-source", mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: { "source-small": "5", "source-large": "8" } } },
+    { id: "second-original", label: "Second pizza", price: "10", maxQuantity: 1,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "s6e2-source", mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: { "source-small": "5", "source-large": "8" } } },
+    { id: "custom", label: "Extra pizza", price: "3", maxQuantity: 1,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "s6e2-source", mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: {
+        schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6e2-source", revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+        groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "custom-sizes", label: "Pizza sizes", sizes: [{ id: "custom-one", label: "Medium", price: "7" }] }]
+      } } }
+  ] }] };
+const pizzaSelection = (revision = 1) => ({ schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6e2-pizza", configurationRevision: revision, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" },
+  { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "toppings", instances: [
+    { instanceId: "cheese-1", optionId: "cheese", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "sauces", instances: [{ instanceId: "sauce-1", optionId: "bbq" }] }] },
+    { instanceId: "cheese-2", optionId: "cheese" }, { instanceId: "cheese-3", optionId: "cheese" }
+  ] }
+] });
+const comboSelection = () => ({ schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6e2-combo", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{
+  type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "slots", instances: [
+    { instanceId: "z-first", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6e2-source", configurationRevision: 1,
+      groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-small" }] } },
+    { instanceId: "z-second", optionId: "second-original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "s6e2-source", configurationRevision: 1,
