+import React from "react";
+import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { ConfigurationTreePanel } from "./configuration-workspace";
+import { pizzaMargheritaDemo } from "./demos";
+
+describe("ConfigurationTreePanel", () => {
+  it("renders the recursive Arabic tree with stable node identifiers", () => {
+    const configuration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("product-1", 1);
+    const tree = React.createElement(ConfigurationTreePanel, {
+      configuration,
+      onChange: () => undefined,
+      selectedId: "demo-extra-cheese-small",
+      onSelect: () => undefined
+    });
+    const html = renderToStaticMarkup(React.createElement("div", { dir: "rtl" }, tree));
+    expect(html).toContain("بنية الشبكة");
+    expect(html).toContain("حجم البيتزا");
+    expect(html).toContain("جبنة إضافية");
+    expect(html).toContain("pc-tree-branches");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/configuration-workspace.tsx b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/configuration-workspace.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d324348
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/configuration-workspace.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,461 @@
+"use client";
+
+import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
+import {
+  ArrowDown,
+  ArrowUp,
+  Boxes,
+  ChevronDown,
+  ChevronLeft,
+  CirclePlus,
+  Link2,
+  PackagePlus,
+  Plus,
+  Trash2
+} from "lucide-react";
+import type {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  OptionChoice,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  SizeChoice
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import {
+  appendChildGroup,
+  appendChoice,
+  appendRootGroup,
+  collectPriceNodes,
+  collectSizeChoices,
+  countDescendants,
+  EditableNode,
+  findNode,
+  moveNode,
+  removeNode,
+  updateNode
+} from "./editor-model";
+import type { EditorNodeRef, ProductCandidate, ProductConfigurationEnvelope } from "./types";
+import { searchRestaurantProducts } from "./api";
+
+type WorkspaceProps = {
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  onChange: (configuration: ProductConfigurationV1) => void;
+  currentProductId: string;
+  candidates: ProductCandidate[];
+  sourceConfigurations: ReadonlyMap<string, ProductConfigurationEnvelope>;
+  ensureSource: (productId: string) => Promise<ProductConfigurationEnvelope>;
+  readOnly?: boolean;
+  compact?: boolean;
+};
+
+type TreeProps = Pick<WorkspaceProps, "configuration" | "onChange" | "readOnly"> & {
+  selectedId: string | null;
+  onSelect: (ref: EditorNodeRef) => void;
+};
+
+function nodeHasData(node: EditableNode) {
+  if ("type" in node) return (node.type === "SIZE" ? node.sizes.length : node.options.length) > 0;
+  return countDescendants(node) > 0 || Boolean(node.label.trim());
+}
+
+function TreeActions({
+  refValue,
+  node,
+  onMove,
+  onDelete,
+  readOnly
+}: {
+  refValue: EditorNodeRef;
+  node: EditableNode;
+  onMove: (direction: -1 | 1) => void;
+  onDelete: () => void;
+  readOnly?: boolean;
+}) {
+  if (readOnly) return null;
+  return (
+    <span className="pc-tree-actions">
+      <button type="button" title="تحريك لأعلى" aria-label="تحريك لأعلى" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onMove(-1); }}><ArrowUp size={14} /></button>
+      <button type="button" title="تحريك لأسفل" aria-label="تحريك لأسفل" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onMove(1); }}><ArrowDown size={14} /></button>
+      <button
+        type="button"
+        className="danger"
+        title="حذف"
+        aria-label={`حذف ${refValue.kind}`}
+        onClick={(event) => {
+          event.stopPropagation();
+          const confirmed = !nodeHasData(node) || window.confirm("يحتوي هذا العنصر على بيانات أو عناصر متداخلة. هل تريد حذفه؟");
+          if (confirmed) onDelete();
+        }}
+      ><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
+    </span>
+  );
+}
+
+function ConfigurationBranches({
+  groups,
+  level,
+  selectedId,
+  onSelect,
+  configuration,
+  onChange,
+  readOnly
+}: TreeProps & { groups: ConfigurationGroup[]; level: number }) {
+  return (
+    <div className="pc-tree-branches" style={{ "--pc-depth": level } as React.CSSProperties}>
+      {groups.map((group) => {
+        const groupRef: EditorNodeRef = { kind: "group", id: group.id };
+        const choices = group.type === "SIZE" ? group.sizes : group.options;
+        return (
+          <article className={`pc-tree-group ${selectedId === group.id ? "selected" : ""}`} key={group.id}>
+            <div className="pc-tree-node pc-tree-group-node">
+              <button type="button" className="pc-tree-select" onClick={() => onSelect(groupRef)}>
+                <span className={`pc-tree-type ${group.type.toLocaleLowerCase()}`}>{group.type === "SIZE" ? "أحجام" : "خيارات"}</span>
+                <b>{group.label || "بلا اسم"}</b>
+                <small>{choices.length} عناصر</small>
+              </button>
+              <TreeActions
+                refValue={groupRef}
+                node={group}
+                readOnly={readOnly}
+                onMove={(direction) => onChange(moveNode(configuration, groupRef, direction))}
+                onDelete={() => onChange(removeNode(configuration, groupRef))}
+              />
+            </div>
+            <div className="pc-tree-choices">
+              {choices.map((choice) => {
+                const kind = group.type === "SIZE" ? "size" : "option";
+                const choiceRef: EditorNodeRef = { kind, id: choice.id };
+                return (
+                  <div className="pc-tree-choice-wrap" key={choice.id}>
+                    <div className={`pc-tree-node pc-tree-choice ${selectedId === choice.id ? "selected" : ""}`}>
+                      <button type="button" className="pc-tree-select" onClick={() => onSelect(choiceRef)}>
+                        {choice.children?.length ? <ChevronDown size={15} /> : <ChevronLeft size={15} />}
+                        <span>{choice.label || "بلا اسم"}</span>
+                        <small>{choice.price}</small>
+                        {"linkedProduct" in choice && choice.linkedProduct ? <Link2 size={14} aria-label="صنف مرتبط" /> : null}
+                      </button>
+                      <TreeActions
+                        refValue={choiceRef}
+                        node={choice}
+                        readOnly={readOnly}
+                        onMove={(direction) => onChange(moveNode(configuration, choiceRef, direction))}
+                        onDelete={() => onChange(removeNode(configuration, choiceRef))}
+                      />
+                    </div>
+                    {choice.children?.length ? (
+                      <ConfigurationBranches
+                        groups={choice.children}
+                        level={level + 1}
+                        selectedId={selectedId}
+                        onSelect={onSelect}
+                        configuration={configuration}
+                        onChange={onChange}
+                        readOnly={readOnly}
+                      />
+                    ) : null}
+                  </div>
+                );
+              })}
+              {!readOnly ? (
+                <button type="button" className="pc-tree-add-choice" onClick={() => onChange(appendChoice(configuration, group.id))}>
+                  <Plus size={14} /> {group.type === "SIZE" ? "إضافة حجم" : "إضافة خيار"}
+                </button>
+              ) : null}
+            </div>
+          </article>
+        );
+      })}
+    </div>
+  );
+}
+
+export function ConfigurationTreePanel(props: TreeProps) {
+  return (
+    <section className="pc-tree-panel" aria-label="شجرة تكوين الصنف">
+      <header>
+        <div><Boxes size={19} /><b>بنية الشبكة</b></div>
+        {!props.readOnly ? (
+          <span>
+            <button type="button" onClick={() => props.onChange(appendRootGroup(props.configuration, "SIZE"))}><CirclePlus size={15} /> أحجام</button>
+            <button type="button" onClick={() => props.onChange(appendRootGroup(props.configuration, "OPTIONS"))}><CirclePlus size={15} /> خيارات</button>
+          </span>
+        ) : null}
+      </header>
+      {props.configuration.groups.length ? (
+        <ConfigurationBranches {...props} groups={props.configuration.groups} level={0} />
+      ) : (
+        <div className="pc-empty-tree"><PackagePlus size={28} /><b>ابدأ بإضافة مجموعة أحجام أو خيارات</b><small>يمكنك إنشاء أكثر من مجموعة أحجام مستقلة.</small></div>
+      )}
+    </section>
+  );
+}
+
+function Toggle({ checked, onChange, label, disabled }: { checked: boolean; onChange: (value: boolean) => void; label: string; disabled?: boolean }) {
+  return <label className="pc-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={checked} disabled={disabled} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.checked)} /><span>{label}</span></label>;
+}
+
+function numberValue(value: string, fallback = 0) {
+  if (!value.trim()) return fallback;
+  const parsed = Number(value);
+  return Number.isInteger(parsed) ? parsed : fallback;
+}
+
+function SourceTree({ configuration }: { configuration: ProductConfigurationV1 }) {
+  function renderGroups(groups: ConfigurationGroup[], depth = 0): React.ReactNode {
+    return groups.map((group) => (
+      <div className="pc-source-node" key={group.id} style={{ marginInlineStart: depth * 14 }}>
+        <b>{group.type === "SIZE" ? "أحجام" : "خيارات"}: {group.label}</b>
+        {(group.type === "SIZE" ? group.sizes : group.options).map((choice) => (
+          <div key={choice.id}>
+            <span>{choice.label}</span><small>{choice.price}</small>
+            {choice.children?.length ? renderGroups(choice.children, depth + 1) : null}
+          </div>
+        ))}
+      </div>
+    ));
+  }
+  return <div className="pc-source-tree">{configuration.groups.length ? renderGroups(configuration.groups) : <small>المصدر لا يحتوي على مجموعات.</small>}</div>;
+}
+
+function LinkedProductEditor({
+  option,
+  onOptionChange,
+  configuration,
+  currentProductId,
+  candidates,
+  sourceConfigurations,
+  ensureSource,
+  readOnly
+}: WorkspaceProps & { option: OptionChoice; onOptionChange: (option: OptionChoice) => void }) {
+  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
+  const [searchLoading, setSearchLoading] = useState(false);
+  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<ProductCandidate[]>(candidates);
+  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
+  const linked = option.linkedProduct;
+  const source = linked ? sourceConfigurations.get(linked.sourceProductId) : undefined;
+  const filtered = (search.trim() ? searchResults : candidates).filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== currentProductId).slice(0, 30);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!search.trim()) {
+      setSearchResults(candidates);
+      setSearchLoading(false);
+      return;
+    }
+    let cancelled = false;
+    setSearchLoading(true);
+    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
+      void searchRestaurantProducts(search).then((products) => {
+        if (!cancelled) setSearchResults(products);
+      }).catch(() => {
+        if (!cancelled) setMessage("تعذر البحث عن الأصناف حاليًا.");
+      }).finally(() => {
+        if (!cancelled) setSearchLoading(false);
+      });
+    }, 250);
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+      window.clearTimeout(timer);
+    };
+  }, [search, candidates]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (linked?.sourceProductId && !source) void ensureSource(linked.sourceProductId).catch(() => undefined);
+  }, [linked?.sourceProductId, source, ensureSource]);
+
+  async function selectSource(sourceProductId: string) {
+    setLoading(true);
+    setMessage("");
+    try {
+      const envelope = await ensureSource(sourceProductId);
+      onOptionChange({
+        ...option,
+        linkedProduct: envelope.mode === "NETWORK"
+          ? { sourceProductId, mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: {} }
+          : { sourceProductId, mode: "CUSTOM" }
+      });
+      if (envelope.mode === "LEGACY") setMessage("هذا مصدر Legacy. أنشئ لقطة CUSTOM صريحة قبل الحفظ؛ ORIGINAL غير مسموح.");
+    } catch (error) {
+      setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "تعذر تحميل الصنف المرتبط.");
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function createSnapshot() {
+    if (!linked || !source) return;
+    const snapshot = source.configurationTree
+      ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(source.configurationTree)) as ProductConfigurationV1
+      : { schemaVersion: 1 as const, productId: source.productId, revision: source.configurationVersion, basePrice: source.basePrice, groups: [] };
+    onOptionChange({ ...option, linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: linked.sourceProductId, mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: snapshot } });
+    setMessage("تم إنشاء لقطة CUSTOM صريحة داخل هذا السياق. عدّلها أدناه حسب الحاجة.");
+  }
+
+  const priceNodes = source?.configurationTree ? collectPriceNodes(source.configurationTree) : [];
+
+  return (
+    <section className="pc-linked-editor">
+      <header><Link2 size={17} /><b>Linked Product / Combo</b></header>
+      {!linked ? (
+        <div className="pc-linked-picker">
+          <input value={search} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder="ابحث في أصناف المطعم الحالي..." />
+          {searchLoading ? <small>جارٍ البحث...</small> : null}
+          <div>{filtered.map((candidate) => (
+            <button type="button" disabled={readOnly || loading || !candidate.isAvailable} key={candidate.id} onClick={() => void selectSource(candidate.id)}>
+              <span>{candidate.name}</span><small>{!candidate.isAvailable ? "غير متاح — غير قابل للربط" : candidate.configurationMode === "NETWORK" ? "Network" : "Legacy — CUSTOM فقط"}</small>
+            </button>
+          ))}</div>
+        </div>
+      ) : (
+        <div className="pc-linked-settings">
+          <div className="pc-linked-summary">
+            <b>{candidates.find((candidate) => candidate.id === linked.sourceProductId)?.name ?? linked.sourceProductId}</b>
+            {!readOnly ? <button type="button" className="danger-link" onClick={() => onOptionChange({ ...option, linkedProduct: undefined })}>إزالة الرابط</button> : null}
+          </div>
+          <div className="pc-segmented">
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className={linked.mode === "ORIGINAL" ? "active" : ""}
+              disabled={readOnly || source?.mode !== "NETWORK"}
+              onClick={() => onOptionChange({ ...option, linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: linked.sourceProductId, mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: {} } })}
+            >ORIGINAL</button>
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className={linked.mode === "CUSTOM" ? "active" : ""}
+              disabled={readOnly}
+              onClick={() => onOptionChange({ ...option, linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: linked.sourceProductId, mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: linked.customConfiguration } })}
+            >CUSTOM</button>
+          </div>
+          {source?.mode === "LEGACY" ? <p className="pc-inline-warning">مصدر Legacy: لا يمكن استخدام ORIGINAL، ولا يحدث أي تحويل تلقائي.</p> : null}
+          {linked.mode === "ORIGINAL" ? (
+            <>
+              <div className="pc-source-preview"><b>بنية المصدر الحية</b>{source?.configurationTree ? <SourceTree configuration={source.configurationTree} /> : <small>جارٍ تحميل بنية المصدر...</small>}</div>
+              <div className="pc-overrides">
+                <b>أسعار السياق الأب (لا تُورث أسعار المصدر المستقل)</b>
+                {priceNodes.map((node) => (
+                  <label key={node.id}><span>{node.label}<small>{node.kind}</small></span><input
+                    inputMode="decimal"
+                    disabled={readOnly}
+                    value={linked.originalPriceOverrides?.[node.id] ?? ""}
+                    placeholder="0"
+                    onChange={(event) => {
+                      const originalPriceOverrides = { ...(linked.originalPriceOverrides ?? {}) };
+                      if (event.target.value === "") delete originalPriceOverrides[node.id];
+                      else originalPriceOverrides[node.id] = event.target.value;
+                      onOptionChange({ ...option, linkedProduct: { ...linked, mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides } });
+                    }}
+                  /></label>
+                ))}
+              </div>
+            </>
+          ) : (
+            <div className="pc-custom-snapshot">
+              {!linked.customConfiguration ? (
+                <div className="pc-snapshot-required">
+                  <p>يلزم إنشاء لقطة صريحة. لن يحوّل النظام منتج Legacy تلقائيًا.</p>
+                  <button type="button" disabled={readOnly || !source} onClick={createSnapshot}>إنشاء لقطة CUSTOM صريحة</button>
+                </div>
+              ) : (
+                <>
+                  <div className="pc-snapshot-head"><b>محرر اللقطة المخصصة</b>{!readOnly ? <button type="button" onClick={createSnapshot}>إعادة اللقطة من المصدر</button> : null}</div>
+                  <ConfigurationWorkspace
+                    configuration={linked.customConfiguration}
+                    onChange={(customConfiguration) => onOptionChange({ ...option, linkedProduct: { ...linked, mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration } })}
+                    currentProductId={linked.customConfiguration.productId}
+                    candidates={candidates}
+                    sourceConfigurations={sourceConfigurations}
+                    ensureSource={ensureSource}
+                    readOnly={readOnly}
+                    compact
+                  />
+                </>
+              )}
+            </div>
+          )}
+        </div>
+      )}
+      {message ? <p className="pc-inline-note">{message}</p> : null}
+    </section>
+  );
+}
+
+function NodeInspector(props: WorkspaceProps & { selected: { node: EditableNode; ref: EditorNodeRef } | null }) {
+  const { selected, configuration, onChange, readOnly } = props;
+  if (!selected) return <aside className="pc-inspector pc-empty-inspector"><PackagePlus size={30} /><b>اختر عنصرًا من الشجرة لتعديله</b></aside>;
+  const { node, ref } = selected;
+  const apply = (next: EditableNode) => onChange(updateNode(configuration, ref.id, () => next));
+
+  if (ref.kind === "group") {
+    const group = node as ConfigurationGroup;
+    return (
+      <aside className="pc-inspector">
+        <header><span>{group.type === "SIZE" ? "مجموعة أحجام" : "مجموعة خيارات"}</span><code>{group.id}</code></header>
+        <label><span>اسم المجموعة</span><input disabled={readOnly} value={group.label} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...group, label: event.target.value })} /></label>
+        <Toggle disabled={readOnly} checked={group.available !== false} label="المجموعة متاحة" onChange={(available) => apply({ ...group, available })} />
+        {group.type === "OPTIONS" ? (
+          <div className="pc-field-grid">
+            <label><span>الحد الأدنى</span><input type="number" min="0" disabled={readOnly} value={group.min} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...group, min: numberValue(event.target.value) })} /></label>
+            <label><span>الحد الأقصى</span><input type="number" min="0" disabled={readOnly} value={group.max ?? ""} placeholder="بلا حد تاجر" onChange={(event) => apply({ ...group, max: event.target.value === "" ? null : numberValue(event.target.value) })} /></label>
+            <label><span>الكمية المشمولة</span><input type="number" min="0" disabled={readOnly} value={group.includedQuantity} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...group, includedQuantity: numberValue(event.target.value) })} /></label>
+          </div>
+        ) : <p className="pc-help">كل حجم يحمل سعر بيع كاملًا مستقلًا، وليس فرق سعر.</p>}
+        {!readOnly ? <button type="button" className="pc-wide-action" onClick={() => onChange(appendChoice(configuration, group.id))}><Plus size={15} />{group.type === "SIZE" ? "إضافة حجم" : "إضافة خيار"}</button> : null}
+      </aside>
+    );
+  }
+
+  if (ref.kind === "size") {
+    const size = node as SizeChoice;
+    return (
+      <aside className="pc-inspector">
+        <header><span>حجم بسعر كامل</span><code>{size.id}</code></header>
+        <label><span>اسم الحجم</span><input disabled={readOnly} value={size.label} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...size, label: event.target.value })} /></label>
+        <label><span>السعر الكامل</span><input inputMode="decimal" disabled={readOnly} value={size.price} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...size, price: event.target.value })} /></label>
+        <label><span>السعرات (اختياري)</span><input disabled={readOnly} value={size.calories ?? ""} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...size, calories: event.target.value || null })} /></label>
+        <Toggle disabled={readOnly} checked={size.available !== false} label="الحجم متاح" onChange={(available) => apply({ ...size, available })} />
+        {!readOnly ? <div className="pc-nested-actions"><b>إضافة أسفل الحجم</b><button type="button" onClick={() => onChange(appendChildGroup(configuration, size.id, "OPTIONS"))}>مجموعة خيارات</button></div> : null}
+      </aside>
+    );
+  }
+
+  const option = node as OptionChoice;
+  const sizes = collectSizeChoices(configuration);
+  return (
+    <aside className="pc-inspector">
+      <header><span>خيار / Modifier</span><code>{option.id}</code></header>
+      <label><span>اسم الخيار</span><input disabled={readOnly} value={option.label} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...option, label: event.target.value })} /></label>
+      <label><span>السعر الافتراضي</span><input inputMode="decimal" disabled={readOnly} value={option.price} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...option, price: event.target.value })} /></label>
+      <div className="pc-field-grid">
+        <label><span>أقل كمية</span><input type="number" min="0" disabled={readOnly} value={option.minQuantity ?? ""} placeholder="0" onChange={(event) => apply({ ...option, minQuantity: event.target.value === "" ? undefined : numberValue(event.target.value) })} /></label>
+        <label><span>أقصى كمية</span><input type="number" min="0" disabled={readOnly} value={option.maxQuantity} onChange={(event) => apply({ ...option, maxQuantity: numberValue(event.target.value, 1) })} /></label>
+      </div>
+      <Toggle disabled={readOnly} checked={option.available !== false} label="الخيار متاح" onChange={(available) => apply({ ...option, available })} />
+      {sizes.length ? (
+        <section className="pc-size-overrides">
+          <b>سعر حسب الحجم</b><small>اتركه فارغًا للرجوع إلى السعر الافتراضي؛ 0 يعني مجانيًا صراحة.</small>
+          {sizes.map(({ groupLabel, size }) => {
+            const override = option.priceOverrides?.find((item) => item.sizeChoiceId === size.id);
+            return <label key={size.id}><span>{groupLabel} / {size.label}</span><input inputMode="decimal" disabled={readOnly} value={override?.price ?? ""} placeholder="السعر الافتراضي" onChange={(event) => {
+              const others = (option.priceOverrides ?? []).filter((item) => item.sizeChoiceId !== size.id);
+              apply({ ...option, priceOverrides: [...others, { sizeChoiceId: size.id, price: event.target.value === "" ? null : event.target.value }] });
+            }} /></label>;
+          })}
+        </section>
+      ) : null}
+      {!readOnly ? <div className="pc-nested-actions"><b>مجموعات متداخلة</b><button type="button" onClick={() => onChange(appendChildGroup(configuration, option.id, "OPTIONS"))}>إضافة خيارات</button><button type="button" onClick={() => onChange(appendChildGroup(configuration, option.id, "SIZE"))}>إضافة أحجام</button></div> : null}
+      <LinkedProductEditor {...props} option={option} onOptionChange={apply} />
+    </aside>
+  );
+}
+
+export function ConfigurationWorkspace(props: WorkspaceProps) {
+  const [selectedRef, setSelectedRef] = useState<EditorNodeRef | null>(null);
+  const selected = useMemo(() => selectedRef ? findNode(props.configuration, selectedRef.id) : null, [props.configuration, selectedRef]);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (selectedRef && !selected) setSelectedRef(null);
+  }, [selected, selectedRef]);
+  return (
+    <div className={`pc-workspace ${props.compact ? "compact" : ""}`} dir="rtl">
+      <ConfigurationTreePanel {...props} selectedId={selectedRef?.id ?? null} onSelect={setSelectedRef} />
+      <NodeInspector {...props} selected={selected} />
+    </div>
+  );
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/demos.ts b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/demos.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f464565
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/demos.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,182 @@
+import type { ProductConfigurationV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import type { ProductCandidate, ProductConfigurationEnvelope } from "./types";
+import { cloneConfiguration } from "./editor-model";
+
+export type DemoLinkedSource = {
+  product: ProductCandidate;
+  envelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope;
+};
+
+export function selectComboDemoSources(sources: DemoLinkedSource[]) {
+  const original = sources.find(({ envelope }) => envelope.mode === "NETWORK" && Boolean(envelope.configurationTree)) ?? null;
+  const custom = sources.find(({ envelope }) => envelope.mode === "LEGACY")
+    ?? sources.find(({ product }) => product.id !== original?.product.id)
+    ?? sources[0]
+    ?? null;
+  return { original, custom };
+}
+
+export function pizzaMargheritaDemo(productId: string, revision: number): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision,
+    basePrice: null,
+    groups: [{
+      type: "SIZE",
+      id: "demo-pizza-sizes",
+      label: "حجم البيتزا",
+      sizes: [
+        { id: "demo-size-small", label: "صغير", price: "80", children: nestedPizzaOptions("small") },
+        { id: "demo-size-medium", label: "وسط", price: "110", children: nestedPizzaOptions("medium") },
+        { id: "demo-size-large", label: "كبير", price: "145", children: nestedPizzaOptions("large") }
+      ]
+    }]
+  };
+}
+
+function nestedPizzaOptions(suffix: string) {
+  return [{
+    type: "OPTIONS" as const,
+    id: `demo-pizza-toppings-${suffix}`,
+    label: "الإضافات",
+    min: 0,
+    max: 4,
+    includedQuantity: 0,
+    options: [{
+      id: `demo-extra-cheese-${suffix}`,
+      label: "جبنة إضافية",
+      price: "15",
+      maxQuantity: 2,
+      priceOverrides: [
+        { sizeChoiceId: "demo-size-small", price: "10" },
+        { sizeChoiceId: "demo-size-medium", price: "15" },
+        { sizeChoiceId: "demo-size-large", price: "22.5" }
+      ],
+      children: [{
+        type: "OPTIONS" as const,
+        id: `demo-cheese-finish-${suffix}`,
+        label: "تعديل الجبنة",
+        min: 0,
+        max: 1,
+        includedQuantity: 0,
+        options: [
+          { id: `demo-cheese-baked-${suffix}`, label: "تحمير إضافي", price: "5", maxQuantity: 1 },
+          { id: `demo-cheese-herbs-${suffix}`, label: "أعشاب", price: "3", maxQuantity: 1 }
+        ]
+      }]
+    }, {
+      id: `demo-olives-${suffix}`,
+      label: "زيتون",
+      price: "8",
+      maxQuantity: 2
+    }]
+  }, {
+    type: "OPTIONS" as const,
+    id: `demo-pizza-sauces-${suffix}`,
+    label: "الصوصات",
+    min: 0,
+    max: 3,
+    includedQuantity: 0,
+    options: [
+      { id: `demo-bbq-${suffix}`, label: "باربكيو", price: "6", maxQuantity: 3 },
+      { id: `demo-ranch-${suffix}`, label: "رانش", price: "7", maxQuantity: 3 }
+    ]
+  }];
+}
+
+export function includedQuantityDemo(productId: string, revision: number): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision,
+    basePrice: "100",
+    groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      id: "demo-included-toppings",
+      label: "اختر إضافاتك (أعلى إضافتين مجانًا)",
+      min: 2,
+      max: 5,
+      includedQuantity: 2,
+      options: [
+        { id: "demo-included-mushroom", label: "مشروم", price: "30", maxQuantity: 3 },
+        { id: "demo-included-cheese", label: "جبنة", price: "15", maxQuantity: 3 },
+        { id: "demo-included-meat", label: "لحم", price: "50", maxQuantity: 3 }
+      ]
+    }]
+  };
+}
+
+export function sizeSpecificPricingDemo(productId: string, revision: number): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return pizzaMargheritaDemo(productId, revision);
+}
+
+function explicitCustomSnapshot(source: DemoLinkedSource): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  if (source.envelope.configurationTree) return cloneConfiguration(source.envelope.configurationTree);
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId: source.product.id,
+    revision: source.envelope.configurationVersion,
+    basePrice: source.envelope.basePrice,
+    groups: []
+  };
+}
+
+export function comboDemo(
+  productId: string,
+  revision: number,
+  originalSource: DemoLinkedSource,
+  customSource: DemoLinkedSource
+): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  if (!originalSource.envelope.configurationTree || originalSource.envelope.mode !== "NETWORK") {
+    throw new Error("مثال ORIGINAL يحتاج منتج مصدر محفوظ بنظام Network.");
+  }
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId,
+    revision,
+    basePrice: "0",
+    groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS",
+      id: "demo-combo-slots",
+      label: "مكونات الكومبو المطلوبة",
+      min: 3,
+      max: 3,
+      includedQuantity: 0,
+      options: [{
+        id: "demo-combo-pizza-1",
+        label: `البيتزا الأولى — ${originalSource.product.name}`,
+        price: "100",
+        minQuantity: 1,
+        maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: {
+          sourceProductId: originalSource.product.id,
+          mode: "ORIGINAL",
+          originalPriceOverrides: {}
+        }
+      }, {
+        id: "demo-combo-pizza-2",
+        label: `البيتزا الثانية — ${originalSource.product.name}`,
+        price: "100",
+        minQuantity: 1,
+        maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: {
+          sourceProductId: originalSource.product.id,
+          mode: "ORIGINAL",
+          originalPriceOverrides: {}
+        }
+      }, {
+        id: "demo-combo-custom",
+        label: `اختيار مخصص — ${customSource.product.name}`,
+        price: "40",
+        minQuantity: 1,
+        maxQuantity: 1,
+        linkedProduct: {
+          sourceProductId: customSource.product.id,
+          mode: "CUSTOM",
+          customConfiguration: explicitCustomSnapshot(customSource)
+        }
+      }]
+    }]
+  };
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/editor-model.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/editor-model.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c3f7e58
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/editor-model.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,174 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { calculatePrice, validateConfiguration, type ProductSelectionV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import { buildSelection } from "./configuration-preview";
+import { comboDemo, includedQuantityDemo, pizzaMargheritaDemo, selectComboDemoSources } from "./demos";
+import {
+  appendChildGroup,
+  appendRootGroup,
+  configurationsEqual,
+  createEmptyConfiguration,
+  draftStorageKey,
+  findNode,
+  moveNode,
+  parseDraft,
+  prepareDraft,
+  removeNode,
+  serializeDraft
+} from "./editor-model";
+import type { ProductCandidate, ProductConfigurationEnvelope } from "./types";
+
+const envelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope = {
+  productId: "product-1",
+  mode: "LEGACY",
+  configurationVersion: 0,
+  configurationTree: null,
+  basePrice: null,
+  isAvailable: true,
+  capability: { key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", assigned: true, canRead: true, canWrite: true },
+  orderabilityState: "LEGACY"
+};
+
+describe("product configuration editor model", () => {
+  it("preserves the difference between null and an explicit zero Base", () => {
+    const empty = createEmptyConfiguration(envelope);
+    expect(empty.basePrice).toBeNull();
+    expect(configurationsEqual(empty, { ...empty, basePrice: "0" })).toBe(false);
+    expect(validateConfiguration({ ...empty, basePrice: "0" })).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it("adds, moves, nests, and removes stable nodes without mutating the source", () => {
+    const empty = createEmptyConfiguration(envelope);
+    const first = appendRootGroup(empty, "OPTIONS");
+    const second = appendRootGroup(first, "SIZE");
+    const firstId = second.groups[0].id;
+    const moved = moveNode(second, { kind: "group", id: firstId }, 1);
+    expect(moved.groups[1].id).toBe(firstId);
+    expect(second.groups[0].id).toBe(firstId);
+
+    const optionGroup = second.groups[0];
+    if (optionGroup.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Expected options group");
+    const optionId = optionGroup.options[0].id;
+    const nested = appendChildGroup(second, optionId, "OPTIONS");
+    expect(findNode(nested, optionId)?.ref.kind).toBe("option");
+    expect((findNode(nested, optionId)?.node as { children?: unknown[] }).children).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(findNode(removeNode(nested, { kind: "option", id: optionId }), optionId)).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it("serializes a restaurant-scoped resumable local draft", () => {
+    const draft = prepareDraft(envelope);
+    const parsed = parseDraft(serializeDraft(draft), envelope.productId);
+    expect(parsed).toMatchObject({ expectedVersion: 0, configuration: { productId: "product-1", revision: 1 } });
+    expect(parseDraft(serializeDraft(draft), "another-product")).toBeNull();
+    expect(draftStorageKey("restaurant-a", "product-1")).toContain("restaurant-a:product-1");
+  });
+});
+
+describe("Stage 4 demo fixtures", () => {
+  it("creates a valid nested pizza demo with full size prices and overrides", () => {
+    const demo = pizzaMargheritaDemo("product-1", 1);
+    expect(validateConfiguration(demo)).toEqual([]);
+    expect(demo.basePrice).toBeNull();
+    expect(demo.groups[0].type).toBe("SIZE");
+  });
+
+  it("uses the size-specific override and exact decimal strings in preview pricing", () => {
+    const demo = pizzaMargheritaDemo("product-1", 1);
+    const selection = buildSelection(demo, new Map());
+    const size = selection.groups[0];
+    if (size.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Expected size selection");
+    const toppings = size.children?.find((group) => group.groupId === "demo-pizza-toppings-small");
+    if (!toppings || toppings.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Expected topping selection");
+    toppings.instances.push({
+      instanceId: "cheese-1",
+      optionId: "demo-extra-cheese-small",
+      children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "demo-cheese-finish-small", instances: [] }]
+    });
+    const result = calculatePrice(demo, selection, { catalogId: "restaurant-a", linkedProducts: new Map() });
+    expect(result.valid).toBe(true);
+    expect(result.total).toBe("90");
+    expect(result.lines.find((line) => line.nodeId === "demo-extra-cheese-small")?.amount).toBe("10");
+  });
+
+  it("prices Included Quantity by exempting the highest-priced selected units", () => {
+    const demo = includedQuantityDemo("product-1", 1);
+    const selection: ProductSelectionV1 = {
+      schemaVersion: 1,
+      productId: "product-1",
+      configurationRevision: 1,
+      groups: [{
+        type: "OPTIONS",
+        groupId: "demo-included-toppings",
+        instances: [
+          { instanceId: "mushroom-1", optionId: "demo-included-mushroom" },
+          { instanceId: "cheese-1", optionId: "demo-included-cheese" },
+          { instanceId: "meat-1", optionId: "demo-included-meat" }
+        ]
+      }]
+    };
+    const result = calculatePrice(demo, selection, { catalogId: "restaurant-a", linkedProducts: new Map() });
+    expect(result.valid).toBe(true);
+    expect(result.total).toBe("115");
+    expect(result.lines.filter((line) => line.included).map((line) => line.amount)).toEqual(["30", "50"]);
+  });
+
+  it("creates a valid combo with ORIGINAL, CUSTOM, and a repeated source", () => {
+    const sourceConfiguration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("source-network", 3);
+    const networkEnvelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope = {
+      ...envelope,
+      productId: "source-network",
+      mode: "NETWORK",
+      configurationVersion: 3,
+      configurationTree: sourceConfiguration,
+      basePrice: null,
+      orderabilityState: "PUBLIC_INTEGRATION_PENDING"
+    };
+    const legacyEnvelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope = { ...envelope, productId: "source-legacy", basePrice: "25" };
+    const networkProduct: ProductCandidate = { id: "source-network", name: "بيتزا المصدر", basePrice: null, currency: "EGP", isAvailable: true, configurationMode: "NETWORK", configurationVersion: 3 };
+    const legacyProduct: ProductCandidate = { id: "source-legacy", name: "مشروب قديم", basePrice: 25, currency: "EGP", isAvailable: true, configurationMode: "LEGACY", configurationVersion: 0 };
+    const demo = comboDemo("product-1", 1, { product: networkProduct, envelope: networkEnvelope }, { product: legacyProduct, envelope: legacyEnvelope });
+    expect(validateConfiguration(demo)).toEqual([]);
+    const group = demo.groups[0];
+    if (group.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Expected options group");
+    expect(group.options.map((option) => option.linkedProduct?.sourceProductId)).toEqual(["source-network", "source-network", "source-legacy"]);
+    expect(group.options[2].linkedProduct?.mode).toBe("CUSTOM");
+    expect(group.options[2].linkedProduct?.customConfiguration?.basePrice).toBe("25");
+
+    const sources = new Map([
+      ["source-network", networkEnvelope],
+      ["source-legacy", legacyEnvelope]
+    ]);
+    const selection = buildSelection(demo, sources);
+    const linkedProducts = new Map([
+      ["source-network", { productId: "source-network", catalogId: "restaurant-a", configuration: sourceConfiguration, available: true, orderable: true }],
+      ["source-legacy", { productId: "source-legacy", catalogId: "restaurant-a", configuration: legacyEnvelope.configurationTree ?? { schemaVersion: 1 as const, productId: "source-legacy", revision: 0, basePrice: "25", groups: [] }, available: true, orderable: true }]
+    ]);
+    expect(calculatePrice(demo, selection, { catalogId: "restaurant-a", linkedProducts })).toMatchObject({ valid: true, total: "240" });
+  });
+
+  it("prefers an explicit Legacy source for the CUSTOM demo even when Network is listed first", () => {
+    const sourceConfiguration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("source-network", 3);
+    const networkEnvelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope = {
+      ...envelope,
+      productId: "source-network",
+      mode: "NETWORK",
+      configurationVersion: 3,
+      configurationTree: sourceConfiguration,
+      basePrice: null,
+      orderabilityState: "PUBLIC_INTEGRATION_PENDING"
+    };
+    const legacyEnvelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope = { ...envelope, productId: "source-legacy", basePrice: "25" };
+    const selected = selectComboDemoSources([
+      {
+        product: { id: "source-network", name: "Network", basePrice: null, currency: "EGP", isAvailable: true, configurationMode: "NETWORK", configurationVersion: 3 },
+        envelope: networkEnvelope
+      },
+      {
+        product: { id: "source-legacy", name: "Legacy", basePrice: 25, currency: "EGP", isAvailable: true, configurationMode: "LEGACY", configurationVersion: 0 },
+        envelope: legacyEnvelope
+      }
+    ]);
+    expect(selected.original?.product.id).toBe("source-network");
+    expect(selected.custom?.product.id).toBe("source-legacy");
+    expect(selected.custom?.envelope.mode).toBe("LEGACY");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/editor-model.ts b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/editor-model.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bc4539f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/editor-model.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,272 @@
+import type {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  OptionChoice,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  SizeChoice,
+  SizeGroup
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import type { EditorNodeRef, ProductConfigurationDraft, ProductConfigurationEnvelope } from "./types";
+
+export type EditableNode = ConfigurationGroup | SizeChoice | OptionChoice;
+
+export function cloneConfiguration(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configuration)) as ProductConfigurationV1;
+}
+
+export function newNodeId(prefix: string) {
+  const suffix = typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto
+    ? crypto.randomUUID()
+    : `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
+  return `${prefix}-${suffix}`;
+}
+
+export function createEmptyConfiguration(envelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId: envelope.productId,
+    revision: envelope.configurationVersion + 1,
+    basePrice: envelope.basePrice,
+    groups: []
+  };
+}
+
+export function prepareDraft(envelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope): ProductConfigurationDraft {
+  const configuration = envelope.configurationTree
+    ? cloneConfiguration(envelope.configurationTree)
+    : createEmptyConfiguration(envelope);
+  configuration.revision = envelope.configurationVersion + 1;
+  return { expectedVersion: envelope.configurationVersion, configuration, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
+}
+
+export function serializeDraft(draft: ProductConfigurationDraft) {
+  return JSON.stringify(draft);
+}
+
+export function parseDraft(value: string | null, productId: string): ProductConfigurationDraft | null {
+  if (!value) return null;
+  try {
+    const parsed = JSON.parse(value) as ProductConfigurationDraft;
+    if (
+      !parsed || !Number.isInteger(parsed.expectedVersion) || !parsed.configuration
+      || parsed.configuration.productId !== productId || parsed.configuration.schemaVersion !== 1
+    ) return null;
+    return parsed;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+export function draftStorageKey(restaurantId: string, productId: string) {
+  return `ordersawa:product-configuration-draft:${restaurantId}:${productId}:v1`;
+}
+
+export function configurationsEqual(left: ProductConfigurationV1, right: ProductConfigurationV1) {
+  return JSON.stringify(left) === JSON.stringify(right);
+}
+
+export function createGroup(type: "SIZE" | "OPTIONS"): ConfigurationGroup {
+  if (type === "SIZE") {
+    return {
+      type,
+      id: newNodeId("size-group"),
+      label: "مجموعة أحجام جديدة",
+      sizes: [{ id: newNodeId("size"), label: "حجم جديد", price: "0" }]
+    };
+  }
+  return {
+    type,
+    id: newNodeId("options-group"),
+    label: "مجموعة خيارات جديدة",
+    min: 0,
+    max: null,
+    includedQuantity: 0,
+    options: [{ id: newNodeId("option"), label: "خيار جديد", price: "0", maxQuantity: 1 }]
+  };
+}
+
+export function createSize(): SizeChoice {
+  return { id: newNodeId("size"), label: "حجم جديد", price: "0" };
+}
+
+export function createOption(): OptionChoice {
+  return { id: newNodeId("option"), label: "خيار جديد", price: "0", maxQuantity: 1 };
+}
+
+function visitGroups(
+  groups: ConfigurationGroup[],
+  visitor: (node: EditableNode, ref: EditorNodeRef) => boolean | void
+): boolean {
+  for (const group of groups) {
+    if (visitor(group, { kind: "group", id: group.id })) return true;
+    const choices = group.type === "SIZE" ? group.sizes : group.options;
+    for (const choice of choices) {
+      if (visitor(choice, { kind: group.type === "SIZE" ? "size" : "option", id: choice.id })) return true;
+      if (visitGroups(choice.children ?? [], visitor)) return true;
+    }
+  }
+  return false;
+}
+
+export function findNode(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, id: string): { node: EditableNode; ref: EditorNodeRef } | null {
+  let result: { node: EditableNode; ref: EditorNodeRef } | null = null;
+  visitGroups(configuration.groups, (node, ref) => {
+    if (node.id !== id) return false;
+    result = { node, ref };
+    return true;
+  });
+  return result;
+}
+
+function mapGroups(
+  groups: ConfigurationGroup[],
+  id: string,
+  update: (node: EditableNode) => EditableNode
+): ConfigurationGroup[] {
+  return groups.map((group) => {
+    if (group.id === id) return update(group) as ConfigurationGroup;
+    if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+      return {
+        ...group,
+        sizes: group.sizes.map((size) => size.id === id
+          ? update(size) as SizeChoice
+          : { ...size, children: size.children ? mapGroups(size.children, id, update) : undefined })
+      };
+    }
+    return {
+      ...group,
+      options: group.options.map((option) => option.id === id
+        ? update(option) as OptionChoice
+        : { ...option, children: option.children ? mapGroups(option.children, id, update) : undefined })
+    };
+  });
+}
+
+export function updateNode(
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  id: string,
+  update: (node: EditableNode) => EditableNode
+): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return { ...configuration, groups: mapGroups(configuration.groups, id, update) };
+}
+
+export function appendRootGroup(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, type: "SIZE" | "OPTIONS") {
+  return { ...configuration, groups: [...configuration.groups, createGroup(type)] };
+}
+
+export function appendChildGroup(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, choiceId: string, type: "SIZE" | "OPTIONS") {
+  return updateNode(configuration, choiceId, (node) => ({
+    ...node,
+    children: [...("children" in node && node.children ? node.children : []), createGroup(type)]
+  } as EditableNode));
+}
+
+export function appendChoice(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, groupId: string) {
+  return updateNode(configuration, groupId, (node) => {
+    if (!("type" in node)) return node;
+    return node.type === "SIZE"
+      ? { ...node, sizes: [...node.sizes, createSize()] }
+      : { ...node, options: [...node.options, createOption()] };
+  });
+}
+
+function removeFromGroups(groups: ConfigurationGroup[], ref: EditorNodeRef): ConfigurationGroup[] {
+  return groups
+    .filter((group) => !(ref.kind === "group" && group.id === ref.id))
+    .map((group) => group.type === "SIZE"
+      ? {
+          ...group,
+          sizes: group.sizes
+            .filter((size) => !(ref.kind === "size" && size.id === ref.id))
+            .map((size) => ({ ...size, children: size.children ? removeFromGroups(size.children, ref) : undefined }))
+        }
+      : {
+          ...group,
+          options: group.options
+            .filter((option) => !(ref.kind === "option" && option.id === ref.id))
+            .map((option) => ({ ...option, children: option.children ? removeFromGroups(option.children, ref) : undefined }))
+        });
+}
+
+export function removeNode(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, ref: EditorNodeRef) {
+  return { ...configuration, groups: removeFromGroups(configuration.groups, ref) };
+}
+
+function moveInArray<T extends { id: string }>(items: T[], id: string, direction: -1 | 1) {
+  const index = items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id);
+  const target = index + direction;
+  if (index < 0 || target < 0 || target >= items.length) return null;
+  const moved = [...items];
+  [moved[index], moved[target]] = [moved[target], moved[index]];
+  return moved;
+}
+
+function moveInGroups(groups: ConfigurationGroup[], ref: EditorNodeRef, direction: -1 | 1): [ConfigurationGroup[], boolean] {
+  if (ref.kind === "group") {
+    const moved = moveInArray(groups, ref.id, direction);
+    if (moved) return [moved, true];
+  }
+  let changed = false;
+  const next = groups.map((group) => {
+    if (changed) return group;
+    if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+      if (ref.kind === "size") {
+        const sizes = moveInArray(group.sizes, ref.id, direction);
+        if (sizes) { changed = true; return { ...group, sizes }; }
+      }
+      return {
+        ...group,
+        sizes: group.sizes.map((size) => {
+          if (changed || !size.children) return size;
+          const [children, childChanged] = moveInGroups(size.children, ref, direction);
+          changed ||= childChanged;
+          return childChanged ? { ...size, children } : size;
+        })
+      };
+    }
+    if (ref.kind === "option") {
+      const options = moveInArray(group.options, ref.id, direction);
+      if (options) { changed = true; return { ...group, options }; }
+    }
+    return {
+      ...group,
+      options: group.options.map((option) => {
+        if (changed || !option.children) return option;
+        const [children, childChanged] = moveInGroups(option.children, ref, direction);
+        changed ||= childChanged;
+        return childChanged ? { ...option, children } : option;
+      })
+    };
+  });
+  return [next, changed];
+}
+
+export function moveNode(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, ref: EditorNodeRef, direction: -1 | 1) {
+  return { ...configuration, groups: moveInGroups(configuration.groups, ref, direction)[0] };
+}
+
+export function collectSizeChoices(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1) {
+  const sizes: Array<{ groupId: string; groupLabel: string; size: SizeChoice }> = [];
+  visitGroups(configuration.groups, (node) => {
+    if ("type" in node && node.type === "SIZE") {
+      node.sizes.forEach((size) => sizes.push({ groupId: node.id, groupLabel: node.label, size }));
+    }
+  });
+  return sizes;
+}
+
+export function countDescendants(node: EditableNode) {
+  let count = 0;
+  const children = "children" in node ? node.children ?? [] : [];
+  visitGroups(children, () => { count += 1; });
+  if ("type" in node) count += node.type === "SIZE" ? node.sizes.length : node.options.length;
+  return count;
+}
+
+export function collectPriceNodes(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1) {
+  const nodes: Array<{ id: string; label: string; kind: "SIZE" | "OPTION"; price: string }> = [];
+  visitGroups(configuration.groups, (node, ref) => {
+    if (ref.kind === "size") nodes.push({ id: node.id, label: node.label, kind: "SIZE", price: (node as SizeChoice).price });
+    if (ref.kind === "option") nodes.push({ id: node.id, label: node.label, kind: "OPTION", price: (node as OptionChoice).price });
+  });
+  return nodes;
+}

+import type { ConfigurationIssue } from "@menu/shared";
+
+const ISSUE_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
+  INVALID_CONFIGURATION_SHAPE: "بنية شبكة التكوين غير صحيحة.",
+  CONFIGURATION_PRODUCT_MISMATCH: "معرّف الصنف داخل الشبكة لا يطابق الصنف المفتوح.",
+  INVALID_NEXT_REVISION: "نسخة التكوين التالية غير صحيحة. أعد التحميل ثم حاول مجددًا.",
+  DUPLICATE_NODE_ID: "يوجد معرّف ثابت مكرر داخل الشبكة.",
+  EMPTY_GROUP: "يجب أن تحتوي المجموعة على عنصر واحد على الأقل.",
+  INVALID_MONEY: "قيمة السعر غير صحيحة. استخدم رقمًا عشريًا موجبًا بحد أقصى 6 منازل.",
+  INVALID_MONEY_SCALE: "السعر يتجاوز 6 منازل عشرية.",
+  INVALID_GROUP_MIN: "الحد الأدنى للمجموعة غير صحيح.",
+  INVALID_GROUP_MAX: "الحد الأقصى للمجموعة غير صحيح.",
+  INVALID_INCLUDED_QUANTITY: "الكمية المجانية يجب أن تكون ضمن حدود المجموعة.",
+  INVALID_OPTION_QUANTITY: "حدود كمية الخيار غير صحيحة.",
+  OPTION_MAX_EXCEEDS_GROUP_MAX: "الحد الأقصى للخيار يتجاوز حد المجموعة.",
+  SIZE_AFTER_SIZE: "لا يمكن إضافة مجموعة أحجام أسفل مسار دخل بالفعل في حجم.",
+  MAX_DEPTH_EXCEEDED: "تجاوز التداخل الحد الأقصى المعتمد (12 مستوى).",
+  MAX_NODES_EXCEEDED: "تجاوزت الشبكة الحد الأقصى لعدد العقد.",
+  SELF_LINK: "لا يمكن ربط الصنف بنفسه.",
+  LINK_CYCLE: "الرابط ينشئ دورة مباشرة أو عميقة بين الأصناف.",
+  LINK_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: "الصنف المرتبط غير موجود أو غير متاح في هذا المطعم.",
+  CROSS_CATALOG_LINK: "لا يمكن ربط أصناف من مطاعم مختلفة.",
+  MISSING_CUSTOM_CONFIGURATION: "وضع CUSTOM يحتاج لقطة تكوين صريحة.",
+  ORIGINAL_LINKED_SOURCE_REQUIRES_NETWORK_CONFIGURATION: "وضع ORIGINAL يحتاج مصدرًا محفوظًا بنظام Network.",
+  LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: "الصنف المرتبط غير متاح حاليًا.",
+  LINKED_PRODUCT_NOT_ORDERABLE: "الصنف المرتبط غير قابل للطلب حاليًا.",
+  MISSING_GROUP_SELECTION: "هذه المجموعة المطلوبة لم تُستكمل.",
+  GROUP_MIN_NOT_MET: "لم يتم استيفاء الحد الأدنى للمجموعة.",
+  GROUP_MAX_EXCEEDED: "تم تجاوز الحد الأقصى للمجموعة.",
+  OPTION_QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE: "كمية الخيار خارج الحدود المسموحة.",
+  MISSING_LINKED_SELECTION: "أكمل اختيارات الصنف المرتبط.",
+  STALE_CONFIGURATION_REVISION: "المعاينة مبنية على نسخة قديمة من التكوين. أعد ضبطها."
+};
+
+export function issueMessage(issue: ConfigurationIssue) {
+  return ISSUE_MESSAGES[issue.code] ?? issue.message;
+}
+
+export function apiErrorMessage(status: number, code?: string) {
+  if (status === 403 && code === "FEATURE_LOCKED") return "ميزة شبكة تكوين الأصناف غير متاحة في الباقة الحالية. بياناتك المحفوظة لم تُحذف.";
+  if (status === 403) return "لا تملك الصلاحية اللازمة لتعديل شبكة هذا الصنف.";
+  if (status === 409) return "تغيّرت الشبكة في جلسة أخرى. احتفظنا بمسودتك؛ أعد تحميل النسخة الحالية ثم راجع الاختلافات.";
+  if (status === 400) return "تعذر الحفظ لأن الشبكة تحتوي على أخطاء تحقق.";
+  return "تعذر حفظ شبكة التكوين. حاول مرة أخرى.";
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,290 @@
+"use client";
+
+import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
+import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, CloudOff, FlaskConical, Loader2, RefreshCcw, Save, Undo2 } from "lucide-react";
+import { validateConfiguration, type ConfigurationGroup, type ConfigurationIssue, type ProductConfigurationV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import { ConfigurationPreview } from "./configuration-preview";
+import { ConfigurationWorkspace } from "./configuration-workspace";
+import { loadProductConfiguration, saveProductConfiguration, searchRestaurantProducts } from "./api";
+import {
+  comboDemo,
+  includedQuantityDemo,
+  pizzaMargheritaDemo,
+  selectComboDemoSources,
+  sizeSpecificPricingDemo,
+  type DemoLinkedSource
+} from "./demos";
+import {
+  configurationsEqual,
+  draftStorageKey,
+  parseDraft,
+  prepareDraft,
+  serializeDraft
+} from "./editor-model";
+import { apiErrorMessage, issueMessage } from "./messages";
+import type {
+  ProductCandidate,
+  ProductConfigurationApiError,
+  ProductConfigurationDraft,
+  ProductConfigurationEnvelope
+} from "./types";
+
+type EditorProps = {
+  productId: string;
+  productName: string;
+  currency: string;
+  restaurantId: string;
+  onSaved?: (envelope: ProductConfigurationEnvelope) => void;
+  onDirtyChange?: (dirty: boolean) => void;
+};
+
+function linkedSourceIds(groups: ConfigurationGroup[], result = new Set<string>()) {
+  groups.forEach((group) => {
+    const choices = group.type === "SIZE" ? group.sizes : group.options;
+    choices.forEach((choice) => {
+      if ("linkedProduct" in choice && choice.linkedProduct) {
+        result.add(choice.linkedProduct.sourceProductId);
+        if (choice.linkedProduct.mode === "CUSTOM" && choice.linkedProduct.customConfiguration) {
+          linkedSourceIds(choice.linkedProduct.customConfiguration.groups, result);
+        }
+      }
+      linkedSourceIds(choice.children ?? [], result);
+    });
+  });
+  return result;
+}
+
+function hasSize(groups: ConfigurationGroup[]): boolean {
+  return groups.some((group) => group.type === "SIZE" || (group.type === "OPTIONS" && group.options.some((option) => hasSize(option.children ?? []))));
+}
+
+export function ProductConfigurationEditor(props: EditorProps) {
+  const [loadState, setLoadState] = useState<"loading" | "ready" | "error">("loading");
+  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error" | "conflict">("idle");
+  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
+  const [serverIssues, setServerIssues] = useState<ConfigurationIssue[]>([]);
+  const [envelope, setEnvelope] = useState<ProductConfigurationEnvelope | null>(null);
+  const [baseline, setBaseline] = useState<ProductConfigurationV1 | null>(null);
+  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<ProductConfigurationDraft | null>(null);
+  const [pendingLocalDraft, setPendingLocalDraft] = useState<ProductConfigurationDraft | null>(null);
+  const [candidates, setCandidates] = useState<ProductCandidate[]>([]);
+  const [sourceConfigurations, setSourceConfigurations] = useState<Map<string, ProductConfigurationEnvelope>>(new Map());
+  const sourceRef = useRef(sourceConfigurations);
+  sourceRef.current = sourceConfigurations;
+  const storageKey = draftStorageKey(props.restaurantId, props.productId);
+
+  const ensureSource = useCallback(async (productId: string) => {
+    const existing = sourceRef.current.get(productId);
+    if (existing) return existing;
+    const loaded = await loadProductConfiguration(productId);
+    setSourceConfigurations((current) => new Map(current).set(productId, loaded));
+    return loaded;
+  }, []);
+
+  const load = useCallback(async () => {
+    setLoadState("loading");
+    setMessage("");
+    try {
+      const [nextEnvelope, products] = await Promise.all([
+        loadProductConfiguration(props.productId),
+        searchRestaurantProducts()
+      ]);
+      const nextDraft = prepareDraft(nextEnvelope);
+      setEnvelope(nextEnvelope);
+      setDraft(nextDraft);
+      setBaseline(nextDraft.configuration);
+      setCandidates(products.filter((product) => product.id !== props.productId));
+      const local = parseDraft(window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey), props.productId);
+      setPendingLocalDraft(local && !configurationsEqual(local.configuration, nextDraft.configuration) ? local : null);
+      setLoadState("ready");
+      setSaveState("idle");
+      setServerIssues([]);
+    } catch (error) {
+      setLoadState("error");
+      setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "تعذر تحميل شبكة التكوين.");
+    }
+  }, [props.productId, storageKey]);
+
+  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, [load]);
+
+  const dirty = Boolean(draft && baseline && !configurationsEqual(draft.configuration, baseline));
+  useEffect(() => {
+    props.onDirtyChange?.(dirty);
+    return () => props.onDirtyChange?.(false);
+  }, [dirty, props.onDirtyChange]);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!draft || !dirty) return;
+    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, serializeDraft({ ...draft, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() })), 350);
+    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
+  }, [draft, dirty, storageKey]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    function warn(event: BeforeUnloadEvent) {
+      if (!dirty) return;
+      event.preventDefault();
+      event.returnValue = "";
+    }
+    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
+    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
+  }, [dirty]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    function protectNavigation(event: MouseEvent) {
+      if (!dirty || event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0) return;
+      const target = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
+      const anchor = target?.closest("a[href]") as HTMLAnchorElement | null;
+      if (!anchor || anchor.target === "_blank" || anchor.origin !== window.location.origin) return;
+      if (!window.confirm("لديك تغييرات غير محفوظة في شبكة التكوين. هل تريد مغادرة الصفحة؟")) {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        event.stopPropagation();
+      }
+    }
+    document.addEventListener("click", protectNavigation, true);
+    return () => document.removeEventListener("click", protectNavigation, true);
+  }, [dirty]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!draft) return;
+    linkedSourceIds(draft.configuration.groups).forEach((id) => void ensureSource(id).catch(() => undefined));
+  }, [draft, ensureSource]);
+
+  const issues = useMemo(() => draft ? validateConfiguration(draft.configuration) : [], [draft]);
+  const displayedIssues = useMemo(() => [...issues, ...serverIssues], [issues, serverIssues]);
+  const readOnly = envelope ? !envelope.capability.canWrite : true;
+
+  function changeConfiguration(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1) {
+    if (readOnly) return;
+    setDraft((current) => current ? { ...current, configuration } : current);
+    setSaveState("idle");
+    setMessage("");
+    setServerIssues([]);
+  }
+
+  async function save() {
+    if (!draft || issues.length || readOnly) return;
+    setSaveState("saving");
+    setMessage("");
+    const outgoing = { ...draft.configuration, revision: draft.expectedVersion + 1 };
+    try {
+      const saved = await saveProductConfiguration(props.productId, draft.expectedVersion, outgoing);
+      const nextDraft = prepareDraft(saved);
+      setEnvelope(saved);
+      setDraft(nextDraft);
+      setBaseline(nextDraft.configuration);
+      window.localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
+      setPendingLocalDraft(null);
+      setSaveState("saved");
+      setMessage("تم حفظ الشبكة والفهرس المرتبط بها ذريًا.");
+      props.onSaved?.(saved);
+    } catch (error) {
+      const apiError = error as ProductConfigurationApiError;
+      setSaveState(apiError?.status === 409 ? "conflict" : "error");
+      setMessage(apiErrorMessage(apiError?.status ?? 0, apiError?.code));
+      setServerIssues(apiError?.issues ?? []);
+      if (apiError?.status === 403) {
+        void loadProductConfiguration(props.productId).then((latest) => setEnvelope(latest)).catch(() => undefined);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function rebaseAfterConflict() {
+    if (!draft) return;
+    try {
+      const latest = await loadProductConfiguration(props.productId);
+      setEnvelope(latest);
+      setDraft({ ...draft, expectedVersion: latest.configurationVersion, configuration: { ...draft.configuration, revision: latest.configurationVersion + 1 } });
+      setSaveState("idle");
+      setMessage("احتفظنا بمسودتك وربطناها بالنسخة الحالية. راجعها ثم احفظ يدويًا.");
+    } catch (error) {
+      setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "تعذر تحميل النسخة الحالية.");
+    }
+  }
+
+  function cancel() {
+    if (!baseline || !draft) return;
+    if (dirty && !window.confirm("سيتم تجاهل تعديلات الشبكة غير المحفوظة. هل تريد المتابعة؟")) return;
+    setDraft({ ...draft, configuration: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(baseline)) as ProductConfigurationV1 });
+    window.localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
+    setSaveState("idle");
+    setMessage("");
+    setServerIssues([]);
+  }
+
+  function applyDemo(kind: "pizza" | "included" | "size") {
+    if (!draft || !window.confirm("سيستبدل المثال المسودة الحالية محليًا فقط، ولن يُرسل إلى الخادم قبل الضغط على حفظ. متابعة؟")) return;
+    const factory = kind === "included" ? includedQuantityDemo : kind === "size" ? sizeSpecificPricingDemo : pizzaMargheritaDemo;
+    changeConfiguration(factory(props.productId, draft.expectedVersion + 1));
+  }
+
+  async function applyComboDemo() {
+    if (!draft || !window.confirm("سيستبدل مثال الكومبو المسودة الحالية محليًا فقط. متابعة؟")) return;
+    setSaveState("saving");
+    setMessage("جارٍ البحث عن مصدر Network داخل المطعم...");
+    try {
+      const sources: DemoLinkedSource[] = [];
+      for (const product of candidates.slice(0, 30)) {
+        const source = await ensureSource(product.id);
+        sources.push({ product, envelope: source });
+        const selected = selectComboDemoSources(sources);
+        if (selected.original && selected.custom?.envelope.mode === "LEGACY") break;
+      }
+      const { original, custom } = selectComboDemoSources(sources);
+      if (!original || !custom) throw new Error("لا يوجد مصدر Network مناسب لبناء مثال ORIGINAL في بيانات الاختبار الحالية.");
+      changeConfiguration(comboDemo(props.productId, draft.expectedVersion + 1, original, custom));
+      setMessage("تم تحميل مثال Combo في المسودة فقط. يتضمن ORIGINAL وCUSTOM وتكرار المصدر.");
+      setSaveState("idle");
+    } catch (error) {
+      setSaveState("error");
+      setMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "تعذر إنشاء مثال الكومبو.");
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (loadState === "loading") return <section className="pc-shell pc-loading" dir="rtl"><Loader2 className="spin" /><span>جارٍ تحميل شبكة التكوين...</span></section>;
+  if (loadState === "error" || !draft || !envelope) return <section className="pc-shell pc-load-error" dir="rtl"><AlertTriangle /><b>{message || "تعذر تحميل المحرر."}</b><button type="button" onClick={() => void load()}><RefreshCcw size={15} /> إعادة المحاولة</button></section>;
+
+  return (
+    <section className="pc-shell" dir="rtl" aria-label="محرر شبكة تكوين الصنف">
+      <header className="pc-main-header">
+        <div><span className="pc-header-icon"><FlaskConical size={23} /></span><div><h2>شبكة تكوين الصنف</h2><p>{props.productName || "الصنف الحالي"} · النسخة الحالية {envelope.configurationVersion} · {envelope.mode === "NETWORK" ? "Network" : "Legacy"}</p></div></div>
+        <div className="pc-save-actions">
+          {dirty ? <span className="pc-dirty"><CloudOff size={14} /> تغييرات غير محفوظة</span> : <span className="pc-clean"><CheckCircle2 size={14} /> متزامن</span>}
+          <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={!dirty || saveState === "saving"} onClick={cancel}><Undo2 size={16} /> إلغاء</button>
+          <button type="button" className="primary" disabled={!dirty || displayedIssues.length > 0 || readOnly || saveState === "saving"} onClick={() => void save()}>{saveState === "saving" ? <Loader2 className="spin" size={16} /> : <Save size={16} />} حفظ الشبكة</button>
+        </div>
+      </header>
+
+      {pendingLocalDraft ? <div className="pc-draft-banner"><div><b>توجد مسودة محلية غير محفوظة</b><small>حُفظت {new Date(pendingLocalDraft.savedAt).toLocaleString("ar-EG")}. لن تُرسل تلقائيًا.</small></div><span><button type="button" onClick={() => { setDraft(pendingLocalDraft); setPendingLocalDraft(null); }}>استعادة المسودة</button><button type="button" onClick={() => { window.localStorage.removeItem(storageKey); setPendingLocalDraft(null); }}>تجاهلها</button></span></div> : null}
+      {!envelope.capability.assigned ? <div className="pc-capability-warning"><AlertTriangle size={18} /><div><b>الميزة غير متاحة في الباقة الحالية</b><p>يمكنك قراءة الشبكة المحفوظة، لكن الحفظ والتفعيل متوقفان. لم تُحذف البيانات ولم يحدث رجوع إلى Base Price.</p></div></div> : null}
+      {saveState === "conflict" ? <div className="pc-conflict"><AlertTriangle size={18} /><div><b>تعارض نسخة 409</b><p>{message}</p><button type="button" onClick={() => void rebaseAfterConflict()}>تحميل رقم النسخة الحالية مع إبقاء مسودتي</button><button type="button" onClick={() => void load()}>عرض نسخة الخادم بدلًا منها</button></div></div> : null}
+      {message && saveState !== "conflict" ? <p className={`pc-status ${saveState}`}>{message}</p> : null}
+
+      <section className="pc-foundation-card">
+        <div><b>Base Price</b><small>القيمة الفارغة تختلف عن الصفر الصريح. وجود أي Size يجعل المحرك يتجاهل Base.</small></div>
+        {draft.configuration.basePrice === null ? (
+          <div className="pc-null-base"><span>لا يوجد سعر أساسي (null)</span>{!readOnly ? <button type="button" onClick={() => changeConfiguration({ ...draft.configuration, basePrice: "0" })}>إضافة سعر — يبدأ بصفر صريح</button> : null}</div>
+        ) : (
+          <label><span>السعر الأساسي</span><input inputMode="decimal" disabled={readOnly} value={draft.configuration.basePrice} onChange={(event) => changeConfiguration({ ...draft.configuration, basePrice: event.target.value })} />{!readOnly ? <button type="button" onClick={() => changeConfiguration({ ...draft.configuration, basePrice: null })}>جعله null</button> : null}</label>
+        )}
+        {hasSize(draft.configuration.groups) ? <p>يوجد Size في الشبكة؛ Base Price لن يدخل في ناتج التسعير.</p> : null}
+      </section>
+
+      <section className="pc-demo-bar">
+        <div><FlaskConical size={17} /><span><b>أمثلة Demo معزولة</b><small>تملأ المسودة فقط ولا تُنشئ منتجات أو بيانات Production.</small></span></div>
+        <span><button type="button" disabled={readOnly} onClick={() => applyDemo("pizza")}>Pizza Margherita</button><button type="button" disabled={readOnly} onClick={() => applyDemo("included")}>Included Quantity</button><button type="button" disabled={readOnly} onClick={() => applyDemo("size")}>Size Pricing</button><button type="button" disabled={readOnly} onClick={() => void applyComboDemo()}>Combo ORIGINAL/CUSTOM</button></span>
+      </section>
+
+      {displayedIssues.length ? <section className="pc-validation"><header><AlertTriangle size={17} /><b>أخطاء التحقق ({displayedIssues.length})</b></header><ul>{displayedIssues.map((issue, index) => <li key={`${issue.code}-${issue.path}-${index}`}><b>{issueMessage(issue)}</b><code>{issue.path}</code></li>)}</ul></section> : null}
+
+      <ConfigurationWorkspace
+        configuration={draft.configuration}
+        onChange={changeConfiguration}
+        currentProductId={props.productId}
+        candidates={candidates}
+        sourceConfigurations={sourceConfigurations}
+        ensureSource={ensureSource}
+        readOnly={readOnly}
+      />
+      <ConfigurationPreview configuration={draft.configuration} currency={props.currency} restaurantId={props.restaurantId} sources={sourceConfigurations} />
+    </section>
+  );
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/types.ts b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/types.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..20478f5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/dashboard/product-configuration/types.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+import type { ConfigurationIssue, ProductConfigurationV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+
+export type ConfigurationCapability = {
+  key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION";
+  assigned: boolean;
+  canRead: boolean;
+  canWrite: boolean;
+};
+
+export type ProductConfigurationEnvelope = {
+  productId: string;
+  mode: "LEGACY" | "NETWORK";
+  configurationVersion: number;
+  configurationTree: ProductConfigurationV1 | null;
+  basePrice: string | null;
+  isAvailable: boolean;
+  capability: ConfigurationCapability;
+  orderabilityState: "LEGACY" | "SETUP_INCOMPLETE" | "PUBLIC_INTEGRATION_PENDING" | "ACTION_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY";
+};
+
+export type ProductCandidate = {
+  id: string;
+  name: string;
+  basePrice: number | null;
+  currency: string;
+  isAvailable: boolean;
+  configurationMode: "LEGACY" | "NETWORK";
+  configurationVersion: number;
+  category?: { id?: string; name: string } | null;
+};
+
+export type ProductConfigurationDraft = {
+  expectedVersion: number;
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  savedAt: string;
+};
+
+export type EditorNodeKind = "group" | "size" | "option";
+
+export type EditorNodeRef = {
+  kind: EditorNodeKind;
+  id: string;
+};
+
+export type ConfigurationApiIssue = ConfigurationIssue & {
+  translatedMessage?: string;
+};
+
+export class ProductConfigurationApiError extends Error {
+  constructor(
+    message: string,
+    readonly status: number,
+    readonly code?: string,
+    readonly issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [],
+    readonly details?: unknown
+  ) {
+    super(message);
+    this.name = "ProductConfigurationApiError";
+  }
+}

           <label>

@@ -1467,10 +1498,24 @@ export function ProductForm({ productId }: { productId?: string }) {
           <p>{form.description || "وصف مختصر للمنتج سيظهر هنا."}</p>
           {form.ingredients.length ? <small>{form.ingredients.map((item) => item.name.trim()).filter(Boolean).join(" - ")}</small> : null}
           <b>
-            {form.basePrice || "0"} {form.currency}
+            {configurationMode === "NETWORK" ? productId ? "السعر من شبكة التكوين" : "شبكة غير مسعّرة بعد" : form.basePrice.trim() ? displayCurrencyAmount(form.basePrice, form.currency) : "لا يوجد سعر أساسي"}
