diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-model.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-model.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..61601db
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-model.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,260 @@
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import { createSelectionKey, type ProductSelectionV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import type { PublicProduct, PublicProductQuoteResponse } from "@/lib/api";
+import {
+  acceptNetworkRecheck,
+  addOrEditNetworkCartItem,
+  applyNetworkRecheck,
+  applyRebasedNetworkRecheck,
+  cartNeedsPreviewGate,
+  createNetworkCartLineId,
+  networkCartItemFromQuote,
+  putLegacyCartItem,
+  restoreCartStorage,
+  serializeCartStorage,
+  shouldUseTrustedWhatsappCheckout,
+  updateCartLineQuantity,
+  updateCartLineNote
+} from "./cart-model";
+
+const product: PublicProduct = { id: "pizza", slug: "pizza", name: "بيتزا", basePrice: null, currency: "EGP" };
+
+function selection(size = "medium", revision = 1, instanceId = "unit-1", linkedSize = "small"): ProductSelectionV1 {
+  return { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "pizza", configurationRevision: revision, groups: [
+    { type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: size },
+    { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "toppings", instances: [{ instanceId, optionId: "linked", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "sauces", instances: [{ instanceId: `${instanceId}-sauce`, optionId: "bbq" }] }],
+      linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: linkedSize }] }
+    }] }
+  ] };
+}
+
+function quote(selected = selection(), total = "280.000001", sourceRevision = 1): PublicProductQuoteResponse {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1, productId: "pizza", configurationRevision: selected.configurationRevision,
+    selectionKey: createSelectionKey(selected), canonicalSelection: selected, currency: "EGP", trustedTotal: total,
+    baseIgnored: true,
+    priceBreakdown: [
+      { kind: "SIZE", path: "$selection.groups.sizes", nodeId: "medium", label: "Medium", amount: "200", chargedAmount: "200", included: false },
+      { kind: "OPTION", path: "$selection.groups.toppings.unit-1.linked", nodeId: "linked", label: "Pizza slot", sourceProductId: "source", instanceId: "unit-1", amount: "80.000001", chargedAmount: "80.000001", included: false }
+    ],
+    linkedSourceRevisions: [{ sourceProductId: "source", mode: "NETWORK", configurationRevision: sourceRevision }],
+    configurationOrderable: true, previewOnly: true, orderAction: "STAGE_6_REQUIRED", orderingEnabled: false,
+    runtimeContext: { scope: "RESTAURANT", outletDifferentialApplied: false, serviceModeApplied: false, productScheduleApplied: false }
+  };
+}
+
+function item(selected = selection(), total = "280.000001", sourceRevision = 1, lineId = "line-1") {
+  const value = networkCartItemFromQuote({ product, restaurantSlug: "restaurant-a", quote: quote(selected, total, sourceRevision), lineId });
+  if (!value) throw new Error("Expected valid fixture quote");
+  return value;
+}
+
+describe("versioned public cart model", () => {
+  it("adds one Network product and merges semantically equal selections with different unit IDs", () => {
+    const first = item();
+    const equivalent = item(selection("medium", 1, "another-instance"), "280.000001", 1, "line-2");
+    expect(first.selectionKey).toBe(equivalent.selectionKey);
+    const merged = addOrEditNetworkCartItem([first], equivalent);
+    expect(merged).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(merged[0]).toMatchObject({ mode: "NETWORK", quantity: 2, lineId: "line-1" });
+    expect((merged[0] as typeof first).selection.groups[1]).toMatchObject({ type: "OPTIONS", instances: [expect.objectContaining({ instanceId: "unit-1" })] });
+  });
+
+  it("keeps different sizes, revisions, linked child choices, source revisions, restaurants, and currencies apart", () => {
+    const first = item();
+    const variants = [
+      item(selection("large"), "300", 1, "size"),
+      item(selection("medium", 2), "280", 1, "revision"),
+      item(selection("medium", 1, "another", "large"), "290", 1, "linked-child"),
+      item(selection(), "280", 2, "source-revision"),
+      networkCartItemFromQuote({ product, restaurantSlug: "restaurant-b", quote: quote(), lineId: "other-tenant" })!,
+      networkCartItemFromQuote({ product: { ...product, currency: "USD" }, restaurantSlug: "restaurant-a", quote: { ...quote(), currency: "USD" }, lineId: "other-currency" })!
+    ];
+    const cart = variants.reduce((current, variant) => addOrEditNetworkCartItem(current, variant), [first] as ReturnType<typeof addOrEditNetworkCartItem>);
+    expect(cart).toHaveLength(7);
+    expect(new Set(cart.map((line) => line.mode === "NETWORK" ? line.identity : line.lineId)).size).toBe(7);
+  });
+
+  it("edits a line without mutating the old selection and merges if the new identity already exists", () => {
+    const first = item();
+    const large = item(selection("large"), "300", 1, "line-large");
+    const edited = addOrEditNetworkCartItem([first, large], { ...large, lineId: "fresh" }, first.lineId);
+    expect(edited).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(edited[0]).toMatchObject({ lineId: "line-large", quantity: 2 });
+    expect(first.selection.groups[0]).toMatchObject({ sizeChoiceId: "medium" });
+  });
+
+  it("adds the selected draft quantity without merging different configurations", () => {
+    const first = item();
+    const different = item(selection("large"), "300", 1, "line-large");
+    const cart = addOrEditNetworkCartItem([first], different, undefined, 3);
+    expect(cart).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(cart[0]).toMatchObject({ lineId: first.lineId, quantity: 1 });
+    expect(cart[1]).toMatchObject({ lineId: different.lineId, quantity: 3 });
+    const edited = addOrEditNetworkCartItem(cart, { ...different, lineId: "replacement" }, different.lineId, 2);
+    expect(edited.find((line) => line.lineId === different.lineId)).toMatchObject({ quantity: 2 });
+    expect(addOrEditNetworkCartItem(cart, different, undefined, 99)).toEqual(cart);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps independently noted configurations separate and preserves a note through editing", () => {
+    const first = { ...item(), note: "بدون ملح" };
+    const second = { ...item(selection("medium", 1, "other"), "280.000001", 1, "line-2"), note: "حار" };
+    const separate = addOrEditNetworkCartItem([first], second);
+    expect(separate).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(separate.map((line) => line.note)).toEqual(["بدون ملح", "حار"]);
+    const edited = addOrEditNetworkCartItem(separate, { ...item(selection("large"), "300", 1, "new"), note: "بدون ملح" }, first.lineId, 2);
+    expect(edited).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(edited.find((line) => line.lineId === first.lineId)).toMatchObject({ quantity: 2, note: "بدون ملح" });
+    expect(edited.find((line) => line.lineId === second.lineId)).toMatchObject({ quantity: 1, note: "حار" });
+  });
+
+  it("restores old Legacy arrays including explicit zero and safely rejects null price/corrupt entries", () => {
+    const restored = restoreCartStorage(JSON.stringify([
+      { slug: "zero", name: "Zero", quantity: 2, price: 0, currency: "EGP" },
+      { slug: "null", name: "No base", quantity: 1, price: null, currency: "EGP" },
+      { slug: "broken", quantity: -1, price: 7 }
+    ]), "restaurant-a", "EGP");
+    expect(restored).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ mode: "LEGACY", slug: "zero", price: 0, quantity: 2 })]);
+    expect(restoreCartStorage("not-json", "restaurant-a", "EGP")).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it("persists Network selection instances and restores every quote as untrusted CHECKING", () => {
+    const first = item();
+    const restored = restoreCartStorage(serializeCartStorage([first], "restaurant-a"), "restaurant-a", "EGP");
+    expect(restored).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(restored[0]).toMatchObject({ mode: "NETWORK", status: "CHECKING", lineId: first.lineId, identity: first.identity });
+    expect((restored[0] as typeof first).selection).toEqual(first.selection);
+    expect(restoreCartStorage(serializeCartStorage([first], "restaurant-a"), "restaurant-b", "EGP")).toEqual([]);
+    expect(restoreCartStorage(serializeCartStorage([first], "restaurant-a"), "restaurant-a", "USD")).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it("generates checkout-compatible Network IDs even when clock and random output repeat", () => {
+    const clock = vi.spyOn(Date, "now").mockReturnValue(1792936393075);
+    const random = vi.spyOn(Math, "random").mockReturnValue(0.7452965834847075);
+    try {
+      const first = createNetworkCartLineId();
+      const second = createNetworkCartLineId([first]);
+      expect(first).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$/);
+      expect(second).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$/);
+      expect(second).not.toBe(first);
+    } finally {
+      clock.mockRestore();
+      random.mockRestore();
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("repairs old dotted and duplicate IDs without losing or merging independent configurations", () => {
+    const first = { ...item(selection("small"), "200", 1, "network-1-0.123"), quantity: 3, note: "first" };
+    const second = { ...item(selection("large"), "300", 1, "network-1-0.123"), quantity: 2, note: "second" };
+    const third = item(selection("medium"), "280", 1, "valid-id");
+    const restored = restoreCartStorage(serializeCartStorage([first, second, third], "restaurant-a"), "restaurant-a", "EGP");
+    expect(restored).toHaveLength(3);
+    expect(new Set(restored.map((line) => line.lineId)).size).toBe(3);
+    expect(restored.every((line) => /^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$/.test(line.lineId))).toBe(true);
+    expect(restored.map((line) => line.quantity)).toEqual([3, 2, 1]);
+    expect(restored.map((line) => line.mode === "NETWORK" ? line.note : undefined)).toEqual(["first", "second", undefined]);
+    expect(restored.map((line) => line.mode === "NETWORK" ? line.identity : "")).toEqual([first.identity, second.identity, third.identity]);
+    expect(restored[2].lineId).toBe("valid-id");
+    const reloaded = restoreCartStorage(serializeCartStorage(restored, "restaurant-a"), "restaurant-a", "EGP");
+    expect(reloaded.map((line) => line.lineId)).toEqual(restored.map((line) => line.lineId));
+  });
+
+  it("shows changed prices or sources without automatic acceptance, then accepts only the same re-quoted proposal", () => {
+    const first = { ...item(), note: "بدون بصل", quantity: 2 };
+    const proposed = quote(selection(), "285.000001", 2);
+    const changed = applyNetworkRecheck(first, proposed);
+    expect(changed).toMatchObject({ status: "CHANGED", acceptedQuote: { total: "280.000001" }, proposedQuote: { total: "285.000001" } });
+    const movedAgain = acceptNetworkRecheck(changed, quote(selection(), "290", 2));
+    expect(movedAgain).toMatchObject({ status: "CHANGED", acceptedQuote: { total: "280.000001" }, proposedQuote: { total: "290" } });
+    const accepted = acceptNetworkRecheck(changed, proposed);
+    expect(accepted).toMatchObject({ status: "CURRENT", acceptedQuote: { total: "285.000001" } });
+    expect(accepted).toMatchObject({ lineId: first.lineId, quantity: 2, note: "بدون بصل" });
+    expect(accepted.identity).not.toBe(first.identity);
+    const differentMode = { ...proposed, linkedSourceRevisions: [{ sourceProductId: "source", mode: "LEGACY" as const, configurationRevision: 2 }] };
+    expect(acceptNetworkRecheck(changed, differentMode).status).toBe("CHANGED");
+  });
+
+  it("keeps revision-changed prices pending explicit acceptance without changing choices, note, or quantity", () => {
+    const first = { ...item(), quantity: 3, note: "لا بصل" };
+    const rebased = { ...first.selection, configurationRevision: 2 };
+    const currentQuote = quote(rebased, "285.000001", 2);
+    currentQuote.priceBreakdown = currentQuote.priceBreakdown.map((line, index) => index === 0
+      ? { ...line, amount: "205", chargedAmount: "205" } : line);
+    const changed = applyRebasedNetworkRecheck(first, currentQuote, rebased);
+    expect(changed).toMatchObject({ status: "CHANGED", selectionKey: first.selectionKey,
+      proposedSelection: { configurationRevision: 2 }, proposedQuote: { total: "285.000001" } });
+    expect(acceptNetworkRecheck(changed, quote(rebased, "290", 2)).status).toBe("CHANGED");
+    const accepted = acceptNetworkRecheck(changed, currentQuote);
+    expect(accepted).toMatchObject({ status: "CURRENT", configurationRevision: 2, quantity: 3, note: "لا بصل" });
+    expect(accepted.selectionKey).toBe(createSelectionKey(rebased));
+    expect(accepted.selection.groups).toEqual(first.selection.groups);
+    const renamed = { ...currentQuote, priceBreakdown: currentQuote.priceBreakdown.map((line, index) => index === 0
+      ? { ...line, label: "New size name" } : line) };
+    expect(applyRebasedNetworkRecheck(first, renamed, rebased).status).toBe("INVALID");
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a forged quote contract before cart insertion", () => {
+    expect(networkCartItemFromQuote({ product, restaurantSlug: "restaurant-a", quote: { ...quote(), trustedTotal: "1", selectionKey: "tampered" }, lineId: "forged" })).toBeNull();
+    expect(networkCartItemFromQuote({ product, restaurantSlug: "restaurant-a", quote: { ...quote(), orderingEnabled: true as false }, lineId: "forged" })).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it("keeps Legacy add, edit, delete and explicit zero price independent from Network lines", () => {
+    const legacyProduct: PublicProduct = { id: "water", slug: "water", name: "ماء", basePrice: 0, currency: "EGP" };
+    const network = item();
+    const added = putLegacyCartItem([network], legacyProduct, 0, null, 1);
+    expect(added).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(added[1]).toMatchObject({ mode: "LEGACY", quantity: 1, price: 0 });
+    const updated = putLegacyCartItem(added, legacyProduct, 0, null, 3);
+    expect(updated[1]).toMatchObject({ mode: "LEGACY", quantity: 3, price: 0 });
+    expect(updateCartLineQuantity(updated, network.lineId, 2)[0]).toMatchObject({ mode: "NETWORK", quantity: 2 });
+    expect(updateCartLineQuantity(updated, "legacy:water", 0)).toEqual([network]);
+    expect(putLegacyCartItem(updated, legacyProduct, 0, null, 0)).toEqual([network]);
+  });
+
+  it("changes only the selected Network line, enforces the existing 100-unit cart limit, and removes at zero", () => {
+    const small = item(selection("small"), "200", 1, "line-small");
+    const large = item(selection("large"), "300", 1, "line-large");
+    const cart = [small, large];
+    const increased = updateCartLineQuantity(cart, small.lineId, 2);
+    expect(increased).toMatchObject([{ lineId: "line-small", quantity: 2 }, { lineId: "line-large", quantity: 1 }]);
+    expect(increased[1]).toBe(large);
+    expect(updateCartLineQuantity(increased, small.lineId, 100)).toEqual(increased);
+    expect(updateCartLineQuantity(increased, small.lineId, 0)).toEqual([large]);
+    expect(cart).toMatchObject([{ quantity: 1 }, { quantity: 1 }]);
+  });
+
+  it("blocks old checkout when Network exists or a stored Legacy line became Network", () => {
+    const legacy = restoreCartStorage(JSON.stringify([{ slug: "water", name: "Water", price: 0, quantity: 1 }]), "restaurant-a", "EGP");
+    expect(cartNeedsPreviewGate(legacy, [{ id: "water", slug: "water", name: "Water", basePrice: 0, currency: "EGP" }])).toBe(false);
+    expect(cartNeedsPreviewGate([...legacy, item()], [])).toBe(true);
+    expect(cartNeedsPreviewGate(legacy, [{ id: "water", slug: "water", name: "Water", basePrice: null, currency: "EGP", productConfiguration: {
+      mode: "NETWORK", configurationRevision: 1, orderable: true, previewOnly: true,
+      minimumPrice: "0", priceDisplay: "EXACT", issueCodes: []
+    } }])).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it("restores a mixed cart with exact Legacy price hints and independent item notes", () => {
+    const legacyProduct: PublicProduct = {
+      id: "water", slug: "water", name: "Water", basePrice: 1.25,
+      basePriceExact: "1.250001", currency: "EGP"
+    };
+    const legacy = putLegacyCartItem([], legacyProduct, 1.25, null, 2);
+    const network = addOrEditNetworkCartItem(legacy, item());
+    const noted = updateCartLineNote(updateCartLineNote(network, "legacy:water", "Cold"), "line-1", "No onion");
+    const restored = restoreCartStorage(serializeCartStorage(noted, "restaurant-a"), "restaurant-a", "EGP");
+    expect(restored).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(restored[0]).toMatchObject({ mode: "LEGACY", priceText: "1.250001", note: "Cold", quantity: 2 });
+    expect(restored[1]).toMatchObject({ mode: "NETWORK", note: "No onion", status: "CHECKING" });
+  });
+
+  it("routes Legacy-only to the persisted checkout regardless of the Network flag", () => {
+    const legacy = putLegacyCartItem([], { id: "water", slug: "water", name: "Water", basePrice: 0,
+      currency: "EGP" }, 0, null, 1);
+    const network = item();
+    expect(shouldUseTrustedWhatsappCheckout(legacy, false)).toBe(false);
+    expect(shouldUseTrustedWhatsappCheckout(legacy, true)).toBe(false);
+    expect(shouldUseTrustedWhatsappCheckout([network], false)).toBe(false);
+    expect(shouldUseTrustedWhatsappCheckout([network], true)).toBe(true);
+    expect(shouldUseTrustedWhatsappCheckout([...legacy, network], true)).toBe(true);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-model.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-model.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2625537
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-model.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,379 @@
+import {
+  createSelectionKey,
+  DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS,
+  validateMoneyString,
+  type ConfigurationIssue,
+  type PriceLine,
+  type ProductSelectionV1
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import type { PublicProduct, PublicProductQuoteResponse } from "@/lib/api";
+
+export type LegacyCartItem = {
+  mode: "LEGACY";
+  lineId: string;
+  slug: string;
+  name: string;
+  quantity: number;
+  price: number;
+  priceText?: string;
+  currency: string;
+  imageUrl?: string | null;
+  description?: string | null;
+  note?: string;
+};
+
+export type NetworkQuoteValue = {
+  total: string;
+  priceBreakdown: PriceLine[];
+  linkedSourceRevisions: PublicProductQuoteResponse["linkedSourceRevisions"];
+};
+
+export type NetworkCartStatus = "CHECKING" | "CURRENT" | "CHANGED" | "INVALID" | "OFFLINE";
+
+export type NetworkCartItem = {
+  mode: "NETWORK";
+  lineId: string;
+  identity: string;
+  restaurantSlug: string;
+  productId: string;
+  slug: string;
+  name: string;
+  quantity: number;
+  currency: string;
+  imageUrl?: string | null;
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1;
+  selectionKey: string;
+  configurationRevision: number;
+  runtimeContext: PublicProductQuoteResponse["runtimeContext"];
+  acceptedQuote: NetworkQuoteValue;
+  proposedQuote?: NetworkQuoteValue;
+  proposedSelection?: ProductSelectionV1;
+  status: NetworkCartStatus;
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[];
+  note?: string;
+};
+
+export type CartItem = LegacyCartItem | NetworkCartItem;
+
+/** Enabling the Network flow must not replace the persisted Legacy-only checkout. */
+export function shouldUseTrustedWhatsappCheckout(cart: readonly CartItem[], networkFeatureEnabled: boolean): boolean {
+  return networkFeatureEnabled && cart.some((line) => line.mode === "NETWORK");
+}
+
+const CART_STORAGE_VERSION = 2 as const;
+const CHECKOUT_LINE_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$/;
+let networkLineSequence = 0;
+
+/** A cart line ID is an opaque local identifier, not a pricing or security token. */
+export function createNetworkCartLineId(existingIds: readonly string[] = []): string {
+  const used = new Set(existingIds);
+  let lineId: string;
+  do {
+    networkLineSequence += 1;
+    lineId = `network-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${networkLineSequence.toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) || "0"}`;
+  } while (used.has(lineId));
+  return lineId;
+}
+
+export function putLegacyCartItem(cart: readonly CartItem[], product: PublicProduct, price: number, imageUrl: string | null, quantity: number): CartItem[] {
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) || quantity < 0 || !Number.isFinite(price) || price < 0) return [...cart];
+  const existing = cart.find((item): item is LegacyCartItem => item.mode === "LEGACY" && item.slug === product.slug);
+  if (quantity === 0) return cart.filter((item) => item !== existing);
+  if (existing) return cart.map((item) => item === existing ? {
+    ...existing, quantity, price, priceText: product.basePriceExact ?? String(price), currency: product.currency, imageUrl, description: product.description
+  } : item);
+  return [...cart, {
+    mode: "LEGACY", lineId: `legacy:${product.slug}`, slug: product.slug, name: product.name,
+    quantity, price, priceText: product.basePriceExact ?? String(price), currency: product.currency, imageUrl, description: product.description
+  }];
+}
+
+export function updateCartLineQuantity(cart: readonly CartItem[], lineId: string, quantity: number): CartItem[] {
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity)) return [...cart];
+  const line = cart.find((item) => item.lineId === lineId);
+  if (!line) return [...cart];
+  if (quantity > 0 && cart.some((item) => item.mode === "NETWORK")
+    && cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0) - line.quantity + quantity > 100) return [...cart];
+  return cart.map((item) => item.lineId === lineId ? { ...item, quantity } : item).filter((item) => item.quantity > 0);
+}
+
+export function updateCartLineNote(cart: readonly CartItem[], lineId: string, note: string): CartItem[] {
+  if (note.length > 500) return [...cart];
+  return cart.map((item) => item.lineId === lineId ? { ...item, note } : item);
+}
+
+export function cartNeedsPreviewGate(cart: readonly CartItem[], products: readonly PublicProduct[]) {
+  const networkSlugs = new Set(products.filter((product) => product.productConfiguration?.mode === "NETWORK").map((product) => product.slug));
+  return cart.some((item) => item.mode === "NETWORK" || networkSlugs.has(item.slug));
+}
+
+function object(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
+}
+
+function nonempty(value: unknown): value is string {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0 && value.length <= 512;
+}
+
+function selectionKey(value: unknown): value is string {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0 && value.length <= 250_000;
+}
+
+function quantity(value: unknown): value is number {
+  return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Number(value) > 0;
+}
+
+function money(value: unknown): value is string {
+  return validateMoneyString(value, "$cart.total", DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS).length === 0;
+}
+
+function sourceVersions(value: unknown): value is PublicProductQuoteResponse["linkedSourceRevisions"] {
+  return Array.isArray(value) && value.length <= DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxNodes && value.every((source) =>
+    object(source) && nonempty(source.sourceProductId)
+    && (source.mode === "NETWORK" || source.mode === "LEGACY")
+    && Number.isSafeInteger(source.configurationRevision) && Number(source.configurationRevision) >= 0
+  );
+}
+
+function priceLines(value: unknown): value is PriceLine[] {
+  return Array.isArray(value) && value.length <= DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS.maxNodes && value.every((line) =>
+    object(line) && (line.kind === "BASE" || line.kind === "SIZE" || line.kind === "OPTION")
+    && typeof line.path === "string" && typeof line.label === "string"
+    && money(line.amount) && money(line.chargedAmount) && typeof line.included === "boolean"
+  );
+}
+
+export function networkCartIdentity(input: {
+  restaurantSlug: string;
+  currency: string;
+  productId: string;
+  configurationRevision: number;
+  selectionKey: string;
+  linkedSourceRevisions: PublicProductQuoteResponse["linkedSourceRevisions"];
+  runtimeContext: PublicProductQuoteResponse["runtimeContext"];
+}) {
+  return JSON.stringify([
+    "NETWORK", input.restaurantSlug, input.currency, input.productId,
+    input.configurationRevision, input.selectionKey,
+    [...input.linkedSourceRevisions]
+      .map((source) => [source.sourceProductId, source.mode, source.configurationRevision])
+      .sort((left, right) => String(left[0]).localeCompare(String(right[0]))),
+    input.runtimeContext.scope,
+    input.runtimeContext.outletDifferentialApplied,
+    input.runtimeContext.serviceModeApplied,
+    input.runtimeContext.productScheduleApplied
+  ]);
+}
+
+export function networkCartItemFromQuote(args: {
+  product: PublicProduct;
+  restaurantSlug: string;
+  quote: PublicProductQuoteResponse;
+  lineId: string;
+}): NetworkCartItem | null {
+  const { product, quote } = args;
+  if (!product.id || !nonempty(args.lineId) || quote.schemaVersion !== 1
+    || quote.productId !== product.id || quote.currency !== product.currency
+    || quote.configurationOrderable !== true || quote.previewOnly !== true
+    || quote.orderingEnabled !== false || quote.orderAction !== "STAGE_6_REQUIRED"
+    || !money(quote.trustedTotal) || !priceLines(quote.priceBreakdown)
+    || !selectionKey(quote.selectionKey) || !sourceVersions(quote.linkedSourceRevisions)
+    || !object(quote.canonicalSelection) || !Array.isArray(quote.canonicalSelection.groups)
+    || quote.canonicalSelection.productId !== product.id
+    || quote.canonicalSelection.configurationRevision !== quote.configurationRevision
+    || !quote.runtimeContext || quote.runtimeContext.scope !== "RESTAURANT") return null;
+
+  try {
+    if (createSelectionKey(quote.canonicalSelection) !== quote.selectionKey) return null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+  const identity = networkCartIdentity({
+    restaurantSlug: args.restaurantSlug,
+    currency: quote.currency,
+    productId: quote.productId,
+    configurationRevision: quote.configurationRevision,
+    selectionKey: quote.selectionKey,
+    linkedSourceRevisions: quote.linkedSourceRevisions,
+    runtimeContext: quote.runtimeContext
+  });
+  return {
+    mode: "NETWORK", lineId: args.lineId, identity,
+    restaurantSlug: args.restaurantSlug, productId: quote.productId, slug: product.slug,
+    name: product.name, quantity: 1, currency: quote.currency,
+    imageUrl: product.imageUrl ?? product.images?.[0]?.url ?? null,
+    selection: quote.canonicalSelection, selectionKey: quote.selectionKey,
+    configurationRevision: quote.configurationRevision, runtimeContext: quote.runtimeContext,
+    acceptedQuote: { total: quote.trustedTotal, priceBreakdown: quote.priceBreakdown, linkedSourceRevisions: quote.linkedSourceRevisions },
+    status: "CURRENT", issues: []
+  };
+}
+
+export function addOrEditNetworkCartItem(cart: readonly CartItem[], incoming: NetworkCartItem, editingLineId?: string, selectedQuantity?: number): CartItem[] {
+  const previous = editingLineId ? cart.find((item) => item.lineId === editingLineId && item.mode === "NETWORK") as NetworkCartItem | undefined : undefined;
+  const amount = selectedQuantity ?? previous?.quantity ?? incoming.quantity;
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(amount) || amount < 1 || amount > 100) return [...cart];
+  const other = editingLineId ? cart.filter((item) => item.lineId !== editingLineId) : [...cart];
+  const nextNote = incoming.note ?? previous?.note ?? "";
+  const matched = other.find((item): item is NetworkCartItem => item.mode === "NETWORK" && item.identity === incoming.identity && (item.note ?? "") === nextNote);
+  if (other.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0) + amount > 100) return [...cart];
+  if (matched) return other.map((item) => item.lineId === matched.lineId ? {
+    ...matched, quantity: matched.quantity + amount, acceptedQuote: incoming.acceptedQuote,
+    proposedQuote: undefined, status: "CURRENT", issues: []
+  } : item);
+  const next = { ...incoming, quantity: amount, lineId: previous?.lineId ?? incoming.lineId, note: nextNote };
+  if (!previous) return [...other, next];
+  const index = cart.findIndex((item) => item.lineId === previous.lineId);
+  return [...other.slice(0, index), next, ...other.slice(index)];
+}
+
+export function applyNetworkRecheck(item: NetworkCartItem, quote: PublicProductQuoteResponse): NetworkCartItem {
+  const refreshed = networkCartItemFromQuote({
+    product: { id: item.productId, slug: item.slug, name: item.name, basePrice: null, currency: item.currency },
+    restaurantSlug: item.restaurantSlug, quote, lineId: item.lineId
+  });
+  if (!refreshed || quote.selectionKey !== item.selectionKey) {
+    return { ...item, status: "INVALID", proposedQuote: undefined, proposedSelection: undefined, issues: [{ code: "QUOTE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH", path: "$cart", message: "The current quote no longer matches this cart selection." }] };
+  }
+  if (refreshed.identity !== item.identity || refreshed.acceptedQuote.total !== item.acceptedQuote.total
+    || JSON.stringify(refreshed.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown) !== JSON.stringify(item.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown)) {
+    return { ...item, status: "CHANGED", proposedQuote: refreshed.acceptedQuote, proposedSelection: undefined, issues: [] };
+  }
+  return { ...item, status: "CURRENT", acceptedQuote: refreshed.acceptedQuote, proposedQuote: undefined, proposedSelection: undefined, issues: [] };
+}
+
+function sameChoicePresentation(left: readonly PriceLine[], right: readonly PriceLine[]): boolean {
+  return left.length === right.length && left.every((line, index) => {
+    const other = right[index];
+    return line.kind === other.kind && line.path === other.path && line.nodeId === other.nodeId
+      && line.label === other.label && line.instanceId === other.instanceId
+      && line.sourceProductId === other.sourceProductId && line.included === other.included;
+  });
+}
+
+/** A revision-only rebase is safe only when every displayed choice is unchanged. */
+export function applyRebasedNetworkRecheck(item: NetworkCartItem, quote: PublicProductQuoteResponse, rebased: ProductSelectionV1): NetworkCartItem {
+  const refreshed = networkCartItemFromQuote({
+    product: { id: item.productId, slug: item.slug, name: item.name, basePrice: null, currency: item.currency },
+    restaurantSlug: item.restaurantSlug, quote, lineId: item.lineId
+  });
+  if (!refreshed || quote.selectionKey !== createSelectionKey(rebased)
+    || !sameChoicePresentation(item.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown, refreshed.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown)) {
+    return { ...item, status: "INVALID", proposedQuote: undefined, proposedSelection: undefined,
+      issues: [{ code: "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED", path: "$cart", message: "Review the current product choices before continuing." }] };
+  }
+  if (refreshed.acceptedQuote.total === item.acceptedQuote.total
+    && JSON.stringify(refreshed.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown) === JSON.stringify(item.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown)) {
+    return { ...refreshed, quantity: item.quantity, note: item.note };
+  }
+  return { ...item, status: "CHANGED", proposedQuote: refreshed.acceptedQuote,
+    proposedSelection: quote.canonicalSelection, issues: [] };
+}
+
+export function acceptNetworkRecheck(item: NetworkCartItem, quote: PublicProductQuoteResponse): NetworkCartItem {
+  const refreshed = item.proposedSelection
+    ? applyRebasedNetworkRecheck(item, quote, item.proposedSelection)
+    : applyNetworkRecheck(item, quote);
+  if (item.status !== "CHANGED" || !item.proposedQuote || refreshed.status !== "CHANGED"
+    || refreshed.proposedQuote?.total !== item.proposedQuote.total
+    || JSON.stringify(refreshed.proposedQuote?.priceBreakdown) !== JSON.stringify(item.proposedQuote.priceBreakdown)
+    || refreshed.proposedQuote?.linkedSourceRevisions.length !== item.proposedQuote.linkedSourceRevisions.length
+    || refreshed.proposedQuote?.linkedSourceRevisions.some((source, index) => {
+      const previous = item.proposedQuote?.linkedSourceRevisions[index];
+      return !previous || source.sourceProductId !== previous.sourceProductId || source.mode !== previous.mode || source.configurationRevision !== previous.configurationRevision;
+    })) return refreshed;
+  const candidate = networkCartItemFromQuote({
+    product: { id: item.productId, slug: item.slug, name: item.name, basePrice: null, currency: item.currency },
+    restaurantSlug: item.restaurantSlug, quote, lineId: item.lineId
+  });
+  if (!candidate || candidate.selectionKey !== (item.proposedSelection ? createSelectionKey(item.proposedSelection) : item.selectionKey)
+    || (!item.proposedSelection && candidate.configurationRevision !== item.configurationRevision)) return refreshed;
+  return { ...candidate, quantity: item.quantity, note: item.note };
+}
+
+function restoreLegacy(raw: unknown, currency: string): LegacyCartItem | null {
+  if (!object(raw) || !nonempty(raw.slug) || !quantity(raw.quantity)
+    || typeof raw.price !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(raw.price) || raw.price < 0) return null;
+  return {
+    mode: "LEGACY", lineId: `legacy:${raw.slug}`, slug: raw.slug,
+    name: nonempty(raw.name) ? raw.name : raw.slug, quantity: raw.quantity, price: raw.price,
+    priceText: money(raw.priceText) ? raw.priceText : String(raw.price),
+    currency: nonempty(raw.currency) ? raw.currency : currency,
+    imageUrl: typeof raw.imageUrl === "string" ? raw.imageUrl : null,
+    description: typeof raw.description === "string" ? raw.description : null,
+    note: typeof raw.note === "string" && raw.note.length <= 500 ? raw.note : undefined
+  };
+}
+
+function restoreNetwork(raw: unknown, restaurantSlug: string, currency: string): NetworkCartItem | null {
+  if (!object(raw) || raw.mode !== "NETWORK" || raw.restaurantSlug !== restaurantSlug
+    || !nonempty(raw.lineId) || !nonempty(raw.productId) || !nonempty(raw.slug)
+    || !quantity(raw.quantity) || raw.currency !== currency
+    || !object(raw.selection) || !Array.isArray(raw.selection.groups)
+    || raw.selection.productId !== raw.productId
+    || !Number.isSafeInteger(raw.configurationRevision) || raw.selection.configurationRevision !== raw.configurationRevision
+    || !selectionKey(raw.selectionKey) || raw.selection.schemaVersion !== 1
+    || !object(raw.runtimeContext)
+    || raw.runtimeContext.scope !== "RESTAURANT" || !object(raw.acceptedQuote)
+    || !money(raw.acceptedQuote.total) || !priceLines(raw.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown)
+    || !sourceVersions(raw.acceptedQuote.linkedSourceRevisions)) return null;
+  try {
+    if (createSelectionKey(raw.selection as ProductSelectionV1) !== raw.selectionKey) return null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+  const runtimeContext = raw.runtimeContext as NetworkCartItem["runtimeContext"];
+  const linkedSourceRevisions = raw.acceptedQuote.linkedSourceRevisions;
+  return {
+    mode: "NETWORK", lineId: raw.lineId,
+    identity: networkCartIdentity({ restaurantSlug, currency, productId: raw.productId,
+      configurationRevision: raw.configurationRevision as number, selectionKey: raw.selectionKey,
+      linkedSourceRevisions, runtimeContext }),
+    restaurantSlug, productId: raw.productId, slug: raw.slug,
+    name: nonempty(raw.name) ? raw.name : raw.slug, quantity: raw.quantity, currency,
+    imageUrl: typeof raw.imageUrl === "string" ? raw.imageUrl : null,
+    selection: raw.selection as ProductSelectionV1, selectionKey: raw.selectionKey,
+    configurationRevision: raw.configurationRevision as number, runtimeContext,
+    acceptedQuote: { total: raw.acceptedQuote.total, priceBreakdown: raw.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown as PriceLine[], linkedSourceRevisions },
+    status: "CHECKING", issues: [],
+    note: typeof raw.note === "string" && raw.note.length <= 500 ? raw.note : undefined
+  };
+}
+
+export function restoreCartStorage(text: string | null, restaurantSlug: string, currency: string): CartItem[] {
+  if (!text) return [];
+  try {
+    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
+    const oldItems = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : null;
+    const versionedItems = object(parsed) && parsed.version === CART_STORAGE_VERSION && parsed.restaurantSlug === restaurantSlug && Array.isArray(parsed.items)
+      ? parsed.items : null;
+    const restored = (oldItems ?? versionedItems ?? []).slice(0, 200).flatMap((raw) => {
+      const item = oldItems
+        ? object(raw) && raw.mode === "NETWORK" ? null : restoreLegacy(raw, currency)
+        : object(raw) && raw.mode === "NETWORK"
+          ? restoreNetwork(raw, restaurantSlug, currency)
+          : object(raw) && raw.mode === "LEGACY" ? restoreLegacy(raw, currency) : null;
+      return item ? [item] : [];
+    });
+    // Older HTTP-origin carts used Math.random() verbatim, including a dot. Give
+    // each invalid/duplicate Network line a fresh ID without merging selections.
+    const reserved = restored.map((item) => item.lineId);
+    const seen = new Set<string>();
+    return restored.map((item) => {
+      if (item.mode !== "NETWORK" || (CHECKOUT_LINE_ID.test(item.lineId) && !seen.has(item.lineId))) {
+        seen.add(item.lineId);
+        return item;
+      }
+      const lineId = createNetworkCartLineId(reserved);
+      reserved.push(lineId);
+      seen.add(lineId);
+      return { ...item, lineId };
+    });
+  } catch {
+    return [];
+  }
+}
+
+export function serializeCartStorage(items: readonly CartItem[], restaurantSlug: string) {
+  return JSON.stringify({ version: CART_STORAGE_VERSION, restaurantSlug, items });
+}

+import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import type { PriceLine } from "@menu/shared";
+import { networkCartChoiceLabels, networkCartHeading } from "./cart-presentation";
+
+const line = (path: string, nodeId: string, label: string, chargedAmount: string, extra: Partial<PriceLine> = {}): PriceLine => ({
+  kind: "OPTION", path, nodeId, label, amount: chargedAmount, chargedAmount, included: false, ...extra
+});
+
+describe("compact network cart choices", () => {
+  it("shows the Legacy name without repeating the adjacent quantity control", () => {
+    const source = readFileSync(new URL("./public-menu-client.tsx", import.meta.url), "utf8");
+    expect(source).toContain('item.mode === "NETWORK" ? networkCartHeading(item) : item.name');
+  });
+
+  it("shows Network size without duplicating the adjacent quantity", () => {
+    const priceBreakdown: PriceLine[] = [
+      { ...line("$selection.groups.size", "medium", "وسط", "110"), kind: "SIZE" },
+      line("$selection.groups.toppings.a", "olive", "زيتون", "8")
+    ];
+    expect(networkCartHeading({ name: "بيتزا مارغريتا", acceptedQuote: { priceBreakdown } }))
+      .toBe("بيتزا مارغريتا — وسط");
+  });
+
+  it("does not mistake a linked or nested size for the main item size", () => {
+    const priceBreakdown: PriceLine[] = [
+      { ...line("$selection.groups.combo.a.linked.size", "large", "كبير", "0"), kind: "SIZE" }
+    ];
+    expect(networkCartHeading({ name: "كومبو", acceptedQuote: { priceBreakdown } }))
+      .toBe("كومبو");
+  });
+
+  it("groups identical leaf choices per configuration, without individual prices", () => {
+    const lines: PriceLine[] = [
+      { ...line("$selection.groups.size", "large", "كبير", "145"), kind: "SIZE" },
+      line("$selection.groups.toppings.a", "olive", "زيتون", "8"),
+      line("$selection.groups.toppings.b", "olive", "زيتون", "8"),
+      line("$selection.groups.toppings.c", "cheese", "جبنة", "0", { amount: "10", included: true })
+    ];
+    expect(networkCartChoiceLabels(lines)).toEqual([
+      { label: "2 × زيتون", nested: false }, { label: "1 × جبنة", nested: false }
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps nested and repeated linked branches independent", () => {
+    const lines = [
+      line("$selection.groups.combo.a", "slot", "البيتزا الأولى", "50", { sourceProductId: "pizza" }),
+      { ...line("$selection.groups.combo.a.linked.sizes", "small", "صغير", "0"), kind: "SIZE" as const },
+      line("$selection.groups.combo.a.linked.toppings.x", "olive", "زيتون", "8"),
+      line("$selection.groups.combo.b", "slot", "البيتزا الثانية", "50", { sourceProductId: "pizza" }),
+      { ...line("$selection.groups.combo.b.linked.sizes", "large", "كبير", "0"), kind: "SIZE" as const }
+    ];
+    expect(networkCartChoiceLabels(lines)).toEqual([
+      { label: "1 × البيتزا الأولى", nested: false },
+      { label: "صغير", nested: true },
+      { label: "1 × زيتون", nested: true },
+      { label: "1 × البيتزا الثانية", nested: false },
+      { label: "كبير", nested: true }
+    ]);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-presentation.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-presentation.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..39f27c3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/cart-presentation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+import type { PriceLine } from "@menu/shared";
+
+export type CartChoiceLabel = { label: string; nested: boolean };
+
+/** The Network card has its own quantity stepper; show only the product and its top-level size. */
+export function networkCartHeading(item: { name: string; acceptedQuote: { priceBreakdown: readonly PriceLine[] } }): string {
+  const topSizes = item.acceptedQuote.priceBreakdown.filter((line) => line.kind === "SIZE"
+    && !line.path.includes(".linked") && !line.path.includes(".children"));
+  return `${item.name}${topSizes.length === 1 ? ` — ${topSizes[0].label}` : ""}`;
+}
+
+/** Compact presentation of the accepted, per-unit breakdown; amounts remain in the trusted quote. */
+export function networkCartChoiceLabels(lines: readonly PriceLine[]): CartChoiceLabel[] {
+  const rootSizes = lines.filter((line) => line.kind === "SIZE"
+    && !line.path.includes(".linked") && !line.path.includes(".children"));
+  const headingSize = rootSizes.length === 1 ? rootSizes[0] : null;
+  const result: CartChoiceLabel[] = [];
+  const grouped = new Map<string, { index: number; count: number; label: string }>();
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    if (line.kind === "BASE" || line === headingSize) continue;
+    const nested = line.path.includes(".children") || line.path.includes(".linked");
+    if (line.kind !== "OPTION") {
+      result.push({ label: line.label, nested });
+      continue;
+    }
+    const branched = Boolean(line.sourceProductId) || lines.some((other) =>
+      other.path.startsWith(`${line.path}.children.`) || other.path.startsWith(`${line.path}.linked.`));
+    if (branched) {
+      result.push({ label: `1 × ${line.label}`, nested });
+      continue;
+    }
+    const parentPath = line.path.slice(0, line.path.lastIndexOf("."));
+    const key = JSON.stringify([parentPath, line.nodeId, line.label, line.amount, line.chargedAmount, line.included]);
+    const prior = grouped.get(key);
+    if (prior) {
+      prior.count += 1;
+      result[prior.index].label = `${prior.count} × ${prior.label}`;
+    } else {
+      grouped.set(key, { index: result.length, count: 1, label: line.label });
+      result.push({ label: `1 × ${line.label}`, nested });
+    }
+  }
+  return result;
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/currency-display.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/currency-display.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..39e0f4e

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { displayCurrencyAmount, displayRoundingDifference } from "@/lib/currency-display";
+
+describe("current-menu currency display", () => {
+  it("shows Syrian pounds without decimals and exposes invalid historical fractional values", () => {
+    expect(displayCurrencyAmount("12500.000000", "SYP")).toBe("12500 SYP");
+    expect(displayCurrencyAmount("12500.000000", "ل.س")).toBe("12500 ل.س");
+    expect(displayCurrencyAmount("12500.5", "SYP")).toBe("سعر غير صالح للعملة");
+    expect(displayCurrencyAmount(null, "SYP")).toBe("—");
+  });
+
+  it("rounds only presentation for EUR, USD and AED and reveals component differences", () => {
+    for (const currency of ["EUR", "USD", "AED"]) {
+      expect(displayCurrencyAmount("2.345678", currency)).toBe(`2.35 ${currency}`);
+    }
+    expect(displayRoundingDifference(["0.005", "0.005"], "0.01", "USD")).toBe("-0.01 USD");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/invoice-sheet-motion.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/invoice-sheet-motion.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d94c01e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/invoice-sheet-motion.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { invoiceDragHeight, shouldExpandInvoice } from "./invoice-sheet-motion";
+
+describe("checkout invoice sheet motion", () => {
+  it("moves continuously between the two snap heights, including a reversed drag", () => {
+    expect(invoiceDragHeight(200, 600, 200, 700, 650)).toBe(250);
+    expect(invoiceDragHeight(200, 600, 200, 700, 500)).toBe(400);
+    expect(invoiceDragHeight(200, 600, 200, 700, 620)).toBe(280);
+    expect(invoiceDragHeight(200, 600, 200, 700, 100)).toBe(600);
+    expect(invoiceDragHeight(200, 600, 600, 300, 900)).toBe(200);
+  });
+
+  it("snaps by midpoint for a slow release and by direction for a fast release", () => {
+    const base = { collapsed: 200, expanded: 600, wasExpanded: false, moved: true, cancelled: false };
+    expect(shouldExpandInvoice({ ...base, current: 450, velocity: 0.1 })).toBe(true);
+    expect(shouldExpandInvoice({ ...base, current: 350, velocity: 0.1 })).toBe(false);
+    expect(shouldExpandInvoice({ ...base, current: 350, velocity: 0.6 })).toBe(true);
+    expect(shouldExpandInvoice({ ...base, current: 450, velocity: -0.6 })).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps the previous state on touch cancellation", () => {
+    const base = { collapsed: 200, expanded: 600, current: 400, velocity: 1, moved: true, cancelled: true };
+    expect(shouldExpandInvoice({ ...base, wasExpanded: false })).toBe(false);
+    expect(shouldExpandInvoice({ ...base, wasExpanded: true })).toBe(true);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/invoice-sheet-motion.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/invoice-sheet-motion.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7133c3d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/invoice-sheet-motion.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+export function invoiceDragHeight(collapsed: number, expanded: number,
+  startHeight: number, startY: number, currentY: number): number {
+  return Math.max(collapsed, Math.min(expanded, startHeight + startY - currentY));
+}
+
+export function shouldExpandInvoice(input: {
+  collapsed: number;
+  expanded: number;
+  current: number;
+  wasExpanded: boolean;
+  velocity: number;
+  moved: boolean;
+  cancelled: boolean;
+}): boolean {
+  if (input.cancelled) return input.wasExpanded;
+  if (input.moved && Math.abs(input.velocity) > 0.35) return input.velocity > 0;
+  return input.current > (input.collapsed + input.expanded) / 2;
+}
