diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-client.tsx b/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-client.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b29b3c1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-client.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,194 @@
+"use client";
+
+import Link from "next/link";
+import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
+import { restoreCartStorage, type CartItem } from "./cart-model";
+import { draftNeedsFreshAcceptance, testOrderRequestFromCart, type TestOrderDetails, type TrustedTestDraft } from "./network-order-test-model";
+import styles from "./network-order-test-client.module.css";
+
+const API = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:5000";
+type Prepared = { draft: TrustedTestDraft; acceptanceToken: string; requestKey: string };
+type Preview = { orderId: string; message: string; totalAmount: string; currency: string; fromSealedSnapshot: true; orderingEnabled: false };
+
+class DemoApiError extends Error {
+  constructor(readonly status: number, readonly code: string, readonly payload: Record<string, unknown>) {
+    super(typeof payload.message === "string" ? payload.message : code);
+  }
+}
+
+async function demoApi<T>(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
+  const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, {
+    method: body === undefined ? "GET" : "POST",
+    headers: body === undefined ? undefined : { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
+    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body), cache: "no-store"
+  });
+  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as Record<string, unknown>;
+  if (!response.ok) throw new DemoApiError(response.status, String(payload.error ?? "NETWORK_TEST_FAILED"), payload);
+  return (payload.data ?? payload) as T;
+}
+
+export function NetworkOrderTestClient({ restaurantSlug, currency }: { restaurantSlug: string; currency: string }) {
+  const [cart, setCart] = useState<CartItem[]>([]);
+  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
+  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<"ar" | "en">("ar");
+  const [details, setDetails] = useState<TestOrderDetails>({ fulfillmentType: "pickup" });
+  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
+  const [prepared, setPrepared] = useState<Prepared | null>(null);
+  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false);
+  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<Preview | null>(null);
+  const [createdOrderId, setCreatedOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [changed, setChanged] = useState(false);
+  const submissionKey = useRef<string | null>(null);
+  const inFlight = useRef(false);
+  const path = `/public/menus/${encodeURIComponent(restaurantSlug)}/orders/network-test`;
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setCart(restoreCartStorage(window.localStorage.getItem(`cart:${restaurantSlug}:main`), restaurantSlug, currency));
+    setLoaded(true);
+  }, [restaurantSlug, currency]);
+
+  const request = useMemo(() => {
+    try { return testOrderRequestFromCart(cart, restaurantSlug, currency, locale, details, notes); }
+    catch { return null; }
+  }, [cart, restaurantSlug, currency, locale, details, notes]);
+  const requestKey = request ? JSON.stringify(request) : "";
+  const currentPrepared = prepared?.requestKey === requestKey ? prepared : null;
+  const hasMixedCart = cart.some((line) => line.mode === "LEGACY");
+  const pricesDifferFromCart = Boolean(currentPrepared?.draft.items.some((line, index) =>
+    cart[index]?.mode === "NETWORK" && cart[index].acceptedQuote.total !== line.unitPrice));
+
+  function updateDetails<K extends keyof TestOrderDetails>(field: K, value: TestOrderDetails[K]) {
+    setDetails((prior) => ({ ...prior, [field]: value }));
+    setAccepted(false);
+    setPreview(null);
+  }
+
+  async function prepare() {
+    if (!request || busy || inFlight.current) return;
+    inFlight.current = true;
+    setBusy(true);
+    setError(null);
+    setAccepted(false);
+    setPreview(null);
+    setCreatedOrderId(null);
+    submissionKey.current = null;
+    try {
+      const response = await demoApi<{ draft: TrustedTestDraft; acceptanceToken: string; orderingEnabled: false }>(`${path}/prepare`, request);
+      setChanged(prepared ? draftNeedsFreshAcceptance(prepared.draft, response.draft) : false);
+      setPrepared({ draft: response.draft, acceptanceToken: response.acceptanceToken, requestKey });
+    } catch (cause) {
+      setPrepared(null);
+      setError(cause instanceof DemoApiError ? `${cause.code} (HTTP ${cause.status}) — صحّح الاختيارات أو أعد فتح المنتج.` : "تعذر الوصول إلى خادم التجربة المحلي.");
+    } finally { inFlight.current = false; setBusy(false); }
+  }
+
+  async function loadPreview(orderId: string) {
+    const result = await demoApi<Preview>(`${path}/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}/preview`);
+    if (result.fromSealedSnapshot !== true || result.orderingEnabled !== false) throw new Error("INVALID_SAVED_PREVIEW");
+    setPreview(result);
+  }
+
+  async function create() {
+    if (!request || !currentPrepared || !accepted || busy || inFlight.current) return;
+    inFlight.current = true;
+    setBusy(true);
+    setError(null);
+    try {
+      submissionKey.current ??= crypto.randomUUID();
+      const result = await demoApi<{ orderId: string; orderingEnabled: false }>(path, {
+        ...request, acceptanceToken: currentPrepared.acceptanceToken, idempotencyKey: submissionKey.current
+      });
+      if (result.orderingEnabled !== false) throw new Error("ORDERING_GATE_MISMATCH");
+      setCreatedOrderId(result.orderId);
+      await loadPreview(result.orderId);
+    } catch (cause) {
+      if (cause instanceof DemoApiError && cause.status === 409) {
+        const updated = cause.payload.changedQuote as TrustedTestDraft | undefined;
+        const token = cause.payload.acceptanceToken;
+        if (cause.code === "NETWORK_ORDER_REQUIRES_NEW_ACCEPTANCE" && updated && typeof token === "string") {
+          setPrepared({ draft: updated, acceptanceToken: token, requestKey });
+          setChanged(true);
+          setAccepted(false);
+          submissionKey.current = null;
+          setError("تغير السعر أو التكوين. راجع المسودة الجديدة ووافق عليها صراحة قبل المحاولة مرة أخرى.");
+        } else {
+          setPrepared(null);
+          setAccepted(false);
+          setError(`${cause.code} — لم يُنشأ طلب. افتح المنتج وحدّث الاختيارات ثم اطلب مسودة جديدة.`);
+        }
+      } else {
+        setError(cause instanceof DemoApiError ? `${cause.code} (HTTP ${cause.status})` : "تعذر تأكيد النتيجة؛ أعد المحاولة بنفس المفتاح أو حمّل المعاينة إذا ظهر رقم الطلب التجريبي.");
+      }
+    } finally { inFlight.current = false; setBusy(false); }
+  }
+
+  return <main className={styles.page} dir={locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}>
+    <header className={styles.header}>
+      <Link href={`/m/${encodeURIComponent(restaurantSlug)}/cart`}>العودة إلى السلة</Link>
+      <span className={styles.badge}>تجربة محلية معزولة · لا إرسال WhatsApp</span>
+      <h1>معاينة الطلب الموثوق</h1>
+      <p>هذه الصفحة لا تنشئ طلبًا حقيقيًا. الخادم يعيد قراءة التكوين والأسعار قبل حفظ الطلب التجريبي.</p>
+      <button type="button" onClick={() => setLocale(locale === "ar" ? "en" : "ar")}>{locale === "ar" ? "English" : "العربية"}</button>
+    </header>
+
+    <section className={styles.card}>
+      <h2>سلة الشبكة</h2>
+      {!loaded ? <p>تحميل السلة…</p> : cart.length === 0 ? <p>السلة فارغة. أضف بيتزا أو كومبو من المنيو أولًا.</p> : null}
+      {hasMixedCart ? <p role="alert">السلة المختلطة غير مدعومة في التجربة. لن تُرسل المنتجات القديمة جزئيًا؛ افصلها دون تحويل صامت.</p> : null}
+      <ul>{cart.map((line) => <li key={line.lineId}>{line.name} × {line.quantity} — {line.mode === "NETWORK" ? "تكوين شبكة" : "منتج قديم"}
+        {line.mode === "NETWORK" ? <label className={styles.note}>ملاحظة الصنف
+          <input value={notes[line.lineId] ?? ""} onChange={(event) => setNotes((prior) => ({ ...prior, [line.lineId]: event.target.value }))} maxLength={500} />
+        </label> : null}</li>)}</ul>
+    </section>
+
+    <section className={styles.card}>
+      <h2>بيانات الطلب التجريبي</h2>
+      <div className={styles.grid}>
+        <label>اسم الزبون <input value={details.customerName ?? ""} onChange={(event) => updateDetails("customerName", event.target.value)} maxLength={120} /></label>
+        <label>الهاتف (اختياري) <input value={details.customerPhone ?? ""} onChange={(event) => updateDetails("customerPhone", event.target.value)} maxLength={40} /></label>
+        <label>طريقة الاستلام <select value={details.fulfillmentType ?? "pickup"} onChange={(event) => {
+          const mode = event.target.value as "pickup" | "delivery";
+          setDetails((prior) => ({ customerName: prior.customerName, customerPhone: prior.customerPhone,
+            orderNote: prior.orderNote, fulfillmentType: mode }));
+          setAccepted(false);
+        }}><option value="pickup">استلام من المطعم</option><option value="delivery">توصيل</option></select></label>
+        {details.fulfillmentType === "delivery" ? <>
+          <label>المنطقة <input value={details.deliveryArea ?? ""} onChange={(event) => updateDetails("deliveryArea", event.target.value)} maxLength={160} /></label>
+          <label>بالقرب من <input value={details.deliveryNear ?? ""} onChange={(event) => updateDetails("deliveryNear", event.target.value)} maxLength={160} /></label>
+          <label>بجانب <input value={details.deliveryBeside ?? ""} onChange={(event) => updateDetails("deliveryBeside", event.target.value)} maxLength={160} /></label>
+        </> : <label>موعد الاستلام (اختياري) <input value={details.pickupTime ?? ""} onChange={(event) => updateDetails("pickupTime", event.target.value)} maxLength={80} /></label>}
+        <label className={styles.wide}>ملاحظات الطلب <textarea value={details.orderNote ?? ""} onChange={(event) => updateDetails("orderNote", event.target.value)} maxLength={500} /></label>
+      </div>
+      <button type="button" onClick={prepare} disabled={!request || busy || Boolean(createdOrderId)}>اطلب مسودة موثوقة</button>
+    </section>
+
+    {currentPrepared ? <section className={styles.card} aria-label="Trusted Draft">
+      <h2>مسودة الخادم — راجع قبل الموافقة</h2>
+      {(changed || pricesDifferFromCart) ? <p role="alert">تغير السعر أو التكوين مقارنةً بما شاهدته في السلة. لم يُنشأ طلب تلقائيًا.</p> : null}
+      <p>المطعم: {currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.restaurantName}</p>
+      <p>الزبون: {currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.customerName ?? "غير مذكور"} · {currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.fulfillmentType === "delivery" ? "توصيل" : "استلام"}</p>
+      {currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.fulfillmentType === "delivery" ? <p>العنوان: {[currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.deliveryArea, currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.deliveryNear, currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.deliveryBeside].filter(Boolean).join(" — ")}</p> : null}
+      {currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.orderNote ? <p>ملاحظة: {currentPrepared.draft.orderDetails.orderNote}</p> : null}
+      {currentPrepared.draft.items.map((line, index) => <article key={`${line.productId}-${index}`} className={styles.line}>
+        <h3>{line.productName} × {line.quantity}</h3>
+        {line.note ? <p>ملاحظة الصنف: {line.note}</p> : null}
+        <ul>{line.priceBreakdown.map((entry, entryIndex) => <li key={`${entry.path}-${entryIndex}`}>{entry.label} — {entry.included ? "مشمول" : `${entry.chargedAmount} ${currentPrepared.draft.currency}`}</li>)}</ul>
+        <p>سعر الوحدة: {line.unitPrice} {currentPrepared.draft.currency} · إجمالي الصنف: {line.lineTotal} {currentPrepared.draft.currency}</p>
+      </article>)}
+      <strong>إجمالي المسودة الموثوقة: {currentPrepared.draft.totalAmount} {currentPrepared.draft.currency}</strong>
+      <label className={styles.accept}><input type="checkbox" checked={accepted} onChange={(event) => setAccepted(event.target.checked)} /> راجعت المسودة والأسعار وأوافق على إنشاء طلب تجريبي فقط.</label>
+      <button type="button" onClick={create} disabled={!accepted || busy || Boolean(createdOrderId)}>إنشاء طلب تجريبي بعد الموافقة</button>
+    </section> : prepared && !currentPrepared ? <p role="alert" className={styles.card}>تغيّرت بيانات الطلب بعد المسودة. اطلب مسودة جديدة قبل الموافقة.</p> : null}
+
+    {error ? <p role="alert" className={styles.error}>{error}</p> : null}
+    {createdOrderId && !preview ? <button type="button" onClick={() => loadPreview(createdOrderId).catch(() => setError("تعذر قراءة Snapshot المحفوظة."))}>إعادة تحميل معاينة الطلب المحفوظ</button> : null}
+    {preview ? <section className={styles.card} aria-label="WhatsApp Preview">
+      <h2>رسالة WhatsApp من Snapshot محفوظة</h2>
+      <p>طلب تجريبي محفوظ · لا إرسال ولا فتح للرابط</p>
+      <pre className={styles.message} dir="auto">{preview.message}</pre>
+      <button type="button" onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(preview.message).catch(() => setError("تعذر نسخ الرسالة."))}>نسخ الرسالة</button>
+    </section> : null}
+  </main>;
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-model.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-model.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..628ad55
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-model.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { createSelectionKey } from "@menu/shared";
+import { draftNeedsFreshAcceptance, testOrderRequestFromCart, type TrustedTestDraft } from "./network-order-test-model";
+import { isNetworkOrderTestHostAllowed } from "@/lib/network-order-test-guard";
+import type { NetworkCartItem } from "./cart-model";
+
+const selection = { schemaVersion: 1 as const, productId: "pizza", configurationRevision: 2,
+  groups: [{ type: "SIZE" as const, groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "large" }] };
+const item: NetworkCartItem = {
+  mode: "NETWORK", lineId: "line-1", identity: "test", restaurantSlug: "demo", productId: "pizza", slug: "pizza",
+  name: "Pizza", quantity: 2, currency: "EGP", selection, selectionKey: createSelectionKey(selection), configurationRevision: 2,
+  runtimeContext: { scope: "RESTAURANT", outletDifferentialApplied: false, serviceModeApplied: false, productScheduleApplied: false },
+  acceptedQuote: { total: "1.000001", priceBreakdown: [], linkedSourceRevisions: [] }, status: "CURRENT", issues: []
+};
+
+describe("isolated Network order request", () => {
+  it("transports only selection and quantity, never Local Storage names, totals or prices", () => {
+    const request = testOrderRequestFromCart([item], "demo", "EGP", "ar", { customerName: "Demo", fulfillmentType: "pickup" }, { "line-1": "No onion" });
+    expect(request).toEqual({ locale: "ar", items: [{ productId: "pizza", quantity: 2, selection, note: "No onion" }],
+      customerName: "Demo", fulfillmentType: "pickup" });
+    expect(JSON.stringify(request)).not.toContain("1.000001");
+    expect(JSON.stringify(request)).not.toContain("Pizza");
+  });
+
+  it("refuses mixed carts, wrong tenant/currency, and empty carts", () => {
+    expect(() => testOrderRequestFromCart([], "demo", "EGP", "ar", {}, {})).toThrow();
+    expect(() => testOrderRequestFromCart([item, { mode: "LEGACY", lineId: "legacy", slug: "old", name: "Old", quantity: 1, price: 2, currency: "EGP" }], "demo", "EGP", "ar", {}, {})).toThrow();
+    expect(() => testOrderRequestFromCart([{ ...item, restaurantSlug: "other" }], "demo", "EGP", "ar", {}, {})).toThrow();
+    expect(() => testOrderRequestFromCart([{ ...item, currency: "USD" }], "demo", "EGP", "ar", {}, {})).toThrow();
+  });
+
+  it("requires fresh acceptance for changed trusted totals or details", () => {
+    const draft = { currency: "EGP", totalAmount: "10.000001", items: [{ unitPrice: "10.000001" }], orderDetails: { restaurantName: "Demo" } } as TrustedTestDraft;
+    expect(draftNeedsFreshAcceptance(draft, { ...draft, totalAmount: "10.000002" })).toBe(true);
+    expect(draftNeedsFreshAcceptance(draft, { ...draft, orderDetails: { restaurantName: "Demo", customerName: "Other" } })).toBe(true);
+    expect(draftNeedsFreshAcceptance(draft, { ...draft })).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it("hides demo outside explicit local non-production server conditions", () => {
+    expect(isNetworkOrderTestHostAllowed("development", "1", "localhost:3000", "http://127.0.0.1:5000")).toBe(true);
+    expect(isNetworkOrderTestHostAllowed("production", "1", "localhost:3000", "http://127.0.0.1:5000")).toBe(false);
+    expect(isNetworkOrderTestHostAllowed("development", undefined, "localhost:3000", "http://127.0.0.1:5000")).toBe(false);
+    expect(isNetworkOrderTestHostAllowed("development", "1", "example.com", "http://127.0.0.1:5000")).toBe(false);
+    expect(isNetworkOrderTestHostAllowed("development", "1", "localhost:3000", "https://api.example.com")).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-model.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-model.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6dd91cf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/network-order-test-model.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+import type { ProductSelectionV1, PriceLine } from "@menu/shared";
+import type { CartItem } from "./cart-model";
+
+export type TestOrderDetails = {
+  customerName?: string;
+  customerPhone?: string;
+  fulfillmentType?: "pickup" | "delivery";
+  deliveryArea?: string;
+  deliveryNear?: string;
+  deliveryBeside?: string;
+  pickupTime?: string;
+  orderNote?: string;
+};
+
+export type TestOrderRequest = TestOrderDetails & {
+  locale: "ar" | "en";
+  items: Array<{ productId: string; quantity: number; selection: ProductSelectionV1; note?: string }>;
+};
+
+export type TrustedTestDraft = {
+  schemaVersion: 1;
+  restaurantId: string;
+  restaurantSlug: string;
+  currency: string;
+  locale: "ar" | "en";
+  orderDetails: TestOrderDetails & { restaurantName: string };
+  items: Array<{
+    productId: string;
+    productName: string;
+    quantity: number;
+    note?: string;
+    unitPrice: string;
+    lineTotal: string;
+    priceBreakdown: PriceLine[];
+  }>;
+  totalAmount: string;
+  orderingEnabled: false;
+};
+
+/** Local Cart is selection transport only. No local price, name, or total enters the Order request. */
+export function testOrderRequestFromCart(
+  cart: readonly CartItem[], restaurantSlug: string, currency: string,
+  locale: "ar" | "en", details: TestOrderDetails, notes: Record<string, string>
+): TestOrderRequest {
+  if (!cart.length || cart.some((line) => line.mode !== "NETWORK")) {
+    throw new Error("NETWORK_ONLY_CART_REQUIRED");
+  }
+  const items = cart.map((line) => {
+    if (line.mode !== "NETWORK" || line.restaurantSlug !== restaurantSlug || line.currency !== currency
+      || !Number.isSafeInteger(line.quantity) || line.quantity < 1 || line.quantity > 100) {
+      throw new Error("NETWORK_CART_CONTEXT_INVALID");
+    }
+    const note = notes[line.lineId]?.trim();
+    return { productId: line.productId, quantity: line.quantity, selection: line.selection,
+      ...(note ? { note } : {}) };
+  });
+  return { locale, items, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(details).filter(([, value]) => Boolean(value?.trim()))) };
+}
+
+export function draftNeedsFreshAcceptance(previous: TrustedTestDraft, current: TrustedTestDraft): boolean {
+  return previous.currency !== current.currency || previous.totalAmount !== current.totalAmount
+    || JSON.stringify(previous.items) !== JSON.stringify(current.items)
+    || JSON.stringify(previous.orderDetails) !== JSON.stringify(current.orderDetails);
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-model.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-model.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7f80595
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-model.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,362 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import type { OptionGroupSelection, ProductConfigurationV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+import type { PublicProductConfigurationResponse } from "@/lib/api";
+import { includedQuantityDemo, pizzaMargheritaDemo } from "../dashboard/product-configuration/demos";
+import {
+  buildInitialSelection,
+  buildOptionInstance,
+  canAddOptionInstance,
+  calculatePublicPreview,
+  changeSizeSelection,
+  LatestQuoteGate,
+  rebaseSelectionRevisions,
+  updateOptionGroup
+} from "./product-configurator-model";
+
+describe("canAddOptionInstance", () => {
+  it("allows replacing the selected value in a full single-choice group", () => {
+    expect(canAddOptionInstance({
+      available: true,
+      optionCount: 0,
+      optionMax: 1,
+      groupCount: 1,
+      groupMax: 1,
+      radioMode: true
+    })).toBe(true);
+
+    expect(canAddOptionInstance({
+      available: true,
+      optionCount: 0,
+      optionMax: 1,
+      groupCount: 1,
+      groupMax: 1,
+      radioMode: false
+    })).toBe(false);
+  });
+});
+
+describe("LatestQuoteGate", () => {
+  it("ignores an older Quote response after the selection changes or another request starts", async () => {
+    const gate = new LatestQuoteGate();
+    const applied: string[] = [];
+    let resolveOld!: (value: string) => void;
+    let resolveNew!: (value: string) => void;
+    const old = new Promise<string>((resolve) => { resolveOld = resolve; });
+    const newest = new Promise<string>((resolve) => { resolveNew = resolve; });
+    const oldToken = gate.next();
+    const oldWork = old.then((value) => { if (gate.isCurrent(oldToken)) applied.push(value); });
+    gate.invalidate();
+    const newToken = gate.next();
+    const newWork = newest.then((value) => { if (gate.isCurrent(newToken)) applied.push(value); });
+    resolveNew("latest");
+    resolveOld("stale");
+    await Promise.all([oldWork, newWork]);
+    expect(applied).toEqual(["latest"]);
+  });
+});
+
+function ids() {
+  let value = 0;
+  return (prefix: string) => `${prefix}-${++value}`;
+}
+
+function envelope(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1): PublicProductConfigurationResponse {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: 1,
+    productId: configuration.productId,
+    productSlug: configuration.productId,
+    productName: configuration.productId,
+    configurationRevision: configuration.revision,
+    configuration,
+    linkedProducts: [],
+    orderable: true,
+    previewOnly: true,
+    orderAction: "STAGE_6_REQUIRED",
+    minimumPrice: null,
+    maximumRequiredPrice: null,
+    priceDisplay: "EXACT",
+    issues: [],
+    runtimeContext: {
+      scope: "RESTAURANT",
+      outletDifferentialApplied: false,
+      serviceModeApplied: false,
+      productScheduleApplied: false
+    }
+  };
+}
+
+describe("public product configurator model", () => {
+  it("rebases only revisions, preserving nested choices and IDs; rejects removed or unavailable choices", () => {
+    const configuration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("pizza", 1);
+    const createId = ids();
+    const original = buildInitialSelection(configuration, new Map(), createId);
+    const size = configuration.groups[0];
+    if (size.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Missing sizes");
+    const toppings = size.sizes[0].children?.[0];
+    if (toppings?.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing toppings");
+    const chosen = buildOptionInstance(toppings.options[0], new Map(), createId);
+    const selected = { ...original, groups: original.groups.map((group) => group.type === "SIZE"
+      ? { ...group, children: [{ type: "OPTIONS" as const, groupId: toppings.id, instances: [chosen] }] } : group) };
+    const current = pizzaMargheritaDemo("pizza", 2);
+    const rebased = rebaseSelectionRevisions(selected, current, new Map());
+    expect(rebased).toMatchObject({ configurationRevision: 2 });
+    expect(rebased?.groups).toEqual(selected.groups);
+    const currentSize = current.groups[0];
+    if (currentSize.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Missing current sizes");
+    const currentToppings = currentSize.sizes[0].children?.[0];
+    if (currentToppings?.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing current toppings");
+    currentToppings.options[0].available = false;
+    expect(rebaseSelectionRevisions(selected, current, new Map())).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it("recovers a removed size by explicit new-size selection while preserving compatible nested choices", () => {
+    const configuration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("pizza", 2);
+    const size = configuration.groups[0];
+    if (size.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Missing sizes");
+    const toppings = size.sizes[0].children?.[0];
+    if (toppings?.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing toppings");
+    const old = buildInitialSelection(configuration, new Map(), ids());
+    const selected = { ...old, groups: old.groups.map((group) => group.type === "SIZE"
+      ? { ...group, sizeChoiceId: "removed-size", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS" as const,
+        groupId: toppings.id, instances: [{ instanceId: "saved-cheese", optionId: toppings.options[0].id }] }] }
+      : group) };
+    const result = changeSizeSelection(selected, size, size.sizes[0].id, new Map(), ids());
+    expect(result.error).toBeUndefined();
+    expect(result.selection?.groups[0]).toMatchObject({ type: "SIZE", sizeChoiceId: size.sizes[0].id,
+      children: [{ instances: [{ instanceId: "saved-cheese", optionId: toppings.options[0].id }] }] });
+    expect(calculatePublicPreview(envelope(configuration), "restaurant", result.selection!)).toMatchObject({ valid: true });
+  });
+
+  it("rebases repeated ORIGINAL and CUSTOM linked instances independently", () => {
+    const source: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", revision: 3,
+      basePrice: null, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "source-size", label: "Size",
+        sizes: [{ id: "small", label: "Small", price: "10" }] }] };
+    const custom: ProductConfigurationV1 = { ...source, revision: 2 };
+    const combo: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "combo", revision: 4,
+      basePrice: "0", groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: "Pizzas", min: 0, max: 3,
+        includedQuantity: 0, options: [
+          { id: "original", label: "Original", price: "10", maxQuantity: 2,
+            linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "ORIGINAL" } },
+          { id: "custom", label: "Custom", price: "10", maxQuantity: 1,
+            linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: custom } }
+        ] }] };
+    const child = (instanceId: string) => ({ instanceId, optionId: "original",
+      linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1 as const, productId: "source", configurationRevision: 1,
+        groups: [{ type: "SIZE" as const, groupId: "source-size", sizeChoiceId: "small" }] } });
+    const selection = { schemaVersion: 1 as const, productId: "combo", configurationRevision: 1,
+      groups: [{ type: "OPTIONS" as const, groupId: "slots", instances: [child("first"), child("second"),
+        { ...child("third"), optionId: "custom" }] }] };
+    const sources = new Map([["source", { productId: "source", slug: "source", name: "Source",
+      mode: "NETWORK" as const, available: true, orderable: true, configuration: source }]]);
+    const result = rebaseSelectionRevisions(selection, combo, sources);
+    expect(result?.groups[0]).toMatchObject({ type: "OPTIONS", instances: [
+      { instanceId: "first", linkedSelection: { configurationRevision: 3 } },
+      { instanceId: "second", linkedSelection: { configurationRevision: 3 } },
+      { instanceId: "third", linkedSelection: { configurationRevision: 2 } }
+    ] });
+    expect((result?.groups[0] as { instances: { instanceId: string }[] }).instances.map((entry) => entry.instanceId))
+      .toEqual(["first", "second", "third"]);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps olives, cheese, nested choices and stable instances through Small → Large → Medium → Small", () => {
+    const configuration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("pizza", 4);
+    const sizeGroup = configuration.groups[0];
+    if (sizeGroup.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Missing size group");
+    const small = sizeGroup.sizes[0];
+    const toppings = small.children?.[0];
+    if (!toppings || toppings.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing toppings");
+    const cheese = toppings.options[0];
+    const olives = toppings.options[1];
+    const sources = new Map();
+    const createId = ids();
+    let selection = buildInitialSelection(configuration, sources, createId);
+    const cheeseInstance = buildOptionInstance(cheese, sources, createId);
+    const nested = cheese.children?.[0];
+    if (!nested || nested.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing nested group");
+    cheeseInstance.children = [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: nested.id,
+      instances: [buildOptionInstance(nested.options[0], sources, createId)] }];
+    const instances = [buildOptionInstance(olives, sources, createId), buildOptionInstance(olives, sources, createId), cheeseInstance];
+    selection = { ...selection, groups: selection.groups.map((group) => group.type === "SIZE"
+      ? { ...group, children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: toppings.id, instances }] } : group) };
+    for (const [sizeId, expectedTotal] of [
+      ["demo-size-large", "188.5"], ["demo-size-medium", "146"], ["demo-size-small", "111"]
+    ] as const) {
+      const changed = changeSizeSelection(selection, sizeGroup, sizeId, sources, createId);
+      expect(changed.error).toBeUndefined();
+      selection = changed.selection!;
+      const selectedSize = selection.groups[0];
+      if (selectedSize.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Missing selection");
+      const selectedToppings = selectedSize.children?.[0];
+      if (selectedToppings?.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing selected toppings");
+      expect(selectedToppings.instances.map((entry) => entry.instanceId)).toEqual(instances.map((entry) => entry.instanceId));
+      expect(selectedToppings.instances[2].children?.[0].type).toBe("OPTIONS");
+      expect(calculatePublicPreview(envelope(configuration), "restaurant", selection)).toMatchObject({ valid: true, total: expectedTotal });
+    }
+  });
+
+  it("blocks an incompatible size without silently discarding selected units", () => {
+    const configuration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("pizza", 1);
+    const sizeGroup = configuration.groups[0];
+    if (sizeGroup.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Missing size group");
+    const toppings = sizeGroup.sizes[0].children?.[0];
+    if (!toppings || toppings.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing toppings");
+    const sources = new Map();
+    const createId = ids();
+    const initial = buildInitialSelection(configuration, sources, createId);
+    const selection = { ...initial, groups: initial.groups.map((group) => group.type === "SIZE"
+      ? { ...group, children: [{ type: "OPTIONS" as const, groupId: toppings.id,
+        instances: [buildOptionInstance(toppings.options[1], sources, createId), buildOptionInstance(toppings.options[1], sources, createId)] }] }
+      : group) };
+    const large = sizeGroup.sizes[2];
+    const targetToppings = large.children?.[0];
+    if (!targetToppings || targetToppings.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing target toppings");
+    targetToppings.options[1].maxQuantity = 1;
+    expect(changeSizeSelection(selection, sizeGroup, large.id, sources, createId)).toEqual({ error: "زيتون" });
+    expect((selection.groups[0] as { sizeChoiceId: string }).sizeChoiceId).toBe("demo-size-small");
+    targetToppings.options[1].maxQuantity = 2;
+    targetToppings.options[1].available = false;
+    expect(changeSizeSelection(selection, sizeGroup, large.id, sources, createId)).toEqual({ error: "زيتون" });
+  });
+
+  it("keeps an independent linked selection inside a size-specific option branch", () => {
+    const source = pizzaMargheritaDemo("linked-pizza", 2);
+    const configuration: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+      schemaVersion: 1, productId: "parent", revision: 1, basePrice: null,
+      groups: [{ type: "SIZE", id: "parent-size", label: "الوجبة", sizes: ["small", "large"].map((name) => ({
+        id: name, label: name, price: name === "small" ? "80" : "120", children: [{
+          type: "OPTIONS" as const, id: `linked-group-${name}`, label: "المكوّن", min: 1, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0,
+          options: [{ id: `linked-choice-${name}`, label: "بيتزا", price: "0", minQuantity: 1, maxQuantity: 1,
+            linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "linked-pizza", mode: "ORIGINAL" as const } }]
+        }]
+      })) }]
+    };
+    const response = envelope(configuration);
+    response.linkedProducts = [{ productId: "linked-pizza", slug: "linked-pizza", name: "بيتزا",
+      mode: "NETWORK", available: true, orderable: true, configuration: source }];
+    const sources = new Map(response.linkedProducts.map((entry) => [entry.productId, entry]));
+    const createId = ids();
+    const selection = buildInitialSelection(configuration, sources, createId);
+    const group = configuration.groups[0];
+    if (group.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Missing parent size");
+    const old = selection.groups[0];
+    if (old.type !== "SIZE" || old.children?.[0].type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing linked choice");
+    const originalInstance = old.children[0].instances[0];
+    const changed = changeSizeSelection(selection, group, "large", sources, createId);
+    const next = changed.selection?.groups[0];
+    if (next?.type !== "SIZE" || next.children?.[0].type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing mapped choice");
+    expect(next.children[0].instances[0].instanceId).toBe(originalInstance.instanceId);
+    expect(next.children[0].instances[0].linkedSelection).toEqual(originalInstance.linkedSelection);
+    expect(calculatePublicPreview(response, "restaurant", changed.selection!)).toMatchObject({ valid: true, total: "120" });
+  });
+
+  it("uses full Size price and a Size-specific option override", () => {
+    const configuration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("pizza", 4);
+    const sourceMap = new Map();
+    const createId = ids();
+    let selection = buildInitialSelection(configuration, sourceMap, createId);
+    const sizeGroup = configuration.groups[0];
+    if (!sizeGroup || sizeGroup.type !== "SIZE") throw new Error("Missing sizes fixture");
+    const medium = sizeGroup.sizes.find((size) => size.id === "demo-size-medium")!;
+    const nested = buildInitialSelection({ ...configuration, groups: medium.children ?? [] }, sourceMap, createId);
+    selection = {
+      ...selection,
+      groups: selection.groups.map((group) => group.type === "SIZE"
+        ? { ...group, sizeChoiceId: medium.id, children: nested.groups }
+        : group)
+    };
+    const toppings = medium.children?.find((group) => group.id === "demo-pizza-toppings-medium");
+    if (!toppings || toppings.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing toppings fixture");
+    const cheese = toppings.options.find((option) => option.id === "demo-extra-cheese-medium")!;
+    selection = {
+      ...selection,
+      groups: selection.groups.map((group) => group.type === "SIZE"
+        ? { ...group, children: updateOptionGroup({ ...selection, groups: group.children ?? [] }, toppings.id, [buildOptionInstance(cheese, sourceMap, createId)]).groups }
+        : group)
+    };
+
+    const result = calculatePublicPreview(envelope(configuration), "restaurant", selection);
+    expect(result.valid).toBe(true);
+    expect(result.total).toBe("125");
+    expect(result.baseIgnored).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps child charges when the highest-priced parent units are included", () => {
+    const configuration = includedQuantityDemo("included", 1);
+    const sourceMap = new Map();
+    const createId = ids();
+    let selection = buildInitialSelection(configuration, sourceMap, createId);
+    const group = configuration.groups[0];
+    if (!group || group.type !== "OPTIONS") throw new Error("Missing Included Quantity fixture");
+    const instances = group.options.map((option) => buildOptionInstance(option, sourceMap, createId));
+    selection = updateOptionGroup(selection, group.id, instances);
+
+    const result = calculatePublicPreview(envelope(configuration), "restaurant", selection);
+    expect(result.valid).toBe(true);
+    expect(result.total).toBe("115");
+    expect(result.lines.filter((line) => line.included).map((line) => line.amount).sort()).toEqual(["30", "50"]);
+  });
+
+  it("creates stable independent instances for repeated linked products", () => {
+    const linked = pizzaMargheritaDemo("linked-pizza", 2);
+    const configuration: ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+      schemaVersion: 1,
+      productId: "combo",
+      revision: 1,
+      basePrice: "0",
+      groups: [{
+        type: "OPTIONS",
+        id: "combo-slots",
+        label: "اختيارات الكومبو",
+        min: 2,
+        max: 2,
+        includedQuantity: 0,
+        options: [{
+          id: "pizza-slot",
+          label: "بيتزا",
+          price: "50",
+          minQuantity: 2,
+          maxQuantity: 2,
+          linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "linked-pizza", mode: "ORIGINAL" }
+        }]
+      }]
+    };
+    const response = envelope(configuration);
+    response.linkedProducts = [{
+      productId: "linked-pizza",
+      slug: "linked-pizza",
+      name: "بيتزا مرتبطة",
+      mode: "NETWORK",
+      available: true,
+      orderable: true,
+      configuration: linked
+    }];
+    const sources = new Map(response.linkedProducts.map((source) => [source.productId, source]));
+    const selection = buildInitialSelection(configuration, sources, ids());
+    const group = selection.groups[0] as OptionGroupSelection;
+
+    expect(group.instances).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(group.instances[0].instanceId).not.toBe(group.instances[1].instanceId);
+    expect(group.instances[0].linkedSelection).not.toBe(group.instances[1].linkedSelection);
+    expect(calculatePublicPreview(response, "restaurant", selection)).toMatchObject({ valid: true, total: "100" });
+  });
+
+  it("does not produce a price when the server marks a required source unavailable", () => {
+    const configuration = pizzaMargheritaDemo("pizza", 1);
+    const response = envelope(configuration);
+    response.orderable = false;
+    response.issues = [{ code: "LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE", path: "$configuration", message: "Unavailable" }];
+    const selection = buildInitialSelection(configuration, new Map(), ids());
+    const result = calculatePublicPreview(response, "restaurant", selection);
+
+    expect(result.valid).toBe(false);
+    expect(result.total).toBeNull();
+    expect(result.issues[0].code).toBe("LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE");
+  });
+
+  it("keeps null Base distinct from explicit zero", () => {
+    const nullBase = pizzaMargheritaDemo("null-base", 1);
+    const zeroBase: ProductConfigurationV1 = { ...nullBase, productId: "zero-base", basePrice: "0" };
+    expect(nullBase.basePrice).toBeNull();
+    expect(zeroBase.basePrice).toBe("0");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-model.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-model.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0a01720
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-model.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,339 @@
+import {
+  calculatePrice,
+  PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+  validateSelection,
+  type ConfigurationGroup,
+  type GroupSelection,
+  type LinkedProductCatalogEntry,
+  type OptionChoice,
+  type OptionGroupSelection,
+  type OptionSelectionInstance,
+  type SizeGroup,
+  type PriceResult,
+  type ProductConfigurationContext,
+  type ProductConfigurationV1,
+  type ProductSelectionV1,
+  type SizeGroupSelection
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import type {
+  PublicLinkedConfigurationSource,
+  PublicProductConfigurationResponse
+} from "@/lib/api";
+
+export type InstanceIdFactory = (prefix: string) => string;
+
+/** Prevents an older async quote from acting on a newer selection or route. */
+export class LatestQuoteGate {
+  private generation = 0;
+
+  next() { this.generation += 1; return this.generation; }
+  invalidate() { this.generation += 1; }
+  isCurrent(generation: number) { return generation === this.generation; }
+}
+
+export function publicConfigurationContext(
+  restaurantSlug: string,
+  sources: readonly PublicLinkedConfigurationSource[]
+): ProductConfigurationContext {
+  const linkedProducts = new Map<string, LinkedProductCatalogEntry>();
+  for (const source of sources) {
+    linkedProducts.set(source.productId, {
+      productId: source.productId,
+      catalogId: restaurantSlug,
+      configuration: source.configuration,
+      available: source.available,
+      orderable: source.orderable
+    });
+  }
+  return { catalogId: restaurantSlug, linkedProducts };
+}
+
+export function linkedConfiguration(
+  option: OptionChoice,
+  sources: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicLinkedConfigurationSource>
+) {
+  const linked = option.linkedProduct;
+  if (!linked) return null;
+  if (linked.mode === "CUSTOM") return linked.customConfiguration ?? null;
+  return sources.get(linked.sourceProductId)?.configuration ?? null;
+}
+
+/** Keep the customer's exact choice and instance IDs when only configuration revisions changed.
+ * The server quote still decides whether this selection is valid and what it costs. */
+export function rebaseSelectionRevisions(
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1,
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  sources: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicLinkedConfigurationSource>,
+  depth = 0
+): ProductSelectionV1 | null {
+  if (depth > 12 || selection.productId !== configuration.productId) return null;
+  const groups: GroupSelection[] = [];
+  for (const selected of selection.groups) {
+    const group = configuration.groups.find((candidate) => candidate.id === selected.groupId && candidate.type === selected.type);
+    if (!group || group.available === false) return null;
+    if (selected.type === "SIZE") {
+      if (group.type !== "SIZE") return null;
+      const size = group.sizes.find((candidate) => candidate.id === selected.sizeChoiceId && candidate.available !== false);
+      if (!size) return null;
+      const children = rebaseSelectionRevisions({ ...selection, groups: selected.children ?? [] },
+        { ...configuration, groups: size.children ?? [] }, sources, depth + 1);
+      if (!children) return null;
+      groups.push({ ...selected, children: children.groups });
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (group.type !== "OPTIONS") return null;
+    const instances: OptionSelectionInstance[] = [];
+    for (const instance of selected.instances) {
+      const option = group.options.find((candidate) => candidate.id === instance.optionId && candidate.available !== false);
+      if (!option) return null;
+      const children = rebaseSelectionRevisions({ ...selection, groups: instance.children ?? [] },
+        { ...configuration, groups: option.children ?? [] }, sources, depth + 1);
+      if (!children) return null;
+      const linked = linkedConfiguration(option, sources);
+      if (Boolean(linked) !== Boolean(instance.linkedSelection)) return null;
+      const linkedSelection = linked && instance.linkedSelection
+        ? rebaseSelectionRevisions(instance.linkedSelection, linked, sources, depth + 1) : undefined;
+      if (linked && !linkedSelection) return null;
+      instances.push({ ...instance, children: children.groups,
+        ...(linkedSelection ? { linkedSelection } : {}) });
+    }
+    groups.push({ ...selected, instances });
+  }
+  return { ...selection, configurationRevision: configuration.revision, groups };
+}
+
+function buildGroups(
+  groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[],
+  sources: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicLinkedConfigurationSource>,
+  idFactory: InstanceIdFactory
+): GroupSelection[] {
+  const result: GroupSelection[] = [];
+  for (const group of groups) {
+    if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+      const size = group.sizes.find((candidate) => candidate.available !== false);
+      if (size) {
+        result.push({
+          type: "SIZE",
+          groupId: group.id,
+          sizeChoiceId: size.id,
+          children: buildGroups(size.children ?? [], sources, idFactory)
+        });
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const instances: OptionSelectionInstance[] = [];
+    for (const option of group.options) {
+      const minimum = option.available === false ? 0 : option.minQuantity ?? 0;
+      for (let index = 0; index < minimum; index += 1) {
+        instances.push(buildOptionInstance(option, sources, idFactory));
+      }
+    }
+
+    let cursor = 0;
+    while (instances.length < group.min && cursor < group.options.length * 100) {
+      const option = group.options[cursor % Math.max(1, group.options.length)];
+      const count = option ? instances.filter((instance) => instance.optionId === option.id).length : 0;
+      if (option && option.available !== false && count < option.maxQuantity) {
+        instances.push(buildOptionInstance(option, sources, idFactory));
+      }
+      cursor += 1;
+    }
+
+    if (instances.length || group.min > 0) {
+      result.push({ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: group.id, instances });
+    }
+  }
+  return result;
+}
+
+export function buildOptionInstance(
+  option: OptionChoice,
+  sources: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicLinkedConfigurationSource>,
+  idFactory: InstanceIdFactory
+): OptionSelectionInstance {
+  const linked = linkedConfiguration(option, sources);
+  return {
+    instanceId: idFactory("selection"),
+    optionId: option.id,
+    children: buildGroups(option.children ?? [], sources, idFactory),
+    ...(linked ? { linkedSelection: buildInitialSelection(linked, sources, idFactory) } : {})
+  };
+}
+
+export function buildInitialSelection(
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  sources: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicLinkedConfigurationSource>,
+  idFactory: InstanceIdFactory
+): ProductSelectionV1 {
+  return {
+    schemaVersion: PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+    productId: configuration.productId,
+    configurationRevision: configuration.revision,
+    groups: buildGroups(configuration.groups, sources, idFactory)
+  };
+}
+
+type SizeChangeResult = { selection: ProductSelectionV1; error?: never } | { error: string; selection?: never };
+
+/** Preserve selected branches when size-specific groups use different node IDs. Never discard an unmatched choice. */
+export function changeSizeSelection(
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1,
+  group: SizeGroup,
+  targetSizeId: string,
+  sources: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicLinkedConfigurationSource>,
+  idFactory: InstanceIdFactory
+): SizeChangeResult {
+  const old = selection.groups.find((entry): entry is SizeGroupSelection => entry.type === "SIZE" && entry.groupId === group.id);
+  const target = group.sizes.find((size) => size.id === targetSizeId);
+  if (!target || target.available === false) return { error: group.label };
+  if (old?.sizeChoiceId === targetSizeId) return { selection };
+  const previous = group.sizes.find((size) => size.id === old?.sizeChoiceId);
+  const failure = { label: "" };
+
+  function counterpart<T extends { id: string; label: string }>(item: T, choices: readonly T[]): T | undefined {
+    const byId = choices.find((choice) => choice.id === item.id);
+    if (byId) return byId;
+    const byLabel = choices.filter((choice) => choice.label === item.label);
+    return byLabel.length === 1 ? byLabel[0] : undefined;
+  }
+
+  function merge(
+    oldDefinitions: readonly ConfigurationGroup[],
+    newDefinitions: readonly ConfigurationGroup[],
+    oldSelections: readonly GroupSelection[],
+    defaults: readonly GroupSelection[]
+  ): GroupSelection[] | null {
+    const merged = [...defaults];
+    for (const oldSelection of oldSelections) {
+      const oldDefinition = oldDefinitions.find((entry) => entry.id === oldSelection.groupId);
+      if (!oldDefinition || oldDefinition.type !== oldSelection.type) { failure.label = oldSelection.groupId; return null; }
+      const newDefinition = counterpart(oldDefinition, newDefinitions.filter((entry) => entry.type === oldDefinition.type));
+      if (!newDefinition || newDefinition.type !== oldSelection.type || newDefinition.available === false) {
+        failure.label = oldDefinition.label; return null;
+      }
+      let mapped: GroupSelection;
+      if (oldSelection.type === "SIZE" && oldDefinition.type === "SIZE" && newDefinition.type === "SIZE") {
+        const oldSize = oldDefinition.sizes.find((entry) => entry.id === oldSelection.sizeChoiceId);
+        const newSize = oldSize && counterpart(oldSize, newDefinition.sizes);
+        if (!oldSize || !newSize || newSize.available === false) { failure.label = oldDefinition.label; return null; }
+        const childDefaults = buildGroups(newSize.children ?? [], sources, idFactory);
+        const children = merge(oldSize.children ?? [], newSize.children ?? [], oldSelection.children ?? [], childDefaults);
+        if (!children) return null;
+        mapped = { ...oldSelection, groupId: newDefinition.id, sizeChoiceId: newSize.id, children };
+      } else if (oldSelection.type === "OPTIONS" && oldDefinition.type === "OPTIONS" && newDefinition.type === "OPTIONS") {
+        if (newDefinition.max !== null && oldSelection.instances.length > newDefinition.max) {
+          failure.label = newDefinition.label; return null;
+        }
+        const counts = new Map<string, number>();
+        const instances: OptionSelectionInstance[] = [];
+        for (const instance of oldSelection.instances) {
+          const oldOption = oldDefinition.options.find((entry) => entry.id === instance.optionId);
+          const newOption = oldOption && counterpart(oldOption, newDefinition.options);
+          if (!oldOption || !newOption || newOption.available === false
+            || oldOption.linkedProduct?.sourceProductId !== newOption.linkedProduct?.sourceProductId
+            || oldOption.linkedProduct?.mode !== newOption.linkedProduct?.mode) {
+            failure.label = oldOption?.label ?? oldDefinition.label; return null;
+          }
+          const count = (counts.get(newOption.id) ?? 0) + 1;
+          if (count > newOption.maxQuantity) { failure.label = newOption.label; return null; }
+          counts.set(newOption.id, count);
+          const childDefaults = buildGroups(newOption.children ?? [], sources, idFactory);
+          const children = merge(oldOption.children ?? [], newOption.children ?? [], instance.children ?? [], childDefaults);
+          if (!children) return null;
+          instances.push({ ...instance, optionId: newOption.id, children });
+        }
+        mapped = { ...oldSelection, groupId: newDefinition.id, instances };
+      } else { failure.label = oldDefinition.label; return null; }
+      const index = merged.findIndex((entry) => entry.groupId === mapped.groupId);
+      if (index >= 0) merged[index] = mapped;
+      else merged.push(mapped);
+    }
+    return merged;
+  }
+
+  const defaults = buildGroups(target.children ?? [], sources, idFactory);
+  // If the prior size was removed, match its still-selected children against the newly
+  // chosen size by stable IDs. Reject incompatible branches instead of discarding them.
+  const children = merge(previous?.children ?? target.children ?? [], target.children ?? [], old?.children ?? [], defaults);
+  if (!children) return { error: failure.label || group.label };
+  const next: SizeGroupSelection = { type: "SIZE", groupId: group.id, sizeChoiceId: targetSizeId, children };
+  return { selection: replaceGroupSelection(selection, next) };
+}
+
+export function replaceGroupSelection(selection: ProductSelectionV1, group: GroupSelection | null) {
+  const groupId = group?.groupId;
+  if (!groupId) return selection;
+  const existing = selection.groups.some((item) => item.groupId === groupId);
+  return {
+    ...selection,
+    groups: group === null
+      ? selection.groups.filter((item) => item.groupId !== groupId)
+      : existing
+        ? selection.groups.map((item) => item.groupId === groupId ? group : item)
+        : [...selection.groups, group]
+  };
+}
+
+export function updateOptionGroup(
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1,
+  groupId: string,
+  instances: OptionSelectionInstance[]
+) {
+  const group: OptionGroupSelection = { type: "OPTIONS", groupId, instances };
+  const existing = selection.groups.some((item) => item.groupId === groupId);
+  return {
+    ...selection,
+    groups: instances.length === 0
+      ? selection.groups.filter((item) => item.groupId !== groupId)
+      : existing
+        ? selection.groups.map((item) => item.groupId === groupId ? group : item)
+        : [...selection.groups, group]
+  };
+}
+
+export function canAddOptionInstance(input: {
+  available: boolean;
+  optionCount: number;
+  optionMax: number;
+  groupCount: number;
+  groupMax: number;
+  radioMode: boolean;
+}) {
+  return input.available
+    && input.optionCount < input.optionMax
+    && (input.radioMode || input.groupCount < input.groupMax);
+}
+
+export function calculatePublicPreview(
+  envelope: PublicProductConfigurationResponse,
+  restaurantSlug: string,
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1
+): PriceResult {
+  const context = publicConfigurationContext(restaurantSlug, envelope.linkedProducts);
+  if (!envelope.orderable) {
+    return {
+      valid: false,
+      total: null,
+      baseIgnored: false,
+      lines: [],
+      issues: envelope.issues.length
+        ? envelope.issues
+        : [{ code: "PRODUCT_UNORDERABLE", path: "$configuration", message: "Product is not currently orderable." }]
+    };
+  }
+  return calculatePrice(envelope.configuration, selection, context);
+}
+
+export function validatePublicSelection(
+  envelope: PublicProductConfigurationResponse,
+  restaurantSlug: string,
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1
+) {
+  if (!envelope.orderable) return envelope.issues;
+  return validateSelection(
+    envelope.configuration,
+    selection,
+    publicConfigurationContext(restaurantSlug, envelope.linkedProducts)
+  );
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-summary.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-summary.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a747728
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-summary.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { calculatePrice, sumMoney, type PriceLine } from "@menu/shared";
+import { includedQuantityDemo } from "../dashboard/product-configuration/demos";
+import { summarizeConfigurationPriceLines } from "./product-configurator-summary";
+
+const size: PriceLine = { kind: "SIZE", path: "$selection.groups.sizes", nodeId: "small", label: "صغير", amount: "100", chargedAmount: "100", included: false };
+function option(instanceId: string, amount = "5", included = false): PriceLine {
+  return { kind: "OPTION", path: `$selection.groups.extras.${instanceId}`, nodeId: "olive", instanceId,
+    label: "زيتون", amount, chargedAmount: included ? "0" : amount, included };
+}
+
+describe("customer price summary presentation", () => {
+  it("starts with the actual product and selected size, groups matching leaf units, and keeps charges Decimal-safe", () => {
+    const rows = summarizeConfigurationPriceLines([size, option("a"), option("b"), option("c")], "بيتزا مارغريتا");
+    expect(rows).toEqual([
+      { label: "1 × بيتزا مارغريتا — صغير", chargedAmount: "100", included: false },
+      { label: "3 × زيتون", chargedAmount: "15", included: false }
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it("does not merge included, differently priced, nested or linked instances", () => {
+    const branched = option("nested");
+    const child: PriceLine = { ...option("child"), path: `${branched.path}.children.sauce.child`, nodeId: "sauce", label: "رانش" };
+    const linked = { ...option("linked"), sourceProductId: "source-pizza" };
+    const rows = summarizeConfigurationPriceLines([option("a"), option("b", "5", true), option("c", "7"), branched, child, linked], "بيتزا");
+    expect(rows.map((row) => row.label)).toEqual([
+      "1 × بيتزا", "1 × زيتون", "1 × زيتون", "1 × زيتون", "1 × زيتون", "1 × رانش", "1 × زيتون"
+    ]);
+    expect(rows.map((row) => row.chargedAmount)).toEqual([undefined, "5", "0", "7", "5", "5", "5"]);
+  });
+
+  it("keeps real included-unit charges as zero and reconciles the summary with the Shared quote", () => {
+    const configuration = includedQuantityDemo("included", 1);
+    const selection = { schemaVersion: 1 as const, productId: "included", configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{
+      type: "OPTIONS" as const, groupId: "demo-included-toppings", instances: [
+        { instanceId: "m", optionId: "demo-included-mushroom" },
+        { instanceId: "c", optionId: "demo-included-cheese" },
+        { instanceId: "l", optionId: "demo-included-meat" }
+      ]
+    }] };
+    const quote = calculatePrice(configuration, selection, { catalogId: "demo", linkedProducts: new Map() });
+    expect(quote.valid).toBe(true);
+    expect(quote.total).toBe("115");
+    const rows = summarizeConfigurationPriceLines(quote.lines, "بيتزا");
+    expect(rows.filter((row) => row.included).map((row) => [row.label, row.chargedAmount])).toEqual([
+      ["1 × مشروم", "0"], ["1 × لحم", "0"]
+    ]);
+    expect(sumMoney(rows.map((row) => row.chargedAmount ?? "0"))).toBe(quote.total);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-summary.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-summary.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1a70a30
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator-summary.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+import { multiplyMoney } from "@menu/shared";
+import type { PriceLine } from "@menu/shared";
+
+export type DisplayPriceLine = { label: string; chargedAmount?: string; included: boolean };
+
+/** Presentation only: retain every trusted charge, and never merge branched instances. */
+export function summarizeConfigurationPriceLines(
+  lines: readonly PriceLine[], productName: string
+): DisplayPriceLine[] {
+  const rootSizes = lines.filter((line) => line.kind === "SIZE"
+    && !line.path.includes(".linked") && !line.path.includes(".children"));
+  const primarySize = rootSizes.length === 1 ? rootSizes[0] : null;
+  const base = lines.find((line) => line.kind === "BASE");
+  const result: DisplayPriceLine[] = [{
+    label: `1 × ${productName}${primarySize ? ` — ${primarySize.label}` : ""}`,
+    chargedAmount: primarySize?.chargedAmount ?? base?.chargedAmount,
+    included: false
+  }];
+  const grouped = new Map<string, { row: DisplayPriceLine; count: number }>();
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    if (line === primarySize || line === base && !primarySize) continue;
+    if (line.kind !== "OPTION") {
+      result.push({ label: line.label, chargedAmount: line.chargedAmount, included: line.included });
+      continue;
+    }
+    const hasBranch = lines.some((other) => other.path.startsWith(`${line.path}.children.`)
+      || other.path.startsWith(`${line.path}.linked.`));
+    if (hasBranch || line.sourceProductId) {
+      result.push({ label: `1 × ${line.label}`, chargedAmount: line.chargedAmount, included: line.included });
+      continue;
+    }
+    const parentPath = line.path.slice(0, line.path.lastIndexOf("."));
+    const key = JSON.stringify([parentPath, line.nodeId, line.label, line.amount, line.chargedAmount, line.included]);
+    const prior = grouped.get(key);
+    if (prior) {
+      prior.count += 1;
+      prior.row.label = `${prior.count} × ${line.label}`;
+      prior.row.chargedAmount = multiplyMoney(line.chargedAmount, prior.count);
+    } else {
+      const row = { label: `1 × ${line.label}`, chargedAmount: line.chargedAmount, included: line.included };
+      result.push(row);
+      grouped.set(key, { row, count: 1 });
+    }
+  }
+  return result;
+}

+.configurator {
+  --pc-accent: var(--color-primary);
+  display: grid;
+  gap: 14px;
+  margin: 20px 0;
+  color: var(--color-text);
+  font-family: var(--font-base, inherit);
+  font-size: var(--font-size-base, 16px);
+  line-height: 1.45;
+}
+
+.heading,
+.groupHeader,
+.optionRow,
+.summaryTitle,
+.total {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  gap: 12px;
+}
+
+.heading {
+  padding-block-end: 12px;
+  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+}
+
+.heading h2 {
+  margin: 0;
+  color: var(--color-text-first);
+  font-family: var(--font-heading, inherit);
+  font-size: 14px;
+  font-weight: 900;
+  line-height: 1.4;
+  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+}
+
+.heading button,
+.previewGate button {
+  display: inline-flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  justify-content: center;
+  gap: 7px;
+  border: 0;
+  border-radius: 12px;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  font: inherit;
+}
+
+.heading button {
+  min-height: 40px;
+  padding: 8px 12px;
+  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 90%, var(--color-primary));

+  font-size: 12px;
+}
+
+.groups {

+  gap: 14px;
+}
+
+.group {

+  padding: 14px;
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-card, 18px);

+  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 5%, transparent);
+}

+.groupHeader {

+}
