+}
+
+.linkedMeta small {
+  margin-inline-start: auto;
+  color: var(--color-error);
+}
+
+.instance {
+  margin: 0 10px 10px;
+}
+
+.nested,
+.linkedSelection {
+  min-width: 0;
+  padding: 11px;
+  border-inline-start: 2px solid var(--color-secondary);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-button, 12px);
+  background: var(--color-surface);
+}
+
+.nested .group,
+.linkedSelection .group {
+  box-shadow: none;
+}
+
+.linkedSelection {
+  margin-block-start: 9px;
+  border-inline-start-color: var(--color-primary);
+}
+
+.summary {
+  padding: 14px;
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-card, 18px);
+  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 94%, var(--color-secondary));
+}
+
+.summaryTitle > span {
+  font-weight: 800;
+}
+
+.summaryTitle small {
+  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
+  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 82%, var(--color-secondary));
+}
+
+.total {
+  margin: 13px 0;
+  padding: 12px 0;
+  border-top: 1px dashed var(--color-border);
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: baseline;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  gap: 12px;
+}
+
+.unitPrice {
+  display: flex;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  gap: 12px;
+  margin-block-start: 12px;
+  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
+  font-size: 12px;
+}
+
+.total strong {
+  color: var(--color-secondary);
+  font-size: 18px;
+  font-weight: 900;
+}
+
+.total small {
+  font-size: 12px;
+}
+
+.summary ul,
+.errors ul {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: 7px;
+  margin: 0;
+  padding: 0;
+  list-style: none;
+}
+
+.summary li {
+  display: flex;
+  justify-content: space-between;
+  gap: 12px;
+  font-size: 12px;
+  line-height: 1.4;
+}
+
+.summary li span {
+  min-width: 0;
+  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
+}
+
+.summary li b {
+  flex: 0 0 auto;
+  color: var(--color-text);
+}
+
+.hint,
+.previewGate p,
+.unavailable p {
+  margin: 8px 0 0;
+  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
+  font-size: 12px;
+  line-height: 1.7;
+}
+
+.errors {
+  margin-block-start: 12px;
+  color: var(--color-error);
+}
+
+.errors li {
+  padding: 8px 10px;
+  border-radius: 10px;
+  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 90%, var(--color-error));
+  font-size: 12px;
+}
+
+.previewGate {
+  display: grid;
+  gap: 6px;
+}
+
+.previewGate button {
+  min-height: 48px;
+  background: var(--pc-accent);
+  color: var(--color-surface);
+  font-weight: 800;
+}
+
+.previewGate button:disabled {
+  opacity: .55;
+  cursor: not-allowed;
+}
+
+.previewGate a {
+  color: var(--pc-accent);
+  font-weight: 700;
+  text-decoration: underline;
+}
+
+.previewGate strong {
+  padding: 10px;
+  border-radius: 10px;
+  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 90%, var(--color-success));
+  color: var(--color-success);
+  font-size: 13px;
+}
+
+.unavailable,
+.state {
+  display: flex;
+  align-items: center;
+  gap: 11px;
+  padding: 14px;
+  border: 1px solid var(--color-error);
+  border-radius: var(--radius-button, 14px);
+  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 90%, var(--color-error));
+  color: var(--color-error);
+}
+
+.configurator :where(button, a):focus-visible {
+  outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
+  outline-offset: 2px;
+}
+
+@media (hover: hover) {
+  .sizeGrid button:not(:disabled):not(.selected):hover,
+  .option:not(.optionSelected):hover,
+  .quantity button:not(:disabled):hover,
+  .heading button:hover {
+    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface) 90%, var(--color-primary));
+  }
+}
+
+.state {
+  justify-content: center;
+  min-height: 100px;
+  margin: 18px 0;
+}
+
+.spin {
+  animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
+}
+
+@keyframes spin {
+  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
+}
+
+@media (max-width: 640px) {
+  .configurator {
+    margin-inline: -2px;
+  }
+
+  .heading {
+    align-items: flex-start;
+  }
+
+  .heading h2 {
+    font-size: 14px;
+  }
+
+  .heading button {
+    flex: 0 0 auto;
+    padding-inline: 9px;
+    font-size: 12px;
+  }
+
+  .group {
+    padding: 12px;
+    border-radius: 15px;
+  }
+
+  .groupHeader {
+    align-items: flex-start;
+    flex-direction: column;
+    gap: 5px;
+  }
+
+  .sizeGrid {
+    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 105px), 1fr));
+  }
+
+  .sizeGrid:has(> button:nth-child(3):last-child) {
+    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
+  }
+
+  .sizeGrid button {
+    padding-inline: 4px;
+    font-size: 12px;
+  }
+
+  .sizeGrid button strong {
+    font-size: 11px;
+  }
+
+  .optionRow {
+    gap: 7px;
+  }
+
+  .nested,
+  .linkedSelection {
+    padding: 8px;
+  }
+
+  .summary li {
+    align-items: flex-start;
+  }
+}
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator.test.tsx b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0b0388a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { ProductConfigurator } from "./product-configurator";
+
+describe("ProductConfigurator", () => {
+  it("renders an Arabic RTL loading state without any order action", () => {
+    const html = renderToStaticMarkup(
+      <ProductConfigurator restaurantSlug="demo" productId="pizza" currency="EGP" />
+    );
+    expect(html).toContain('dir="rtl"');
+    expect(html).toContain("جارٍ تحميل خيارات الصنف");
+    expect(html).not.toContain("إضافة إلى السلة");
+    expect(html).not.toContain("واتساب");
+  });
+
+  it("follows the menu language while loading", () => {
+    const html = renderToStaticMarkup(
+      <ProductConfigurator restaurantSlug="demo" productId="pizza" currency="SYP" locale="en" showPrices={false} />
+    );
+    expect(html).toContain('dir="ltr"');
+    expect(html).toContain("Loading product choices");
+    expect(html).not.toContain("جارٍ تحميل");
+  });
+
+  it("keeps three sizes in one themed mobile row with accessible selection controls", () => {
+    const css = readFileSync(new URL("./product-configurator.module.css", import.meta.url), "utf8");
+    const source = readFileSync(new URL("./product-configurator.tsx", import.meta.url), "utf8");
+    expect(css).toContain("@media (max-width: 640px)");
+    expect(css).toContain(".sizeGrid:has(> button:nth-child(3):last-child)");
+    expect(css).toContain("grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))");
+    expect(css).toContain("var(--color-surface)");
+    expect(css).toContain("var(--color-border)");
+    expect(css).toContain("var(--color-secondary)");
+    expect(css).toContain(":focus-visible");
+    expect(source).toContain('role="radiogroup"');
+    expect(source).toContain('role={radioMode ? "radiogroup"');
+    expect(source).toContain("getPublicProductQuote");
+    expect(source).toContain("orderingEnabled && preview.valid");
+    expect(source).toContain("product-bottom-cart-network");
+    expect(css).toContain("var(--color-primary)");
+  });
+
+  it("keeps customer copy free of reset and pricing-engine explanations", () => {
+    const source = readFileSync(new URL("./product-configurator.tsx", import.meta.url), "utf8");
+    expect(source).not.toContain("تكوين مستقل");
+    expect(source).not.toContain("تم تجاهل السعر الأساسي");
+    expect(source).not.toContain("معاينة فقط");
+    expect(source).not.toContain("إعادة الضبط");
+    expect(source.indexOf("preview.lines.map")).toBeLessThan(source.indexOf("styles.total"));
+    expect(source).toContain("multiplyMoney(preview.total, draftQuantity)");
+    expect(source).toContain("displayCurrencyAmount(line.chargedAmount, currency)");
+    expect(source).not.toContain('line.included ? say(locale, "مشمول", "Included")');
+  });
+
+  it("removes repeated Network headings and routine checkout explanation while preserving safeguards", () => {
+    const source = readFileSync(new URL("./product-configurator.tsx", import.meta.url), "utf8");
+    expect(source).not.toContain("ستُراجع الأسعار والتوفر مجددًا قبل فتح WhatsApp");
+    expect(source).not.toContain("<h2 dir=\"auto\">{envelope.productName}</h2>");
+    expect(source).not.toContain("اختر حجمًا واحدًا");
+    expect(source).toContain("!checkoutEnabled || !orderingEnabled");
+    expect(source).toContain("أسعار هذه القائمة مخفية؛ لا يمكن إضافة الصنف للسلة");
+    expect(source).toContain("multiplyMoney(preview.total, draftQuantity)");
+    expect(source).toContain("preview.issues.slice(0, 8)");
+    expect(source).toContain("option.label.includes(source.name)");
+    expect(source).toContain("linked?.groups.length && instance.linkedSelection");
+    expect(source).not.toContain("styles.linkedHeading");
+    const css = readFileSync(new URL("./product-configurator.module.css", import.meta.url), "utf8");
+    expect(css).toContain(".optionSelected > .optionRow .optionLabel i");
+    expect(css).not.toContain(".optionSelected .optionLabel i");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator.tsx b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cb824a7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/product-configurator.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,530 @@
+"use client";
+
+import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
+import { AlertTriangle, Check, Loader2, Minus, Plus, ShoppingBag } from "lucide-react";
+import { multiplyMoney } from "@menu/shared";
+import type {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  GroupSelection,
+  OptionGroupSelection,
+  OptionSelectionInstance,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  ProductSelectionV1,
+  SizeGroupSelection
+} from "@menu/shared";
+import {
+  getPublicProductConfiguration,
+  getPublicProductQuote,
+  PublicProductQuoteError,
+  type PublicLinkedConfigurationSource,
+  type PublicProductConfigurationResponse,
+  type PublicProductQuoteResponse
+} from "@/lib/api";
+import {
+  buildInitialSelection,
+  buildOptionInstance,
+  canAddOptionInstance,
+  calculatePublicPreview,
+  changeSizeSelection,
+  linkedConfiguration,
+  LatestQuoteGate,
+  updateOptionGroup
+} from "./product-configurator-model";
+import styles from "./product-configurator.module.css";
+import { summarizeConfigurationPriceLines } from "./product-configurator-summary";
+import { displayCurrencyAmount, displayRoundingDifference } from "@/lib/currency-display";
+
+type Props = {
+  restaurantSlug: string;
+  productId: string;
+  currency: string;
+  cartHref?: string;
+  cartCount?: number;
+  initialSelection?: ProductSelectionV1 | null;
+  editingLineId?: string;
+  initialQuantity?: number;
+  maxQuantity?: number;
+  onNetworkQuote?: (quote: PublicProductQuoteResponse, editingLineId?: string, quantity?: number) => boolean;
+  checkoutEnabled?: boolean;
+  orderingEnabled?: boolean;
+  showPrices?: boolean;
+  showBottomBar?: boolean;
+  hideBottomBarCartIcon?: boolean;
+  freshStart?: boolean;
+  editableQuantity?: boolean;
+  locale?: "ar" | "en";
+};
+
+function say(locale: "ar" | "en", ar: string, en: string) {
+  return locale === "ar" ? ar : en;
+}
+
+function issueText(code: string, fallback: string, locale: "ar" | "en") {
+  const messages: Record<string, string> = {
+    SIZE_REQUIRED: "اختر حجمًا للمتابعة.",
+    GROUP_MIN_NOT_MET: "لم يكتمل الحد الأدنى من الاختيارات المطلوبة.",
+    GROUP_MAX_EXCEEDED: "تجاوزت الحد الأقصى المسموح لهذه الخيارات.",
+    OPTION_MIN_NOT_MET: "أحد الخيارات الإلزامية لم يكتمل.",
+    OPTION_MAX_EXCEEDED: "تجاوزت الكمية المسموحة لهذا الخيار.",
+    LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: "أحد الأصناف المرتبطة غير متاح حاليًا.",
+    LINK_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: "تعذر العثور على مصدر أحد الأصناف المرتبطة.",
+    MISSING_LINKED_SELECTION: "أكمل اختيارات الصنف المرتبط.",
+    PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: "ميزة تكوين الأصناف غير متاحة لهذه القائمة حاليًا.",
+    PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: "هذا الصنف غير متاح حاليًا.",
+    UNSATISFIABLE_CONFIGURATION: "لا يمكن استيفاء الاختيارات المطلوبة حاليًا."
+  };
+  const english: Record<string, string> = {
+    SIZE_REQUIRED: "Choose a size to continue.", GROUP_MIN_NOT_MET: "Choose the required options.",
+    GROUP_MAX_EXCEEDED: "Too many options selected.", OPTION_MIN_NOT_MET: "A required option is missing.",
+    OPTION_MAX_EXCEEDED: "The option quantity limit was exceeded.",
+    LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: "A linked product is unavailable.", LINK_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: "A linked product could not be found.",
+    MISSING_LINKED_SELECTION: "Complete the linked product choices.",
+    PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: "Configuration is unavailable for this menu.",
+    PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: "This product is unavailable.", UNSATISFIABLE_CONFIGURATION: "Required choices cannot be completed."
+  };
+  return (locale === "ar" ? messages : english)[code] ?? fallback;
+}
+
+function groupSelection(selection: ProductSelectionV1, groupId: string) {
+  return selection.groups.find((item) => item.groupId === groupId);
+}
+
+function replaceGroup(selection: ProductSelectionV1, group: GroupSelection) {
+  return {
+    ...selection,
+    groups: selection.groups.some((item) => item.groupId === group.groupId)
+      ? selection.groups.map((item) => item.groupId === group.groupId ? group : item)
+      : [...selection.groups, group]
+  };
+}
+
+function sourceMap(sources: readonly PublicLinkedConfigurationSource[]) {
+  return new Map(sources.map((source) => [source.productId, source]));
+}
+
+function SelectionGroups({
+  configuration,
+  selection,
+  sources,
+  currency,
+  locale,
+  showPrices,
+  createId,
+  onChange,
+  onSelectionProblem,
+  depth = 0
+}: {
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1;
+  sources: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicLinkedConfigurationSource>;
+  currency: string;
+  locale: "ar" | "en";
+  showPrices: boolean;
+  createId: (prefix: string) => string;
+  onChange: (selection: ProductSelectionV1) => void;
+  onSelectionProblem: (label: string) => void;
+  depth?: number;
+}) {
+  return <div className={styles.groups} data-depth={depth}>{configuration.groups.map((group) => {
+    if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+      const selected = groupSelection(selection, group.id) as SizeGroupSelection | undefined;
+      const selectedSize = group.sizes.find((size) => size.id === selected?.sizeChoiceId);
+      return <section className={styles.group} key={group.id} data-group-type="SIZE">
+        <header className={styles.groupHeader}>
+          <div><b dir="auto">{group.label}</b><span className={styles.required}>{say(locale, "مطلوب", "Required")}</span></div>
+        </header>
+        <div className={styles.sizeGrid} role="radiogroup" aria-label={group.label}>
+          {group.sizes.map((size) => <button
+            type="button"
+            role="radio"
+            aria-checked={selected?.sizeChoiceId === size.id}
+            className={selected?.sizeChoiceId === size.id ? styles.selected : ""}
+            disabled={size.available === false}
+            key={size.id}
+            onClick={() => {
+              const result = changeSizeSelection(selection, group, size.id, sources, createId);
+              if (result.selection) onChange(result.selection);
+              else onSelectionProblem(result.error);
+            }}
+          >
+            <span dir="auto">{size.label}</span>
+            {showPrices ? <strong>{displayCurrencyAmount(size.price, currency)}</strong> : null}
+          </button>)}
+        </div>
+        {selectedSize && selected && (selectedSize.children?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? <div className={styles.nested}>
+          <SelectionGroups
+            configuration={{ ...configuration, groups: selectedSize.children ?? [] }}
+            selection={{ ...selection, groups: selected.children ?? [] }}
+            sources={sources}
+            currency={currency}
+            locale={locale}
+            showPrices={showPrices}
+            createId={createId}
+            depth={depth + 1}
+            onChange={(nested) => onChange(replaceGroup(selection, { ...selected, children: nested.groups }))}
+            onSelectionProblem={onSelectionProblem}
+          />
+        </div> : null}
+      </section>;
+    }
+
+    return <OptionGroup
+      key={group.id}
+      group={group}
+      configuration={configuration}
+      selection={selection}
+      sources={sources}
+      currency={currency}
+      locale={locale}
+      showPrices={showPrices}
+      createId={createId}
+      depth={depth}
+      onChange={onChange}
+      onSelectionProblem={onSelectionProblem}
+    />;
+  })}</div>;
+}
+
+function OptionGroup({
+  group,
+  configuration,
+  selection,
+  sources,
+  currency,
+  locale,
+  showPrices,
+  createId,
+  depth,
+  onChange,
+  onSelectionProblem
+}: {
+  group: Extract<ConfigurationGroup, { type: "OPTIONS" }>;
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1;
+  sources: ReadonlyMap<string, PublicLinkedConfigurationSource>;
+  currency: string;
+  locale: "ar" | "en";
+  showPrices: boolean;
+  createId: (prefix: string) => string;
+  depth: number;
+  onChange: (selection: ProductSelectionV1) => void;
+  onSelectionProblem: (label: string) => void;
+}) {
+  const selected = groupSelection(selection, group.id) as OptionGroupSelection | undefined;
+  const instances = selected?.instances ?? [];
+  const radioMode = group.max === 1 && group.options.every(
+    (option) => option.maxQuantity === 1 && (option.minQuantity ?? 0) === 0
+  );
+  const max = group.max ?? 100;
+
+  function setInstances(next: OptionSelectionInstance[]) {
+    onChange(updateOptionGroup(selection, group.id, next));
+  }
+
+  return <section className={styles.group} data-group-type="OPTIONS">
+    <header className={styles.groupHeader}>
+      <div>
+        <b dir="auto">{group.label}</b>
+        <span className={group.min > 0 ? styles.required : styles.optional}>{group.min > 0 ? say(locale, "مطلوب", "Required") : say(locale, "اختياري", "Optional")}</span>
+      </div>
+      {group.max === 1 ? <small>{group.min > 0 ? say(locale, "اختر خيارًا واحدًا", "Choose one option") : say(locale, "اختر خيارًا واحدًا كحد أقصى", "Choose up to one option")}</small>
+        : group.max !== null && group.min === group.max ? <small>{say(locale, `اختر ${group.min} خيارات`, `Choose ${group.min} options`)}</small>
+        : group.max !== null ? <small>{group.min > 0
+          ? say(locale, `اختر من ${group.min} إلى ${group.max} خيارات`, `Choose ${group.min} to ${group.max} options`)
+          : say(locale, `اختر حتى ${group.max} خيارات`, `Choose up to ${group.max} options`)}</small>
+          : group.min > 0 ? <small>{say(locale, `اختر ${group.min} خيارات على الأقل`, `Choose at least ${group.min} options`)}</small> : null}
+    </header>
+    <div className={styles.options} role={radioMode ? "radiogroup" : "group"} aria-label={group.label}>
+      {group.options.map((option) => {
+        const optionInstances = instances.filter((instance) => instance.optionId === option.id);
+        const count = optionInstances.length;
+        const canAdd = canAddOptionInstance({
+          available: option.available !== false,
+          optionCount: count,
+          optionMax: option.maxQuantity,
+          groupCount: instances.length,
+          groupMax: max,
+          radioMode
+        });
+        const canRemove = count > (option.minQuantity ?? 0);
+        const source = option.linkedProduct ? sources.get(option.linkedProduct.sourceProductId) : null;
+        const sourceNameAlreadyShown = Boolean(source && option.label.includes(source.name));
+        const priceHint = option.priceOverrides?.length ? say(locale, "يتغير حسب الحجم", "Varies by size") : option.price;
+
+        function add() {
+          if (!canAdd) return;
+          if (radioMode) {
+            setInstances([buildOptionInstance(option, sources, createId)]);
+            return;
+          }
+          setInstances([...instances, buildOptionInstance(option, sources, createId)]);
+        }
+
+        function remove() {
+          if (!canRemove) return;
+          const id = optionInstances[optionInstances.length - 1]?.instanceId;
+          setInstances(instances.filter((instance) => instance.instanceId !== id));
+        }
+
+        return <article className={`${styles.option} ${count ? styles.optionSelected : ""}`.trim()} key={option.id}>
+          <div className={styles.optionRow}>
+            <button
+              type="button"
+              className={styles.optionLabel}
+              role={radioMode ? "radio" : option.maxQuantity === 1 ? "checkbox" : undefined}
+              aria-checked={radioMode || option.maxQuantity === 1 ? count > 0 : undefined}
+              disabled={option.available === false}
+              onClick={() => count > 0 && (radioMode || option.maxQuantity === 1) && canRemove ? remove() : add()}
+            >
+              <i>{count > 0 ? <Check size={14} /> : null}</i>
+              <span><b dir="auto">{option.label}</b>{showPrices ? <small>{priceHint === option.price ? displayCurrencyAmount(option.price, currency) : priceHint}</small> : null}</span>
+            </button>
+            {option.maxQuantity > 1 ? <div className={styles.quantity}>
+              <button type="button" onClick={remove} disabled={!canRemove} aria-label={`${say(locale, "تقليل", "Decrease")} ${option.label}`}><Minus size={14} /></button>
+              <strong>{count}</strong>
+              <button type="button" onClick={add} disabled={!canAdd} aria-label={`${say(locale, "زيادة", "Increase")} ${option.label}`}><Plus size={14} /></button>
+            </div> : null}
+          </div>
+          {option.linkedProduct && (!sourceNameAlreadyShown || source?.orderable === false) ? <div className={styles.linkedMeta}>
+            {!sourceNameAlreadyShown ? <b dir="auto">{source?.name ?? say(locale, "مصدر غير متاح", "Source unavailable")}</b> : null}
+            {source && !source.orderable ? <small>{say(locale, "غير قابل للطلب حاليًا", "Currently unavailable")}</small> : null}
+          </div> : null}
+          {optionInstances.map((instance) => {
+            const linked = linkedConfiguration(option, sources);
+            const hasLinkedChoices = Boolean(linked?.groups.length && instance.linkedSelection);
+            if (!(option.children?.length ?? 0) && !hasLinkedChoices) return null;
+            return <div className={styles.instance} key={instance.instanceId}>
+              {(option.children?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? <div className={styles.nested}>
+                <SelectionGroups
+                  configuration={{ ...configuration, groups: option.children ?? [] }}
+                  selection={{ ...selection, groups: instance.children ?? [] }}
+                  sources={sources}
+                  currency={currency}
+                  locale={locale}
+                  showPrices={showPrices}
+                  createId={createId}
+                  depth={depth + 1}
+                  onChange={(nested) => setInstances(instances.map((item) => item.instanceId === instance.instanceId
+                    ? { ...item, children: nested.groups }
+                    : item))}
+                  onSelectionProblem={onSelectionProblem}
+                />
+              </div> : null}
+              {hasLinkedChoices && linked && instance.linkedSelection ? <div className={styles.linkedSelection}>
+                <SelectionGroups
+                  configuration={linked}
+                  selection={instance.linkedSelection}
+                  sources={sources}
+                  currency={currency}
+                  locale={locale}
+                  showPrices={showPrices}
+                  createId={createId}
+                  depth={depth + 1}
+                  onChange={(linkedSelection) => setInstances(instances.map((item) => item.instanceId === instance.instanceId
+                    ? { ...item, linkedSelection }
+                    : item))}
+                  onSelectionProblem={onSelectionProblem}
+                />
+              </div> : null}
+            </div>;
+          })}
+        </article>;
+      })}
+    </div>
+  </section>;
+}
+
+export function ProductConfigurator({ restaurantSlug, productId, currency, cartHref, cartCount = 0, initialSelection,
+  editingLineId, initialQuantity = 1, maxQuantity = 100, onNetworkQuote, checkoutEnabled = false,
+  orderingEnabled = false, showPrices = true, showBottomBar = false, hideBottomBarCartIcon = false, freshStart = false,
+  editableQuantity = false, locale = "ar" }: Props) {
+  const [envelope, setEnvelope] = useState<PublicProductConfigurationResponse | null>(null);
+  const [selection, setSelection] = useState<ProductSelectionV1 | null>(null);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [continueMessage, setContinueMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [quoteAdded, setQuoteAdded] = useState(false);
+  const [quoteBusy, setQuoteBusy] = useState(false);
+  const [staleEdit, setStaleEdit] = useState(false);
+  const [draftQuantity, setDraftQuantity] = useState(Math.max(1, Math.min(100, initialQuantity)));
+  const quoteGate = useRef(new LatestQuoteGate());
+  const idCounter = useRef(0);
+  const createId = (prefix: string) => {
+    idCounter.current += 1;
+    const random = typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto ? crypto.randomUUID() : `${Date.now()}-${idCounter.current}`;
+    return `${prefix}-${random}`;
+  };
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let cancelled = false;
+    quoteGate.current.invalidate();
+    setEnvelope(null);
+    setSelection(null);
+    setError(null);
+    setQuoteAdded(false);
+    setStaleEdit(false);
+    void getPublicProductConfiguration(restaurantSlug, productId)
+      .then((value) => {
+        if (cancelled) return;
+        const sources = sourceMap(value.linkedProducts);
+        const storageKey = `ordersawa:configurator:${restaurantSlug}:${productId}:r${value.configurationRevision}`;
+        let initial: ProductSelectionV1 | null = null;
+        if (!freshStart) {
+          try {
+            const stored = window.sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey);
+            if (stored) {
+              const parsed = JSON.parse(stored) as ProductSelectionV1;
+              if (parsed.productId === value.productId && parsed.configurationRevision === value.configurationRevision) initial = parsed;
+            }
+          } catch {
+            // Invalid local preview drafts are ignored without affecting server data.
+          }
+        }
+        setEnvelope(value);
+        if (editingLineId && initialSelection) {
+          const compatible = initialSelection.productId === value.productId
+            && initialSelection.configurationRevision === value.configurationRevision;
+          setStaleEdit(!compatible);
+          setSelection(compatible ? initialSelection : buildInitialSelection(value.configuration, sources, createId));
+        } else {
+          setSelection(initial ?? buildInitialSelection(value.configuration, sources, createId));
+        }
+      })
+      .catch(() => {
+        if (!cancelled) setError("تعذر تحميل شبكة التكوين العامة لهذا الصنف.");
+      });
+    return () => { cancelled = true; quoteGate.current.invalidate(); };
+  }, [productId, restaurantSlug, editingLineId, freshStart]);
+
+  useEffect(() => { setDraftQuantity(Math.max(1, Math.min(100, initialQuantity))); }, [initialQuantity, editingLineId, productId]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!envelope || !selection || freshStart) return;
+    const storageKey = `ordersawa:configurator:${restaurantSlug}:${productId}:r${envelope.configurationRevision}`;
+    try {
+      window.sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(selection));
+    } catch {
+      // Local draft persistence is optional and must never block configuration.
+    }
+  }, [envelope, productId, restaurantSlug, selection, freshStart]);
+
+  const sources = useMemo(() => sourceMap(envelope?.linkedProducts ?? []), [envelope]);
+  const preview = useMemo(
+    () => envelope && selection ? calculatePublicPreview(envelope, restaurantSlug, selection) : null,
+    [envelope, restaurantSlug, selection]
+  );
+
+  if (error) return <section className={styles.state} dir={locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}><AlertTriangle size={22} /><b>{locale === "ar" ? error : "Could not load this product's choices."}</b></section>;
+  if (!envelope || !selection || !preview) return <section className={styles.state} dir={locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}><Loader2 className={styles.spin} size={22} /><b>{say(locale, "جارٍ تحميل خيارات الصنف...", "Loading product choices...")}</b></section>;
+
+  async function continuePreview() {
+    if (!preview?.valid || preview.total === null) {
+      setContinueMessage(say(locale, "أكمل الاختيارات المطلوبة وصحّح الأخطاء أولًا.", "Complete the required choices first."));
+      return;
+    }
+    if (!orderingEnabled || !envelope?.orderable || !selection || !onNetworkQuote || draftQuantity > maxQuantity) {
+      setContinueMessage(say(locale, "لا يمكن إضافة هذا التكوين إلى السلة حاليًا.", "This configuration cannot be added to the cart right now."));
+      return;
+    }
+    const requestId = quoteGate.current.next();
+    setQuoteBusy(true);
+    setContinueMessage(null);
+    setQuoteAdded(false);
+    try {
+      const quote = await getPublicProductQuote(restaurantSlug, productId, selection);
+      if (!quoteGate.current.isCurrent(requestId)) return;
+      if (!onNetworkQuote(quote, editingLineId, draftQuantity)) {
+        setContinueMessage(say(locale, "استجابة السعر غير متوافقة أو تجاوزت السلة الحد؛ لم تُعدَّل السلة.", "The quote is incompatible or the cart limit was exceeded. The cart was not changed."));
+        return;
+      }
+      setContinueMessage(editingLineId
+        ? say(locale, "حُفظت الاختيارات في السلة.", "Choices saved in the cart.")
+        : say(locale, "أُضيف الصنف إلى السلة.", "Item added to the cart."));
+      setQuoteAdded(true);
+      setStaleEdit(false);
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (!quoteGate.current.isCurrent(requestId)) return;
+      if (error instanceof PublicProductQuoteError) {
+        const firstIssue = error.issues[0];
+        setContinueMessage(firstIssue ? issueText(firstIssue.code, firstIssue.message, locale) : error.message);
+      } else {
+        setContinueMessage(say(locale, "تعذر الاتصال بخدمة السعر؛ لم تُضف إلى السلة.", "Could not verify the price; nothing was added to the cart."));
+      }
+    } finally {
+      if (quoteGate.current.isCurrent(requestId)) setQuoteBusy(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const canAdd = orderingEnabled && preview.valid && envelope.orderable && draftQuantity <= maxQuantity && !quoteBusy;
+  return <>
+    <section className={styles.configurator} dir={locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"} data-testid="public-product-configurator">
+    <header className={styles.heading}>
+      <h2>{say(locale, "تخصيص الصنف", "Customize product")}</h2>
+    </header>
+
+    {!envelope.orderable ? <div className={styles.unavailable}><AlertTriangle size={18} /><div><b>{say(locale, "التكوين غير قابل للطلب حاليًا", "This configuration is currently unavailable")}</b></div></div> : null}
+
+    {staleEdit ? <div className={styles.unavailable}><AlertTriangle size={18} /><div><b>{say(locale, "تغيّر تكوين الصنف منذ إضافته للسلة", "Product choices changed since this item was added")}</b><p>{say(locale, "اختيارات السلة القديمة محفوظة دون تعديل. راجع التكوين الحالي واحفظه إذا رغبت.", "Your previous cart choices were not changed. Review and save the current choices if you wish.")}</p></div></div> : null}
+
+    <SelectionGroups
+      configuration={envelope.configuration}
+      selection={selection}
+      sources={sources}
+      currency={currency}
+      locale={locale}
+      showPrices={showPrices}
+      createId={createId}
+      onChange={(next) => { quoteGate.current.invalidate(); setQuoteBusy(false); setContinueMessage(null); setQuoteAdded(false); setSelection(next); }}
+      onSelectionProblem={(label) => setContinueMessage(say(locale,
+        `لا يمكن نقل اختيار «${label}» إلى الحجم الجديد. صحّح الاختيار أولًا ثم حاول مجددًا.`,
+        `The choice “${label}” is not valid for the new size. Adjust it first, then try again.`))}
+    />
+
+    {showPrices ? <aside className={styles.summary} aria-live="polite">
+      <div className={styles.summaryTitle}><span>{say(locale, "ملخص السعر", "Price summary")}</span></div>
+      {preview.valid && preview.total !== null ? <>
+        <ul>{summarizeConfigurationPriceLines(preview.lines, envelope.productName).map((line, index) => <li key={`${line.label}-${index}`}>
+          <span dir="auto">{line.label}</span>
+          {line.chargedAmount !== undefined ? <b>{displayCurrencyAmount(line.chargedAmount, currency)}</b> : null}
+        </li>)}</ul>
+        {displayRoundingDifference(preview.lines.map((line) => line.chargedAmount), preview.total, currency)
+          ? <p className={styles.hint}>{say(locale, "فرق عرض الأسعار", "Displayed price difference")}: {displayRoundingDifference(preview.lines.map((line) => line.chargedAmount), preview.total, currency)}</p> : null}
+        <div className={styles.unitPrice}><span>{say(locale, "سعر القطعة مع الإضافات", "Price per item with choices")}</span><b>{displayCurrencyAmount(preview.total, currency)}</b></div>
+        <div className={styles.unitPrice}><span>{say(locale, "الكمية", "Quantity")}</span><b>× {draftQuantity}</b></div>
+        <div className={styles.total}><span>{say(locale, "الإجمالي", "Total")}</span><strong>{displayCurrencyAmount(multiplyMoney(preview.total, draftQuantity), currency)}</strong></div>
+      </> : <div className={styles.errors}>
+        <b>{say(locale, "لا يمكن عرض سعر نهائي بعد", "A final price is not available yet")}</b>
+        <ul>{preview.issues.slice(0, 8).map((issue, index) => <li key={`${issue.code}-${index}`}>{issueText(issue.code, issue.message, locale)}</li>)}</ul>
+      </div>}
+    </aside> : null}
+
+    <div className={styles.previewGate}>
+      {editableQuantity && !showBottomBar ? <div className="quantity-control" aria-label={say(locale, "كمية التكوين الجاري", "Current configuration quantity")}>
+        <button type="button" onClick={() => setDraftQuantity((value) => Math.min(maxQuantity, value + 1))}
+          disabled={draftQuantity >= maxQuantity} aria-label={say(locale, "زيادة الكمية", "Increase quantity")}><Plus size={16} /></button>
+        <strong>{draftQuantity}</strong>
+        <button type="button" onClick={() => setDraftQuantity((value) => Math.max(1, value - 1))}
+          disabled={draftQuantity <= 1} aria-label={say(locale, "إنقاص الكمية", "Decrease quantity")}><Minus size={16} /></button>
+      </div> : null}
+      {!showBottomBar ? <button type="button" onClick={() => void continuePreview()} disabled={!canAdd}>
+        {quoteBusy ? say(locale, "جارٍ التحقق من السعر...", "Checking the price...") : editingLineId ? say(locale, "حفظ التكوين في السلة", "Save cart choices") : say(locale, "إضافة إلى السلة", "Add to cart")}
+      </button> : null}
+      {!showPrices ? <p>{say(locale, "أسعار هذه القائمة مخفية؛ لا يمكن إضافة الصنف للسلة.", "Prices are hidden for this menu; this item cannot be added to the cart.")}</p>
+        : !checkoutEnabled || !orderingEnabled ? <p>{say(locale, "لا يمكن طلب هذا الصنف حاليًا.", "This item cannot be ordered right now.")}</p> : null}
+      {continueMessage ? <strong>{continueMessage}</strong> : null}
+      {cartHref && quoteAdded && !showBottomBar ? <a href={cartHref}>{say(locale, "عرض السلة", "View cart")}</a> : null}
+    </div>
+    </section>
+    {showBottomBar ? <div className="product-bottom-cart product-bottom-cart-network" dir="ltr">
+      <div className="quantity-control" aria-label={say(locale, "كمية التكوين الجاري", "Current configuration quantity")}>
+        <button type="button" onClick={() => setDraftQuantity((value) => Math.min(maxQuantity, value + 1))} disabled={draftQuantity >= maxQuantity} aria-label={say(locale, "زيادة الكمية", "Increase quantity")}><Plus size={16} /></button>
+        <strong>{draftQuantity}</strong>
+        <button type="button" onClick={() => setDraftQuantity((value) => Math.max(1, value - 1))} disabled={draftQuantity <= 1} aria-label={say(locale, "إنقاص الكمية", "Decrease quantity")}><Minus size={16} /></button>
+      </div>
+      <button type="button" className="product-cart-link" dir={locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"} onClick={() => void continuePreview()} disabled={!canAdd}>
+        {quoteBusy ? <Loader2 size={18} className={styles.spin} /> : !hideBottomBarCartIcon ? <ShoppingBag size={18} /> : null}
+        <span>{editingLineId ? say(locale, "حفظ التكوين", "Save choices") : say(locale, "إضافة إلى السلة", "Add to cart")}</span>
+      </button>
+      {cartHref ? <a href={cartHref} className="product-network-cart-shortcut" aria-label={say(locale, "عرض السلة", "View cart")} title={say(locale, "عرض السلة", "View cart")}><ShoppingBag size={20} /><b>{cartCount}</b></a> : null}
+    </div> : null}
+  </>;
+}

+    case "GROUP_MIN_NOT_MET": return ar ? "أكمل الخيارات المطلوبة." : "Complete the required choices.";

diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/public-quote-client.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/public-quote-client.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..18c488f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/public-quote-client.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
+import { getPublicProductQuote, PublicProductQuoteError } from "@/lib/api";
+import type { ProductSelectionV1 } from "@menu/shared";
+
+const selection: ProductSelectionV1 = {
+  schemaVersion: 1, productId: "pizza", configurationRevision: 3,
+  groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "large" }]
+};
+
+afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());
+
+describe("public server quote client", () => {
+  it("sends selection only and reads the canonical server response", async () => {
+    const serverQuote = { productId: "pizza", trustedTotal: "15.000001", canonicalSelection: selection };
+    const fetchMock = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({ data: serverQuote }) });
+    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
+    expect(await getPublicProductQuote("restaurant a", "pizza", selection)).toBe(serverQuote);
+    const [url, options] = fetchMock.mock.calls[0] as [string, RequestInit];
+    expect(url).toContain("/public/menus/restaurant%20a/products/pizza/quote");
+    expect(options.method).toBe("POST");
+    expect(JSON.parse(options.body as string)).toEqual({ selection });
+  });
+
+  it("preserves structured revision and capability failures", async () => {
+    const fetchMock = vi.fn()
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: false, status: 409, json: async () => ({
+        error: "CONFIGURATION_REVISION_CHANGED", message: "Changed", currentRevision: 4,
+        issues: [{ code: "STALE_CONFIGURATION_REVISION", path: "$selection", message: "Changed" }]
+      }) })
+      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ok: false, status: 403, json: async () => ({ error: "CAPABILITY_DENIED", message: "Disabled" }) });
+    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
+    await expect(getPublicProductQuote("r", "pizza", selection)).rejects.toMatchObject({
+      status: 409, code: "CONFIGURATION_REVISION_CHANGED", currentRevision: 4,
+      issues: [expect.objectContaining({ code: "STALE_CONFIGURATION_REVISION" })]
+    });
+    await expect(getPublicProductQuote("r", "pizza", selection)).rejects.toMatchObject({
+      status: 403, code: "CAPABILITY_DENIED"
+    });
+  });
+
+  it("fails closed on network failures or missing quote data", async () => {
+    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error("offline")));
+    await expect(getPublicProductQuote("r", "pizza", selection)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(PublicProductQuoteError);
+    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({ data: null }) }));
+    await expect(getPublicProductQuote("r", "pizza", selection)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "QUOTE_RESPONSE_INVALID" });
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/trusted-whatsapp-checkout.test.ts b/apps/web/src/components/public/trusted-whatsapp-checkout.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fedce72
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/trusted-whatsapp-checkout.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { PublicWhatsappCheckoutError, type PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft, type PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest } from "@/lib/api";
+import { buildTrustedCheckoutRequest, compareTrustedDraft, trustedCheckoutErrorMessage } from "./trusted-whatsapp-checkout";
+
+const request: PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest = {
+  locale: "ar", fulfillmentType: "pickup",
+  items: [
+    { mode: "LEGACY", lineId: "old", productSlug: "water", quantity: 2, expectedUnitPrice: "1.250000" },
+    { mode: "NETWORK", lineId: "pizza", productId: "pizza", quantity: 1, expectedUnitPrice: "10.125000" }
+  ]
+};
+const draft: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft = {
+  restaurantName: "تجريبي", restaurantSlug: "demo", currency: "USD", locale: "ar", details: {},
+  items: [
+    { mode: "LEGACY", lineId: "old", productName: "Water", quantity: 2, unitPrice: "1.250000", lineTotal: "2.500000", changed: false },
+    { mode: "NETWORK", lineId: "pizza", productName: "بيتزا", quantity: 1, unitPrice: "10.125000", lineTotal: "10.125000", changed: false }
+  ],
+  itemsSubtotal: "12.625000", deliveryFee: null, totalAmount: "12.625000", requiresExplicitAcceptance: true
+};
+
+const compare = (value: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft, displayed = "12.625000") =>
+  compareTrustedDraft(value, request, displayed, "demo", "ar");
+
+describe("trusted checkout visible-invoice acceptance", () => {
+  it("accepts only a matching server draft, preserving six-decimal precision", () => {
+    expect(compare(draft)).toBe("CURRENT");
+    expect(compare({ ...draft, itemsSubtotal: "12.625001", totalAmount: "12.625001" })).toBe("PRICE_CHANGED");
+    expect(compare({ ...draft, items: [draft.items[0], { ...draft.items[1], unitPrice: "10.125001" }] })).toBe("PRICE_CHANGED");
+  });
+
+  it("requires acceptance when the server delivery fee changes, including pending versus free", () => {
+    const delivery = { ...request, fulfillmentType: "delivery" as const };
+    expect(compareTrustedDraft({ ...draft, deliveryFee: "0", totalAmount: "12.625000" }, delivery,
+      "12.625000", "demo", "ar", null)).toBe("PRICE_CHANGED");
+    expect(compareTrustedDraft({ ...draft, deliveryFee: "5", totalAmount: "17.625000" }, delivery,
+      "12.625000", "demo", "ar", "0")).toBe("PRICE_CHANGED");
+  });
+
+  it("does not silently accept a changed linked source even when the total is equal", () => {
+    expect(compare({ ...draft, items: [draft.items[0], { ...draft.items[1], changed: true }] })).toBe("SOURCE_CHANGED");
+  });
+
+  it("rejects a different restaurant, line identity, order, or quantity", () => {
+    expect(compare({ ...draft, restaurantSlug: "another" })).toBe("INVALID");
+    expect(compare({ ...draft, items: [...draft.items].reverse() })).toBe("INVALID");
+    expect(compare({ ...draft, items: [{ ...draft.items[0], quantity: 3 }, draft.items[1]] })).toBe("INVALID");
+    expect(compare({ ...draft, items: [{ ...draft.items[0], lineId: "other" }, draft.items[1]] })).toBe("INVALID");
+  });
+});
+
+describe("checkout delivery fields and customer-safe errors", () => {
+  const details = {
+    customerName: "", customerPhone: "", fulfillmentType: "delivery" as const,
+    deliveryArea: " حلب ", deliveryNear: " الباسل ", pickupTime: "old pickup time", orderNote: ""
+  };
+
+  it("sends only the active fulfillment fields, even when stale state contains a pickup time", () => {
+    const delivery = buildTrustedCheckoutRequest([], "ar", details);
+    expect(delivery).toMatchObject({ fulfillmentType: "delivery", deliveryArea: "حلب", deliveryNear: "الباسل" });
+    expect(delivery).not.toHaveProperty("deliveryBeside");
+    expect(delivery).not.toHaveProperty("pickupTime");
+    const pickup = buildTrustedCheckoutRequest([], "ar", { ...details, fulfillmentType: "pickup" });
+    expect(pickup.pickupTime).toBe("old pickup time");
+    expect(pickup).not.toHaveProperty("deliveryArea");
+    expect(pickup).not.toHaveProperty("deliveryNear");
+  });
+
+  it("never shows raw server field names or English validation text on an Arabic menu", () => {
+    const staleServer = new PublicWhatsappCheckoutError(
+      "Delivery requires area, near and beside; pickupTime is not applicable.", 400, "INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_DETAILS");
+    const message = trustedCheckoutErrorMessage(staleServer, "ar", details);
+    expect(message).toContain("عنوان التوصيل");
+    expect(message).not.toMatch(/beside|pickupTime|Delivery/);
+    expect(trustedCheckoutErrorMessage(staleServer, "ar", { ...details, deliveryArea: "" })).toBe("يرجى إدخال منطقة التوصيل.");
+    expect(trustedCheckoutErrorMessage(staleServer, "en", { ...details, deliveryNear: "" })).toBe("Enter a nearby landmark for delivery.");
+    expect(trustedCheckoutErrorMessage(new PublicWhatsappCheckoutError("internal SQL detail", 500, "UNKNOWN"), "ar", details))
+      .not.toContain("SQL");
+  });
+});
diff --git a/apps/web/src/components/public/trusted-whatsapp-checkout.tsx b/apps/web/src/components/public/trusted-whatsapp-checkout.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5687505
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/components/public/trusted-whatsapp-checkout.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,342 @@
+"use client";
+
+import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
+import { compareMoney, multiplyMoney, sumMoney } from "@menu/shared";
+import {
+  confirmPublicWhatsappCheckout, preparePublicWhatsappCheckout, PublicWhatsappCheckoutError,
+  type PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft, type PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest
+} from "@/lib/api";
+import type { CartItem } from "./cart-model";
+
+type Locale = "ar" | "en";
+type Details = {
+  customerName: string; customerPhone: string; fulfillmentType: "pickup" | "delivery";
+  deliveryArea: string; deliveryNear: string;
+  pickupTime: string; orderNote: string;
+};
+
+export function trustedCheckoutErrorMessage(error: unknown, locale: Locale, details: Details): string {
+  const ar = locale === "ar";
+  if (!(error instanceof PublicWhatsappCheckoutError)) {
+    return error instanceof TypeError
+      ? ar ? "تعذر الاتصال بخدمة التحقق. تحقق من الاتصال وحاول مجددًا." : "Could not reach checkout verification. Check your connection and retry."
+      : ar ? "حدث خطأ أثناء التحقق. حاول مجددًا." : "An error occurred during verification. Try again.";
+  }
+  if (error.code === "INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_DETAILS") {
+    if (details.fulfillmentType === "delivery") {
+      if (!details.deliveryArea.trim()) return ar ? "يرجى إدخال منطقة التوصيل." : "Enter the delivery area.";
+      if (!details.deliveryNear.trim()) return ar ? "يرجى إدخال أقرب معلم للتوصيل." : "Enter a nearby landmark for delivery.";
+      return ar ? "تعذر التحقق من عنوان التوصيل. راجع بياناته وحاول مجددًا." : "Could not verify the delivery address. Review it and try again.";
+    }
+    return ar ? "راجع بيانات الاستلام وحاول مجددًا." : "Review the pickup details and try again.";
+  }
+  if (["INVALID_QUOTE_SELECTION", "CONFIGURATION_NOT_ORDERABLE", "WHATSAPP_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE",
+    "WHATSAPP_PRODUCT_TYPE_CHANGED", "WHATSAPP_SNAPSHOT_PRICE_MISMATCH", "WHATSAPP_CART_REVIEW_REQUIRED"].includes(error.code)) {
+    return ar ? "تغير أحد الأصناف أو خياراته. راجع السلة وأعد المحاولة." : "A product or its options changed. Review the cart and try again.";
+  }
+  if (["WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_DISABLED", "WHATSAPP_ORDERING_DISABLED", "WHATSAPP_PRICES_HIDDEN",
+    "WHATSAPP_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE", "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE"].includes(error.code)) {
+    return ar ? "الطلب عبر WhatsApp غير متاح حاليًا لهذا المنيو." : "WhatsApp checkout is unavailable for this menu.";
+  }
+  if (error.code === "WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_REQUIRES_ACCEPTANCE") {
+    return ar ? "انتهت صلاحية الموافقة السابقة؛ راجع الطلب وأعد المحاولة." : "The previous approval expired; review the order and retry.";
+  }
+  if (error.code === "WHATSAPP_MESSAGE_TOO_LONG") {
+    return ar ? "رسالة الطلب طويلة جدًا؛ قلّل تفاصيل الطلب ثم حاول مجددًا." : "The order message is too long; reduce its details and retry.";
+  }
+  if (["WHATSAPP_PHONE_UNAVAILABLE", "WHATSAPP_PHONE_INVALID"].includes(error.code)) {
+    return ar ? "رقم WhatsApp الخاص بالمطعم غير متاح حاليًا. حاول لاحقًا." : "The restaurant's WhatsApp number is unavailable. Try later.";
+  }
+  if (error.lineErrors.length) {
+    return ar ? "بعض الأصناف تحتاج مراجعة قبل المتابعة." : "Some items need review before continuing.";
+  }
+  if (error.code === "WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_CONCURRENT_UPDATE") {
+    return ar ? "تحدّثت القائمة أثناء التحقق. حاول مجددًا." : "The menu changed during verification. Try again.";
+  }
+  if (error.status >= 500 || error.status === 429) {
+    return ar ? "خدمة التحقق غير متاحة مؤقتًا. بقيت بيانات طلبك محفوظة؛ حاول مجددًا." : "Checkout verification is temporarily unavailable. Your order details are saved; retry.";
+  }
+  return ar ? "تعذر التحقق من الطلب. بقيت بياناتك محفوظة؛ حاول مجددًا."
+    : "Could not verify the order. Your details are saved; try again.";
+}
+
+export function buildTrustedCheckoutRequest(cart: readonly CartItem[], locale: Locale, details: Details): PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest {
+  return {
+    locale,
+    ...(details.customerName.trim() ? { customerName: details.customerName.trim() } : {}),
+    ...(details.customerPhone.trim() ? { customerPhone: details.customerPhone.trim() } : {}),
+    fulfillmentType: details.fulfillmentType,
+    ...(details.fulfillmentType === "delivery" ? {
+      deliveryArea: details.deliveryArea.trim(), deliveryNear: details.deliveryNear.trim()
+    } : details.pickupTime.trim() ? { pickupTime: details.pickupTime.trim() } : {}),
+    ...(details.orderNote.trim() ? { orderNote: details.orderNote.trim() } : {}),
+    items: cart.map((item) => item.mode === "LEGACY" ? {
+      mode: "LEGACY" as const, lineId: item.lineId, productSlug: item.slug,
+      quantity: item.quantity, ...(item.note?.trim() ? { note: item.note.trim() } : {}),
+      expectedUnitPrice: item.priceText ?? String(item.price)
+    } : {
+      mode: "NETWORK" as const, lineId: item.lineId, productId: item.productId,
+      quantity: item.quantity, selection: item.selection,
+      ...(item.note?.trim() ? { note: item.note.trim() } : {}),
+      expectedUnitPrice: item.acceptedQuote.total,
+      expectedLinkedSourceRevisions: item.acceptedQuote.linkedSourceRevisions
+    })
+  };
+}
+type PendingPrice = {
+  request: PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest; draft: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft;
+  acceptanceToken: string; messagePreview: string;
+};
+
+export function compareTrustedDraft(draft: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft, checkoutRequest: PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest,
+  displayedTotal: string, restaurantSlug: string, locale: Locale, displayedFee: string | null = null): "INVALID" | "PRICE_CHANGED" | "SOURCE_CHANGED" | "CURRENT" {
+  if (draft.items.length !== checkoutRequest.items.length || draft.restaurantSlug !== restaurantSlug
+    || draft.locale !== locale || !draft.items.every((line, index) => {
+      const requested = checkoutRequest.items[index];
+      return line.lineId === requested.lineId && line.mode === requested.mode && line.quantity === requested.quantity;
+    })) return "INVALID";
+  const feeChanged = checkoutRequest.fulfillmentType === "delivery"
+    && (draft.deliveryFee === null || displayedFee === null
+      ? draft.deliveryFee !== displayedFee : compareMoney(draft.deliveryFee, displayedFee) !== 0);
+  const priceChanged = compareMoney(draft.itemsSubtotal, displayedTotal) !== 0 || feeChanged || draft.items.some((line, index) => {
+    const requested = checkoutRequest.items[index];
+    return !requested.expectedUnitPrice || compareMoney(line.unitPrice, requested.expectedUnitPrice) !== 0
+      || compareMoney(line.lineTotal, multiplyMoney(requested.expectedUnitPrice, requested.quantity)) !== 0;
+  });
+  if (priceChanged) return "PRICE_CHANGED";
+  return draft.items.some((line) => line.changed) ? "SOURCE_CHANGED" : "CURRENT";
+}
+
+/** Checkout behavior only. CartView owns the two-step visual shell. */
+export function useTrustedWhatsappCheckout({ cart, restaurantSlug, locale, details, disabledReason, displayedFee }: {
+  cart: readonly CartItem[]; restaurantSlug: string; locale: Locale; details: Details; disabledReason?: string;
+  displayedFee: string | null;
+}) {
+  const [pendingPrice, setPendingPrice] = useState<PendingPrice | null>(null);
+  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [failureCode, setFailureCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [failureField, setFailureField] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [reviewIssue, setReviewIssue] = useState<PublicWhatsappCheckoutError | null>(null);
+  const [previewMessage, setPreviewMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [previewPriceChanged, setPreviewPriceChanged] = useState(false);
+  const busyRef = useRef(false);
+  const editVersion = useRef(0);
+  const attemptRef = useRef<{ requestJson: string; idempotencyKey: string; acceptanceToken: string } | null>(null);
+  const ar = locale === "ar";
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    editVersion.current += 1;
+    attemptRef.current = null;
+    setPendingPrice(null);
+    setPreviewMessage(null);
+    setError(null);
+    setFailureCode(null);
+    setFailureField(null);
+  }, [cart, locale, details.customerName, details.customerPhone, details.fulfillmentType,
+    details.deliveryArea, details.deliveryNear, details.pickupTime, details.orderNote]);
+
+  useEffect(() => { setReviewIssue(null); }, [cart]);
+
+  function recordError(caught: unknown) {
+    setFailureCode(caught instanceof PublicWhatsappCheckoutError ? caught.code : null);
+    setFailureField(caught instanceof PublicWhatsappCheckoutError && caught.code === "INVALID_NETWORK_ORDER_DETAILS"
+      ? /^(customerName|customerPhone|deliveryArea|deliveryNear|pickupTime|orderNote)\b/.exec(caught.message)?.[1] ?? null : null);
+    setReviewIssue(caught instanceof PublicWhatsappCheckoutError && caught.lineErrors.length ? caught : null);
+    setError(trustedCheckoutErrorMessage(caught, locale, details));
+  }
+
+  function clearFailure() {
+    setError(null);
+    setFailureCode(null);
+    setFailureField(null);
+    setReviewIssue(null);
+  }
+
+  function request(): PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest {
+    return buildTrustedCheckoutRequest(cart, locale, details);
+  }
+
+  async function preview() {
+    if (disabledReason || !cart.length || busyRef.current) return;
+    busyRef.current = true;
+    setBusy(true);
+    setError(null);
+    setFailureCode(null);
+    setFailureField(null);
+    setPreviewMessage(null);
+    const version = editVersion.current;
+    const checkoutRequest = request();
+    try {
+      const prepared = await preparePublicWhatsappCheckout(restaurantSlug, checkoutRequest);
+      if (editVersion.current !== version) return;
+      const comparison = compareTrustedDraft(prepared.draft, checkoutRequest,
+        cartDisplayedTotal(cart), restaurantSlug, locale, displayedFee);
+      if (comparison === "INVALID" || comparison === "SOURCE_CHANGED") {
+        setError(ar ? "تغيرت اختيارات الطلب؛ راجع السلة قبل معاينة الرسالة." : "Order choices changed; review the cart before previewing.");
+        return;
+      }
+      setPreviewPriceChanged(comparison === "PRICE_CHANGED");
+      setPreviewMessage(prepared.messagePreview);
+    } catch (caught) {
+      if (editVersion.current === version) recordError(caught);
+    } finally {
+      busyRef.current = false;
+      setBusy(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function handleConfirmationError(caught: unknown, checkoutRequest: PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest, displayedTotal: string,
+    version: number, approvedDraft?: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft) {
+    if (editVersion.current !== version) return;
+    if (caught instanceof PublicWhatsappCheckoutError && caught.status === 409
+      && caught.changedDraft && caught.changedMessagePreview && caught.acceptanceToken) {
+      const comparison = approvedDraft
+        ? caught.changedDraft.totalAmount !== approvedDraft.totalAmount
+          || caught.changedDraft.items.some((line, index) => {
+            const approvedLine = approvedDraft.items[index];
+            return !approvedLine || compareMoney(line.unitPrice, approvedLine.unitPrice) !== 0;
+          }) ? "PRICE_CHANGED" : JSON.stringify(caught.changedDraft) !== JSON.stringify(approvedDraft) ? "SOURCE_CHANGED" : "CURRENT"
+        : compareTrustedDraft(caught.changedDraft, checkoutRequest, displayedTotal, restaurantSlug, locale, displayedFee);
+      if (comparison === "PRICE_CHANGED") {
+        setPendingPrice({ request: checkoutRequest, draft: caught.changedDraft,
+          messagePreview: caught.changedMessagePreview, acceptanceToken: caught.acceptanceToken });
+        return;
+      }
+      setError(comparison === "SOURCE_CHANGED"
+        ? ar ? "تغيرت تفاصيل أحد الأصناف. راجع اختيارات السلة وأعد المحاولة." : "Product details changed. Review your cart choices and try again."
+        : ar ? "انتهت صلاحية التحقق. راجع الطلب وأعد الإرسال." : "The verification expired. Review the order and try again.");
+      return;
+    }
+    recordError(caught);
+  }
+
+  async function confirmAndOpen(checkoutRequest: PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest, acceptanceToken: string,
+    idempotencyKey: string, displayedTotal: string, version: number, tab: Window | null) {
+    try {
+      const result = await confirmPublicWhatsappCheckout(restaurantSlug, checkoutRequest, acceptanceToken, idempotencyKey);
+      if (!result.whatsappUrl.startsWith("https://wa.me/")) throw new Error("Invalid WhatsApp destination");
+      if (editVersion.current !== version) { tab?.close(); return; }
+      const comparison = compareTrustedDraft(result.draft, checkoutRequest, displayedTotal, restaurantSlug, locale, displayedFee);
+      if (comparison !== "CURRENT") {
+        tab?.close();
+        setError(ar ? "تغير الطلب أثناء التحقق. راجعه وأعد الإرسال." : "The order changed during verification. Review and retry.");
+        return;
+      }
+      try {
+        if (tab) tab.location.href = result.whatsappUrl;
+        else window.location.href = result.whatsappUrl;
+      } catch {
+        setError(ar ? `حُفظ الطلب رقم ${result.orderNumber}، لكن تعذّر فتح WhatsApp. اضغط الزر مجددًا لإعادة فتحه دون إنشاء طلب جديد.`
+          : `Order ${result.orderNumber} was saved, but WhatsApp could not open. Tap again to retry without a new order.`);
+      }
+    } catch (caught) {
+      tab?.close();
+      handleConfirmationError(caught, checkoutRequest, displayedTotal, version);
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function submit(displayedTotal: string) {
+    if (disabledReason || !cart.length || busyRef.current) return;
+    if (details.fulfillmentType === "delivery"
+      && (!details.deliveryArea.trim() || !details.deliveryNear.trim())) {
+      setError(ar ? "أدخل منطقة التوصيل والعلامة القريبة." : "Enter the delivery area and nearby landmark.");
+      return;
+    }
+    // Reserve a tab during the click; it stays blank until both server calls succeed.
+    const tab = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
+    if (tab) tab.opener = null;
+    busyRef.current = true;
+    setBusy(true);
+    setError(null);
+    setFailureCode(null);
+    setFailureField(null);
+    setPendingPrice(null);
+    const version = editVersion.current;
+    const checkoutRequest = request();
+    const requestJson = JSON.stringify(checkoutRequest);
+    try {
+      if (attemptRef.current?.requestJson === requestJson) {
+        await confirmAndOpen(checkoutRequest, attemptRef.current.acceptanceToken,
+          attemptRef.current.idempotencyKey, displayedTotal, version, tab);
+        return;
+      }
+      const prepared = await preparePublicWhatsappCheckout(restaurantSlug, checkoutRequest);
+      if (editVersion.current !== version) { tab?.close(); return; }
+      const comparison = compareTrustedDraft(prepared.draft, checkoutRequest, displayedTotal, restaurantSlug, locale, displayedFee);
+      if (comparison === "PRICE_CHANGED") {
+        tab?.close();
+        setPendingPrice({ request: checkoutRequest, ...prepared });
+        return;
+      }
+      if (comparison !== "CURRENT") {
+        tab?.close();
+        setError(comparison === "SOURCE_CHANGED"
+          ? ar ? "تغيرت تفاصيل أحد الأصناف. راجع اختيارات السلة وأعد المحاولة." : "Product details changed. Review your cart choices and try again."
+          : ar ? "تعذر مطابقة الفاتورة مع الطلب. راجع السلة." : "The invoice does not match your order. Review the cart.");
+        return;
+      }
+      // The user's send click accepts only the total already visible in the original invoice.
+      const idempotencyKey = window.crypto.randomUUID();
+      attemptRef.current = { requestJson, idempotencyKey, acceptanceToken: prepared.acceptanceToken };
+      await confirmAndOpen(checkoutRequest, prepared.acceptanceToken, idempotencyKey, displayedTotal, version, tab);
+    } catch (caught) {
+      tab?.close();
+      if (editVersion.current === version) recordError(caught);
+    } finally {
+      busyRef.current = false;
+      setBusy(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function acceptUpdatedPrice() {
+    if (!pendingPrice || busyRef.current) return;
+    const tab = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
+    if (tab) tab.opener = null;
+    const version = editVersion.current;
+    const { request: checkoutRequest, acceptanceToken, draft } = pendingPrice;
+    busyRef.current = true;
+    setBusy(true);
+    setError(null);
+    setFailureCode(null);
+    setFailureField(null);
+    setPendingPrice(null);
+    try {
+      // Confirm independently revalidates the draft and the HMAC-bound approval.
+      const idempotencyKey = attemptRef.current?.requestJson === JSON.stringify(checkoutRequest)
+        ? attemptRef.current.idempotencyKey : window.crypto.randomUUID();
+      attemptRef.current = { requestJson: JSON.stringify(checkoutRequest), idempotencyKey, acceptanceToken };
+      const result = await confirmPublicWhatsappCheckout(restaurantSlug, checkoutRequest, acceptanceToken, idempotencyKey);
+      if (!result.whatsappUrl.startsWith("https://wa.me/")) throw new Error("Invalid WhatsApp destination");
+      if (editVersion.current !== version) { tab?.close(); return; }
+      if (JSON.stringify(result.draft) !== JSON.stringify(draft)) {
+        tab?.close();
+        setError(ar ? "تغير الطلب مرة أخرى. راجع السلة وأعد المحاولة." : "The order changed again. Review the cart and retry.");
+        return;
+      }
+      try {
+        if (tab) tab.location.href = result.whatsappUrl;
+        else window.location.href = result.whatsappUrl;
+      } catch {
+        setError(ar ? `حُفظ الطلب رقم ${result.orderNumber}، لكن تعذّر فتح WhatsApp. اضغط الزر مجددًا لإعادة فتحه دون إنشاء طلب جديد.`
+          : `Order ${result.orderNumber} was saved, but WhatsApp could not open. Tap again to retry without a new order.`);
+      }
+    } catch (caught) {
+      tab?.close();
+      handleConfirmationError(caught, checkoutRequest, draft.itemsSubtotal, version, draft);
+    } finally {
+      busyRef.current = false;
+      setBusy(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  return { busy, error, failureCode, failureField, reviewIssue, pendingPrice, previewMessage, previewPriceChanged, preview,
+    clearFailure,
+    closePreview: () => setPreviewMessage(null), submit, acceptUpdatedPrice, dismissUpdatedPrice: () => setPendingPrice(null) };
+}
+
+export function cartDisplayedTotal(cart: readonly CartItem[]): string {
+  return sumMoney(cart.map((line) => multiplyMoney(
+    line.mode === "NETWORK" ? line.acceptedQuote.total : line.priceText ?? String(line.price), line.quantity
+  )));
+}

+export class PublicWhatsappCheckoutError extends Error {
+  constructor(message: string, readonly status: number, readonly code: string,
+    readonly changedDraft?: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft, readonly acceptanceToken?: string,
+    readonly changedMessagePreview?: string, readonly lineErrors: PublicWhatsappLineError[] = [],
+    readonly priceChanges: PublicWhatsappPriceChange[] = []) {
+    super(message);
+  }
+}
+
+async function whatsappCheckoutPost<T>(slug: string, action: "prepare" | "confirm", body: unknown): Promise<T> {
+  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/public/menus/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}/checkout/whatsapp/${action}`, {
+    method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body), cache: "no-store"
+  });
+  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null) as {
+    data?: T; error?: string; message?: string; changedDraft?: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft;
+    acceptanceToken?: string; changedMessagePreview?: string; lineId?: string;
+    issues?: PublicWhatsappLineError["issues"]; lineErrors?: PublicWhatsappLineError[];
+    priceChanges?: PublicWhatsappPriceChange[]
+  } | null;
+  const lineErrors = Array.isArray(payload?.lineErrors) ? payload.lineErrors
+    : typeof payload?.lineId === "string" && typeof payload?.error === "string"
+      ? [{ lineId: payload.lineId, code: payload.error, issues: Array.isArray(payload.issues) ? payload.issues : [] }] : [];
+  if (!response.ok) throw new PublicWhatsappCheckoutError(payload?.message ?? "Checkout could not be verified.",
+    response.status, payload?.error ?? "WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_FAILED", payload?.changedDraft,
+    payload?.acceptanceToken, payload?.changedMessagePreview, lineErrors,
+    Array.isArray(payload?.priceChanges) ? payload.priceChanges : []);
+  if (!payload?.data) throw new PublicWhatsappCheckoutError("Trusted checkout response is unavailable.", 502, "WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_RESPONSE_INVALID");
+  return payload.data;
+}
+
+export function preparePublicWhatsappCheckout(slug: string, request: PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest) {
+  return whatsappCheckoutPost<{ draft: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft; messagePreview: string; acceptanceToken: string }>(slug, "prepare", request);
+}
+
+export function confirmPublicWhatsappCheckout(slug: string, request: PublicWhatsappCheckoutRequest,
+  acceptanceToken: string, idempotencyKey: string) {
+  return whatsappCheckoutPost<{ orderId: string; orderNumber: string; draft: PublicWhatsappCheckoutDraft;
+    message: string; whatsappUrl: string; replayed: boolean }>(slug, "confirm", { request, acceptanceToken, idempotencyKey });
+}

diff --git a/apps/web/src/lib/currency-display.ts b/apps/web/src/lib/currency-display.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a44d1fa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/lib/currency-display.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+import { currencyDisplayReconciliation, formatCurrencyAmount } from "@menu/shared";
+
+/** UI-only rendering. Invalid historical values are never rounded into valid prices. */
+export function displayCurrencyAmount(value: string | number | null | undefined, currency: string): string {
+  if (value === null || value === undefined) return "—";
+  try {
+    return formatCurrencyAmount(String(value), currency);
+  } catch {
+    return "سعر غير صالح للعملة";
+  }
+}
+
+export function displayRoundingDifference(lineTotals: readonly string[], total: string, currency: string): string | null {
+  try {
+    return currencyDisplayReconciliation(lineTotals, total, currency);
+  } catch {
+    return null; // Invalid historical money is shown as invalid by displayCurrencyAmount.
+  }
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fcb1b0d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/src/lib/network-order-test-guard.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+import { headers } from "next/headers";
+
+/** Server-side gate for the isolated Stage 6D.2B page; the API independently verifies the actual DB. */
+export async function networkOrderTestPageEnabled(): Promise<boolean> {
+  const host = (await headers()).get("host") ?? "";
+  const api = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:5000";
+  return isNetworkOrderTestHostAllowed(process.env.NODE_ENV, process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS, host, api);
+}
+
+export function isNetworkOrderTestHostAllowed(nodeEnv: string | undefined, flag: string | undefined, host: string, api: string): boolean {
+  if (nodeEnv === "production" || flag !== "1") return false;
+  try {
+    const browserHost = new URL(`http://${host}`).hostname;
+    const apiUrl = new URL(api);
+    return ["localhost", "127.0.0.1"].includes(browserHost)
+      && ["localhost", "127.0.0.1"].includes(apiUrl.hostname)
+      && apiUrl.protocol === "http:" && apiUrl.port === "5000";
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
