+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
+$stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
+$archive = Join-Path $dir "demo-before-update-$stamp.dump"
+$pgDump = Join-Path $p.PgBin 'pg_dump.exe'
+$pgRestore = Join-Path $p.PgBin 'pg_restore.exe'
+& $pgDump -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55448 -U ordersawa_preview -d ordersawa_unified_interactive_preview -Fc -f $archive
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Demo pg_dump failed; update must not proceed.' }
+$list = @(& $pgRestore -l $archive)
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $list.Count -lt 20) { throw 'Demo backup archive failed validation; update must not proceed.' }
+$uploads = Join-Path $p.State 'uploads'
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uploads)) { $uploads = Join-Path $p.Repo 'apps\api\uploads' }
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uploads -PathType Container)) { throw 'Demo upload source missing; update must not proceed.' }
+$media = Join-Path $dir "uploads-before-update-$stamp"
+Copy-Item -LiteralPath $uploads -Destination $media -Recurse
+$originals = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $uploads -File -Recurse)
+$copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $media -File -Recurse)
+if ($originals.Count -ne $copies.Count) { throw 'Upload backup count mismatch; update must not proceed.' }
+foreach ($original in $originals) {
+  $relative = $original.FullName.Substring($uploads.Length).TrimStart('\')
+  $copy = Join-Path $media $relative
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $copy) -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $original.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $copy -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw "Upload backup hash mismatch: $relative" }
+}
+[pscustomobject]@{ Archive = $archive; Bytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $archive).Length; SHA256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; UploadsCopy = $media }
diff --git a/ops/demo/build-demo-release.ps1 b/ops/demo/build-demo-release.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c087aba
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/build-demo-release.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+param([switch]$SkipIntegration)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+$p = Get-DemoPaths
+$git = 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe'
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $git)) { $git = 'git.exe' }
+$commit = (& $git -C $p.Repo -c "safe.directory=$($p.Repo.Replace('\','/'))" rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $commit -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') { throw 'Unable to identify source commit.' }
+$files = @(& $git -C $p.Repo -c "safe.directory=$($p.Repo.Replace('\','/'))" ls-files | Sort-Object)
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $files.Count -lt 20) { throw 'Unable to enumerate tracked source files.' }
+$hashRows = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string]
+foreach ($relative in $files) {
+  $source = Join-Path $p.Repo $relative
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Tracked source missing: $relative" }
+  $hashRows.Add("$relative $((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)")
+}
+$sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
+try { $bytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(($hashRows -join "`n")); $sourceHash = ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($bytes))).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant() }
+finally { $sha.Dispose() }
+$id = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ') + '-' + $sourceHash.Substring(0,12)
+$release = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'releases') $id
+if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $release) { throw 'Release directory already exists; retry in a later second.' }
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $release -Force | Out-Null
+foreach ($relative in $files) {
+  $dest = Join-Path $release $relative
+  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $dest -Parent) -Force | Out-Null
+  Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p.Repo $relative) -Destination $dest
+}
+$dirty = @(& $git -C $p.Repo -c "safe.directory=$($p.Repo.Replace('\','/'))" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no).Count -gt 0
+$env:NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL = '/api'
+$env:ORDERSAWA_RELEASE_ID = $id
+$env:ORDERSAWA_PREVIEW_INTERNAL_API_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:5001'
+$env:npm_config_cache = Join-Path $p.State 'npm-cache'
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $env:npm_config_cache -Force | Out-Null
+Set-Location $release
+& npm.cmd ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "npm ci failed; release $id not activated." }
+$env:NODE_ENV = 'production'
+& npm.cmd run prisma:generate
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Prisma generation failed; release $id not activated." }
+& npm.cmd run build
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Build failed; release $id not activated." }
+& npm.cmd run typecheck
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Typecheck failed; release $id not activated." }
+& npm.cmd run test:shared
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Shared tests failed; release $id not activated." }
+& npm.cmd run test -w '@menu/web'
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Web tests failed; release $id not activated." }
+if (-not $SkipIntegration) {
+  $bin = $p.PgBin
+  foreach ($exe in @('createdb.exe','dropdb.exe','pg_dump.exe','pg_restore.exe')) {
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $bin $exe))) { throw "Missing PostgreSQL test tool $exe" }
+  }
+  $testRoot = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'test-runs') $id
+  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testRoot -Force | Out-Null
+  $testDb = 'ordersawa_demo_release_checkout_' + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddHHmmss') + '_' + $sourceHash.Substring(0,6)
+  $created = $false
+  try {
+    & (Join-Path $bin 'createdb.exe') -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55448 -U ordersawa_preview $testDb
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Disposable database creation failed.' }
+    $created = $true
+    $schemaDump = Join-Path $testRoot 'demo-schema.dump'
+    & (Join-Path $bin 'pg_dump.exe') -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55448 -U ordersawa_preview -d ordersawa_unified_interactive_preview --schema-only -Fc -f $schemaDump
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Demo schema-only export failed.' }
+    & (Join-Path $bin 'pg_restore.exe') -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55448 -U ordersawa_preview -d $testDb --no-owner --no-privileges $schemaDump
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Disposable schema restore failed.' }
+    $env:WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_TEST_DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://ordersawa_preview@127.0.0.1:55448/${testDb}?schema=public"
+    & npm.cmd run test -w '@menu/api' -- --run src/modules/public-menu/public-whatsapp-checkout.integration.spec.ts
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'PostgreSQL checkout integration tests failed.' }
+  } finally {
+    Remove-Item Env:WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_TEST_DATABASE_URL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    if ($created -and $testDb -match '^ordersawa_demo_release_checkout_[0-9]{14}_[0-9a-f]{6}$') {
+      & (Join-Path $bin 'dropdb.exe') -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55448 -U ordersawa_preview $testDb
+      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Disposable test database $testDb could not be removed; review it manually." }
+    }
+  }
+}
+$manifest = [ordered]@{
+  schemaVersion = 1; releaseId = $id; sourceHash = $sourceHash; gitCommit = $commit; dirtyTrackedSource = $dirty
+  builtAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); nodeVersion = (& node --version).Trim()
+  api = @{ sourceHash = $sourceHash; entry = 'apps/api/dist/main.js'; port = 5001 }
+  web = @{ sourceHash = $sourceHash; entry = 'apps/web/.next'; port = 3102 }
+  tests = @{ build = 'passed'; typecheck = 'passed'; shared = 'passed'; web = 'passed'; checkoutPostgres = $(if ($SkipIntegration) { 'skipped' } else { 'passed' }) }
+}
+$manifestPath = Join-Path $release 'release.json'
+[IO.File]::WriteAllText($manifestPath, ($manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8), [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+Write-Output ([pscustomobject]@{ ReleaseId = $id; SourceHash = $sourceHash; Path = $release; Manifest = $manifestPath; Integration = $manifest.tests.checkoutPostgres })
diff --git a/ops/demo/demo-common.ps1 b/ops/demo/demo-common.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5919bcb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/demo-common.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+function Get-DemoPaths {
+  $repo = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'))
+  $outer = Split-Path $repo -Parent
+  $work = Join-Path $outer 'work'
+  [pscustomobject]@{
+    Repo = $repo
+    Work = $work
+    State = Join-Path $work 'ordersawa-demo-state'
+    Tools = Join-Path $work 'demo-ops-tools'
+    PgBin = Join-Path $work 'stage6f3-pg18\pgsql\bin'
+    PgData = Join-Path $work 'ordersawa-unified-preview-pg18-data'
+    LegacyApi = Join-Path $work 'start-rydtest-api.ps1'
+  }
+}
+
+function Get-DemoNames {
+  @('OrderSawaDemoPostgres', 'OrderSawaDemoApi', 'OrderSawaDemoWeb', 'OrderSawaDemoProxy', 'OrderSawaDemoTunnel')
+}
+
+function Get-DemoService([string]$name) {
+  if ($name -notin (Get-DemoNames)) { throw "Unexpected service name: $name" }
+  Get-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+}
+
+function Assert-DemoLoopbackDatabase([string]$url) {
+  $uri = [uri]$url
+  if ($uri.Scheme -notin @('postgresql','postgres') -or $uri.Host -notin @('127.0.0.1','localhost') -or
+      $uri.Port -ne 55448 -or $uri.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/') -ne 'ordersawa_unified_interactive_preview') {
+    throw 'Refusing a database URL other than the verified loopback Demo database.'
+  }
+}
+
+function Read-DemoActive {
+  $p = Get-DemoPaths
+  $path = Join-Path $p.State 'active.json'
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'No active Demo release manifest. Installation has not been activated.' }
+  $active = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+  if ($active.schemaVersion -ne 1 -or $active.releaseId -notmatch '^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{12}$' -or
+      $active.sourceHash -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw 'Invalid active Demo manifest.' }
+  $releasePath = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'releases') $active.releaseId
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releasePath 'release.json') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Active release files are missing.' }
+  $release = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releasePath 'release.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+  if ($release.releaseId -ne $active.releaseId -or $release.sourceHash -ne $active.sourceHash -or
+      $release.web.sourceHash -ne $active.sourceHash -or $release.api.sourceHash -ne $active.sourceHash) {
+    throw 'Frontend/backend release manifest mismatch.'
+  }
+  [pscustomobject]@{ Active = $active; Release = $release; Path = $releasePath }
+}
+
+function Write-DemoActiveAtomic([string]$state, [string]$json) {
+  $pointer = $json | ConvertFrom-Json
+  if ($pointer.schemaVersion -ne 1 -or $pointer.releaseId -notmatch '^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{12}$' -or
+      $pointer.sourceHash -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw 'Invalid active Demo pointer; no change made.' }
+  $activePath = Join-Path $state 'active.json'
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $activePath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Active pointer is missing; no change made.' }
+  $temporary = Join-Path $state ('active-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.tmp')
+  $backup = Join-Path $state ('active-backup-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.tmp')
+  try {
+    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary,$json,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+    [IO.File]::Replace($temporary,$activePath,$backup)
+    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $backup
+  } finally {
+    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporary) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary }
+  }
+}
+
+function Test-DemoEndpoint([string]$uri, [string]$releaseId, [int]$timeout = 5) {
+  try {
+    $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Headers @{ Host = 'rydtest.ordersawa.com' } -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec $timeout
+    $servedId = @($response.Headers['X-OrderSawa-Release'])[0]
+    return ($response.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $servedId -eq $releaseId)
+  } catch { return $false }
+}
+
+function Wait-DemoEndpoint([string]$uri, [string]$releaseId, [int]$seconds = 90) {
+  $until = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($seconds)
+  while ((Get-Date) -lt $until) {
+    if (Test-DemoEndpoint $uri $releaseId 3) { return }
+    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
+  }
+  throw "Demo endpoint did not become ready: $uri"
+}
+
+function Assert-DemoServiceSet {
+  $missing = @(Get-DemoNames | Where-Object { -not (Get-DemoService $_) })
+  if ($missing.Count) { throw "Demo services are not installed: $($missing -join ', ')" }
+}
+
+function Assert-DemoPortOwnership([int[]]$ports) {
+  $listening = @(Get-DemoListeners | Where-Object { $_.Port -in $ports })
+  if ($listening.Count) {
+    $labels = $listening | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Port)/PID$($_.PID)" }
+    throw "Demo ports already occupied: $($labels -join ', '). Do not terminate these PIDs automatically."
+  }
+}
+
+function Get-DemoListeners {
+  $lines = @(netstat.exe -ano -p tcp)
+  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to inspect local TCP listeners safely.' }
+  foreach ($line in $lines) {
+    if ($line -match '^\s*TCP\s+\S+:(\d+)\s+\S+\s+LISTENING\s+(\d+)\s*$') {
+      [pscustomobject]@{ Port = [int]$Matches[1]; PID = [int]$Matches[2] }
+    }
+  }
+}
diff --git a/ops/demo/install-demo-services.ps1 b/ops/demo/install-demo-services.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..21f7f1f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/install-demo-services.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,196 @@
+param([string]$ReleaseId, [string]$TokenFile, [switch]$PreflightOnly, [switch]$ConfirmMaintenance)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+$p = Get-DemoPaths
+$wrapperSource = Join-Path $p.Tools 'WinSW-x64-v2.12.0.exe'
+$expectedWrapperHash = '05B82D46AD331CC16BDC00DE5C6332C1EF818DF8CEEFCD49C726553209B3A0DA'
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $wrapperSource -PathType Leaf) -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $wrapperSource -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $expectedWrapperHash) {
+  throw 'Pinned WinSW v2.12.0 binary is missing or SHA-256 does not match. No installation attempted.'
+}
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p.PgBin 'pg_ctl.exe')) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p.PgData) -or
+    -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe') -or
+    -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\Program Files (x86)\cloudflared\cloudflared.exe')) { throw 'A required Demo-only runtime is missing.' }
+if (-not $ReleaseId) {
+  $candidate = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p.State 'releases') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
+    Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName 'release.json') } | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
+  if (-not $candidate) { throw 'No built Demo candidate exists. Run update-demo.ps1 -BuildOnly first.' }
+  $ReleaseId = $candidate.Name
+}
+if ($ReleaseId -notmatch '^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{12}$') { throw 'Invalid release ID.' }
+$releasePath = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'releases') $ReleaseId
+$release = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releasePath 'release.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+if ($release.releaseId -ne $ReleaseId -or $release.sourceHash -ne $release.api.sourceHash -or
+    $release.sourceHash -ne $release.web.sourceHash -or $release.tests.checkoutPostgres -ne 'passed') { throw 'Candidate is not fully tested or frontend/backend mismatch.' }
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releasePath 'apps\api\dist\main.js')) -or
+    -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releasePath 'apps\web\.next\BUILD_ID'))) { throw 'Candidate build artifacts missing.' }
+$installedNames = @(Get-DemoNames | Where-Object { Get-DemoService $_ })
+if ($installedNames.Count -eq 5 -and -not $PreflightOnly) {
+  $alreadyActive = Read-DemoActive
+  if ($alreadyActive.Active.releaseId -ne $ReleaseId) { throw 'Demo services are already installed with a different active release. Use update-demo.ps1.' }
+  Write-Output "All five Demo services are already registered for $ReleaseId. No installation changes made. Use status-demo.ps1 to verify readiness."
+  return
+}
+if ($installedNames.Count -gt 0 -and $installedNames.Count -lt 5 -and -not $PreflightOnly) {
+  throw "Partial Demo service registration found: $($installedNames -join ', '). Review logs and use the authorized uninstall/recovery procedure before retrying."
+}
+$legacyLine = Get-Content -LiteralPath $p.LegacyApi | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\$env:DATABASE_URL\s*=' } | Select-Object -First 1
+if ($legacyLine -notmatch "'([^']+)'" ) { throw 'Unable to read existing Demo database URL from the local legacy launcher.' }
+$databaseUrl = $Matches[1]
+Assert-DemoLoopbackDatabase $databaseUrl
+if (-not $TokenFile) {
+  $possible = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $env:LOCALAPPDATA -Filter 'ordersawa-rydtest-recovery-*' -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
+    ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'cloudflared.token' } | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue })
+  if ($possible.Count -eq 1) { $TokenFile = $possible[0] }
+}
+$tokenVisible = [bool]($TokenFile -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $TokenFile -PathType Leaf))
+$listeners = @(Get-DemoListeners)
+$occupied = @($listeners | Where-Object { $_.Port -in @(5001,3102,3210) } |
+  ForEach-Object { "$($_.Port)/PID$($_.PID)" })
+$postgresListeners = @($listeners | Where-Object { $_.Port -eq 55448 })
+$pidFile = Join-Path $p.PgData 'postmaster.pid'
+$postgresOwned = $postgresListeners.Count -eq 0
+if ($postgresListeners.Count -eq 1 -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pidFile -PathType Leaf)) {
+  $pidLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $pidFile -TotalCount 4)
+  $expectedData = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($p.PgData).TrimEnd('\').Replace('\','/')
+  $pidData = $pidLines[1].TrimEnd('\').Replace('\','/')
+  $postgresOwned = $pidLines.Count -eq 4 -and $pidLines[0] -eq [string]$postgresListeners[0].PID -and
+    $pidLines[3] -eq '55448' -and $pidData -eq $expectedData
+}
+$oldTunnel = @(Get-Process -Name cloudflared -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
+$manager = Join-Path $p.State 'manager'; $serviceDir = Join-Path $p.State 'services'
+$secretDir = Join-Path $p.State 'secrets'; $logDir = Join-Path $p.State 'logs'; $uploads = Join-Path $p.State 'uploads'
+function New-DemoServiceXml([string]$name, [string]$role) {
+  $args = '-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "' + (Join-Path $manager 'launch-demo.ps1') + '" -Role ' + $role
+  $dependencies = switch ($role) {
+    'api' { @('OrderSawaDemoPostgres') }
+    # The launcher waits for its loopback upstreams. SCM dependencies here would
+    # prevent a Web/API-only update while the proxy and tunnel stay running.
+    'web' { @() }
+    'proxy' { @() }
+    'tunnel' { @('OrderSawaDemoProxy') }
+  }
+  $dependencyXml = ($dependencies | ForEach-Object { '  <depend>' + $_ + '</depend>' }) -join "`n"
+  $safeArgs = [Security.SecurityElement]::Escape($args)
+  $safeManager = [Security.SecurityElement]::Escape($manager)
+  $safeState = [Security.SecurityElement]::Escape($p.State)
+  $safeLogs = [Security.SecurityElement]::Escape($logDir)
+  $xml = @"
+<service>
+  <id>$name</id><name>$name</name><description>OrderSawa Demo $role only</description>
+  <executable>C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe</executable>
+  <arguments>$safeArgs</arguments>
+  <workingdirectory>$safeManager</workingdirectory>
+  <env name="ORDERSAWA_DEMO_STATE_ROOT" value="$safeState" />
+  <startmode>Automatic</startmode><delayedAutoStart>true</delayedAutoStart>
+$dependencyXml
+  <serviceaccount><username>NT AUTHORITY\LocalService</username></serviceaccount>
+  <logpath>$safeLogs</logpath>
+  <log mode="roll-by-size"><sizeThreshold>10240</sizeThreshold><keepFiles>5</keepFiles></log>
+  <onfailure action="restart" delay="15 sec" />
+</service>
+"@
+  [xml]$xml | Out-Null
+  return $xml
+}
+if ($PreflightOnly) {
+  $previewDir = Join-Path $p.State 'install-preview'
+  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $previewDir -Force | Out-Null
+  foreach ($item in @(@('Api','api'),@('Web','web'),@('Proxy','proxy'),@('Tunnel','tunnel'))) {
+    $name = "OrderSawaDemo$($item[0])"
+    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $previewDir "$name.xml"),(New-DemoServiceXml $name $item[1]),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+  }
+  [pscustomobject]@{ Candidate=$ReleaseId; Database='127.0.0.1:55448/ordersawa_unified_interactive_preview'; TokenVisible=$tokenVisible;
+    OccupiedPreviewPorts=($occupied -join ', '); PostgresListener=($postgresListeners | ForEach-Object { "55448/PID$($_.PID)" }) -join ', '; PostgresOwned=$postgresOwned;
+    ManualTunnelProcesses=$oldTunnel.Count; ConfigPreview=$previewDir; ConfigValidated=$true; Administrator=([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator);
+    SecurityReady=$false; SecurityBlockers='Release/state ACLs remain writable by the Codex sandbox; API and tunnel share LocalService secret access; no owner-approved protected release activator exists.';
+    SafeToInstall=$false }
+  return
+}
+if (-not $ConfirmMaintenance) { throw 'Installation requires -ConfirmMaintenance after owner approval and an agreed maintenance window.' }
+throw 'Security gate: installation is disabled until release/state ACL isolation, per-service secret access, and an owner-approved protected activation path are implemented and tested. Do not bypass this guard or delegate service control to CodexSandboxUsers.'
+if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) { throw 'Run this reviewed installer once from an elevated PowerShell window. No permanent Codex elevation required.' }
+if (-not $tokenVisible) { throw 'Owner token file not visible. Do not paste it into chat.' }
+if ($occupied.Count -or $oldTunnel.Count) { throw 'Old preview processes still active. Close only their known owner terminals before installation; this installer never kills arbitrary PIDs.' }
+if (-not $postgresOwned) { throw 'Port 55448 is not proved to belong to the expected Demo PostgreSQL data directory. No process will be stopped.' }
+$backup = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p.Work 'ordersawa-demo-backups') -Filter '*.dump' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 } | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
+if (-not $backup) { throw 'Verified Demo backup missing.' }
+$backupList = @(& (Join-Path $p.PgBin 'pg_restore.exe') -l $backup.FullName)
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $backupList.Count -lt 20) { throw 'Most recent Demo backup archive cannot be listed; installation refused.' }
+& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'backup-demo.ps1') | Out-Host
+foreach ($dir in @($manager,$serviceDir,$secretDir,$logDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uploads)) {
+  $sourceUploads = Join-Path $p.Repo 'apps\api\uploads'
+  Copy-Item -LiteralPath $sourceUploads -Destination $uploads -Recurse
+  $sourceFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $sourceUploads -File -Recurse)
+  $copiedFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $uploads -File -Recurse)
+  if ($sourceFiles.Count -ne $copiedFiles.Count) { throw 'Upload copy count mismatch; no services registered.' }
+  foreach ($sourceFile in $sourceFiles) {
+    $relative = $sourceFile.FullName.Substring($sourceUploads.Length).TrimStart('\')
+    $copy = Join-Path $uploads $relative
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $copy) -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $sourceFile.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $copy -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw "Upload copy hash mismatch: $relative" }
+  }
+}
+$owner = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name
+$backupDir = Join-Path $p.Work 'ordersawa-demo-backups'
+& icacls.exe $backupDir /inheritance:r /grant:r "${owner}:(OI)(CI)F" '*S-1-5-18:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F' | Out-Null
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Failed to protect Demo backup directory ACL.' }
+& icacls.exe $p.State /grant '*S-1-5-19:(OI)(CI)RX' | Out-Null
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Failed to grant LocalService read access to Demo releases.' }
+& icacls.exe $p.PgBin /grant '*S-1-5-19:(OI)(CI)RX' | Out-Null
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Failed to grant LocalService read access to PostgreSQL binaries.' }
+& icacls.exe $logDir /grant '*S-1-5-19:(OI)(CI)M' | Out-Null
+& icacls.exe $uploads /grant '*S-1-5-19:(OI)(CI)M' | Out-Null
+& icacls.exe $p.PgData /grant '*S-1-5-19:(OI)(CI)M' /T | Out-Null
+& icacls.exe $secretDir /inheritance:r /grant:r "${owner}:(OI)(CI)F" '*S-1-5-18:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-19:(OI)(CI)RX' | Out-Null
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Failed to protect Demo secret directory ACL.' }
+$secretsPath = Join-Path $secretDir 'demo-secrets.json'
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $secretsPath)) {
+  $rng = [Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create()
+  try {
+    $jwt = New-Object byte[] 32; $hmac = New-Object byte[] 64
+    $rng.GetBytes($jwt); $rng.GetBytes($hmac)
+    $secrets = @{ databaseUrl=$databaseUrl; jwtSecret=([BitConverter]::ToString($jwt)).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant(); checkoutHmacKey=([BitConverter]::ToString($hmac)).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant() }
+    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($secretsPath,($secrets | ConvertTo-Json -Compress),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+  } finally { $rng.Dispose() }
+}
+$existing = Get-Content -LiteralPath $secretsPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+Assert-DemoLoopbackDatabase $existing.databaseUrl
+if ($existing.jwtSecret.Length -lt 32 -or $existing.checkoutHmacKey -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64,}$') { throw 'Existing stable Demo secrets invalid.' }
+$protectedToken = Join-Path $secretDir 'cloudflared.token'
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $protectedToken)) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $TokenFile -Destination $protectedToken }
+if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $protectedToken).Length -lt 20 -or
+    (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $protectedToken -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $TokenFile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) {
+  throw 'Protected tunnel token file is empty/incomplete or differs from the owner source; no services registered.'
+}
+foreach ($file in @($secretsPath,$protectedToken)) { & icacls.exe $file /inheritance:r /grant:r "${owner}:F" '*S-1-5-18:F' '*S-1-5-32-544:F' '*S-1-5-19:R' | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Secret file ACL failed.' } }
+Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'launch-demo.ps1') -Destination (Join-Path $manager 'launch-demo.ps1') -Force
+Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'proxy.cjs') -Destination (Join-Path $manager 'proxy.cjs') -Force
+$activePath = Join-Path $p.State 'active.json'
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $activePath)) {
+  $pointer = @{schemaVersion=1;releaseId=$ReleaseId;sourceHash=$release.sourceHash;activatedAtUtc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')}
+  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($activePath,($pointer | ConvertTo-Json),[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+}
+if ($postgresListeners.Count -eq 1) {
+  & (Join-Path $p.PgBin 'pg_ctl.exe') stop -D $p.PgData -m fast -w -t 60
+  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or @(Get-DemoListeners | Where-Object { $_.Port -eq 55448 }).Count -ne 0) {
+    throw 'Expected Demo PostgreSQL did not stop cleanly; no services registered.'
+  }
+}
+$pgService = 'OrderSawaDemoPostgres'
+if (-not (Get-DemoService $pgService)) {
+  & (Join-Path $p.PgBin 'pg_ctl.exe') register -N $pgService -D $p.PgData -S auto -U 'NT AUTHORITY\LocalService' -o '-h 127.0.0.1 -p 55448'
+  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'PostgreSQL service registration failed. Inspect service account support before retry.' }
+  & sc.exe failure $pgService 'reset= 86400' 'actions= restart/60000/restart/60000/restart/60000' | Out-Null
+  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'PostgreSQL service recovery policy could not be registered.' }
+}
+foreach ($item in @(@('Api','api'),@('Web','web'),@('Proxy','proxy'),@('Tunnel','tunnel'))) {
+  $name = "OrderSawaDemo$($item[0])"; $role=$item[1]
+  $binary = Join-Path $serviceDir "$name.exe"; $xmlFile = Join-Path $serviceDir "$name.xml"
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $binary)) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $wrapperSource -Destination $binary }
+  if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $binary -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $expectedWrapperHash) { throw "Wrapper checksum mismatch for $name" }
+  $xml = New-DemoServiceXml $name $role
+  [xml]$xml | Out-Null
+  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($xmlFile,$xml,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+  if (-not (Get-DemoService $name)) { & $binary install; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Service registration failed for $name" } }
+}
+& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'start-demo.ps1')
+Write-Output "Demo services installed and started on release $ReleaseId. Check external Access from an authorized device."
diff --git a/ops/demo/launch-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/launch-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..09659bc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/launch-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+param([ValidateSet('api','web','proxy','tunnel')][string]$Role)
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+$state = $env:ORDERSAWA_DEMO_STATE_ROOT
+if (-not $state -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $state -PathType Container)) { throw 'Demo state directory is unavailable.' }
+$activePath = Join-Path $state 'active.json'
+$active = Get-Content -LiteralPath $activePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+if ($active.releaseId -notmatch '^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{12}$') { throw 'Invalid active release ID.' }
+$release = Join-Path (Join-Path $state 'releases') $active.releaseId
+$manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $release 'release.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+if ($manifest.releaseId -ne $active.releaseId -or $manifest.sourceHash -ne $active.sourceHash) { throw 'Manifest mismatch.' }
+$env:ORDERSAWA_RELEASE_ID = $active.releaseId
+$node = 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe'
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $node -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Node.js runtime missing.' }
+function Wait-Port([int]$port) {
+  $until = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(120)
+  while ((Get-Date) -lt $until) {
+    try { $tcp = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1',$port); $tcp.Close(); return } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }
+  }
+  throw "Dependency on loopback port $port is not ready."
+}
+switch ($Role) {
+  'api' {
+    Wait-Port 55448
+    $secrets = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $state 'secrets\demo-secrets.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+    $u = [uri]$secrets.databaseUrl
+    if ($u.Host -notin @('127.0.0.1','localhost') -or $u.Port -ne 55448 -or $u.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/') -ne 'ordersawa_unified_interactive_preview') { throw 'Non-Demo database rejected.' }
+    $env:DATABASE_URL = $secrets.databaseUrl
+    $env:JWT_SECRET = $secrets.jwtSecret
+    $env:PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT_HMAC_KEY = $secrets.checkoutHmacKey
+    $env:ENABLE_PUBLIC_NETWORK_WHATSAPP_CHECKOUT = '1'
+    $env:ORDERSAWA_DEMO_UPLOADS_DIR = Join-Path $state 'uploads'
+    $env:NODE_ENV = 'production'; $env:PORT = '5001'; $env:API_HOST = '127.0.0.1'
+    $env:WEB_ORIGIN = 'https://rydtest.ordersawa.com'; $env:API_ORIGIN = 'http://127.0.0.1:5001'
+    $env:CORS_ORIGINS = 'https://rydtest.ordersawa.com'
+    Set-Location (Join-Path $release 'apps\api')
+    & $node 'dist\main.js'
+  }
+  'web' {
+    Wait-Port 5001
+    $env:NODE_ENV = 'production'; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL = '/api'
+    $env:ORDERSAWA_PREVIEW_INTERNAL_API_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:5001'
+    Set-Location (Join-Path $release 'apps\web')
+    & $node (Join-Path $release 'node_modules\next\dist\bin\next') start -p 3102 -H 127.0.0.1
+  }
+  'proxy' {
+    Wait-Port 5001; Wait-Port 3102
+    & $node (Join-Path $state 'manager\proxy.cjs')
+  }
+  'tunnel' {
+    Wait-Port 3210
+    $cloudflared = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\cloudflared\cloudflared.exe'
+    $tokenFile = Join-Path $state 'secrets\cloudflared.token'
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cloudflared -PathType Leaf) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tokenFile -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Tunnel executable or protected token file unavailable.' }
+    & $cloudflared tunnel --loglevel warn run --token-file $tokenFile
+  }
+}
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
+throw "$Role exited unexpectedly; service recovery will retry."
diff --git a/ops/demo/package-demo-candidate.ps1 b/ops/demo/package-demo-candidate.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1311e78
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/package-demo-candidate.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ReleaseId)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'secure\secure-common.ps1')
+Assert-ReleaseId $ReleaseId
+$p = Get-DemoPaths
+$candidate = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'releases') $ReleaseId
+Assert-ChildPath (Join-Path $p.State 'releases') $candidate
+if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Container)) { throw 'Built candidate does not exist.' }
+$manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $candidate 'release.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+if ($manifest.releaseId -cne $ReleaseId -or $manifest.tests.checkoutPostgres -ne 'passed') { throw 'Candidate has not passed PostgreSQL integration.' }
+$packages = Join-Path $p.State 'packages'
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $packages -Force | Out-Null
+$archive = Join-Path $packages "$ReleaseId.zip"
+if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $archive) { throw 'Package already exists. Build a new release instead of overwriting an approval candidate.' }
+$temp = Join-Path $packages ('.package-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.zip')
+Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression
+Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
+try {
+  $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($temp,[IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
+  try {
+    foreach ($file in (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $candidate -File -Recurse -Force | Sort-Object FullName)) {
+      if (($file.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { throw 'Candidate contains reparse point.' }
+      $name = $file.FullName.Substring($candidate.Length).TrimStart('\').Replace('\','/')
+      [IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($zip,$file.FullName,$name,[IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
+    }
+  } finally { $zip.Dispose() }
+  $info = Read-PackageManifest $temp
+  if ($info.releaseId -ne $ReleaseId) { throw 'Packaged release ID differs from candidate.' }
+  [IO.File]::Move($temp,$archive)
+  [pscustomobject]@{ ReleaseId=$ReleaseId; Package=$archive; Sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; Bytes=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $archive).Length; Approval='Owner must review candidate and approve this exact SHA-256 outside Codex; not auto-activated.' }
+} finally { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp } }
diff --git a/ops/demo/proxy.cjs b/ops/demo/proxy.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4694eca
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/proxy.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+"use strict";
+// Loopback-only, Access-protected Demo gateway. Never logs requests or secrets.
+const http = require("node:http");
+const fs = require("node:fs");
+const path = require("node:path");
+const state = process.env.ORDERSAWA_DEMO_STATE_ROOT;
+if (!state) throw Error("Demo state directory missing");
+const host = "127.0.0.1";
+const testMode = process.env.ORDERSAWA_DEMO_TEST_MODE === "1";
+const port = testMode ? Number(process.env.ORDERSAWA_DEMO_PROXY_PORT) : 3210;
+const apiPort = testMode ? Number(process.env.ORDERSAWA_DEMO_API_PORT) : 5001;
+const webPort = testMode ? Number(process.env.ORDERSAWA_DEMO_WEB_PORT) : 3102;
+if (![port, apiPort, webPort].every((value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value > 1024 && value < 65536)) throw Error("Invalid Demo loopback port");
+const demoSlug = /^\/m\/preview-ordersawa(?:\/|$)/;
+const appPage = /^\/(?:login|dashboard|admin)(?:\/|$)/;
+const nextAsset = /^\/_next\/(?:static\/|image(?:\?|$))/;
+const demoApi = /^\/public\/menus\/preview-ordersawa(?:\/|$)/;
+const privateApi = /^\/(?:auth|dashboard|admin)(?:\/|$)/;
+
+function deny(res, status = 404, message = "Preview route unavailable") {
+  res.writeHead(status, { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "Cache-Control": "no-store" });
+  res.end(message);
+}
+function active() {
+  const value = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(state, "active.json"), "utf8"));
+  if (!/^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(value.releaseId)) throw Error("Bad release ID");
+  return value.releaseId;
+}
+
+http.createServer((req, res) => {
+  if (!req.url || !req.headers.host || !(req.headers.host === `127.0.0.1:${port}` || req.headers.host === "rydtest.ordersawa.com")) return deny(res, 403);
+  let url;
+  try { url = new URL(req.url, `http://${host}:${port}`); } catch { return deny(res); }
+  const pathname = url.pathname;
+  if (/%2f|%5c|\\|\.\./i.test(pathname) || pathname.endsWith(".map")) return deny(res);
+  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(state, "maintenance.flag"))) return deny(res, 503, "Demo update in progress");
+  let releaseId;
+  try { releaseId = active(); } catch { return deny(res, 503, "Demo release unavailable"); }
+  if (pathname === "/__demo/version" && req.method === "GET") {
+    const check = async (target) => {
+      const response = await fetch(target, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
+      return response.ok && response.headers.get("x-ordersawa-release") === releaseId;
+    };
+    Promise.all([check(`http://127.0.0.1:${apiPort}/health`), check(`http://127.0.0.1:${webPort}/login`)])
+      .then(([api, web]) => {
+        if (!api || !web) return deny(res, 503, "Demo release mismatch");
+        res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-OrderSawa-Release": releaseId });
+        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, releaseId, api, web }));
+      }).catch(() => deny(res, 503, "Demo upstream unavailable"));
+    return;
+  }
+  if (pathname === "/" && req.method === "GET") {
+    res.writeHead(302, { Location: "/login", "Cache-Control": "no-store" });
+    return res.end();
+  }
+  const isApi = pathname.startsWith("/api/");
+  const apiPath = isApi ? pathname.slice(4) : "";
+  if (isApi && !(demoApi.test(apiPath) || privateApi.test(apiPath) || apiPath.startsWith("/uploads/"))) return deny(res);
+  if (!isApi && !(demoSlug.test(pathname) || appPage.test(pathname) || nextAsset.test(pathname) || pathname === "/favicon.ico")) return deny(res);
+  if (!isApi && !["GET", "HEAD"].includes(req.method)) return deny(res);
+  if (isApi && !["GET", "HEAD", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"].includes(req.method)) return deny(res);
+  const upstreamPort = isApi ? apiPort : webPort;
+  const headers = { ...req.headers, host: `127.0.0.1:${upstreamPort}` };
+  for (const key of ["origin", "cookie", "proxy-authorization", "cf-access-jwt-assertion", "x-forwarded-host", "x-forwarded-proto"]) delete headers[key];
+  const upstream = http.request({ hostname: host, port: upstreamPort, path: isApi ? req.url.slice(4) : req.url, method: req.method, headers, timeout: 30000 }, (upstreamRes) => {
+    if (upstreamRes.headers["x-ordersawa-release"] !== releaseId) {
+      upstreamRes.resume();
+      return deny(res, 503, "Demo release mismatch");
+    }
+    res.writeHead(upstreamRes.statusCode || 502, { ...upstreamRes.headers, "Cache-Control": "no-store", "X-Preview-Only": "1", "X-OrderSawa-Release": releaseId });
+    upstreamRes.pipe(res);
+  });
+  upstream.on("timeout", () => upstream.destroy(new Error("Demo upstream timeout")));
+  upstream.on("error", () => { if (!res.headersSent) deny(res, 502, "Demo temporarily unavailable"); else res.end(); });
+  req.pipe(upstream);
+}).listen(port, host, () => process.stdout.write(`Demo gateway ready on ${host}:${port}\n`));
diff --git a/ops/demo/proxy.test.cjs b/ops/demo/proxy.test.cjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..91889dd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/proxy.test.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+"use strict";
+const { test } = require("node:test");
+const assert = require("node:assert/strict");
+const http = require("node:http");
+const fs = require("node:fs");
+const os = require("node:os");
+const path = require("node:path");
+const { spawn } = require("node:child_process");
+
+const oldId = "20261101T230000Z-aaaaaaaaaaaa";
+const newId = "20261101T230100Z-bbbbbbbbbbbb";
+function serve(getRelease) {
+  const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
+    res.writeHead(200, { "x-ordersawa-release": getRelease(), "content-type": "text/plain" });
+    res.end(req.url);
+  });
+  return new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(server)));
+}
+function freePort() {
+  return new Promise((resolve) => {
+    const server = http.createServer();
+    server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => {
+      const port = server.address().port;
+      server.close(() => resolve(port));
+    });
+  });
+}
+async function get(port, target) {
+  const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${target}`);
+  return { status: response.status, body: await response.text() };
+}
+test("gateway fails closed on release mismatch and restores prior release", async () => {
+  const state = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "ordersawa-proxy-test-"));
+  let apiId = oldId;
+  let webId = oldId;
+  const api = await serve(() => apiId);
+  const web = await serve(() => webId);
+  const port = await freePort();
+  const active = (releaseId) => fs.writeFileSync(path.join(state, "active.json"), JSON.stringify({ releaseId }));
+  active(oldId);
+  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [path.join(__dirname, "proxy.cjs")], {
+    env: { ...process.env, ORDERSAWA_DEMO_STATE_ROOT: state, ORDERSAWA_DEMO_TEST_MODE: "1",
+      ORDERSAWA_DEMO_PROXY_PORT: String(port), ORDERSAWA_DEMO_API_PORT: String(api.address().port), ORDERSAWA_DEMO_WEB_PORT: String(web.address().port) },
+    stdio: "ignore", windowsHide: true
+  });
+  try {
+    let ready = false;
+    for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
+      try { if ((await get(port, "/__demo/version")).status === 200) { ready = true; break; } } catch {}
+      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
+    }
+    assert.equal(ready, true, "proxy should become ready");
+    assert.equal((await get(port, "/api/public/menus/preview-ordersawa")).status, 200);
+    active(newId);
+    assert.equal((await get(port, "/__demo/version")).status, 503, "old upstream must not be advertised as new release");
+    assert.equal((await get(port, "/api/public/menus/preview-ordersawa")).status, 503, "old API response must not pass through");
+    apiId = newId; webId = newId;
+    assert.equal((await get(port, "/__demo/version")).status, 200);
+    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(state, "maintenance.flag"), "updating");
+    assert.equal((await get(port, "/__demo/version")).status, 503);
+    fs.unlinkSync(path.join(state, "maintenance.flag"));
+    active(oldId); apiId = oldId; webId = oldId;
+    assert.equal((await get(port, "/__demo/version")).status, 200, "rollback pointer and processes should restore readiness");
+  } finally {
+    child.kill();
+    await Promise.all([new Promise((resolve) => api.close(resolve)), new Promise((resolve) => web.close(resolve))]);
+    for (const file of ["active.json", "maintenance.flag"]) {
+      const target = path.join(state, file);
+      if (fs.existsSync(target)) fs.unlinkSync(target);
+    }
+    if (path.dirname(state) === os.tmpdir()) fs.rmdirSync(state);
+  }
+});
diff --git a/ops/demo/restart-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/restart-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..db02115
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/restart-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+Assert-DemoServiceSet
+& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'stop-demo.ps1')
+& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'start-demo.ps1')
diff --git a/ops/demo/rollback-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/rollback-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a352e10
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/rollback-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ReleaseId, [switch]$ConfirmRollback)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+throw 'Automated rollback is disabled until protected published releases and a reviewed activator exist. Do not switch a service to a Codex-writable release.'
+if (-not $ConfirmRollback) { throw 'Explicit -ConfirmRollback is required; only the application release is switched.' }
+Assert-DemoServiceSet
+$p = Get-DemoPaths
+$current = Read-DemoActive
+if ($ReleaseId -notmatch '^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{12}$') { throw 'Invalid built Demo release ID.' }
+if ($ReleaseId -eq $current.Active.releaseId) { Write-Output "Release $ReleaseId is already active; no services restarted."; return }
+$targetPath = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'releases') $ReleaseId
+$targetManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $targetPath 'release.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+if ($targetManifest.schemaVersion -ne 1 -or $targetManifest.releaseId -ne $ReleaseId -or
+    $targetManifest.sourceHash -ne $targetManifest.api.sourceHash -or $targetManifest.sourceHash -ne $targetManifest.web.sourceHash -or
+    $targetManifest.tests.checkoutPostgres -ne 'passed' -or $targetManifest.tests.build -ne 'passed') { throw 'Target release manifest is invalid or untested.' }
+foreach ($artifact in @('apps\api\dist\main.js','apps\web\.next\BUILD_ID')) {
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $targetPath $artifact) -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Missing target artifact: $artifact" }
+}
+if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $current.Path 'apps\api\prisma\schema.prisma') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne
+    (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $targetPath 'apps\api\prisma\schema.prisma') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) {
+  throw 'Database schema differs; automatic application-only rollback refused.'
+}
+$lockPath = Join-Path $p.State 'update.lock'
+$lock = [IO.File]::Open($lockPath,[IO.FileMode]::OpenOrCreate,[IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite,[IO.FileShare]::None)
+try {
+  & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'backup-demo.ps1') | Out-Host
+  $flag = Join-Path $p.State 'maintenance.flag'
+  $oldJson = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p.State 'active.json') -Raw
+  $newPointer = [ordered]@{schemaVersion=1;releaseId=$ReleaseId;sourceHash=$targetManifest.sourceHash;activatedAtUtc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')}
+  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($flag,'application rollback in progress')
+  try {
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoWeb','OrderSawaDemoApi')) {
+      if ((Get-DemoService $name).Status -ne 'Stopped') { Stop-Service -Name $name; (Get-Service $name).WaitForStatus('Stopped',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90)) }
+    }
+    Assert-DemoPortOwnership @(5001,3102)
+    Write-DemoActiveAtomic $p.State ($newPointer | ConvertTo-Json)
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoApi','OrderSawaDemoWeb')) {
+      Start-Service -Name $name
+      (Get-Service $name).WaitForStatus('Running',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90))
+      if ($name -eq 'OrderSawaDemoApi') { Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:5001/health' $ReleaseId 120 }
+      else { Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:3102/login' $ReleaseId 120 }
+    }
+    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $flag
+    Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:3210/__demo/version' $ReleaseId 30
+    Write-Output "Application rolled back from $($current.Active.releaseId) to $ReleaseId. PostgreSQL and tunnel were not restarted."
+  } catch {
+    $failure = $_.Exception.Message
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoWeb','OrderSawaDemoApi')) {
+      try { if ((Get-DemoService $name).Status -ne 'Stopped') { Stop-Service -Name $name; (Get-Service $name).WaitForStatus('Stopped',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90)) } } catch {}
+    }
+    Write-DemoActiveAtomic $p.State $oldJson
+    try {
+      Start-Service -Name 'OrderSawaDemoApi'; (Get-Service 'OrderSawaDemoApi').WaitForStatus('Running',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90))
+      Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:5001/health' $current.Active.releaseId 120
+      Start-Service -Name 'OrderSawaDemoWeb'; (Get-Service 'OrderSawaDemoWeb').WaitForStatus('Running',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90))
+      Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:3102/login' $current.Active.releaseId 120
+      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $flag -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+      throw "Requested rollback failed ($failure); original application release restored. No database rollback performed."
+    } catch {
+      if ($_.Exception.Message -like 'Requested rollback failed*') { throw }
+      throw "Requested rollback failed ($failure); recovery health failed ($($_.Exception.Message)). Gateway remains in maintenance mode."
+    }
+  }
+} finally { $lock.Dispose() }
diff --git a/ops/demo/secure/backup-protected-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/secure/backup-protected-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8621414
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/secure/backup-protected-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Root)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'secure-common.ps1')
+if ($Root -cne $script:ProtectedDemoRoot) { throw 'Only protected OrderSawa Demo root may be backed up.' }
+$config = Get-ProtectedConfig
+Assert-Owner $config
+$backupDir = Join-Path $Root 'backups'
+$stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
+$archive = Join-Path $backupDir "demo-$stamp.dump"
+$dump = Join-Path $Root 'pg-bin\pg_dump.exe'
+$restore = Join-Path $Root 'pg-bin\pg_restore.exe'
+& $dump -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55448 -U ordersawa_preview -d ordersawa_unified_interactive_preview -Fc -f $archive
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Protected Demo pg_dump failed.' }
+$list = @(& $restore -l $archive)
+if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $list.Count -lt 20) { throw 'Protected backup archive cannot be listed.' }
+$uploads = Join-Path $Root 'uploads'
+$copy = Join-Path $backupDir "uploads-$stamp"
+Copy-Item -LiteralPath $uploads -Destination $copy -Recurse
+$sources = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $uploads -File -Recurse)
+$copied = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $copy -File -Recurse)
+if ($sources.Count -ne $copied.Count) { throw 'Protected upload backup count mismatch.' }
+foreach ($item in $sources) {
+  $relative = $item.FullName.Substring($uploads.Length).TrimStart('\')
+  $target = Join-Path $copy $relative
+  if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $item.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw 'Protected upload backup hash mismatch.' }
+}
+[pscustomobject]@{ Archive=$archive; Bytes=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $archive).Length; UploadCount=$sources.Count }
diff --git a/ops/demo/secure/publish-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/secure/publish-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d0f50c8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/secure/publish-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+param(
+  [string]$CandidateArchive,
+  [string]$ApprovedSha256,
+  [string]$RollbackReleaseId,
+  [switch]$VerifyOnly,
+  [switch]$ConfirmActivate,
+  [switch]$ConfirmRollback
+)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'secure-common.ps1')
+if ($CandidateArchive -and $RollbackReleaseId) { throw 'Choose publication or rollback, not both.' }
+if ($VerifyOnly) {
+  if (-not $CandidateArchive) { throw '-VerifyOnly needs a candidate archive.' }
+  Assert-Sha256 $ApprovedSha256
+  if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $CandidateArchive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -cne $ApprovedSha256.ToUpperInvariant()) { throw 'Candidate package differs from approved SHA-256.' }
+  $manifest = Read-PackageManifest $CandidateArchive
+  [pscustomobject]@{ ReleaseId=$manifest.releaseId; SourceHash=$manifest.sourceHash; PackageSha256=$ApprovedSha256.ToUpperInvariant(); Verified=$true; Activated=$false }
+  return
+}
+$config = Get-ProtectedConfig
+Assert-Owner $config
+$root = $config.root
+if (-not $CandidateArchive -and -not $RollbackReleaseId) { throw 'Specify a candidate or a published rollback release.' }
+if ($CandidateArchive -and -not $ConfirmActivate) { throw 'Explicit -ConfirmActivate and owner-approved SHA-256 are required.' }
+if ($RollbackReleaseId -and -not $ConfirmRollback) { throw 'Explicit -ConfirmRollback is required.' }
+$lockPath = Join-Path $root 'update.lock'
+$lock = [IO.File]::Open($lockPath,[IO.FileMode]::OpenOrCreate,[IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite,[IO.FileShare]::None)
+try {
+  $targetId = $null
+  $targetSha = $null
+  if ($CandidateArchive) {
+    Assert-Sha256 $ApprovedSha256
+    Assert-ChildPath $config.candidatePackages $CandidateArchive
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $CandidateArchive -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Candidate package missing.' }
+    if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $CandidateArchive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -cne $ApprovedSha256.ToUpperInvariant()) { throw 'Candidate changed after owner approval.' }
+    $manifest = Read-PackageManifest $CandidateArchive
+    $targetId = $manifest.releaseId
+    $targetSha = $ApprovedSha256.ToUpperInvariant()
+    $final = Join-Path (Join-Path $root 'releases') $targetId
+    Assert-ChildPath (Join-Path $root 'releases') $final
+    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $final) { throw 'Release already published; use rollback only for an existing protected release.' }
+    $storedArchive = Join-Path (Join-Path $root 'archives') "$targetId.zip"
+    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $storedArchive) { throw 'Protected package ID already exists.' }
+    $pendingArchive = Join-Path (Join-Path $root 'archives') ('.pending-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.zip')
+    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $CandidateArchive -Destination $pendingArchive
+    if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $pendingArchive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -cne $targetSha) { throw 'Package changed while being copied; protected copy retained for inspection.' }
+    $pendingRelease = Join-Path (Join-Path $root 'releases') ('.pending-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
+    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $pendingRelease | Out-Null
+    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
+    [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::ExtractToDirectory($pendingArchive,$pendingRelease)
+    $extracted = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $pendingRelease 'release.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+    if ($extracted.releaseId -cne $targetId -or $extracted.sourceHash -cne $manifest.sourceHash) { throw 'Extracted release manifest differs from approved archive.' }
+    $treeSha = Get-TreeDigest $pendingRelease
+    [IO.Directory]::Move($pendingRelease,$final)
+    [IO.File]::Move($pendingArchive,$storedArchive)
+    $index = Get-PublishedIndex $root
+    $rows = @($index.releases) + @([pscustomobject]@{ releaseId=$targetId; archiveSha256=$targetSha; treeSha256=$treeSha; sourceHash=$manifest.sourceHash; approvedAtUtc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') })
+    Write-JsonAtomic (Join-Path $root 'release-index.json') ([ordered]@{schemaVersion=1;releases=$rows})
+  } else {
+    Assert-ReleaseId $RollbackReleaseId
+    $targetId = $RollbackReleaseId
+  }
+  $published = Assert-PublishedRelease $root $targetId
+  $activePath = Join-Path $root 'active.json'
+  $oldJson = Get-Content -LiteralPath $activePath -Raw
+  $old = $oldJson | ConvertFrom-Json
+  if ($old.releaseId -eq $targetId) { Write-Output "Already active: $targetId"; return }
+  $oldPublished = Assert-PublishedRelease $root $old.releaseId
+  $oldSchema = Join-Path $oldPublished.Path 'apps\api\prisma\schema.prisma'
+  $newSchema = Join-Path $published.Path 'apps\api\prisma\schema.prisma'
+  if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $oldSchema -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $newSchema -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw 'Prisma schema differs; separate migration approval required.' }
+  & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'backup-protected-demo.ps1') -Root $root
+  if ($LASTEXITCODE -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Protected backup failed.' }
+  $flag = Join-Path $root 'maintenance.flag'
+  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($flag,'app release change',[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+  try {
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoWeb','OrderSawaDemoApi')) {
+      Assert-DemoAppServiceName $name
+      $service = Get-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop
+      if ($service.Status -ne 'Stopped') { Stop-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop; $service.WaitForStatus('Stopped',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90)) }
+    }
+    $listeners = @(netstat.exe -ano -p tcp | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*TCP\s+\S+:(5001|3102)\s+\S+\s+LISTENING\s+' })
+    if ($listeners.Count) { throw 'Old API/Web listener remains after service stop; no pointer switch.' }
+    $newPointer = [ordered]@{ schemaVersion=1; releaseId=$targetId; sourceHash=$published.Entry.sourceHash; activatedAtUtc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }
+    Write-JsonAtomic $activePath $newPointer
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoApi','OrderSawaDemoWeb')) {
+      Assert-DemoAppServiceName $name
+      Start-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop
+      (Get-Service -Name $name).WaitForStatus('Running',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90))
+      $uri = if ($name -eq 'OrderSawaDemoApi') { 'http://127.0.0.1:5001/health' } else { 'http://127.0.0.1:3102/login' }
+      $until = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(120)
+      $ready = $false
+      while ((Get-Date) -lt $until) {
+        try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Headers @{Host='rydtest.ordersawa.com'} -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; if ($r.StatusCode -eq 200 -and @($r.Headers['X-OrderSawa-Release'])[0] -eq $targetId) { $ready=$true; break } } catch {}
+        Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
+      }
+      if (-not $ready) { throw "Service readiness failed: $name" }
+    }
+    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $flag
+    Write-Output "Published and active: $targetId. PostgreSQL and tunnel were not restarted."
+  } catch {
+    $failure = $_.Exception.Message
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoWeb','OrderSawaDemoApi')) {
+      try { Assert-DemoAppServiceName $name; Stop-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}
+    }
+    Write-JsonAtomic $activePath ($oldJson | ConvertFrom-Json)
+    try {
+      foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoApi','OrderSawaDemoWeb')) { Assert-DemoAppServiceName $name; Start-Service -Name $name -ErrorAction Stop }
+      throw "Activation failed ($failure); old pointer restored. Verify health before clearing maintenance."
+    } catch { throw "Activation failed ($failure); old pointer restored, manual service/health check required. Maintenance flag remains." }
+  }
+} finally { $lock.Dispose() }
diff --git a/ops/demo/secure/secure-common.ps1 b/ops/demo/secure/secure-common.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c00263d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/secure/secure-common.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
+$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+
+$script:DemoServiceNames = @('OrderSawaDemoPostgres','OrderSawaDemoApi','OrderSawaDemoWeb','OrderSawaDemoProxy','OrderSawaDemoTunnel')
+$script:ProtectedDemoRoot = 'C:\Program Files\OrderSawaDemo'
+
+function Assert-ReleaseId([string]$value) {
+  if ($value -notmatch '^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{12}$') { throw 'Invalid Demo release ID.' }
+}
+
+function Assert-Sha256([string]$value) {
+  if ($value -cnotmatch '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{64}$') { throw 'An explicit 64-character SHA-256 approval is required.' }
+}
+
+function Assert-DemoServiceName([string]$name) {
+  if ($name -cnotin $script:DemoServiceNames) { throw "Service outside OrderSawa Demo allowlist: $name" }
+}
+
+function Assert-DemoAppServiceName([string]$name) {
+  if ($name -cnotin @('OrderSawaDemoApi','OrderSawaDemoWeb')) { throw "Only OrderSawa Demo API/Web can be updated: $name" }
+}
+
+function Assert-ChildPath([string]$parent, [string]$child) {
+  $p = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($parent).TrimEnd('\') + '\'
+  $c = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($child)
+  if (-not $c.StartsWith($p,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Path escapes its approved Demo directory.' }
+}
+
+function Get-TreeDigest([string]$directory) {
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $directory -PathType Container)) { throw 'Release directory missing.' }
+  $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $directory -File -Recurse -Force | Sort-Object { $_.FullName.Substring($directory.Length).Replace('\','/') })
+  if ($files.Count -lt 2) { throw 'Release directory is incomplete.' }
+  $rows = foreach ($file in $files) {
+    if (($file.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { throw 'Release cannot contain reparse points.' }
+    $relative = $file.FullName.Substring($directory.TrimEnd('\').Length).TrimStart('\').Replace('\','/')
+    "$relative $((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant())"
+  }
+  $sha = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
+  try {
+    $data = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(($rows -join "`n"))
+    return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($data))).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant()
+  } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
+}
+
+function Read-PackageManifest([string]$archive) {
+  Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression
+  Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
+  $zip = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($archive)
+  try {
+    $seen = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
+    $manifestEntry = $null
+    foreach ($entry in $zip.Entries) {
+      $name = $entry.FullName.Replace('\','/')
+      if (-not $name -or $name.StartsWith('/') -or $name -match '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)|:|[\x00-\x1f]' -or -not $seen.Add($name)) { throw 'Unsafe or duplicate package path.' }
+      if ($name -eq 'release.json') { $manifestEntry = $entry }
+    }
+    if (-not $manifestEntry) { throw 'Package release.json missing.' }
+    $reader = [IO.StreamReader]::new($manifestEntry.Open(),[Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
+    try { $manifest = $reader.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
+    Assert-ReleaseId $manifest.releaseId
+    Assert-Sha256 $manifest.sourceHash
+    if ($manifest.schemaVersion -ne 1 -or $manifest.api.sourceHash -ne $manifest.sourceHash -or
+        $manifest.web.sourceHash -ne $manifest.sourceHash -or $manifest.tests.build -ne 'passed' -or
+        $manifest.tests.typecheck -ne 'passed' -or $manifest.tests.shared -ne 'passed' -or
+        $manifest.tests.web -ne 'passed' -or $manifest.tests.checkoutPostgres -ne 'passed') {
+      throw 'Package is not a fully tested matching Web/API candidate.'
+    }
+    foreach ($required in @('apps/api/dist/main.js','apps/web/.next/BUILD_ID','apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma')) {
+      if (-not $seen.Contains($required)) { throw "Package artifact missing: $required" }
+    }
+    return $manifest
+  } finally { $zip.Dispose() }
+}
+
+function Get-ProtectedConfig {
+  $path = Join-Path $script:ProtectedDemoRoot 'manager\settings.json'
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Protected Demo manager is not installed.' }
+  $config = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+  if ($config.schemaVersion -ne 1 -or $config.root -ne $script:ProtectedDemoRoot -or
+      $config.candidatePackages -notmatch '\\ordersawa-demo-state\\packages$' -or
+      $config.ownerSid -notmatch '^S-1-5-21-[0-9-]+$') { throw 'Protected manager configuration invalid.' }
+  return $config
+}
+
+function Assert-Owner([object]$config) {
+  $current = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value
+  if ($current -ne $config.ownerSid) { throw 'Only the designated owner account can approve a Demo release.' }
+}
+
+function Get-PublishedIndex([string]$root) {
+  $path = Join-Path $root 'release-index.json'
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Protected release index missing.' }
+  return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
+}
+
+function Assert-PublishedRelease([string]$root, [string]$id) {
+  Assert-ReleaseId $id
+  $index = Get-PublishedIndex $root
+  $entry = @($index.releases | Where-Object { $_.releaseId -ceq $id })
+  if ($entry.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Release is not in protected publication index.' }
+  Assert-Sha256 $entry[0].archiveSha256
+  Assert-Sha256 $entry[0].treeSha256
+  $releasePath = Join-Path (Join-Path $root 'releases') $id
+  Assert-ChildPath (Join-Path $root 'releases') $releasePath
+  if ((Get-TreeDigest $releasePath) -ne $entry[0].treeSha256.ToLowerInvariant()) { throw 'Published release changed after approval.' }
+  return [pscustomobject]@{ Path=$releasePath; Entry=$entry[0] }
+}
+
+function Write-JsonAtomic([string]$path, [object]$value) {
+  $parent = Split-Path $path -Parent
+  $temp = Join-Path $parent ('.write-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
+  $json = $value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12
+  try {
+    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($temp,$json,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) { [IO.File]::Replace($temp,$path,$null) }
+    else { [IO.File]::Move($temp,$path) }
+  } finally { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp } }
+}
diff --git a/ops/demo/start-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/start-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..84cdd88
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/start-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+Assert-DemoServiceSet
+$active = Read-DemoActive
+$id = $active.Active.releaseId
+foreach ($name in Get-DemoNames) {
+  $service = Get-DemoService $name
+  if ($service.Status -ne 'Running') { Start-Service -Name $name; (Get-Service -Name $name).WaitForStatus('Running',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90)) }
+  switch ($name) {
+    'OrderSawaDemoApi' { Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:5001/health' $id 120 }
+    'OrderSawaDemoWeb' { Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:3102/login' $id 120 }
+    'OrderSawaDemoProxy' { Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:3210/__demo/version' $id 120 }
+  }
+}
+Write-Output "Demo services running on release $id. Tunnel external Access must still be checked separately."
diff --git a/ops/demo/status-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/status-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..77bfead
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/status-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+$p = Get-DemoPaths
+foreach ($name in Get-DemoNames) {
+  $service = Get-DemoService $name
+  [pscustomobject]@{ Layer = $name; Installed = [bool]$service; Status = $(if ($service) { $service.Status.ToString() } else { 'NotInstalled' }); StartType = $(if ($service) { $service.StartType.ToString() } else { '-' }) }
+}
+try {
+  $active = Read-DemoActive
+  [pscustomobject]@{ ReleaseId = $active.Active.releaseId; GitCommit = $active.Release.gitCommit; SourceHash = $active.Active.sourceHash; BuiltAtUtc = $active.Release.builtAtUtc }
+} catch { Write-Warning $_.Exception.Message }
+try {
+  $version = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3210/__demo/version' -Headers @{ Host='rydtest.ordersawa.com' } -TimeoutSec 5
+  [pscustomobject]@{ GatewayHealthy = $version.ok; ApiMatches = $version.api; WebMatches = $version.web; ServingRelease = $version.releaseId }
+} catch { Write-Warning 'Managed gateway/version is not ready. This may be normal before installation.' }
+$pg = Join-Path $p.PgBin 'pg_isready.exe'
+if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pg) { & $pg -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55448 }
diff --git a/ops/demo/stop-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/stop-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..22694cf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/stop-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+Assert-DemoServiceSet
+$names = @(Get-DemoNames)
+[array]::Reverse($names)
+foreach ($name in $names) {
+  $service = Get-DemoService $name
+  if ($service.Status -ne 'Stopped') { Stop-Service -Name $name; (Get-Service -Name $name).WaitForStatus('Stopped',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90)) }
+}
+Write-Output 'Only the five named OrderSawa Demo services were stopped. Demo data and releases remain intact.'
diff --git a/ops/demo/test-demo-manifest.ps1 b/ops/demo/test-demo-manifest.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0119920
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/test-demo-manifest.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ReleaseId)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+$p = Get-DemoPaths
+if ($ReleaseId -notmatch '^[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z-[0-9a-f]{12}$') { throw 'Invalid candidate release ID.' }
+$releasePath = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'releases') $ReleaseId
+$manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releasePath 'release.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+if ($manifest.schemaVersion -ne 1 -or $manifest.releaseId -ne $ReleaseId -or $manifest.sourceHash -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
+    $manifest.api.sourceHash -ne $manifest.sourceHash -or $manifest.web.sourceHash -ne $manifest.sourceHash -or
+    $manifest.tests.checkoutPostgres -ne 'passed') { throw 'Candidate release manifest does not pass validation.' }
+foreach ($artifact in @('apps\api\dist\main.js','apps\web\.next\BUILD_ID')) {
+  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releasePath $artifact) -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Missing artifact: $artifact" }
+}
+$testDir = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'test-runs') ('manifest-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $testDir | Out-Null
+$first = @{schemaVersion=1;releaseId=$ReleaseId;sourceHash=$manifest.sourceHash} | ConvertTo-Json
+$second = @{schemaVersion=1;releaseId='20261101T230000Z-aaaaaaaaaaaa';sourceHash=('a'*64)} | ConvertTo-Json
+$activePath = Join-Path $testDir 'active.json'
+try {
+  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($activePath,$first,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+  Write-DemoActiveAtomic $testDir $second
+  if ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $activePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).releaseId -ne '20261101T230000Z-aaaaaaaaaaaa') { throw 'Atomic switch failed.' }
+  Write-DemoActiveAtomic $testDir $first
+  if ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $activePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).releaseId -ne $ReleaseId) { throw 'Isolated rollback failed.' }
+  Write-Output "Candidate manifest and isolated pointer switch/rollback passed: $ReleaseId"
+} finally {
+  if (([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($testDir)).StartsWith(([IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $p.State 'test-runs'))) + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
+    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $activePath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $testDir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+  }
+}
diff --git a/ops/demo/uninstall-demo-services.ps1 b/ops/demo/uninstall-demo-services.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..224f8a6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/uninstall-demo-services.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+param([switch]$ConfirmUninstall)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+if (-not $ConfirmUninstall) { throw 'Explicit -ConfirmUninstall is required. Data, releases and secrets will be preserved.' }
+if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)) { throw 'Administrator is required to unregister Windows services.' }
+$p = Get-DemoPaths
+$names = @(Get-DemoNames); [array]::Reverse($names)
+foreach ($name in $names) {
+  $service = Get-DemoService $name
+  if (-not $service) { continue }
+  if ($service.Status -ne 'Stopped') { Stop-Service -Name $name; (Get-Service $name).WaitForStatus('Stopped',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90)) }
+  if ($name -eq 'OrderSawaDemoPostgres') {
+    & (Join-Path $p.PgBin 'pg_ctl.exe') unregister -N $name
+  } else {
+    $wrapper = Join-Path (Join-Path $p.State 'services') "$name.exe"
+    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $wrapper)) { throw "Wrapper for $name missing; refusing to delete an unverified service." }
+    & $wrapper uninstall
+  }
+  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Failed to unregister $name. Other state preserved." }
+}
+Write-Output 'Only named OrderSawa Demo services unregistered. Database files, backups, uploads, releases and token file were not deleted. Existing manual preview is not restarted automatically.'
diff --git a/ops/demo/update-demo.ps1 b/ops/demo/update-demo.ps1
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3820ca1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ops/demo/update-demo.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+param([switch]$BuildOnly, [switch]$SkipIntegration)
+. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'demo-common.ps1')
+if (-not $BuildOnly) {
+  throw 'Activation is disabled until releases, active pointer, and service control are isolated from the Codex sandbox and an owner-approved protected activator is installed. Use -BuildOnly to prepare a candidate without touching live Demo.'
+}
+$p = Get-DemoPaths
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $p.State -Force | Out-Null
+$lockPath = Join-Path $p.State 'update.lock'
+$lock = [IO.File]::Open($lockPath,[IO.FileMode]::OpenOrCreate,[IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite,[IO.FileShare]::None)
+try {
+  if (-not $BuildOnly) { Assert-DemoServiceSet; $previous = Read-DemoActive }
+  $output = @(& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'build-demo-release.ps1') -SkipIntegration:$SkipIntegration)
+  if ($LASTEXITCODE -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Release build failed.' }
+  if ($output.Count -eq 0 -or -not $output[-1].ReleaseId) { throw 'Release builder did not return a validated candidate.' }
+  $candidate = $output[-1]
+  $output | Select-Object -SkipLast 1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
+  $manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath $candidate.Manifest -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+  if ($manifest.releaseId -ne $candidate.ReleaseId -or $manifest.api.sourceHash -ne $manifest.web.sourceHash -or
+      $manifest.tests.build -ne 'passed' -or $manifest.tests.typecheck -ne 'passed' -or
+      $manifest.tests.shared -ne 'passed' -or $manifest.tests.web -ne 'passed') { throw 'Candidate release manifest invalid.' }
+  if ($BuildOnly) {
+    Write-Output "Built and tested candidate $($candidate.ReleaseId); live Demo untouched."
+    Write-Output $candidate
+    return
+  }
+  if ($manifest.sourceHash -eq $previous.Active.sourceHash) {
+    Write-Output "Source hash is already active on Demo ($($previous.Active.releaseId)); no services restarted."
+    return
+  }
+  if ($manifest.tests.checkoutPostgres -ne 'passed') { throw 'Checkout PostgreSQL integration is required for activation.' }
+  $oldSchema = Join-Path $previous.Path 'apps\api\prisma\schema.prisma'
+  $newSchema = Join-Path $candidate.Path 'apps\api\prisma\schema.prisma'
+  if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $oldSchema -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $newSchema -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) {
+    throw 'Prisma schema changed. Automatic Demo update refused; request a separate migration review.'
+  }
+  & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'backup-demo.ps1') | Out-Host
+  $flag = Join-Path $p.State 'maintenance.flag'
+  $activePath = Join-Path $p.State 'active.json'
+  $previousJson = Get-Content -LiteralPath $activePath -Raw
+  $next = [ordered]@{ schemaVersion = 1; releaseId = $candidate.ReleaseId; sourceHash = $candidate.SourceHash; activatedAtUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }
+  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($flag,'update in progress')
+  try {
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoWeb','OrderSawaDemoApi')) {
+      if ((Get-DemoService $name).Status -ne 'Stopped') { Stop-Service -Name $name; (Get-Service $name).WaitForStatus('Stopped',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90)) }
+    }
+    Assert-DemoPortOwnership @(5001,3102)
+    Write-DemoActiveAtomic $p.State ($next | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5)
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoApi','OrderSawaDemoWeb')) {
+      Start-Service -Name $name
+      (Get-Service $name).WaitForStatus('Running',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90))
+      if ($name -eq 'OrderSawaDemoApi') { Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:5001/health' $candidate.ReleaseId 120 }
+      else { Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:3102/login' $candidate.ReleaseId 120 }
+    }
+    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $flag
+    Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:3210/__demo/version' $candidate.ReleaseId 30
+    Write-Output "Demo activated: $($candidate.ReleaseId). PostgreSQL and tunnel were not restarted."
+  } catch {
+    $failure = $_.Exception.Message
+    foreach ($name in @('OrderSawaDemoWeb','OrderSawaDemoApi')) {
+      try { if ((Get-DemoService $name).Status -ne 'Stopped') { Stop-Service -Name $name; (Get-Service $name).WaitForStatus('Stopped',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90)) } } catch {}
+    }
+    Write-DemoActiveAtomic $p.State $previousJson
+    try {
+      Start-Service -Name 'OrderSawaDemoApi'; (Get-Service 'OrderSawaDemoApi').WaitForStatus('Running',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90))
+      Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:5001/health' $previous.Active.releaseId 120
+      Start-Service -Name 'OrderSawaDemoWeb'; (Get-Service 'OrderSawaDemoWeb').WaitForStatus('Running',[TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(90))
+      Wait-DemoEndpoint 'http://127.0.0.1:3102/login' $previous.Active.releaseId 120
+      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $flag -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+      throw "Candidate activation failed ($failure); previous application release restored. No database rollback performed."
+    } catch {
+      if ($_.Exception.Message -like 'Candidate activation failed*') { throw }
+      throw "Candidate activation failed ($failure); rollback health failed ($($_.Exception.Message)). Gateway remains in maintenance mode."
+    }
+  }
+} finally { $lock.Dispose() }
