diff --git a/packages/shared/src/currency-policy.test.ts b/packages/shared/src/currency-policy.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3ee20e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/currency-policy.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import { currencyDisplayReconciliation, formatCurrencyAmount, validateConfigurationCurrency, validateCurrencyAmount } from "./currency-policy";
+import type { ProductConfigurationV1 } from "./product-configuration/types";
+
+describe("approved current-restaurant currency policy", () => {
+  it("accepts numeric whole SYP including zero-filled fractional notation, rejects real fractions", () => {
+    expect(validateCurrencyAmount("12500", "SYP", "$price")).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateCurrencyAmount("12500.000000", "SYP", "$price")).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateCurrencyAmount("12500.000000", "ل.س", "$price")).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateCurrencyAmount("0", "SYP", "$price")).toEqual([]);
+    expect(validateCurrencyAmount("12500.50", "SYP", "$price")[0]).toMatchObject({ code: "SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE", path: "$price" });
+    expect(validateCurrencyAmount("12500.50", "ل.س", "$price")[0]).toMatchObject({ code: "SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE" });
+    expect(() => formatCurrencyAmount("12500.50", "SYP")).toThrow("SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE");
+  });
+
+  it("uses exact decimal HALF_UP for presentation without changing six-decimal input", () => {
+    for (const currency of ["EUR", "USD", "AED"]) {
+      const input = "12.345678";
+      expect(formatCurrencyAmount(input, currency)).toBe(`12.35 ${currency}`);
+      expect(input).toBe("12.345678");
+      expect(formatCurrencyAmount("0.004999", currency)).toBe(`0.00 ${currency}`);
+      expect(formatCurrencyAmount("0.005000", currency)).toBe(`0.01 ${currency}`);
+    }
+    expect(formatCurrencyAmount("12500.000000", "SYP")).toBe("12500 SYP");
+    expect(formatCurrencyAmount("12500.000000", "ل.س")).toBe("12500 ل.س");
+    expect(formatCurrencyAmount("1.123456", "EGP")).toBe("1.123456 EGP");
+  });
+
+  it("makes displayed component/total differences explicit", () => {
+    expect(currencyDisplayReconciliation(["0.005", "0.005"], "0.01", "USD")).toBe("-0.01 USD");
+    expect(currencyDisplayReconciliation(["0.004", "0.004"], "0.008", "EUR")).toBe("+0.01 EUR");
+    expect(currencyDisplayReconciliation(["1", "2"], "3", "SYP")).toBeNull();
+    expect(() => currencyDisplayReconciliation(["1"], "2", "USD")).toThrow("CURRENCY_LINE_TOTAL_MISMATCH");
+  });
+
+  it("visits base, sizes, nested options, size overrides, ORIGINAL overrides and CUSTOM snapshots", () => {
+    const custom: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "source", revision: 1, basePrice: "0.2", groups: [] };
+    const tree: ProductConfigurationV1 = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: "owner", revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+      { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [{ id: "small", label: "Small", price: "100.000001", children: [
+        { type: "OPTIONS", id: "nested", label: "Nested", min: 0, max: 2, includedQuantity: 0, options: [{
+          id: "cheese", label: "Cheese", price: "0.5", maxQuantity: 2,
+          priceOverrides: [{ sizeChoiceId: "small", price: "0.25" }],
+          linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: "source", mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: custom, originalPriceOverrides: { extra: "1.1" } }
+        }] }
+      ] }] }
+    ] };
+    const issues = validateConfigurationCurrency(tree, "SYP");
+    expect(issues.map((issue) => issue.code)).toEqual(Array(5).fill("SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE"));
+    expect(issues.some((issue) => issue.path.includes("customConfiguration.basePrice"))).toBe(true);
+    expect(validateConfigurationCurrency(tree, "USD")).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/packages/shared/src/currency-policy.ts b/packages/shared/src/currency-policy.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..275bbb2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/currency-policy.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+import { compareMoney, normalizeMoney, sumMoney, validateMoneyString } from "./product-configuration/money";
+import { DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS, type ConfigurationGroup, type ConfigurationIssue, type ProductConfigurationV1 } from "./product-configuration/types";
+
+/** Presentation policy only. Pricing and persisted Decimal(24,6) values stay exact. */
+export function currencyDisplayScale(currency: string): 0 | 2 | null {
+  // Older Restaurant rows use the Arabic currency label as their stored value.
+  if (currency === "SYP" || currency === "ل.س") return 0;
+  if (currency === "EUR" || currency === "USD" || currency === "AED") return 2;
+  return null; // Do not invent a policy for other currencies.
+}
+
+export function validateCurrencyAmount(value: unknown, currency: string, path: string): ConfigurationIssue[] {
+  const issues = validateMoneyString(value, path, DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS);
+  if (issues.length || currencyDisplayScale(currency) !== 0) return issues;
+  if (normalizeMoney(value as string).includes(".")) {
+    return [{ code: "SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE", path, message: "SYP prices must be whole amounts; fractional values are not allowed." }];
+  }
+  return [];
+}
+
+/** Traverse every price-bearing V1 node, including nested CUSTOM snapshots. */
+export function validateConfigurationCurrency(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1, currency: string): ConfigurationIssue[] {
+  if (currencyDisplayScale(currency) !== 0) return [];
+  const issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [];
+  const visited = new Set<ProductConfigurationV1>();
+  function visit(config: ProductConfigurationV1, path: string) {
+    if (visited.has(config)) return; // validateConfiguration reports reference cycles separately.
+    visited.add(config);
+    if (config.basePrice !== null) issues.push(...validateCurrencyAmount(config.basePrice, currency, `${path}.basePrice`));
+    function groups(nodes: readonly ConfigurationGroup[], prefix: string) {
+      nodes.forEach((group, groupIndex) => {
+        const groupPath = `${prefix}[${groupIndex}]`;
+        if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+          group.sizes.forEach((size, sizeIndex) => {
+            const sizePath = `${groupPath}.sizes[${sizeIndex}]`;
+            issues.push(...validateCurrencyAmount(size.price, currency, `${sizePath}.price`));
+            groups(size.children ?? [], `${sizePath}.children`);
+          });
+        } else {
+          group.options.forEach((option, optionIndex) => {
+            const optionPath = `${groupPath}.options[${optionIndex}]`;
+            issues.push(...validateCurrencyAmount(option.price, currency, `${optionPath}.price`));
+            option.priceOverrides?.forEach((override, overrideIndex) => {
+              if (override.price !== null) issues.push(...validateCurrencyAmount(override.price, currency, `${optionPath}.priceOverrides[${overrideIndex}].price`));
+            });
+            Object.entries(option.linkedProduct?.originalPriceOverrides ?? {}).forEach(([id, price]) => {
+              issues.push(...validateCurrencyAmount(price, currency, `${optionPath}.linkedProduct.originalPriceOverrides.${id}`));
+            });
+            if (option.linkedProduct?.mode === "CUSTOM" && option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration) {
+              visit(option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration, `${optionPath}.linkedProduct.customConfiguration`);
+            }
+            groups(option.children ?? [], `${optionPath}.children`);
+          });
+        }
+      });
+    }
+    groups(config.groups, `${path}.groups`);
+  }
+  visit(configuration, "$configuration");
+  return issues;
+}
+
+function minorUnits(value: string, scale: 0 | 2): bigint {
+  const issues = validateMoneyString(value, "$amount", DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS);
+  if (issues.length) throw new Error(`INVALID_CURRENCY_AMOUNT: ${issues[0].code}`);
+  if (scale === 0 && normalizeMoney(value).includes(".")) throw new Error("SYP_FRACTIONAL_PRICE");
+  const [whole, fraction = ""] = value.split(".");
+  const coefficient = BigInt(`${whole}${fraction}`);
+  if (fraction.length <= scale) return coefficient * (10n ** BigInt(scale - fraction.length));
+  const divisor = 10n ** BigInt(fraction.length - scale);
+  const quotient = coefficient / divisor;
+  return (coefficient % divisor) * 2n >= divisor ? quotient + 1n : quotient;
+}
+
+function formatMinor(value: bigint, scale: 0 | 2): string {
+  const whole = value / (10n ** BigInt(scale));
+  if (scale === 0) return whole.toString();
+  return `${whole}.${(value % 100n).toString().padStart(2, "0")}`;
+}
+
+/** Non-negative HALF_UP at the approved display scale; never changes the input. */
+export function formatDecimalForDisplay(value: string, scale: 0 | 2): string {
+  return formatMinor(minorUnits(value, scale), scale);
+}
+
+export function formatCurrencyAmount(value: string, currency: string): string {
+  const scale = currencyDisplayScale(currency);
+  if (scale === null) {
+    const issues = validateMoneyString(value, "$amount", DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS);
+    if (issues.length) throw new Error(`INVALID_CURRENCY_AMOUNT: ${issues[0].code}`);
+    return `${normalizeMoney(value)} ${currency}`;
+  }
+  return `${formatDecimalForDisplay(value, scale)} ${currency}`;
+}
+
+/** Difference caused solely by rounding displayed lines independently of their exact total. */
+export function currencyDisplayReconciliation(lineTotals: readonly string[], exactTotal: string, currency: string): string | null {
+  const scale = currencyDisplayScale(currency);
+  if (scale === null) return null;
+  if (compareMoney(sumMoney(lineTotals), exactTotal) !== 0) throw new Error("CURRENCY_LINE_TOTAL_MISMATCH");
+  const difference = minorUnits(exactTotal, scale) - lineTotals.reduce((sum, line) => sum + minorUnits(line, scale), 0n);
+  if (difference === 0n) return null;
+  const sign = difference < 0n ? "-" : "+";
+  return `${sign}${formatMinor(difference < 0n ? -difference : difference, scale)} ${currency}`;
+}

diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/dependencies.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/dependencies.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..489395d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/dependencies.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+import {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  ConfigurationIssue,
+  DependencyEdge,
+  ProductConfigurationRecord,
+  ProductConfigurationV1
+} from "./types";
+
+export function collectDependencyEdges(configuration: ProductConfigurationV1): DependencyEdge[] {
+  const edges: DependencyEdge[] = [];
+
+  function visit(groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[], path: string) {
+    groups.forEach((group, groupIndex) => {
+      const groupPath = `${path}.groups[${groupIndex}]`;
+      if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+        group.sizes.forEach((size, sizeIndex) => visit(size.children ?? [], `${groupPath}.sizes[${sizeIndex}]`));
+        return;
+      }
+
+      group.options.forEach((option, optionIndex) => {
+        const optionPath = `${groupPath}.options[${optionIndex}]`;
+        if (option.linkedProduct) {
+          edges.push({
+            productId: configuration.productId,
+            sourceProductId: option.linkedProduct.sourceProductId,
+            optionId: option.id,
+            path: optionPath,
+            mode: option.linkedProduct.mode
+          });
+          if (option.linkedProduct.mode === "CUSTOM" && option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration) {
+            visit(option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration.groups, `${optionPath}.linkedProduct.customConfiguration`);
+          }
+        }
+        visit(option.children ?? [], optionPath);
+      });
+    });
+  }
+
+  visit(configuration.groups, "$configuration");
+  return edges;
+}
+
+export function validateDependencyGraph(records: readonly ProductConfigurationRecord[]): ConfigurationIssue[] {
+  const issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [];
+  const byProduct = new Map<string, ProductConfigurationRecord>();
+  const adjacency = new Map<string, DependencyEdge[]>();
+
+  for (const record of records) {
+    if (byProduct.has(record.productId)) {
+      issues.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_PRODUCT_RECORD", path: record.productId, message: "Dependency input contains a duplicate product record." });
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (record.configuration.productId !== record.productId) {
+      issues.push({ code: "CONFIGURATION_PRODUCT_MISMATCH", path: record.productId, message: "Configuration product ID does not match its catalog record." });
+    }
+    byProduct.set(record.productId, record);
+    adjacency.set(record.productId, collectDependencyEdges(record.configuration));
+  }
+
+  for (const record of records) {
+    for (const edge of adjacency.get(record.productId) ?? []) {
+      const target = byProduct.get(edge.sourceProductId);
+      if (!target) {
+        issues.push({ code: "LINK_TARGET_NOT_FOUND", path: edge.path, message: `Linked product '${edge.sourceProductId}' is not in the catalog input.` });
+      } else if (target.catalogId !== record.catalogId) {
+        issues.push({ code: "CROSS_CATALOG_LINK", path: edge.path, message: "Linked products must belong to the same catalog/tenant." });
+      }
+      if (edge.sourceProductId === record.productId) {
+        issues.push({ code: "SELF_LINK", path: edge.path, message: "A product cannot link to itself." });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  const state = new Map<string, "VISITING" | "VISITED">();
+  const stack: string[] = [];
+  const reported = new Set<string>();
+
+  function canonicalCycle(cycle: string[]) {
+    const ring = cycle.slice(0, -1);
+    const rotations = ring.map((_, index) => [...ring.slice(index), ...ring.slice(0, index)].join("->"));
+    return rotations.sort()[0];
+  }
+
+  function visit(productId: string) {
+    state.set(productId, "VISITING");
+    stack.push(productId);
+    for (const edge of adjacency.get(productId) ?? []) {
+      if (!byProduct.has(edge.sourceProductId)) continue;
+      if (state.get(edge.sourceProductId) === "VISITING") {
+        const start = stack.indexOf(edge.sourceProductId);
+        const cycle = [...stack.slice(start), edge.sourceProductId];
+        const key = canonicalCycle(cycle);
+        if (!reported.has(key)) {
+          reported.add(key);
+          issues.push({ code: "LINK_CYCLE", path: edge.path, message: `Linked product cycle detected: ${cycle.join(" -> ")}.` });
+        }
+      } else if (!state.has(edge.sourceProductId)) {
+        visit(edge.sourceProductId);
+      }
+    }
+    stack.pop();
+    state.set(productId, "VISITED");
+  }
+
+  for (const productId of byProduct.keys()) {
+    if (!state.has(productId)) visit(productId);
+  }
+  return issues;
+}

diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/minimum-price.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/minimum-price.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8f486d1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/minimum-price.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,251 @@
+import { calculatePrice } from "./pricing";
+import { compareMoney } from "./money";
+import { resolveLinkedConfiguration } from "./resolution";
+import {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  ConfigurationIssue,
+  GroupSelection,
+  MinimumPriceResult,
+  OptionChoice,
+  OptionSelectionInstance,
+  ProductConfigurationContext,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  ProductSelectionV1,
+  PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION
+} from "./types";
+import { resolveEngineLimits, validateConfiguration } from "./validation";
+
+type MaybeGroupSelection = GroupSelection | undefined;
+
+function uniqueIssues(issues: readonly ConfigurationIssue[]): ConfigurationIssue[] {
+  const seen = new Set<string>();
+  return issues.filter((issue) => {
+    const key = `${issue.code}\u0000${issue.path}\u0000${issue.message}`;
+    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
+    seen.add(key);
+    return true;
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * Enumerates only the units required by group/option minima. Optional upsells are
+ * deliberately excluded, so they cannot turn a directly purchasable Base into
+ * a misleading "starting at" price.
+ */
+export function calculateMinimumPrice(
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  context: ProductConfigurationContext
+): MinimumPriceResult {
+  const limits = resolveEngineLimits(context.limits);
+  const issues = validateConfiguration(configuration, limits);
+  let generatedStates = 0;
+  let stateLimitReached = false;
+
+  function countState<T>(value: T): T | undefined {
+    generatedStates += 1;
+    if (generatedStates <= limits.maxMinimumPriceStates) return value;
+    if (!stateLimitReached) {
+      issues.push({
+        code: "MINIMUM_PRICE_STATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
+        path: "$configuration",
+        message: "Minimum-price enumeration exceeded the configured safety limit."
+      });
+      stateLimitReached = true;
+    }
+    return undefined;
+  }
+
+  function combine<T>(sets: readonly (readonly T[])[]): T[][] {
+    let rows: T[][] = [[]];
+    for (const set of sets) {
+      const next: T[][] = [];
+      for (const row of rows) {
+        for (const value of set) {
+          const candidate = countState([...row, value]);
+          if (candidate) next.push(candidate);
+          if (stateLimitReached) return [];
+        }
+      }
+      rows = next;
+    }
+    return rows;
+  }
+
+  function enumerateAllocations(group: Extract<ConfigurationGroup, { type: "OPTIONS" }>): number[][] {
+    const effectiveMax = group.max ?? limits.maxQuantityPerGroup;
+    const minima = group.options.map((option) => option.minQuantity ?? 0);
+    if (group.options.some((option, index) => option.available === false && minima[index] > 0)) return [];
+    const requiredTotal = Math.max(group.min, minima.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0));
+    if (requiredTotal > effectiveMax) return [];
+
+    const results: number[][] = [];
+    function visit(index: number, remaining: number, current: number[]) {
+      if (stateLimitReached) return;
+      if (index === group.options.length) {
+        if (remaining === 0) {
+          const state = countState([...current]);
+          if (state) results.push(state);
+        }
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const option = group.options[index];
+      const minimum = option.available === false ? 0 : minima[index];
+      const maximum = option.available === false ? 0 : Math.min(option.maxQuantity, remaining);
+      for (let quantity = minimum; quantity <= maximum; quantity += 1) {
+        current.push(quantity);
+        visit(index + 1, remaining - quantity, current);
+        current.pop();
+      }
+    }
+    visit(0, requiredTotal, []);
+    return results;
+  }
+
+  function enumerateProduct(
+    config: ProductConfigurationV1,
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[]
+  ): ProductSelectionV1[] {
+    return enumerateGroups(config.groups, path, productStack).map((groups) => ({
+      schemaVersion: PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+      productId: config.productId,
+      configurationRevision: config.revision,
+      groups
+    }));
+  }
+
+  function enumerateOptionUnit(
+    option: OptionChoice,
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[]
+  ): Array<Pick<OptionSelectionInstance, "children" | "linkedSelection">> {
+    const childSelections = enumerateGroups(option.children ?? [], `${path}.children`, productStack);
+    if (!option.linkedProduct) return childSelections.map((children) => ({ children }));
+
+    const resolved = resolveLinkedConfiguration(option.linkedProduct, context, `${path}.linkedProduct`, productStack);
+    issues.push(...resolved.issues);
+    if (!resolved.resolved || resolved.issues.length) return [];
+    const linkedSelections = enumerateProduct(
+      resolved.resolved.configuration,
+      `${path}.linked`,
+      [...productStack, resolved.resolved.sourceProductId]
+    );
+    const variants: Array<Pick<OptionSelectionInstance, "children" | "linkedSelection">> = [];
+    for (const children of childSelections) {
+      for (const linkedSelection of linkedSelections) {
+        const state = countState({ children, linkedSelection });
+        if (state) variants.push(state);
+      }
+    }
+    return variants;
+  }
+
+  function enumerateGroup(
+    group: ConfigurationGroup,
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[]
+  ): MaybeGroupSelection[] {
+    if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+      if (group.available === false) return [];
+      const selections: MaybeGroupSelection[] = [];
+      group.sizes.forEach((size, sizeIndex) => {
+        if (size.available === false) return;
+        const childSelections = enumerateGroups(size.children ?? [], `${path}.sizes[${sizeIndex}]`, productStack);
+        childSelections.forEach((children) => {
+          const state = countState<GroupSelection>({
+            type: "SIZE",
+            groupId: group.id,
+            sizeChoiceId: size.id,
+            children
+          });
+          if (state) selections.push(state);
+        });
+      });
+      return selections;
+    }
+
+    if (group.available === false) {
+      const requiredMinimum = Math.max(
+        group.min,
+        group.options.reduce((total, option) => total + (option.minQuantity ?? 0), 0)
+      );
+      return requiredMinimum === 0 ? [undefined] : [];
+    }
+    const allocations = enumerateAllocations(group);
+    const selections: MaybeGroupSelection[] = [];
+    allocations.forEach((allocation, allocationIndex) => {
+      if (allocation.every((quantity) => quantity === 0)) {
+        selections.push(undefined);
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const unitSets: Array<Array<{ option: OptionChoice; unit: number; variant: Pick<OptionSelectionInstance, "children" | "linkedSelection"> }>> = [];
+      group.options.forEach((option, optionIndex) => {
+        for (let unit = 0; unit < allocation[optionIndex]; unit += 1) {
+          const variants = enumerateOptionUnit(option, `${path}.options[${optionIndex}].units[${unit}]`, productStack);
+          unitSets.push(variants.map((variant) => ({ option, unit, variant })));
+        }
+      });
+
+      combine(unitSets).forEach((units) => {
+        const instances = units.map(({ option, unit, variant }, index): OptionSelectionInstance => ({
+          instanceId: `${path}:a${allocationIndex}:u${index}:${option.id}:${unit}`,
+          optionId: option.id,
+          ...(variant.children?.length ? { children: variant.children } : {}),
+          ...(variant.linkedSelection ? { linkedSelection: variant.linkedSelection } : {})
+        }));
+        const state = countState<GroupSelection>({ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: group.id, instances });
+        if (state) selections.push(state);
+      });
+    });
+    return selections;
+  }
+
+  function enumerateGroups(
+    groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[],
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[]
+  ): GroupSelection[][] {
+    if (!groups.length) return [[]];
+    const alternatives = groups.map((group, index) => enumerateGroup(group, `${path}.groups[${index}]`, productStack));
+    if (alternatives.some((values) => values.length === 0)) return [];
+    return combine(alternatives).map((row) => row.filter((value): value is GroupSelection => value !== undefined));
+  }
+
+  if (issues.length) {
+    return { orderable: false, minimum: null, maximumRequired: null, display: "UNAVAILABLE", baseIgnored: false, issues: uniqueIssues(issues) };
+  }
+
+  const selections = enumerateProduct(configuration, "$minimum", [configuration.productId]);
+  const totals: string[] = [];
+  let baseIgnored = false;
+  for (const selection of selections) {
+    const result = calculatePrice(configuration, selection, context);
+    baseIgnored ||= result.baseIgnored;
+    if (result.valid && result.total !== null) totals.push(result.total);
+    else issues.push(...result.issues);
+  }
+
+  if (!totals.length || stateLimitReached) {
+    if (!issues.length) {
+      issues.push({ code: "UNSATISFIABLE_CONFIGURATION", path: "$configuration", message: "No current valid required configuration exists." });
+    }
+    return { orderable: false, minimum: null, maximumRequired: null, display: "UNAVAILABLE", baseIgnored, issues: uniqueIssues(issues) };
+  }
+
+  let minimum = totals[0];
+  let maximum = totals[0];
+  totals.slice(1).forEach((total) => {
+    if (compareMoney(total, minimum) < 0) minimum = total;
+    if (compareMoney(total, maximum) > 0) maximum = total;
+  });
+  return {
+    orderable: true,
+    minimum,
+    maximumRequired: maximum,
+    display: compareMoney(minimum, maximum) === 0 ? "EXACT" : "STARTING_AT",
+    baseIgnored,
+    issues: []
+  };
+}
diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/money.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/money.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a0f6f0a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/money.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+import { ConfigurationIssue, EngineLimits, MoneyString } from "./types";
+
+type DecimalParts = { coefficient: bigint; scale: number };
+
+const MONEY_PATTERN = /^(0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.(\d+))?$/;
+
+function powerOfTen(value: number) {
+  return 10n ** BigInt(value);
+}
+
+function parseUnchecked(value: MoneyString): DecimalParts {
+  const [integer, fraction = ""] = value.split(".");
+  return {
+    coefficient: BigInt(`${integer}${fraction}`),
+    scale: fraction.length
+  };
+}
+
+function formatParts(parts: DecimalParts): MoneyString {
+  let coefficient = parts.coefficient;
+  let scale = parts.scale;
+
+  while (scale > 0 && coefficient % 10n === 0n) {
+    coefficient /= 10n;
+    scale -= 1;
+  }
+
+  if (scale === 0) return coefficient.toString();
+  const digits = coefficient.toString().padStart(scale + 1, "0");
+  return `${digits.slice(0, -scale)}.${digits.slice(-scale)}`;
+}
+
+function align(left: DecimalParts, right: DecimalParts): [DecimalParts, DecimalParts] {
+  const scale = Math.max(left.scale, right.scale);
+  return [
+    { coefficient: left.coefficient * powerOfTen(scale - left.scale), scale },
+    { coefficient: right.coefficient * powerOfTen(scale - right.scale), scale }
+  ];
+}
+
+export function isMoneyString(value: unknown): value is MoneyString {
+  return typeof value === "string" && MONEY_PATTERN.test(value);
+}
+
+export function validateMoneyString(
+  value: unknown,
+  path: string,
+  limits: Pick<EngineLimits, "maxMoneyIntegerDigits" | "maxMoneyScale">
+): ConfigurationIssue[] {
+  if (!isMoneyString(value)) {
+    return [{ code: "INVALID_MONEY", path, message: "Money must be a non-negative plain decimal string." }];
+  }
+
+  const [integer, fraction = ""] = value.split(".");
+  const issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [];
+  if (integer.length > limits.maxMoneyIntegerDigits) {
+    issues.push({ code: "MONEY_INTEGER_TOO_LARGE", path, message: "Money integer digits exceed the engine limit." });
+  }
+  if (fraction.length > limits.maxMoneyScale) {
+    issues.push({ code: "MONEY_SCALE_TOO_LARGE", path, message: "Money decimal scale exceeds the engine limit." });
+  }
+  return issues;
+}
+
+export function normalizeMoney(value: MoneyString): MoneyString {
+  if (!isMoneyString(value)) throw new Error(`Invalid money string: ${value}`);
+  return formatParts(parseUnchecked(value));
+}
+
+export function addMoney(left: MoneyString, right: MoneyString): MoneyString {
+  const [a, b] = align(parseUnchecked(normalizeMoney(left)), parseUnchecked(normalizeMoney(right)));
+  return formatParts({ coefficient: a.coefficient + b.coefficient, scale: a.scale });
+}
+
+export function subtractMoney(left: MoneyString, right: MoneyString): MoneyString {
+  const [a, b] = align(parseUnchecked(normalizeMoney(left)), parseUnchecked(normalizeMoney(right)));
+  if (a.coefficient < b.coefficient) throw new Error("Money subtraction cannot produce a negative value.");
+  return formatParts({ coefficient: a.coefficient - b.coefficient, scale: a.scale });
+}
+
+export function multiplyMoney(value: MoneyString, quantity: number): MoneyString {
+  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) || quantity < 0) throw new Error("Money quantity must be a non-negative safe integer.");
+  const parts = parseUnchecked(normalizeMoney(value));
+  return formatParts({ coefficient: parts.coefficient * BigInt(quantity), scale: parts.scale });
+}
+
+export function compareMoney(left: MoneyString, right: MoneyString): -1 | 0 | 1 {
+  const [a, b] = align(parseUnchecked(normalizeMoney(left)), parseUnchecked(normalizeMoney(right)));
+  if (a.coefficient === b.coefficient) return 0;
+  return a.coefficient < b.coefficient ? -1 : 1;
+}
+
+export function sumMoney(values: readonly MoneyString[]): MoneyString {
+  return values.reduce<MoneyString>((sum, value) => addMoney(sum, value), "0");
+}
diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/pricing.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/pricing.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bf24650
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/pricing.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,203 @@
+import { compareMoney, normalizeMoney, sumMoney } from "./money";
+import { resolveLinkedConfiguration } from "./resolution";
+import { validateSelection } from "./selection";
+import {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  ConfigurationIssue,
+  GroupSelection,
+  MoneyString,
+  OptionChoice,
+  OptionGroupSelection,
+  PriceLine,
+  PriceResult,
+  ProductConfigurationContext,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  ProductSelectionV1,
+  SizeGroupSelection
+} from "./types";
+
+function selectedGroupMap(selections: readonly GroupSelection[]) {
+  return new Map(selections.map((selection) => [selection.groupId, selection]));
+}
+
+function collectDirectSelectedSizeIds(
+  groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[],
+  selections: readonly GroupSelection[],
+  inherited: ReadonlySet<string>
+) {
+  const result = new Set(inherited);
+  const selected = selectedGroupMap(selections);
+  for (const group of groups) {
+    const groupSelection = selected.get(group.id);
+    if (group.type === "SIZE" && groupSelection?.type === "SIZE") {
+      result.add(groupSelection.sizeChoiceId);
+    }
+  }
+  return result;
+}
+
+function effectiveOptionPrice(
+  option: OptionChoice,
+  selectedSizeIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[],
+  path: string,
+  originalOverlay?: Readonly<Record<string, MoneyString>>
+): MoneyString {
+  if (originalOverlay) return normalizeMoney(originalOverlay[option.id] ?? "0");
+  const defaultPrice = normalizeMoney(option.price);
+  const candidates = (option.priceOverrides ?? [])
+    .filter((override) => selectedSizeIds.has(override.sizeChoiceId))
+    .map((override) => normalizeMoney(override.price ?? defaultPrice));
+  if (!candidates.length) return defaultPrice;
+  const first = candidates[0];
+  if (candidates.some((candidate) => compareMoney(candidate, first) !== 0)) {
+    issues.push({ code: "AMBIGUOUS_SIZE_PRICE_OVERRIDE", path, message: "Multiple selected Size contexts resolve this option to different prices." });
+  }
+  return first;
+}
+
+function effectiveSizePrice(
+  sizeId: string,
+  price: MoneyString,
+  originalOverlay?: Readonly<Record<string, MoneyString>>
+) {
+  return normalizeMoney(originalOverlay ? originalOverlay[sizeId] ?? "0" : price);
+}
+
+function configurationContainsResolvedSize(
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  context: ProductConfigurationContext,
+  path: string,
+  stack: readonly string[],
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[]
+): boolean {
+  function visit(groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[], groupPath: string, productStack: readonly string[]): boolean {
+    for (const [groupIndex, group] of groups.entries()) {
+      const currentPath = `${groupPath}.groups[${groupIndex}]`;
+      if (group.type === "SIZE") return true;
+      for (const [optionIndex, option] of group.options.entries()) {
+        const optionPath = `${currentPath}.options[${optionIndex}]`;
+        if (visit(option.children ?? [], optionPath, productStack)) return true;
+        if (option.linkedProduct) {
+          const resolved = resolveLinkedConfiguration(option.linkedProduct, context, optionPath, productStack);
+          if (resolved.resolved && !resolved.issues.some((issue) => issue.code === "LINK_CYCLE")) {
+            if (visit(resolved.resolved.configuration.groups, `${optionPath}.linked`, [...productStack, resolved.resolved.sourceProductId])) return true;
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    return false;
+  }
+  return visit(configuration.groups, path, stack);
+}
+
+export function calculatePrice(
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1,
+  context: ProductConfigurationContext
+): PriceResult {
+  const issues = validateSelection(configuration, selection, context);
+  const resolutionIssues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [];
+  const baseIgnored = configurationContainsResolvedSize(
+    configuration,
+    context,
+    "$configuration",
+    [configuration.productId],
+    resolutionIssues
+  );
+  for (const issue of resolutionIssues) {
+    if (!issues.some((existing) => existing.code === issue.code && existing.path === issue.path)) issues.push(issue);
+  }
+  if (issues.length) return { valid: false, total: null, baseIgnored, lines: [], issues };
+
+  const lines: PriceLine[] = [];
+
+  function priceGroups(
+    groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[],
+    selections: readonly GroupSelection[],
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[],
+    originalOverlay?: Readonly<Record<string, MoneyString>>,
+    inheritedSizeIds: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set()
+  ) {
+    const selected = selectedGroupMap(selections);
+    const activeSelectedSizeIds = collectDirectSelectedSizeIds(groups, selections, inheritedSizeIds);
+    for (const group of groups) {
+      const groupSelection = selected.get(group.id);
+      const groupPath = `${path}.${group.id}`;
+      if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+        const sizeSelection = groupSelection as SizeGroupSelection;
+        const size = group.sizes.find((candidate) => candidate.id === sizeSelection.sizeChoiceId)!;
+        const amount = effectiveSizePrice(size.id, size.price, originalOverlay);
+        lines.push({ kind: "SIZE", path: groupPath, nodeId: size.id, label: size.label, amount, chargedAmount: amount, included: false });
+        priceGroups(size.children ?? [], sizeSelection.children ?? [], `${groupPath}.${size.id}`, productStack, originalOverlay, activeSelectedSizeIds);
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const optionSelection = groupSelection as OptionGroupSelection | undefined;
+      const instances = optionSelection?.instances ?? [];
+      const parentLines: Array<{ line: PriceLine; amount: MoneyString }> = [];
+      for (const instance of instances) {
+        const option = group.options.find((candidate) => candidate.id === instance.optionId)!;
+        const instancePath = `${groupPath}.${instance.instanceId}`;
+        const amount = effectiveOptionPrice(option, activeSelectedSizeIds, issues, instancePath, originalOverlay);
+        const line: PriceLine = {
+          kind: "OPTION",
+          path: instancePath,
+          nodeId: option.id,
+          label: option.label,
+          instanceId: instance.instanceId,
+          sourceProductId: option.linkedProduct?.sourceProductId,
+          amount,
+          chargedAmount: amount,
+          included: false
+        };
+        lines.push(line);
+        parentLines.push({ line, amount });
+        priceGroups(option.children ?? [], instance.children ?? [], `${instancePath}.children`, productStack, originalOverlay, activeSelectedSizeIds);
+
+        if (option.linkedProduct && instance.linkedSelection) {
+          const resolved = resolveLinkedConfiguration(option.linkedProduct, context, instancePath, productStack).resolved!;
+          const linkedOverlay = resolved.mode === "ORIGINAL" ? resolved.originalPriceOverrides : undefined;
+          priceGroups(
+            resolved.configuration.groups,
+            instance.linkedSelection.groups,
+            `${instancePath}.linked`,
+            [...productStack, resolved.sourceProductId],
+            linkedOverlay,
+            activeSelectedSizeIds
+          );
+        }
+      }
+
+      parentLines
+        .sort((left, right) => {
+          const priceOrder = compareMoney(right.amount, left.amount);
+          return priceOrder || (left.line.instanceId ?? "").localeCompare(right.line.instanceId ?? "");
+        })
+        .slice(0, group.includedQuantity)
+        .forEach(({ line }) => {
+          line.included = true;
+          line.chargedAmount = "0";
+        });
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!baseIgnored && configuration.basePrice !== null) {
+    const amount = normalizeMoney(configuration.basePrice);
+    lines.push({ kind: "BASE", path: "$configuration.basePrice", nodeId: configuration.productId, label: "Base", amount, chargedAmount: amount, included: false });
+  }
+  priceGroups(configuration.groups, selection.groups, "$selection.groups", [configuration.productId]);
+
+  if (!baseIgnored && configuration.basePrice === null && !lines.some((line) => line.kind !== "BASE")) {
+    issues.push({ code: "MISSING_PRICE_SOURCE", path: "$configuration.basePrice", message: "A null Base requires a selected explicit pricing path; it cannot silently become zero." });
+  }
+  if (issues.length) return { valid: false, total: null, baseIgnored, lines: [], issues };
+  return {
+    valid: true,
+    total: sumMoney(lines.map((line) => line.chargedAmount)),
+    baseIgnored,
+    lines,
+    issues: []
+  };
+}
diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/product-configuration.test.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/product-configuration.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0ec23df
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/product-configuration.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,351 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
+import {
+  ProductConfigurationContext,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  ProductSelectionV1,
+  PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+  PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION
+} from "./types";
+import { addMoney, multiplyMoney, normalizeMoney } from "./money";
+import { validateConfiguration } from "./validation";
+import { validateSelection } from "./selection";
+import { calculatePrice } from "./pricing";
+import { calculateMinimumPrice } from "./minimum-price";
+import { createConfigurationSnapshot, createSelectionKey } from "./snapshot";
+import { validateDependencyGraph } from "./dependencies";
+
+const context: ProductConfigurationContext = { catalogId: "catalog-1", linkedProducts: new Map() };
+
+function config(groups: ProductConfigurationV1["groups"] = [], basePrice: string | null = "100", productId = "product-1"): ProductConfigurationV1 {
+  return { schemaVersion: PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SCHEMA_VERSION, productId, revision: 1, basePrice, groups };
+}
+
+function selection(groups: ProductSelectionV1["groups"] = [], productId = "product-1", revision = 1): ProductSelectionV1 {
+  return { schemaVersion: PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION, productId, configurationRevision: revision, groups };
+}
+
+describe("decimal-safe money", () => {

+    expect(addMoney("0.1", "0.2")).toBe("0.3");

+  });

+  it("rejects scientific notation and numeric money", () => {

+    expect(validateConfiguration({ ...config(), basePrice: 10 as unknown as string }).map((issue) => issue.code)).toContain("INVALID_MONEY");
+  });
+});

@@ -0,0 +1,124 @@
+import {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  ConfigurationIssue,
+  LinkedProductDefinition,
+  ProductConfigurationContext,
+  ProductConfigurationV1
+} from "./types";
+
+export type ResolvedLinkedProduct = {
+  path: string;
+  sourceProductId: string;
+  mode: "ORIGINAL" | "CUSTOM";
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  originalPriceOverrides: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
+};
+
+export type ResolvedConfigurationContext = {
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  linkedConfigurations: ReadonlyMap<string, ResolvedLinkedProduct>;
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[];
+};
+
+function collectPriceNodeIds(groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[], result = new Set<string>()) {
+  for (const group of groups) {
+    if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+      for (const size of group.sizes) {
+        result.add(size.id);
+        collectPriceNodeIds(size.children ?? [], result);
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+    for (const option of group.options) {
+      result.add(option.id);
+      collectPriceNodeIds(option.children ?? [], result);
+    }
+  }
+  return result;
+}
+
+export function resolveLinkedConfiguration(
+  linked: LinkedProductDefinition,
+  context: ProductConfigurationContext,
+  path: string,
+  productStack: readonly string[]
+): { resolved?: ResolvedLinkedProduct; issues: ConfigurationIssue[] } {
+  const issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [];
+  const source = context.linkedProducts?.get(linked.sourceProductId);
+  if (!source) {
+    issues.push({ code: "LINK_TARGET_NOT_FOUND", path, message: "Linked source product was not found in the runtime catalog." });
+    return { issues };
+  }
+  if (source.catalogId !== context.catalogId) {
+    issues.push({ code: "CROSS_CATALOG_LINK", path, message: "Linked source product belongs to another catalog/tenant." });
+  }
+  if (source.available === false || source.orderable === false) {
+    issues.push({ code: "LINKED_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE", path, message: "Linked source product is not currently orderable." });
+  }
+  if (source.configuration.productId !== source.productId) {
+    issues.push({ code: "LINK_SOURCE_CONFIGURATION_MISMATCH", path, message: "Linked source configuration belongs to another product." });
+  }
+  if (productStack.includes(source.productId)) {
+    issues.push({ code: "LINK_CYCLE", path, message: `Linked runtime cycle detected: ${[...productStack, source.productId].join(" -> ")}.` });
+  }
+
+  const configuration = linked.mode === "CUSTOM" ? linked.customConfiguration : source.configuration;
+  if (!configuration) {
+    issues.push({ code: "MISSING_LINKED_CONFIGURATION", path, message: "Linked product configuration could not be resolved." });
+    return { issues };
+  }
+  if (linked.mode === "ORIGINAL") {
+    const priceNodeIds = collectPriceNodeIds(source.configuration.groups);
+    for (const nodeId of Object.keys(linked.originalPriceOverrides ?? {})) {
+      if (!priceNodeIds.has(nodeId)) {
+        issues.push({ code: "UNKNOWN_ORIGINAL_PRICE_NODE", path: `${path}.originalPriceOverrides.${nodeId}`, message: "Original-mode price override references an unknown live source node." });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    resolved: {
+      path,
+      sourceProductId: source.productId,
+      mode: linked.mode,
+      configuration,
+      originalPriceOverrides: linked.originalPriceOverrides ?? {}
+    },
+    issues
+  };
+}
+
+export function resolveConfigurationContext(
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  context: ProductConfigurationContext
+): ResolvedConfigurationContext {
+  const linkedConfigurations = new Map<string, ResolvedLinkedProduct>();
+  const issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [];
+
+  function visit(groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[], path: string, stack: readonly string[]) {
+    groups.forEach((group, groupIndex) => {
+      const groupPath = `${path}.groups[${groupIndex}]`;
+      if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+        group.sizes.forEach((size, sizeIndex) => visit(size.children ?? [], `${groupPath}.sizes[${sizeIndex}]`, stack));
+        return;
+      }
+      group.options.forEach((option, optionIndex) => {
+        const optionPath = `${groupPath}.options[${optionIndex}]`;
+        if (option.linkedProduct) {
+          const result = resolveLinkedConfiguration(option.linkedProduct, context, optionPath, stack);
+          issues.push(...result.issues);
+          if (result.resolved) {
+            linkedConfigurations.set(optionPath, result.resolved);
+            if (!result.issues.some((issue) => issue.code === "LINK_CYCLE")) {
+              visit(result.resolved.configuration.groups, `${optionPath}.linked`, [...stack, result.resolved.sourceProductId]);
+            }
+          }
+        }
+        visit(option.children ?? [], optionPath, stack);
+      });
+    });
+  }
+
+  visit(configuration.groups, "$configuration", [configuration.productId]);
+  return { configuration, linkedConfigurations, issues };
+}
diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/selection.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/selection.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..38b9b95
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/selection.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,198 @@
+import {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  ConfigurationIssue,
+  GroupSelection,
+  OptionGroupSelection,
+  ProductConfigurationContext,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  ProductSelectionV1,
+  PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+  SizeGroupSelection
+} from "./types";
+import { resolveEngineLimits, validateConfiguration } from "./validation";
+import { resolveLinkedConfiguration } from "./resolution";
+
+export function validateSelection(
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1,
+  context: ProductConfigurationContext
+): ConfigurationIssue[] {
+  const limits = resolveEngineLimits(context.limits);
+  const issues = [...validateConfiguration(configuration, limits)];
+  const instanceIds = new Set<string>();
+  let instanceCount = 0;
+
+  function validateProductSelection(
+    config: ProductConfigurationV1,
+    selected: ProductSelectionV1,
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[]
+  ) {
+    if (selected.schemaVersion !== PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
+      issues.push({ code: "UNSUPPORTED_SELECTION_VERSION", path: `${path}.schemaVersion`, message: "Unsupported selection schema version." });
+    }
+    if (selected.productId !== config.productId) {
+      issues.push({ code: "SELECTION_PRODUCT_MISMATCH", path: `${path}.productId`, message: "Selection belongs to another product." });
+    }
+    if (selected.configurationRevision !== config.revision) {
+      issues.push({ code: "STALE_CONFIGURATION_REVISION", path: `${path}.configurationRevision`, message: "Selection revision does not match the current configuration." });
+    }
+    if (!Array.isArray(selected.groups)) {
+      issues.push({ code: "INVALID_GROUP_SELECTIONS", path: `${path}.groups`, message: "Selected groups must be an array." });
+      return;
+    }
+    validateGroups(config.groups, selected.groups, `${path}.groups`, productStack);
+  }
+
+  function validateGroups(
+    groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[],
+    selections: readonly GroupSelection[],
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[]
+  ) {
+    const byGroup = new Map<string, GroupSelection>();
+    selections.forEach((groupSelection, index) => {
+      if (byGroup.has(groupSelection.groupId)) {
+        issues.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_GROUP_SELECTION", path: `${path}[${index}]`, message: "A group can appear only once in one selection scope." });
+      }
+      byGroup.set(groupSelection.groupId, groupSelection);
+    });
+    const knownGroupIds = new Set(groups.map((group) => group.id));
+    selections.forEach((groupSelection, index) => {
+      if (!knownGroupIds.has(groupSelection.groupId)) {
+        issues.push({ code: "UNKNOWN_GROUP_SELECTION", path: `${path}[${index}]`, message: "Selection references an unknown group." });
+      }
+    });
+
+    for (const group of groups) {
+      const selected = byGroup.get(group.id);
+      const groupPath = `${path}.${group.id}`;
+      if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+        validateSizeGroup(group, selected, groupPath, productStack);
+      } else {
+        validateOptionGroup(group, selected, groupPath, productStack);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  function validateSizeGroup(
+    group: Extract<ConfigurationGroup, { type: "SIZE" }>,
+    selected: GroupSelection | undefined,
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[]
+  ) {
+    if (group.available === false) {
+      issues.push({ code: "REQUIRED_SIZE_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE", path, message: "A Size group is unavailable, so the configuration is unsatisfiable." });
+      return;
+    }
+    if (!selected) {
+      issues.push({ code: "SIZE_REQUIRED", path, message: "Exactly one Size must be selected." });
+      return;
+    }
+    if (selected.type !== "SIZE") {
+      issues.push({ code: "GROUP_SELECTION_TYPE_MISMATCH", path, message: "Expected a Size group selection." });
+      return;
+    }
+    const sizeSelection = selected as SizeGroupSelection;
+    const size = group.sizes.find((candidate) => candidate.id === sizeSelection.sizeChoiceId);
+    if (!size) {
+      issues.push({ code: "UNKNOWN_SIZE_SELECTION", path, message: "Selected Size does not exist." });
+      return;
+    }
+    if (size.available === false) {
+      issues.push({ code: "SIZE_UNAVAILABLE", path, message: "Selected Size is unavailable." });
+    }
+    validateGroups(size.children ?? [], sizeSelection.children ?? [], `${path}.children`, productStack);
+  }
+
+  function validateOptionGroup(
+    group: Extract<ConfigurationGroup, { type: "OPTIONS" }>,
+    selected: GroupSelection | undefined,
+    path: string,
+    productStack: readonly string[]
+  ) {
+    if (selected && selected.type !== "OPTIONS") {
+      issues.push({ code: "GROUP_SELECTION_TYPE_MISMATCH", path, message: "Expected an Options group selection." });
+      return;
+    }
+    const optionSelection = selected as OptionGroupSelection | undefined;
+    const instances = optionSelection?.instances ?? [];
+    const effectiveMax = group.max ?? limits.maxQuantityPerGroup;
+    const requiredMinimum = Math.max(
+      group.min,
+      group.options.reduce((total, option) => total + (option.minQuantity ?? 0), 0)
+    );
+
+    if (group.available === false) {
+      if (requiredMinimum > 0) {
+        issues.push({ code: "REQUIRED_OPTIONS_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE", path, message: "A required Options group is unavailable." });
+      }
+      if (instances.length) {
+        issues.push({ code: "OPTIONS_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE", path, message: "Selections cannot be made in an unavailable group." });
+      }
+      return;
+    }
+    if (instances.length < group.min) {
+      issues.push({ code: "GROUP_MIN_NOT_MET", path, message: `Options group requires at least ${group.min} selected units.` });
+    }
+    if (instances.length > effectiveMax) {
+      issues.push({ code: "GROUP_MAX_EXCEEDED", path, message: `Options group allows at most ${effectiveMax} selected units.` });
+    }
+
+    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
+    instances.forEach((instance, index) => {
+      const instancePath = `${path}.instances[${index}]`;
+      instanceCount += 1;
+      if (instanceCount > limits.maxSelectionInstances) {
+        issues.push({ code: "SELECTION_INSTANCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", path: instancePath, message: "Selection instance safety limit exceeded." });
+      }
+      if (!instance.instanceId?.trim()) {
+        issues.push({ code: "MISSING_SELECTION_INSTANCE_ID", path: `${instancePath}.instanceId`, message: "Every selected unit requires a stable instance ID." });
+      } else if (instanceIds.has(instance.instanceId)) {
+        issues.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_SELECTION_INSTANCE_ID", path: `${instancePath}.instanceId`, message: "Selection instance IDs must be globally unique." });
+      } else {
+        instanceIds.add(instance.instanceId);
+      }
+
+      const option = group.options.find((candidate) => candidate.id === instance.optionId);
+      if (!option) {
+        issues.push({ code: "UNKNOWN_OPTION_SELECTION", path: instancePath, message: "Selected option does not exist." });
+        return;
+      }
+      counts.set(option.id, (counts.get(option.id) ?? 0) + 1);
+      if (option.available === false) {
+        issues.push({ code: "OPTION_UNAVAILABLE", path: instancePath, message: "Selected option is unavailable." });
+      }
+      validateGroups(option.children ?? [], instance.children ?? [], `${instancePath}.children`, productStack);
+
+      if (!option.linkedProduct && instance.linkedSelection) {
+        issues.push({ code: "UNEXPECTED_LINKED_SELECTION", path: instancePath, message: "A normal option cannot contain a linked product selection." });
+      }
+      if (option.linkedProduct) {
+        const resolved = resolveLinkedConfiguration(option.linkedProduct, context, instancePath, productStack);
+        issues.push(...resolved.issues);
+        if (!resolved.resolved) return;
+        const linkedConfig = resolved.resolved.configuration;
+        if (!instance.linkedSelection && linkedConfig.groups.length > 0) {
+          issues.push({ code: "MISSING_LINKED_SELECTION", path: instancePath, message: "Linked product configuration is required." });
+        } else if (instance.linkedSelection) {
+          validateProductSelection(linkedConfig, instance.linkedSelection, `${instancePath}.linkedSelection`, [...productStack, linkedConfig.productId]);
+        }
+      }
+    });
+
+    for (const option of group.options) {
+      const count = counts.get(option.id) ?? 0;
+      const min = option.minQuantity ?? 0;
+      if (count < min) {
+        issues.push({ code: "OPTION_MIN_NOT_MET", path: `${path}.${option.id}`, message: `Option requires at least ${min} selected units.` });
+      }
+      if (count > option.maxQuantity) {
+        issues.push({ code: "OPTION_MAX_EXCEEDED", path: `${path}.${option.id}`, message: `Option allows at most ${option.maxQuantity} selected units.` });
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  validateProductSelection(configuration, selection, "$selection", [configuration.productId]);
+  return issues;
+}
diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/snapshot.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/snapshot.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..26dc419
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/snapshot.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+import { calculatePrice } from "./pricing";
+import {
+  ConfigurationSnapshot,
+  GroupSelection,
+  ProductConfigurationContext,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  ProductSelectionV1,
+  PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
+  SnapshotResult
+} from "./types";
+
+function canonicalGroups(groups: readonly GroupSelection[]): unknown[] {
+  return [...groups]
+    .sort((left, right) => (left.groupId < right.groupId ? -1 : left.groupId > right.groupId ? 1 : 0))
+    .map((group) => {
+      if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+        return {
+          type: group.type,
+          groupId: group.groupId,
+          sizeChoiceId: group.sizeChoiceId,
+          children: canonicalGroups(group.children ?? [])
+        };
+      }
+      const instances = group.instances.map((instance) => ({
+        optionId: instance.optionId,
+        children: canonicalGroups(instance.children ?? []),
+        linkedSelection: instance.linkedSelection
+          ? {
+              productId: instance.linkedSelection.productId,
+              configurationRevision: instance.linkedSelection.configurationRevision,
+              groups: canonicalGroups(instance.linkedSelection.groups)
+            }
+          : null
+      }));
+      instances.sort((left, right) => {
+        const a = JSON.stringify(left);
+        const b = JSON.stringify(right);
+        return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
+      });
+      return { type: group.type, groupId: group.groupId, instances };
+    });
+}
+
+/** Stable semantic key: instance IDs and array ordering do not change configuration identity. */
+export function createSelectionKey(selection: ProductSelectionV1): string {
+  return JSON.stringify({
+    schemaVersion: selection.schemaVersion,
+    productId: selection.productId,
+    configurationRevision: selection.configurationRevision,
+    groups: canonicalGroups(selection.groups)
+  });
+}
+
+function cloneJson<T>(value: T): T {
+  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as T;
+}
+
+function deepFreeze<T>(value: T): T {
+  if (value && typeof value === "object" && !Object.isFrozen(value)) {
+    Object.freeze(value);
+    Object.values(value as Record<string, unknown>).forEach((child) => deepFreeze(child));
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+export function createConfigurationSnapshot(args: {
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1;
+  context: ProductConfigurationContext;
+  productName: string;
+  currency: string;
+  createdAt: string;
+}): SnapshotResult {
+  const metadataIssues = [];
+  if (!args.productName.trim()) {
+    metadataIssues.push({ code: "MISSING_PRODUCT_NAME", path: "$snapshot.productName", message: "Snapshot product name is required." });
+  }
+  if (!args.currency.trim()) {
+    metadataIssues.push({ code: "MISSING_CURRENCY", path: "$snapshot.currency", message: "Snapshot currency is required." });
+  }
+  if (!args.createdAt.trim() || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(args.createdAt))) {
+    metadataIssues.push({ code: "INVALID_SNAPSHOT_TIME", path: "$snapshot.createdAt", message: "Snapshot time must be a valid date-time string." });
+  }
+
+  const price = calculatePrice(args.configuration, args.selection, args.context);
+  const issues = [...metadataIssues, ...price.issues];
+  if (!price.valid || price.total === null || issues.length) return { valid: false, snapshot: null, issues };
+
+  const snapshot: ConfigurationSnapshot = {
+    snapshotVersion: PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
+    productId: args.configuration.productId,
+    productName: args.productName,
+    currency: args.currency,
+    configurationRevision: args.configuration.revision,
+    selectionKey: createSelectionKey(args.selection),
+    selection: cloneJson(args.selection),
+    total: price.total,
+    baseIgnored: price.baseIgnored,
+    priceLines: cloneJson(price.lines),
+    createdAt: args.createdAt
+  };
+  return { valid: true, snapshot: deepFreeze(snapshot), issues: [] };
+}
diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/types.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/types.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c9aff41
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/types.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,217 @@
+export const PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1 as const;
+export const PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1 as const;
+export const PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 1 as const;
+
+/** Canonical, non-negative decimal text. Scientific notation is intentionally forbidden. */
+export type MoneyString = string;
+
+export type LinkedProductMode = "ORIGINAL" | "CUSTOM";
+
+export type ConfigurationIssue = {
+  code: string;
+  path: string;
+  message: string;
+};
+
+export type EngineLimits = {
+  maxDepth: number;
+  maxNodes: number;
+  maxGroupChoices: number;
+  maxQuantityPerGroup: number;
+  maxSelectionInstances: number;
+  maxMoneyIntegerDigits: number;
+  maxMoneyScale: number;
+  maxMinimumPriceStates: number;
+};
+
+export const DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS: Readonly<EngineLimits> = Object.freeze({
+  maxDepth: 12,
+  maxNodes: 1_000,
+  maxGroupChoices: 100,
+  maxQuantityPerGroup: 100,
+  maxSelectionInstances: 500,
+  maxMoneyIntegerDigits: 18,
+  maxMoneyScale: 6,
+  maxMinimumPriceStates: 20_000
+});
+
+export type SizePriceOverride = {
+  sizeChoiceId: string;
+  /** null is an explicit blank override and falls back to the option's default price. */
+  price: MoneyString | null;
+};
+
+export type LinkedProductDefinition = {
+  sourceProductId: string;
+  mode: LinkedProductMode;
+  /** Required only in CUSTOM mode. Structure and prices are a local snapshot. */
+  customConfiguration?: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  /**
+   * ORIGINAL mode never inherits standalone source selling prices. Price-bearing source
+   * node IDs not present here resolve to zero inside the parent context.
+   */
+  originalPriceOverrides?: Readonly<Record<string, MoneyString>>;
+};
+
+export type SizeChoice = {
+  id: string;
+  label: string;
+  /** Full selling price contribution, never a delta from Base. */
+  price: MoneyString;
+  calories?: string | null;
+  available?: boolean;
+  children?: ConfigurationGroup[];
+};
+
+export type SizeGroup = {
+  type: "SIZE";
+  id: string;
+  label: string;
+  available?: boolean;
+  sizes: SizeChoice[];
+};
+
+export type OptionChoice = {
+  id: string;
+  label: string;
+  /** Local price per selected unit. For linked products this is the parent-context price. */
+  price: MoneyString;
+  minQuantity?: number;
+  maxQuantity: number;
+  available?: boolean;
+  priceOverrides?: SizePriceOverride[];
+  children?: ConfigurationGroup[];
+  linkedProduct?: LinkedProductDefinition;
+};
+
+export type OptionGroup = {
+  type: "OPTIONS";
+  id: string;
+  label: string;
+  available?: boolean;
+  /** Counts selected units, not distinct option IDs. */
+  min: number;
+  /** null means no merchant max; the platform safety cap still applies. */
+  max: number | null;
+  /** Highest-priced N parent units are free. Child branch prices remain payable. */
+  includedQuantity: number;
+  options: OptionChoice[];
+};
+
+export type ConfigurationGroup = SizeGroup | OptionGroup;
+
+export type ProductConfigurationV1 = {
+  schemaVersion: typeof PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SCHEMA_VERSION;
+  productId: string;
+  revision: number;
+  /** null means no Base price. "0" is an explicit zero price. */
+  basePrice: MoneyString | null;
+  groups: ConfigurationGroup[];
+};
+
+export type SizeGroupSelection = {
+  type: "SIZE";
+  groupId: string;
+  sizeChoiceId: string;
+  children?: GroupSelection[];
+};
+
+export type OptionSelectionInstance = {
+  /** Stable per selected unit/branch. Repeated units must not share an ID. */
+  instanceId: string;
+  optionId: string;
+  children?: GroupSelection[];
+  linkedSelection?: ProductSelectionV1;
+};
+
+export type OptionGroupSelection = {
+  type: "OPTIONS";
+  groupId: string;
+  instances: OptionSelectionInstance[];
+};
+
+export type GroupSelection = SizeGroupSelection | OptionGroupSelection;
+
+export type ProductSelectionV1 = {
+  schemaVersion: typeof PRODUCT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION;
+  productId: string;
+  configurationRevision: number;
+  groups: GroupSelection[];
+};
+
+export type LinkedProductCatalogEntry = {
+  productId: string;
+  catalogId: string;
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+  available?: boolean;
+  orderable?: boolean;
+};
+
+export type ProductConfigurationContext = {
+  catalogId: string;
+  linkedProducts?: ReadonlyMap<string, LinkedProductCatalogEntry>;
+  limits?: Partial<EngineLimits>;
+};
+
+export type DependencyEdge = {
+  productId: string;
+  sourceProductId: string;
+  optionId: string;
+  path: string;
+  mode: LinkedProductMode;
+};
+
+export type ProductConfigurationRecord = {
+  productId: string;
+  catalogId: string;
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1;
+};
+
+export type PriceLine = {
+  kind: "BASE" | "SIZE" | "OPTION";
+  path: string;
+  nodeId: string;
+  label: string;
+  instanceId?: string;
+  sourceProductId?: string;
+  amount: MoneyString;
+  chargedAmount: MoneyString;
+  included: boolean;
+};
+
+export type PriceResult = {
+  valid: boolean;
+  total: MoneyString | null;
+  baseIgnored: boolean;
+  lines: PriceLine[];
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[];
+};
+
+export type MinimumPriceResult = {
+  orderable: boolean;
+  minimum: MoneyString | null;
+  maximumRequired: MoneyString | null;
+  display: "EXACT" | "STARTING_AT" | "UNAVAILABLE";
+  baseIgnored: boolean;
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[];
+};
+
+export type ConfigurationSnapshot = {
+  snapshotVersion: typeof PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SNAPSHOT_VERSION;
+  productId: string;
+  productName: string;
+  currency: string;
+  configurationRevision: number;
+  selectionKey: string;
+  selection: ProductSelectionV1;
+  total: MoneyString;
+  baseIgnored: boolean;
+  priceLines: PriceLine[];
+  createdAt: string;
+};
+
+export type SnapshotResult = {
+  valid: boolean;
+  snapshot: ConfigurationSnapshot | null;
+  issues: ConfigurationIssue[];
+};
diff --git a/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/validation.ts b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/validation.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1e4491b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/shared/src/product-configuration/validation.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,238 @@
+import {
+  ConfigurationGroup,
+  ConfigurationIssue,
+  DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS,
+  EngineLimits,
+  OptionGroup,
+  ProductConfigurationV1,
+  PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SCHEMA_VERSION
+} from "./types";
+import { validateMoneyString } from "./money";
+
+export function resolveEngineLimits(overrides?: Partial<EngineLimits>): EngineLimits {
+  return { ...DEFAULT_ENGINE_LIMITS, ...overrides };
+}
+
+function isBoundedInteger(value: unknown, min: number, max: number) {
+  return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Number(value) >= min && Number(value) <= max;
+}
+
+function requiredText(value: unknown, path: string, issues: ConfigurationIssue[]) {
+  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) {
+    issues.push({ code: "REQUIRED_TEXT", path, message: "A non-empty string is required." });
+  }
+}
+
+function collectSizeChoiceIds(groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[], result = new Set<string>()) {
+  for (const group of groups) {
+    if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+      for (const size of group.sizes) {
+        result.add(size.id);
+        collectSizeChoiceIds(size.children ?? [], result);
+      }
+    } else {
+      for (const option of group.options) collectSizeChoiceIds(option.children ?? [], result);
+    }
+  }
+  return result;
+}
+
+export function configurationContainsSize(groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[]): boolean {
+  for (const group of groups) {
+    if (group.type === "SIZE") return true;
+    for (const option of group.options) {
+      if (configurationContainsSize(option.children ?? [])) return true;
+      if (option.linkedProduct?.mode === "CUSTOM" && option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration) {
+        if (configurationContainsSize(option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration.groups)) return true;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return false;
+}
+
+export function validateConfiguration(
+  configuration: ProductConfigurationV1,
+  limitOverrides?: Partial<EngineLimits>
+): ConfigurationIssue[] {
+  const limits = resolveEngineLimits(limitOverrides);
+  const issues: ConfigurationIssue[] = [];
+  const seenConfigurations = new Set<ProductConfigurationV1>();
+  let nodeCount = 0;
+
+  function validateOne(config: ProductConfigurationV1, path: string) {
+    if (seenConfigurations.has(config)) {
+      issues.push({ code: "INLINE_CONFIGURATION_CYCLE", path, message: "Custom configuration objects cannot contain reference cycles." });
+      return;
+    }
+    seenConfigurations.add(config);
+
+    if (config.schemaVersion !== PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
+      issues.push({ code: "UNSUPPORTED_CONFIGURATION_VERSION", path: `${path}.schemaVersion`, message: "Unsupported configuration schema version." });
+    }
+    requiredText(config.productId, `${path}.productId`, issues);
+    if (!isBoundedInteger(config.revision, 0, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) {
+      issues.push({ code: "INVALID_REVISION", path: `${path}.revision`, message: "Revision must be a non-negative safe integer." });
+    }
+    if (config.basePrice !== null) {
+      issues.push(...validateMoneyString(config.basePrice, `${path}.basePrice`, limits));
+    }
+    if (!Array.isArray(config.groups)) {
+      issues.push({ code: "INVALID_GROUPS", path: `${path}.groups`, message: "Groups must be an array." });
+      seenConfigurations.delete(config);
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const sizeChoiceIds = collectSizeChoiceIds(config.groups);
+    const ids = new Set<string>();
+
+    function registerId(id: unknown, idPath: string) {
+      requiredText(id, idPath, issues);
+      if (typeof id !== "string" || !id.trim()) return;
+      if (ids.has(id)) {
+        issues.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_NODE_ID", path: idPath, message: `Node ID '${id}' is duplicated in one configuration.` });
+      }
+      ids.add(id);
+      nodeCount += 1;
+      if (nodeCount > limits.maxNodes) {
+        issues.push({ code: "NODE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", path: idPath, message: "Configuration node limit exceeded." });
+      }
+    }
+
+    function validateGroups(groups: readonly ConfigurationGroup[], groupPath: string, depth: number, sizeSeen: boolean) {
+      if (depth > limits.maxDepth) {
+        issues.push({ code: "DEPTH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", path: groupPath, message: "Configuration depth limit exceeded." });
+        return;
+      }
+
+      groups.forEach((group, groupIndex) => {
+        const currentPath = `${groupPath}[${groupIndex}]`;
+        registerId(group.id, `${currentPath}.id`);
+        requiredText(group.label, `${currentPath}.label`, issues);
+
+        if (group.type === "SIZE") {
+          if (sizeSeen) {
+            issues.push({ code: "SIZE_AFTER_SIZE", path: currentPath, message: "A path cannot enter another Size group after a Size group." });
+          }
+          if (!Array.isArray(group.sizes) || group.sizes.length === 0) {
+            issues.push({ code: "EMPTY_SIZE_GROUP", path: `${currentPath}.sizes`, message: "A Size group requires at least one size." });
+            return;
+          }
+          if (group.sizes.length > limits.maxGroupChoices) {
+            issues.push({ code: "GROUP_CHOICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", path: `${currentPath}.sizes`, message: "Size choice limit exceeded." });
+          }
+          group.sizes.forEach((size, sizeIndex) => {
+            const sizePath = `${currentPath}.sizes[${sizeIndex}]`;
+            registerId(size.id, `${sizePath}.id`);
+            requiredText(size.label, `${sizePath}.label`, issues);
+            issues.push(...validateMoneyString(size.price, `${sizePath}.price`, limits));
+            validateGroups(size.children ?? [], `${sizePath}.children`, depth + 1, true);
+          });
+          return;
+        }
+
+        validateOptionGroup(group, currentPath, depth, sizeSeen);
+      });
+    }
+
+    function validateOptionGroup(group: OptionGroup, currentPath: string, depth: number, sizeSeen: boolean) {
+      const merchantMax = group.max ?? limits.maxQuantityPerGroup;
+      if (!isBoundedInteger(group.min, 0, limits.maxQuantityPerGroup)) {
+        issues.push({ code: "INVALID_GROUP_MIN", path: `${currentPath}.min`, message: "Group min must be a bounded non-negative integer." });
+      }
+      if (group.max !== null && !isBoundedInteger(group.max, 0, limits.maxQuantityPerGroup)) {
+        issues.push({ code: "INVALID_GROUP_MAX", path: `${currentPath}.max`, message: "Group max must be null or a bounded non-negative integer." });
+      }
+      if (Number.isSafeInteger(group.min) && Number.isSafeInteger(merchantMax) && group.min > merchantMax) {
+        issues.push({ code: "GROUP_MIN_EXCEEDS_MAX", path: currentPath, message: "Group min cannot exceed its effective max." });
+      }
+      if (!isBoundedInteger(group.includedQuantity, 0, limits.maxQuantityPerGroup)) {
+        issues.push({ code: "INVALID_INCLUDED_QUANTITY", path: `${currentPath}.includedQuantity`, message: "Included quantity must be a bounded non-negative integer." });
+      } else if (group.includedQuantity > merchantMax) {
+        issues.push({ code: "INCLUDED_EXCEEDS_GROUP_MAX", path: `${currentPath}.includedQuantity`, message: "Included quantity cannot exceed the group's effective max." });
+      }
+      if (!Array.isArray(group.options) || group.options.length === 0) {
+        issues.push({ code: "EMPTY_OPTIONS_GROUP", path: `${currentPath}.options`, message: "An Options group requires at least one option." });
+        return;
+      }
+      if (group.options.length > limits.maxGroupChoices) {
+        issues.push({ code: "GROUP_CHOICE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", path: `${currentPath}.options`, message: "Option choice limit exceeded." });
+      }
+
+      group.options.forEach((option, optionIndex) => {
+        const optionPath = `${currentPath}.options[${optionIndex}]`;
+        registerId(option.id, `${optionPath}.id`);
+        requiredText(option.label, `${optionPath}.label`, issues);
+        issues.push(...validateMoneyString(option.price, `${optionPath}.price`, limits));
+        const minQuantity = option.minQuantity ?? 0;
+        if (!isBoundedInteger(minQuantity, 0, limits.maxQuantityPerGroup)) {
+          issues.push({ code: "INVALID_OPTION_MIN", path: `${optionPath}.minQuantity`, message: "Option min must be a bounded non-negative integer." });
+        }
+        if (!isBoundedInteger(option.maxQuantity, 0, limits.maxQuantityPerGroup)) {
+          issues.push({ code: "INVALID_OPTION_MAX", path: `${optionPath}.maxQuantity`, message: "Option max must be a bounded non-negative integer." });
+        }
+        if (Number.isSafeInteger(minQuantity) && Number.isSafeInteger(option.maxQuantity) && minQuantity > option.maxQuantity) {
+          issues.push({ code: "OPTION_MIN_EXCEEDS_MAX", path: optionPath, message: "Option min cannot exceed option max." });
+        }
+        if (group.max !== null && Number.isSafeInteger(option.maxQuantity) && option.maxQuantity > group.max) {
+          issues.push({ code: "OPTION_MAX_EXCEEDS_GROUP_MAX", path: `${optionPath}.maxQuantity`, message: "Option max cannot exceed a numeric parent group max." });
+        }
+
+        const overrideIds = new Set<string>();
+        for (const [overrideIndex, override] of (option.priceOverrides ?? []).entries()) {
+          const overridePath = `${optionPath}.priceOverrides[${overrideIndex}]`;
+          requiredText(override.sizeChoiceId, `${overridePath}.sizeChoiceId`, issues);
+          if (overrideIds.has(override.sizeChoiceId)) {
+            issues.push({ code: "DUPLICATE_SIZE_PRICE_OVERRIDE", path: overridePath, message: "A size price override is duplicated." });
+          }
+          overrideIds.add(override.sizeChoiceId);
+          if (!sizeChoiceIds.has(override.sizeChoiceId)) {
+            issues.push({ code: "UNKNOWN_SIZE_PRICE_OVERRIDE", path: overridePath, message: "Size price override references an unknown size choice." });
+          }
+          if (override.price !== null) {
+            issues.push(...validateMoneyString(override.price, `${overridePath}.price`, limits));
+          }
+        }
+
+        if (option.linkedProduct) {
+          const linkedPath = `${optionPath}.linkedProduct`;
+          requiredText(option.linkedProduct.sourceProductId, `${linkedPath}.sourceProductId`, issues);
+          if (option.linkedProduct.sourceProductId === config.productId) {
+            issues.push({ code: "SELF_LINK", path: linkedPath, message: "A product cannot link to itself." });
+          }
+          if (option.linkedProduct.mode === "CUSTOM") {
+            if (!option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration) {
+              issues.push({ code: "MISSING_CUSTOM_CONFIGURATION", path: linkedPath, message: "CUSTOM mode requires a configuration snapshot." });
+            } else {
+              if (option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration.productId !== option.linkedProduct.sourceProductId) {
+                issues.push({ code: "CUSTOM_SOURCE_ID_MISMATCH", path: linkedPath, message: "Custom snapshot product ID must match the linked source product ID." });
+              }
+              validateOne(option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration, `${linkedPath}.customConfiguration`);
+            }
+          } else if (option.linkedProduct.customConfiguration) {
+            issues.push({ code: "ORIGINAL_HAS_CUSTOM_CONFIGURATION", path: linkedPath, message: "ORIGINAL mode must resolve the live source structure, not an embedded custom snapshot." });
+          }
+          for (const [nodeId, price] of Object.entries(option.linkedProduct.originalPriceOverrides ?? {})) {
+            issues.push(...validateMoneyString(price, `${linkedPath}.originalPriceOverrides.${nodeId}`, limits));
+          }
+        }
+
+        validateGroups(option.children ?? [], `${optionPath}.children`, depth + 1, sizeSeen);
+      });
+
+      const optionMinimumTotal = group.options.reduce((total, option) => total + (option.minQuantity ?? 0), 0);
+      if (optionMinimumTotal > merchantMax) {
+        issues.push({
+          code: "OPTION_MINIMA_EXCEED_GROUP_MAX",
+          path: currentPath,
+          message: "The sum of option minima cannot exceed the group's effective max."
+        });
+      }
+    }
+
+    validateGroups(config.groups, `${path}.groups`, 1, false);
+    seenConfigurations.delete(config);
+  }
+
+  validateOne(configuration, "$configuration");
+  return issues;
+}
