diff --git a/scripts/menu-ux-disposable-product-checks.sql b/scripts/menu-ux-disposable-product-checks.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fcf8ddd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/menu-ux-disposable-product-checks.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+-- Disposable test baseline only. Exact Product CHECK expressions from
+-- 20261012000000_product_configuration_network/migration.sql (Stage 2C).
+-- Run only against a fresh local ordersawa_stage3_* database.
+DO $$ BEGIN
+  IF current_database() NOT LIKE 'ordersawa_stage3_%'
+    OR host(inet_server_addr()) <> '127.0.0.1'
+    OR inet_server_port() <> 55440 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Disposable PostgreSQL on loopback port 55440 required';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+ALTER TABLE "Product"
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_configurationVersion_nonnegative_check"
+    CHECK ("configurationVersion" >= 0) NOT VALID,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_basePrice_nonnegative_check"
+    CHECK ("basePrice" IS NULL OR "basePrice" >= 0) NOT VALID,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_legacy_state_check"
+    CHECK (
+      ("configurationTree" IS NULL AND "configurationVersion" = 0 AND "basePrice" IS NOT NULL)
+      OR
+      ("configurationTree" IS NOT NULL AND "configurationVersion" >= 1)
+    ) NOT VALID,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_shape_check"
+    CHECK (
+      "configurationTree" IS NULL
+      OR (
+        jsonb_typeof("configurationTree") = 'object'
+        AND "configurationTree" ?& ARRAY['schemaVersion', 'productId', 'revision', 'basePrice', 'groups']
+        AND "configurationTree" @> '{"schemaVersion":1}'::jsonb
+        AND "configurationTree" ->> 'productId' = "id"
+        AND "configurationTree" ->> 'revision' = "configurationVersion"::text
+        AND jsonb_typeof("configurationTree" -> 'groups') = 'array'
+      )
+    ) NOT VALID,
+  ADD CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_basePrice_match_check"
+    CHECK (
+      "configurationTree" IS NULL
+      OR CASE
+        WHEN "configurationTree" -> 'basePrice' = 'null'::jsonb
+          THEN "basePrice" IS NULL
+        WHEN jsonb_typeof("configurationTree" -> 'basePrice') = 'string'
+          AND ("configurationTree" ->> 'basePrice') ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})(\.[0-9]{1,6})?$'
+          THEN "basePrice" = ("configurationTree" ->> 'basePrice')::DECIMAL(24, 6)
+        ELSE false
+      END
+    ) NOT VALID;
+
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_configurationVersion_nonnegative_check";
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_basePrice_nonnegative_check";
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_legacy_state_check";
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_shape_check";
+ALTER TABLE "Product" VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "Product_configuration_basePrice_match_check";
diff --git a/scripts/network-cart-ux-browser-regression.mjs b/scripts/network-cart-ux-browser-regression.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..00aca26
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/network-cart-ux-browser-regression.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,362 @@
+// Manual browser regression against the isolated local OrderSawa demo only.
+// CART_UX_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3101 node scripts/network-cart-ux-browser-regression.mjs
+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { mkdtemp, mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
+import { setTimeout as pause } from "node:timers/promises";
+import { createSelectionKey } from "@menu/shared";
+
+const origin = process.env.CART_UX_ORIGIN ?? "http://192.168.178.69:3200";
+const parsed = new URL(origin);
+if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" || ![["127.0.0.1", "3101"], ["192.168.178.69", "3200"]].some(([host, port]) => parsed.hostname === host && parsed.port === port) || parsed.pathname !== "/") {
+  throw new Error("Only the isolated local demo origins are accepted.");
+}
+const output = resolve(process.cwd(), "docs/qa/network-cart");
+await mkdir(output, { recursive: true });
+const profile = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "ordersawa-cart-ux-"));
+const chrome = spawn(process.env.CHROME_PATH ?? "C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe", [
+  "--headless=new", "--disable-gpu", "--no-first-run", "--no-sandbox", "--remote-debugging-port=9238",
+  "--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1", "--remote-allow-origins=*", `--user-data-dir=${profile}`, "about:blank"
+], { windowsHide: true, stdio: "ignore" });
+let socket;
+try {
+  let target;
+  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 80; attempt += 1) {
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9238/json/list");
+      target = (await response.json()).find((entry) => entry.type === "page");
+      if (target) break;
+    } catch { /* Browser still starting. */ }
+    await pause(200);
+  }
+  if (!target) throw new Error("Chrome did not start");
+  socket = new WebSocket(target.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
+  await new Promise((ok, fail) => { socket.addEventListener("open", ok, { once: true }); socket.addEventListener("error", fail, { once: true }); });
+  let nextId = 0;
+  const pending = new Map();
+  const quoteRequests = [];
+  const checkoutRequests = [];
+  socket.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
+    const packet = JSON.parse(String(event.data));
+    if (packet.method === "Network.requestWillBeSent" && packet.params.request.url.includes("/quote")) quoteRequests.push(packet.params.request.url);
+    if (packet.method === "Network.requestWillBeSent" && packet.params.request.url.includes("/orders/whatsapp")) checkoutRequests.push(packet.params.request.url);
+    if (packet.method === "Network.requestWillBeSent" && packet.params.request.url.includes("/checkout/whatsapp/")) checkoutRequests.push(packet.params.request.url);
+    const request = pending.get(packet.id);
+    if (!request) return;
+    pending.delete(packet.id);
+    if (packet.error) request.reject(new Error(JSON.stringify(packet.error)));
+    else request.resolve(packet.result);
+  });
+  const cdp = (method, params = {}) => new Promise((ok, fail) => {
+    const id = ++nextId;
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => { pending.delete(id); fail(new Error(`CDP timeout: ${method}`)); }, 20000);
+    pending.set(id, { resolve: (value) => { clearTimeout(timer); ok(value); }, reject: (error) => { clearTimeout(timer); fail(error); } });
+    socket.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
+  });
+  const evalInPage = async (expression) => {
+    const result = await cdp("Runtime.evaluate", { expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true });
+    if (result.exceptionDetails) throw new Error(result.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? result.exceptionDetails.text);
+    return result.result.value;
+  };
+  const until = async (expression, label, tries = 80) => {
+    for (let i = 0; i < tries; i += 1) {
+      if (await evalInPage(expression)) return;
+      await pause(250);
+    }
+    throw new Error(`Timed out: ${label}; current page: ${await evalInPage("document.body.innerText.slice(0, 500)")}`);
+  };
+  const click = async (selector) => {
+    const found = await evalInPage(`(() => { const e = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(selector)}); e?.click(); return !!e; })()`);
+    if (!found) throw new Error(`Missing click target: ${selector}`);
+  };
+  const pizzaCard = "[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=NETWORK]')].find(e => e.querySelector('.menu-product-copy b')?.textContent.includes('بيتزا مارغريتا'))";
+  const clickPizza = async (selector) => {
+    const found = await evalInPage(`(() => { const e = (${pizzaCard})?.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(selector)}); e?.click(); return !!e; })()`);
+    if (!found) throw new Error(`Missing pizza control: ${selector}`);
+  };
+  const navigate = async (path) => {
+    await cdp("Page.navigate", { url: origin + path });
+    await until(`location.pathname === ${JSON.stringify(path.split("?")[0])} && document.readyState === 'complete'`, `navigate ${path}`, 120);
+  };
+  const shot = async (name) => {
+    await evalInPage("document.fonts.ready");
+    const screenshot = await cdp("Page.captureScreenshot", { format: "png", captureBeyondViewport: false });
+    await writeFile(join(output, name), Buffer.from(screenshot.data, "base64"));
+  };
+  const results = [];
+  await cdp("Page.enable"); await cdp("Runtime.enable"); await cdp("Network.enable");
+  await cdp("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", { width: 390, height: 900, deviceScaleFactor: 1, mobile: false });
+  await navigate("/m/preview-ordersawa/menu?category=demo-products&display=list");
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=NETWORK] .menu-product-quantity')", "Network quantity control");
+  await evalInPage("localStorage.removeItem('cart:preview-ordersawa:main')");
+  await navigate("/m/preview-ordersawa/menu?category=demo-products&display=list");
+  const menuState = await evalInPage(`(() => ({ legacy: !!document.querySelector('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=LEGACY] .menu-product-quantity'),
+    network: [...document.querySelectorAll('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=NETWORK]')].map(e => ({ name: e.querySelector('b')?.textContent, control: !!e.querySelector('.menu-product-quantity') })) }))()`);
+  if (!menuState.legacy || !menuState.network.some((line) => line.control)) throw new Error(`Missing menu controls: ${JSON.stringify(menuState)}`);
+  const rtlStarting = await evalInPage("(() => { const e = document.querySelector('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=NETWORK] .product-price em')?.parentElement; return { dir: e?.dir, parts: [...(e?.children || [])].map(n => n.textContent) }; })()");
+  if (rtlStarting.dir !== "rtl" || !rtlStarting.parts[0]?.includes("ابتداءً") || !rtlStarting.parts[1]?.trim()) {
+    throw new Error(`RTL starting price order differs: ${JSON.stringify(rtlStarting)}`);
+  }
+  results.push({ scenario: "menu quantity controls", menuState });
+  results.push({ scenario: "RTL starting price order", rtlStarting });
+  await shot("menu-network-stepper-390.png");
+  await clickPizza(".menu-product-quantity button:first-of-type");
+  await until("location.pathname.includes('/product/')", "Network + opens configuration");
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('[data-testid=public-product-configurator] [data-group-type=SIZE] [role=radio]')", "configuration loaded");
+  await click("[data-testid=public-product-configurator] [data-group-type=SIZE] [role=radio]:not([disabled])");
+  await evalInPage("document.querySelector('[data-testid=public-product-configurator] [aria-label*=\"زيادة جبنة\"]')?.click()");
+  await click(".product-bottom-cart-network .product-cart-link");
+  await until("!!JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cart:preview-ordersawa:main') || '{}').items?.some?.(item => item.mode === 'NETWORK')", "Network line saved");
+  results.push({ scenario: "Network configuration opened from +", path: await evalInPage("location.pathname") });
+  await navigate("/m/preview-ordersawa/cart");
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('.network-cart-item .network-cart-expand')", "Network cart line");
+  const collapsed = await evalInPage("({ image: !!document.querySelector('.network-cart-item > img, .network-cart-item > .product-image-placeholder'), expanded: document.querySelector('.network-cart-expand')?.getAttribute('aria-expanded'), choiceVisible: !document.querySelector('.network-cart-expanded')?.hidden, price: document.querySelector('.network-cart-item .product-price')?.innerText })");
+  if (!collapsed.image || collapsed.expanded !== "false" || collapsed.choiceVisible !== false || !collapsed.price) throw new Error(`Incorrect collapsed Network card: ${JSON.stringify(collapsed)}`);
+  const cardLayout = await evalInPage(`(() => { const card = document.querySelector('.network-cart-item'); const image = card.querySelector('img, .product-image-placeholder');
+    const rect = image.getBoundingClientRect(); return { ratio: rect.width / rect.height, note: !!card.querySelector('.cart-card-note input'), summary: !!card.querySelector('.network-cart-choice-summary') }; })()`);
+  if (Math.abs(cardLayout.ratio - 1) > 0.03 || !cardLayout.note || !cardLayout.summary) throw new Error(`Card layout differs: ${JSON.stringify(cardLayout)}`);
+  results.push({ scenario: "square card image and inline note", cardLayout });
+  const collapsedInvoice = await evalInPage("({ handle: !!document.querySelector('.cart-invoice-handle'), rows: document.querySelectorAll('.cart-invoice-lines .cart-invoice-line').length, images: document.querySelectorAll('.cart-invoice-scroll img').length })");
+  if (!collapsedInvoice.handle || collapsedInvoice.rows !== 1 || collapsedInvoice.images !== 0) throw new Error(`Invoice shell differs: ${JSON.stringify(collapsedInvoice)}`);
+  await click(".cart-invoice-handle");
+  await until("document.querySelector('.cart-invoice-handle')?.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'", "invoice expands");
+  await shot("network-cart-invoice-expanded-390.png");
+  await click(".cart-invoice-handle");
+  const handlePoint = await evalInPage("(() => { const r = document.querySelector('.cart-invoice-handle').getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.left + r.width / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2 }; })()");
+  await cdp("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mousePressed", x: handlePoint.x, y: handlePoint.y, button: "left", clickCount: 1 });
+  const dragHeights = [0];
+  dragHeights[0] = await evalInPage("document.querySelector('.cart-checkout-card').getBoundingClientRect().height");
+  for (const delta of [25, 55, 100]) {
+    await cdp("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mouseMoved", x: handlePoint.x, y: handlePoint.y - delta, button: "left", buttons: 1 });
+    await pause(40);
+    dragHeights.push(await evalInPage("document.querySelector('.cart-checkout-card').getBoundingClientRect().height"));
+    await shot(`invoice-drag-${delta}-390.png`);
+  }
+  if (!(dragHeights[0] < dragHeights[1] && dragHeights[1] < dragHeights[2] && dragHeights[2] <= dragHeights[3])) {
+    throw new Error(`Invoice did not follow the pointer progressively: ${JSON.stringify(dragHeights)}`);
+  }
+  await cdp("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mouseReleased", x: handlePoint.x, y: handlePoint.y - 100, button: "left", clickCount: 1 });
+  await until("document.querySelector('.cart-invoice-handle')?.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'", "invoice drag opens");
+  await pause(230);
+  const openPoint = await evalInPage("(() => { const r = document.querySelector('.cart-invoice-handle').getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: r.left + r.width / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2 }; })()");
+  await cdp("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mousePressed", x: openPoint.x, y: openPoint.y, button: "left", clickCount: 1 });
+  await cdp("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mouseMoved", x: openPoint.x, y: openPoint.y + 85, button: "left", buttons: 1 });
+  await cdp("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mouseReleased", x: openPoint.x, y: openPoint.y + 85, button: "left", clickCount: 1 });
+  await until("document.querySelector('.cart-invoice-handle')?.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false'", "invoice drag closes");
+  results.push({ scenario: "invoice follows drag progressively, then snaps closed and open", collapsedInvoice, dragHeights });
+  await shot("network-cart-collapsed-390.png");
+  await click(".network-cart-expand");
+  await until("document.querySelector('.network-cart-expanded')?.hidden === false", "expanded choices");
+  const expanded = await evalInPage("({ choices: document.querySelector('.network-cart-expanded')?.innerText, priceLines: document.querySelectorAll('.network-cart-selections .product-price').length })");
+  if (!expanded.choices || expanded.priceLines) throw new Error(`Expanded choices invalid: ${JSON.stringify(expanded)}`);
+  await shot("network-cart-expanded-390.png");
+  await click(".network-cart-edit");
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('.network-cart-editor [data-testid=public-product-configurator] [role=radio]')", "cart editor loaded");
+  const selectedBeforeCancel = await evalInPage("document.querySelector('.network-cart-editor [role=radio][aria-checked=true]')?.innerText");
+  if (!selectedBeforeCancel) throw new Error("Cart editor did not restore selected size");
+  await shot("network-cart-editor-390.png");
+  const cartBeforeCancel = await evalInPage("localStorage.getItem('cart:preview-ordersawa:main')");
+  await click(".network-cart-editor-cancel");
+  if (await evalInPage("!!document.querySelector('.network-cart-editor')")) throw new Error("Cancel did not close editor");

+// Manual, read-only browser regression for the isolated OrderSawa demo.
+// Example: CARD_QA_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3101 node scripts/product-card-browser-regression.mjs
+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { mkdtemp, mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
+import { setTimeout as pause } from "node:timers/promises";
+
+const origin = process.env.CARD_QA_ORIGIN ?? "http://127.0.0.1:3101";
+const url = new URL(origin);
+if (url.protocol !== "http:" || !["127.0.0.1", "192.168.178.69"].includes(url.hostname)
+  || !["3101", "3200"].includes(url.port) || url.pathname !== "/") {
+  throw new Error("This manual browser check accepts only the isolated local demo origin.");
+}
+
+const output = resolve(process.cwd(), "../work/product-card-qa");
+const profile = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "ordersawa-card-qa-"));
+await mkdir(output, { recursive: true });
+const chrome = spawn(process.env.CHROME_PATH ?? "C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe", [
+  "--headless=new", "--disable-gpu", "--no-first-run", "--no-sandbox",
+  "--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1", "--remote-debugging-port=9237",
+  "--remote-allow-origins=*", `--user-data-dir=${profile}`, "about:blank"
+], { windowsHide: true, stdio: "ignore" });
+
+let socket;
+try {
+  let target;
+  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 80; attempt += 1) {
+    try {
+      const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9237/json/list");
+      target = (await response.json()).find((entry) => entry.type === "page");
+      if (target) break;
+    } catch { /* Chrome is starting. */ }
+    await pause(200);
+  }
+  if (!target) throw new Error("Chrome debugger did not start");
+  socket = new WebSocket(target.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
+  await new Promise((ok, fail) => {
+    socket.addEventListener("open", ok, { once: true });
+    socket.addEventListener("error", fail, { once: true });
+  });
+
+  let nextId = 0;
+  const pending = new Map();
+  socket.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
+    const packet = JSON.parse(String(event.data));
+    const request = pending.get(packet.id);
+    if (!request) return;
+    pending.delete(packet.id);
+    if (packet.error) request.reject(new Error(JSON.stringify(packet.error)));
+    else request.resolve(packet.result);
+  });
+  const cdp = (method, params = {}) => new Promise((ok, fail) => {
+    const id = ++nextId;
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => { pending.delete(id); fail(new Error(`CDP timeout: ${method}`)); }, 20000);
+    pending.set(id, {
+      resolve: (value) => { clearTimeout(timer); ok(value); },
+      reject: (error) => { clearTimeout(timer); fail(error); }
+    });
+    socket.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
+  });
+  const evaluate = async (expression) => {
+    const packet = await cdp("Runtime.evaluate", { expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true });
+    if (packet.exceptionDetails) throw new Error(packet.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? packet.exceptionDetails.text);
+    return packet.result.value;
+  };
+  const until = async (expression, label, attempts = 50) => {
+    for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i += 1) {
+      if (await evaluate(expression)) return true;
+      await pause(200);
+    }
+    return false;
+  };
+  const click = async (selector) => {
+    const rect = await evaluate(`(() => { const r = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(selector)})?.getBoundingClientRect(); return r && { x: r.x + r.width / 2, y: r.y + r.height / 2 }; })()`);
+    if (!rect) throw new Error(`Missing click target: ${selector}`);
+    await cdp("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mousePressed", x: rect.x, y: rect.y, button: "left", clickCount: 1 });
+    await cdp("Input.dispatchMouseEvent", { type: "mouseReleased", x: rect.x, y: rect.y, button: "left", clickCount: 1 });
+  };
+  const navigateToMenu = async () => {
+    await cdp("Page.navigate", { url: `${origin}/m/preview-ordersawa/menu?category=demo-products&display=list` });
+    if (!await until("location.pathname === '/m/preview-ordersawa/menu' && document.readyState === 'complete'", "menu navigation", 100)) {
+      throw new Error(`Menu navigation failed: ${await evaluate("location.href")}`);
+    }
+    if (!await until("!!document.querySelector('.menu-product-row .menu-product-open')", "menu product row")) {
+      throw new Error("Menu product row did not render");
+    }
+  };
+
+  await cdp("Page.enable");
+  await cdp("Runtime.enable");
+  await cdp("Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument", { source: `
+    window.__cardQaClicks = [];
+    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => window.__cardQaClicks.push({
+      target: event.target?.tagName, card: !!event.target?.closest('.menu-product-open'),
+      time: Date.now()
+    }), true);
+  ` });
+
+  const results = [];
+  const originLabel = url.hostname === "127.0.0.1" ? "local" : "lan";
+  for (const width of [360, 390, 430, 1280]) {
+    await cdp("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", { width, height: 900, deviceScaleFactor: 1, mobile: false });
+    await navigateToMenu();
+    if (!await until("getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.menu-product-row .menu-product-open')).display === 'grid' && document.querySelector('.menu-category-chip > span:last-of-type').clientWidth > 0", `styles at ${width}px`)) {
+      throw new Error(`Styles did not finish loading at ${width}px`);
+    }
+    await evaluate("document.fonts.ready");
+    const metrics = await evaluate(`(() => {
+      const card = document.querySelector('.menu-product-row');
+      const button = card.querySelector('.menu-product-open');
+      const label = document.querySelector('.menu-category-chip > span:last-of-type');
+      const copy = card.querySelector('.menu-product-copy');
+      const price = card.querySelector('.product-price');
+      const title = card.querySelector('b');
+      const r = (element) => { const box = element.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: box.x, y: box.y, width: box.width, height: box.height, bottom: box.bottom }; };
+      return { width: innerWidth, card: r(card), button: r(button), copy: r(copy),
+        title: r(title), price: r(price), label: { text: label.innerText, scrollWidth: label.scrollWidth, clientWidth: label.clientWidth },
+        direction: document.querySelector('.public-screen')?.dir };
+    })()`);
+    const screenshot = await cdp("Page.captureScreenshot", { format: "png", captureBeyondViewport: false });
+    if (metrics.button.width < 200 || metrics.button.height < 94 || metrics.label.scrollWidth > metrics.label.clientWidth
+      || metrics.title.bottom >= metrics.price.y || metrics.price.bottom > metrics.card.bottom + 1) {
+      throw new Error(`Readability or hitbox failed at ${width}px: ${JSON.stringify(metrics)}`);
+    }
+    const imageName = `menu-after-${originLabel}-${width}.png`;
+    await writeFile(join(output, imageName), Buffer.from(screenshot.data, "base64"));
+    results.push({ width, metrics, screenshot: imageName });
+  }
+
+  await cdp("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", { width: 390, height: 900, deviceScaleFactor: 1, mobile: false });
+  await navigateToMenu();
+  await pause(1200);
+  await click(".menu-product-row .menu-product-open b");

+  if (!navigated) throw new Error(`Product title click did not navigate: ${JSON.stringify(clickEvents)}`);
+  results.push({ scenario: "click product title", clickEvents, navigated, path: await evaluate("location.pathname") });
+
+  await navigateToMenu();
+  await pause(1200);
+  await click(".menu-product-row .menu-product-image-link");
+  const imageNavigated = await until("location.pathname.startsWith('/m/preview-ordersawa/product/')", "image to details", 80);
+  if (!imageNavigated) throw new Error("Product image click did not navigate");
+  results.push({ scenario: "click product image", navigated: imageNavigated });
+
+  await navigateToMenu();
+  await pause(1200);
+  await evaluate("document.querySelector('.menu-product-row .menu-product-open').focus()");
+  await cdp("Input.dispatchKeyEvent", { type: "rawKeyDown", key: "Enter", code: "Enter", windowsVirtualKeyCode: 13, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 13 });
+  await cdp("Input.dispatchKeyEvent", { type: "char", key: "Enter", code: "Enter", text: "\r", unmodifiedText: "\r", windowsVirtualKeyCode: 13, nativeVirtualKeyCode: 13 });
+  await cdp("Input.dispatchKeyEvent", { type: "keyUp", key: "Enter", code: "Enter", windowsVirtualKeyCode: 13 });
+  const keyboardNavigated = await until("location.pathname.startsWith('/m/preview-ordersawa/product/')", "keyboard to details", 80);
+  if (!keyboardNavigated) throw new Error(`Keyboard Enter did not navigate: ${JSON.stringify(await evaluate("({ focused: document.activeElement?.outerHTML.slice(0,180), clicks: window.__cardQaClicks })"))}`);
+  results.push({ scenario: "keyboard Enter", navigated: keyboardNavigated });
+
+  await navigateToMenu();
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=LEGACY] .menu-product-quantity button')", "Legacy quantity control");
+  await pause(1200);
+  const beforeQuantity = await evaluate("document.querySelector('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=LEGACY] .menu-product-quantity strong')?.textContent");
+  await click(".menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=LEGACY] .menu-product-quantity button:first-of-type");
+  await until(`document.querySelector('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=LEGACY] .menu-product-quantity strong')?.textContent !== ${JSON.stringify(beforeQuantity)}`, "Legacy quantity increase");
+  const afterQuantity = await evaluate("document.querySelector('.menu-product-row[data-cart-mode=LEGACY] .menu-product-quantity strong')?.textContent");
+  const stillMenu = await evaluate("location.pathname.endsWith('/menu')");
+  if (!stillMenu || beforeQuantity === afterQuantity) throw new Error("Legacy quantity control navigated or did not update");

+  await click(".menu-view-switch button:first-of-type");

+
+  await evaluate("localStorage.setItem('language:preview-ordersawa', 'en')");

+  if (!touchNavigated) throw new Error("Touch did not open product details");
+  results.push({ scenario: "mobile touch", touchNavigated });

+} finally {
+  socket?.close();
+  chrome.kill();
+}
diff --git a/scripts/stage6d2b-browser-e2e.mjs b/scripts/stage6d2b-browser-e2e.mjs

+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { mkdtemp } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { resolve } from "node:path";
+import { setTimeout as pause } from "node:timers/promises";
+import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+
+// Stage 6D.3A extends the original Stage 6D.2B runner. It never accepts a real DB.
+const databaseUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
+const target = databaseUrl ? new URL(databaseUrl) : null;
+if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" || process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS !== "1"
+  || !target || target.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || target.port !== "55440"
+  || target.pathname !== "/ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3a_demo") {
+  throw new Error("Browser E2E requires the exact Stage 6D.3A disposable demo database and flag.");
+}
+const db = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: databaseUrl });
+const base = "http://127.0.0.1:3000/m/s6d2b-demo";
+const api = "http://127.0.0.1:5000/public/menus/s6d2b-demo/orders/network-test";
+const orderScope = { restaurantId: "s6d2b-demo-restaurant", source: "NETWORK_TEST" };
+const results = [];
+const originalState = new Map();
+const profile = await mkdtemp(resolve(process.cwd(), "../work/stage6d3a-chrome-"));
+const chromePath = process.env.CHROME_PATH ?? "C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe";
+const chrome = spawn(chromePath, ["--headless=new", "--disable-gpu", "--disable-software-rasterizer", "--disable-gpu-compositing",
+  "--disable-features=Vulkan,UseSkiaRenderer", "--no-sandbox", "--no-first-run", "--no-default-browser-check",
+  "--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1", "--remote-debugging-port=9223", "--remote-allow-origins=*",
+  `--user-data-dir=${profile}`, "about:blank"], { windowsHide: true, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] });
+let chromeStartupError = "";
+chrome.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => { chromeStartupError = (chromeStartupError + String(chunk)).slice(-2000); });
+let socket;
+
+function check(value, message) { if (!value) throw new Error(message); }
+async function waitForJson(path) {
+  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
+    for (const loopback of ["127.0.0.1", "[::1]"]) {
+      try { const response = await fetch(`http://${loopback}:9223${path}`); if (response.ok) return response.json(); }
+      catch { /* Chrome debugger is starting or Windows selected the other loopback family. */ }
+    }
+    await pause(200);
+  }
+  throw new Error(`Chrome loopback debugger did not start (exit ${chrome.exitCode ?? "running"}): ${chromeStartupError}`);
+}
+
+try {
+  const tabs = await waitForJson("/json/list");
+  const tab = tabs.find((entry) => entry.type === "page");
+  check(tab, "No Chrome page target");
+  socket = new WebSocket(tab.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
+  await new Promise((ok, fail) => { socket.addEventListener("open", ok, { once: true }); socket.addEventListener("error", fail, { once: true }); });
+  let sequence = 0;
+  const pending = new Map();
+  socket.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
+    const packet = JSON.parse(String(event.data));
+    const request = pending.get(packet.id);
+    if (!request) return;
+    pending.delete(packet.id);
+    if (packet.error) request.reject(new Error(JSON.stringify(packet.error)));
+    else request.resolve(packet.result);
+  });
+  const cdp = (method, params = {}) => new Promise((ok, fail) => {
+    const id = ++sequence;
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => { pending.delete(id); fail(new Error(`CDP timeout: ${method}`)); }, 12_000);
+    pending.set(id, { resolve: (value) => { clearTimeout(timer); ok(value); }, reject: (error) => { clearTimeout(timer); fail(error); } });
+    socket.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
+  });
+  const evaluate = async (expression) => {
+    const packet = await cdp("Runtime.evaluate", { expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true });
+    if (packet.exceptionDetails) throw new Error(packet.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? packet.exceptionDetails.text);
+    return packet.result.value;
+  };
+  const until = async (expression, description, timeout = 12_000) => {
+    const start = Date.now();
+    while (Date.now() - start < timeout) {
+      if (await evaluate(expression)) return;

+    }
+    throw new Error(`Timed out waiting for ${description}`);
+  };
+  const go = async (url, marker = "main") => {

+    await pause(500);
+  };
+  const button = async (fragment, position = 0) => {
+    const clicked = await evaluate(`(() => { const found=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(x=>x.innerText.includes(${JSON.stringify(fragment)})); const target=found[${position}]; if(!target || target.disabled)return false; target.click(); return true; })()`);
+    check(clicked, `Missing or disabled button: ${fragment} #${position}`);
+    await pause(150);
+  };
+  const aria = async (name) => {

+    check(clicked, `Missing or disabled aria button: ${name}`);
+    await pause(150);
+  };
+  const field = async (label, value) => {
+    const changed = await evaluate(`(() => { const wrapper=[...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find(x=>x.innerText.trim().startsWith(${JSON.stringify(label)})); const element=wrapper?.querySelector('input,textarea'); if(!element)return false; const prototype=element.tagName==='TEXTAREA'?HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype:HTMLInputElement.prototype; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(prototype,'value').set.call(element,${JSON.stringify(value)}); element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()`);
+    check(changed, `Missing field: ${label}`);
+    await pause(100);
+  };
+  const clearCart = async () => {
+    await go(`${base}/menu`);
+    await evaluate(`localStorage.removeItem('cart:s6d2b-demo:main')`);
+  };
+  const storedCart = () => evaluate(`JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cart:s6d2b-demo:main') || '{"items":[]}')`);
+  const addPizza = async () => {

+    await until(`[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')==='زيادة جبنة إضافية')`, "Pizza configurator");
+    await button("كبير");
+    await aria("زيادة جبنة إضافية");
+    await aria("زيادة باربكيو");
+    await button("تحقق وأضف");
+    await until(`JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cart:s6d2b-demo:main')||'{"items":[]}').items?.some(x=>x.productId==='s6d2b-pizza')`, "Pizza in Network Cart");
+  };
+  const addCombo = async () => {
+    await go(`${base}/product/combo`);
+    await until(`[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(x=>x.innerText.includes('كبير')).length>=2`, "Combo linked sizes");
+    await button("كبير", 1);
+    await button("تحقق وأضف");
+    await until(`JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cart:s6d2b-demo:main')||'{"items":[]}').items?.some(x=>x.productId==='s6d2b-combo')`, "Combo in Network Cart");
+  };
+  const openDemo = async () => {
+    await go(`${base}/network-order-test`, '[aria-label="Trusted Draft"], main');
+    await until(`document.body.innerText.includes('اطلب مسودة موثوقة')`, "test order form");
+    await until(`document.body.innerText.includes('ملاحظة الصنف') || document.body.innerText.includes('السلة فارغة')`, "hydrated test Cart");
+  };
+  const prepare = async (name = "Demo Customer") => {
+    await field("اسم الزبون", name);
+    await button("اطلب مسودة");
+    await until(`!!document.querySelector('[aria-label="Trusted Draft"]') || !!document.querySelector('[role="alert"]')`, "trusted draft or error");
+    return evaluate(`document.querySelector('[aria-label="Trusted Draft"]')?.innerText ?? ''`);
+  };
+  const accept = async () => { check(await evaluate(`(() => { const box=document.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]'); if(!box)return false; box.click(); return box.checked; })()`), "Consent checkbox unavailable"); };
+  const create = async () => { await button("إنشاء طلب تجريبي"); await until(`!!document.querySelector('[aria-label="WhatsApp Preview"]') || !!document.querySelector('[role="alert"]')`, "create outcome"); await pause(350); };
+  const orderCount = () => db.order.count({ where: orderScope });
+  const rememberProduct = async (id) => {
+    if (!originalState.has(id)) originalState.set(id, await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, select: { configurationTree: true, configurationVersion: true, isAvailable: true } }));
+    return structuredClone(originalState.get(id));
+  };
+  const restoreProducts = async () => {
+    for (const [id, state] of originalState) await db.product.update({ where: { id }, data: state });
+    originalState.clear();
+  };
+  const scenario = async (name, fn) => {
+    if (process.env.BROWSER_E2E_ONLY && !name.startsWith(process.env.BROWSER_E2E_ONLY)) return;
+    try { const outcome = await fn(); if (outcome === "skipped") { results.push({ name, status: "skipped" }); process.stdout.write(`SKIP ${name}\n`); } else { results.push({ name, status: "passed" }); process.stdout.write(`PASS ${name}\n`); } }
+    catch (error) { results.push({ name, status: "failed", reason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }); process.stderr.write(`FAIL ${name}: ${String(error)}\n`); }
+    finally { await restoreProducts(); }
+  };
+
+  await cdp("Page.enable");
+  await cdp("Runtime.enable");
+
+  await scenario("01 Pizza sizes and addons", async () => {

+  });
+  await scenario("02 Combo repeated linked instances", async () => {

+    check(instances.filter((x) => x.linkedSelection?.productId === "s6d2b-pizza").length === 2, "Repeated Pizza source missing");
+  });
+  await scenario("03 Cart persistence after reload", async () => {

+    check((await storedCart()).items.length === 2, "Cart lines lost after reload");
+  });
+  await scenario("04 Price change requires renewed acceptance and saved historical snapshot", async () => {
+    await clearCart(); await addPizza(); await addCombo(); await openDemo();
+    await field("ملاحظة الصنف", "No onion");
+    const draft = await prepare(); check(draft.includes("413.5 EGP"), "Initial trusted total differs");
+    await accept(); const before = await orderCount();
+    const state = await rememberProduct("s6d2b-pizza"); const changed = structuredClone(state.configurationTree);
+    changed.groups[0].sizes.find((size) => size.id === "demo-size-large").price = "155";
+    await db.product.update({ where: { id: "s6d2b-pizza" }, data: { configurationTree: changed } });
+    await create();
+    const changedDraft = await evaluate(`({text:document.querySelector('[aria-label="Trusted Draft"]')?.innerText||'',accepted:document.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]')?.checked,preview:!!document.querySelector('[aria-label="WhatsApp Preview"]')})`);
+    check(changedDraft.text.includes("423.5 EGP") && !changedDraft.accepted && !changedDraft.preview && await orderCount() === before, "Stale acceptance created an order");
+    await accept(); await create();

+    check(await orderCount() === before + 1 && message.includes("423.5 EGP") && message.includes("No onion"), "Accepted order or note missing");
+    check(message.includes("اختيارات المكوّن 1") && message.includes("اختيارات المكوّن 2") && message.includes("اختيارات المكوّن 3"), "Linked instance numbering repeated");
+    check(message.includes("دون تكلفة إضافية للحجم") && !/الحجم:.*مجاني/.test(message), "Linked zero size described as free");
+    const saved = await db.order.findFirstOrThrow({ where: orderScope, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, select: { id: true, cartSnapshot: true } });
+    check(saved.cartSnapshot.totalAmount === "423.5", "Database snapshot total differs");
+    await restoreProducts();

+    check(historical.data?.message === message, "Catalog change rewrote historical message");

+  });
+  await scenario("05 Configuration revision change", async () => {

+    const before = await orderCount(); const state = await rememberProduct("s6d2b-pizza"); const revised = structuredClone(state.configurationTree);
+    revised.revision += 1;

+  });
+  await scenario("06 Availability change", async () => {
+    await clearCart(); await addPizza(); await openDemo(); await prepare(); await accept();
+    const before = await orderCount(); await rememberProduct("s6d2b-pizza");

+    await openDemo();
+    await until(`document.body.innerText.includes('Legacy Demo')`, "mixed Cart hydration");
+    check(await evaluate(`!!document.querySelector('[role="alert"]') && [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.innerText.includes('اطلب مسودة'))?.disabled`), "Mixed Cart could request Draft");
+    await go(`${base}/cart`);
+    check(!await evaluate(`[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(x=>x.innerText.includes('إرسال عبر WhatsApp'))`), "Mixed Cart exposed Legacy send");
+  });
+  await scenario("13 Test flag disabled API", async () => {
+    const guardOffApi = process.env.GUARD_OFF_API_URL;
+    if (!guardOffApi) return "skipped";
+    await go(`${base}/menu`);
+    const status = await evaluate(`(async()=>{const response=await fetch(${JSON.stringify(`${guardOffApi}/public/menus/s6d2b-demo/orders/network-test/prepare`)},{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:'{}'});return response.status;})()`);
+    check(status === 403, `Flag-off API returned HTTP ${status}`);
+  });
+  await scenario("14 Legacy Checkout remains visible", async () => {
+    await clearCart(); await go(`${base}/product/legacy`);
+    await until(`document.body.innerText.includes('Legacy Demo')`, "Legacy product");
+    await until(`localStorage.getItem('cart:s6d2b-demo:main') !== null`, "hydrated Legacy cart");
+    await until(`[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')==='+ Legacy Demo')`, "Legacy quantity control");
+    await aria("+ Legacy Demo");
+    await pause(500);
+    const stored = await evaluate(`({cart:localStorage.getItem('cart:s6d2b-demo:main'),text:document.body.innerText.slice(-800)})`);
+    check(stored.cart && JSON.parse(stored.cart).items?.some((x) => x.mode === "LEGACY"), `Legacy item not stored after quantity click: ${JSON.stringify(stored)}`);
+    await go(`${base}/cart`);
+    check((await storedCart()).items.some((x) => x.mode === "LEGACY"), "Legacy item not persisted");
+    check(await evaluate(`document.body.innerText.includes('تأكيد الطلب') || document.body.innerText.includes('Confirm order')`), "Legacy Checkout UI missing");
+  });
+  await scenario("15 RTL mobile 390px", async () => {
+    await clearCart(); await addPizza(); await openDemo();
+    await cdp("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", { width: 390, height: 844, deviceScaleFactor: 1, mobile: true });
+    const layout = await evaluate(`({rtl:document.querySelector('main')?.getAttribute('dir'),overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth-window.innerWidth})`);
+    check(layout.rtl === "rtl" && layout.overflow <= 2, `Mobile/RTL issue: ${JSON.stringify(layout)}`);
+  });
+
+  const passed = results.filter((entry) => entry.status === "passed").length;
+  const failed = results.filter((entry) => entry.status === "failed").length;
+  const skipped = results.filter((entry) => entry.status === "skipped").length;
+  process.stdout.write(`BROWSER_E2E_RESULT ${JSON.stringify({ passed, failed, skipped, scenarios: results })}\n`);
+  if (failed) process.exitCode = 1;
+} finally {
+  for (const [id, state] of originalState) await db.product.update({ where: { id }, data: state });
+  await db.$disconnect();
+  socket?.close();
+  chrome.kill();
+}

+/**
+ * Manual, bounded Stage 6D.3C3 benchmark. Run only after building Shared and API.

+ * This file is intentionally excluded from the ordinary test suite.
+ */
+import { createRequire } from "node:module";
+import os from "node:os";
+import { performance } from "node:perf_hooks";

+const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);

+const { PublicMenuService } = require("../apps/api/dist/modules/public-menu/public-menu.service.js");
+const { PublicMenuController } = require("../apps/api/dist/modules/public-menu/public-menu.controller.js");

+const { NetworkOrdersController, NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard } = require("../apps/api/dist/modules/orders/network-orders.controller.js");
+const { multiplyMoney } = require("@menu/shared");
+
+const runtimeGuardMode = process.env.STAGE6D3C3F_RUNTIME_GUARD_BENCH === "1";
+const exactDatabase = runtimeGuardMode

+  : "ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3_bench";
+const databaseUrl = runtimeGuardMode ? process.env.STAGE6D3C3F_DATABASE_URL : process.env.STAGE6D3C3_DATABASE_URL;
+if (!databaseUrl || process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" || process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS !== "1") {
+  throw new Error("Stage 6D.3C3 requires an explicit disposable URL, non-Production mode, and the test-only order flag");
+}
+const parsed = new URL(databaseUrl);
+if (parsed.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || parsed.port !== "55440" || parsed.pathname !== `/${exactDatabase}`) {
+  throw new Error("Stage 6D.3C3 refuses a non-disposable database URL");
+}
+
+const restaurantId = "s6d3c3-restaurant";
+const slug = "s6d3c3";
+const pizzaId = "s6d3c3-pizza";
+const sourceId = "s6d3c3-source";
+const comboId = "s6d3c3-combo";
+const unrelatedId = "s6d3c3-unrelated";
+const otherRestaurant = "s6d3c3-other";
+const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
+const limitMs = 45_000;
+const rssLimitMb = 1_200;
+const onlySize = process.env.STAGE6D3C3_ONLY_SIZE;
+const diagnosticMode = process.env.STAGE6D3C3_DIAG === "1";
+if (onlySize && !["10", "100", "1000", "10000"].includes(onlySize)) {
+  throw new Error("STAGE6D3C3_ONLY_SIZE must be one approved bounded catalog size");
+}
+const result = { environment: {}, catalog: [], concurrency: [], complex: [], locking: [], correctness: [], stopped: null };
+
+const pizza = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: pizzaId, revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [
+    { id: "small", label: "Small", price: "100" },
+    { id: "medium", label: "Medium", price: "200.000001" },
+    { id: "large", label: "Large", price: "300" }
+  ] },
+  { type: "OPTIONS", id: "toppings", label: "Toppings", min: 0, max: 3, includedQuantity: 1,
+    options: [{ id: "cheese", label: "Cheese", price: "30.000001", maxQuantity: 3,
+      children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "sauces", label: "Sauces", min: 0, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0,
+        options: [{ id: "bbq", label: "BBQ", price: "5.000001", maxQuantity: 1 }] }] }] }
+] };
+const source = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: sourceId, revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", id: "source-sizes", label: "Source Sizes", sizes: [
+    { id: "source-small", label: "Small", price: "100" },
+    { id: "source-large", label: "Large", price: "200" }
+  ] }
+] };
+const combo = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: comboId, revision: 1, basePrice: "0", groups: [
+  { type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: "Combo Slots", min: 3, max: 3, includedQuantity: 0, options: [
+    { id: "original", label: "Original Pizza", price: "10", maxQuantity: 2,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: sourceId, mode: "ORIGINAL", originalPriceOverrides: { "source-small": "5", "source-large": "8" } } },
+    { id: "custom", label: "Custom Pizza", price: "3", maxQuantity: 1,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: sourceId, mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: {
+        schemaVersion: 1, productId: sourceId, revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+          { type: "SIZE", id: "custom-sizes", label: "Custom Sizes", sizes: [{ id: "custom-medium", label: "Medium", price: "7" }] }
+        ]
+      } } }
+  ] }
+] };
+const pizzaSelection = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: pizzaId, configurationRevision: 1, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" },
+  { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "toppings", instances: [
+    { instanceId: "cheese-1", optionId: "cheese", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "sauces", instances: [{ instanceId: "sauce-1", optionId: "bbq" }] }] },
+    { instanceId: "cheese-2", optionId: "cheese" },
+    { instanceId: "cheese-3", optionId: "cheese" }
+  ] }
+] };
+const comboSelection = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: comboId, configurationRevision: 1, groups: [
+  { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "slots", instances: [
+    { instanceId: "original-1", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: sourceId,
+      configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-small" }] } },
+    { instanceId: "original-2", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: sourceId,
+      configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-large" }] } },
+    { instanceId: "custom-1", optionId: "custom", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1, productId: sourceId,
+      configurationRevision: 1, groups: [{ type: "SIZE", groupId: "custom-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "custom-medium" }] } }
+  ] }
+] };
+
+const cases = {
+  pizza: { productId: pizzaId, selection: pizzaSelection, total: "265.000004" },
+  combo: { productId: comboId, selection: comboSelection, total: "43" }
+};
+const fifty = { lines: Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => ({ productId: pizzaId, quantity: 1, selection: pizzaSelection })),
+  total: multiplyMoney(cases.pizza.total, 50) };
+const ten = { lines: fifty.lines.slice(0, 10), total: multiplyMoney(cases.pizza.total, 10) };
+
+function percentile(values, fraction) {
+  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
+  return sorted.length ? +sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length * fraction) - 1].toFixed(2) : null;
+}
+function summary(values) {
+  return { median: percentile(values, 0.5), p95: values.length >= 20 ? percentile(values, 0.95) : null,
+    max: percentile(values, 1) };
+}
+function median(values) { return summary(values).median; }
+async function withTimeout(promise, ms, label) {
+  let timer;
+  try {
+    return await Promise.race([promise, new Promise((_, reject) => {
+      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`${label} timed out after ${ms} ms`)), ms);
+    })]);
+  } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
+}
+
+const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: databaseUrl, log: [{ emit: "event", level: "query" }] });
+const observer = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: databaseUrl });
+let app;
+let origin;
+let active = null;
+let hold = null;
+
+prisma.$on("query", (event) => {
+  if (!active) return;
+  active.queries += 1;
+  active.queryMs += event.duration;
+  if (/FOR SHARE/i.test(event.query)) active.forShare += 1;
+});
+
+const db = new Proxy(prisma, { get(target, key) {
+  if (key === "$transaction") return async (work, options) => {
+    const began = performance.now();
+    let callbackReturned = false;
+    if (active) active.transactions += 1;
+    try {
+      return await target.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
+        const value = await work(transaction);
+        callbackReturned = true;
+        if (hold) {
+          const latch = hold;
+          latch.arrivals += 1;
+          if (latch.arrivals >= latch.expected) latch.arrived();
+          await latch.releasePromise;
+        }
+        return value;
+      }, options);
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (active) {
+        const code = String(error?.code ?? "UNKNOWN");
+        const stage = callbackReturned ? "commit_or_after_callback" : "statement_or_callback";
+        active.errorCodes[code] = (active.errorCodes[code] ?? 0) + 1;
+        active.errorStages[stage] = (active.errorStages[stage] ?? 0) + 1;
+      }
+      if (active && (error?.code === "P2034" || (error?.code === "P2010" && ["40001", "40P01"].includes(error.meta?.code)))) {
+        active.serializationConflicts += 1;
+      }
+      throw error;
+    } finally {
+      if (active) active.transactionMs.push(performance.now() - began);
+    }
+  };
+  const value = Reflect.get(target, key, target);
+  return typeof value === "function" ? value.bind(target) : value;
+} });
+
+async function verifyTarget() {
+  const [row] = await observer.$queryRaw`SELECT current_database() AS name, host(inet_server_addr()) AS address,
+    inet_server_port() AS port, version() AS version`;
+  if (row?.name !== exactDatabase || row.address !== "127.0.0.1" || row.port !== 55440) {
+    throw new Error("Actual database identity does not match the dedicated disposable target");
+  }
+  const existing = await observer.restaurant.count();
+  if (existing !== 0) throw new Error("Benchmark refuses a database with pre-existing Restaurant rows; create a new disposable database");
+  result.environment = { node: process.version, platform: process.platform, arch: process.arch,
+    logicalCpus: os.cpus().length, totalMemoryGb: +(os.totalmem() / 1024 ** 3).toFixed(2),
+    postgresql: row.version, database: row.name, address: row.address, port: row.port,
+    nodeOldSpaceLimit: "not explicitly set", requestTimeoutMs: limitMs, rssStopMb: rssLimitMb };
+}
+
+async function seedBase() {
+  await observer.restaurant.createMany({ data: [
+    { id: restaurantId, slug, name: "Benchmark restaurant", currency: "EGP" },
+    { id: otherRestaurant, slug: "s6d3c3-other", name: "Other benchmark tenant", currency: "EGP" }
+  ] });
+  await observer.subscriptionPlan.create({ data: { id: "s6d3c3-plan", key: "S6D3C3_TEST", name: "Benchmark plan",
+    features: { create: { id: "s6d3c3-feature", key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true } } } });
+  await observer.restaurantSubscription.create({ data: { id: "s6d3c3-sub", restaurantId,
+    planId: "s6d3c3-plan", status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") } });
+  await observer.product.createMany({ data: [
+    { id: pizzaId, restaurantId, slug: "pizza", name: "Pizza", currency: "EGP", basePrice: null,
+      configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: pizza },
+    { id: sourceId, restaurantId, slug: "source", name: "Linked source", currency: "EGP", basePrice: null,
+      configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: source },
+    { id: comboId, restaurantId, slug: "combo", name: "Combo", currency: "EGP", basePrice: "0",
+      configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: combo },
+    { id: unrelatedId, restaurantId, slug: "unrelated", name: "Unrelated product B", currency: "EGP", basePrice: "1" },
+    { id: "s6d3c3-foreign", restaurantId: otherRestaurant, slug: "foreign", name: "Foreign", currency: "EGP", basePrice: "1" }
+  ] });
+  class BenchmarkModule {}
+  Module({ controllers: [PublicMenuController, NetworkOrdersController], providers: [
+    PublicMenuService, FeatureFlagsService, NetworkOrdersService, NetworkOrderLoopbackGuard,
+    { provide: PrismaService, useValue: db }, { provide: ConfigService, useValue: { get: () => undefined } }
+  ] })(BenchmarkModule);
+  app = await NestFactory.create(BenchmarkModule, { logger: false });
+  await app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1");
+  origin = await app.getUrl();
+}
+
+async function growCatalog(target, tenantId = restaurantId) {
+  const current = await observer.product.count({ where: { restaurantId: tenantId } });
+  const started = performance.now();
+  for (let index = current; index < target; index += 500) {
+    const batch = Array.from({ length: Math.min(500, target - index) }, (_, offset) => {
+      const id = `s6d3c3-legacy-${tenantId}-${index + offset}`;
+      return { id, restaurantId: tenantId, slug: id, name: `Legacy ${index + offset}`, currency: "EGP", basePrice: "1" };
+    });
+    await observer.product.createMany({ data: batch });
+  }
+  const actual = await observer.product.count({ where: { restaurantId: tenantId } });
+  if (actual !== target) throw new Error(`Fixture count ${actual} differs from target ${target}`);
+  return +(performance.now() - started).toFixed(2);
+}
+
+async function post(path, body) {
+  const started = performance.now();
+  try {
+    const response = await fetch(`${origin}${path}`, { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
+      body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(limitMs) });
+    return { duration: performance.now() - started, status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
+  } catch (error) {
+    return { duration: performance.now() - started, status: -1, body: { error: String(error?.name ?? error) } };
+  }
+}
+
+function payload(kind, scenario, index) {
+  const chosen = scenario === "combo" ? cases.combo : cases.pizza;
+  const lines = scenario === "fifty" ? fifty.lines : scenario === "ten" ? ten.lines
+    : [{ productId: chosen.productId, quantity: 1, selection: chosen.selection }];
+  if (kind === "quote") return { path: `/public/menus/${slug}/products/${chosen.productId}/quote`, body: { selection: chosen.selection }, total: chosen.total };
+  const body = { locale: "en", items: lines, orderNote: `Benchmark ${index}-${randomUUID()}` };
+  return { path: `/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/${kind === "prepare" ? "prepare" : ""}`, body,
+    total: scenario === "fifty" ? fifty.total : scenario === "ten" ? ten.total : chosen.total };
+}
+
+async function activitySampler(stop) {
+  const peak = { connections: 0, lockWaiting: 0, rssMb: 0, heapMb: 0 };
+  while (!stop.done) {
+    try {
+      const [row] = await observer.$queryRaw`SELECT count(*)::int AS connections,
+        count(*) FILTER (WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock')::int AS waiting
+        FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database()`;
+      peak.connections = Math.max(peak.connections, row.connections);
+      peak.lockWaiting = Math.max(peak.lockWaiting, row.waiting);
+    } catch { /* Sampler must not change a request result; failures are reported as missing samples. */ }
+    peak.rssMb = Math.max(peak.rssMb, process.memoryUsage().rss / 1024 ** 2);
+    peak.heapMb = Math.max(peak.heapMb, process.memoryUsage().heapUsed / 1024 ** 2);
+    await pause(25);
+  }
+  return peak;
+}
+
+async function wave(kind, scenario, count, label, measure = true, requestFactory = payload) {
+  const requests = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => requestFactory(kind, scenario, index));
+  if (kind === "create") {
+    for (const request of requests) {
+      const prepared = await post(`${request.path}prepare`, request.body);
+      if (prepared.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Create setup Prepare failed: ${prepared.status} ${prepared.body.error}`);
+      request.body = { ...request.body, acceptanceToken: prepared.body.acceptanceToken, idempotencyKey: randomUUID() };
+    }
+  }
+  const orderCountBefore = await observer.order.count({ where: { source: "NETWORK_TEST" } });
+  const metrics = { queries: 0, queryMs: 0, forShare: 0, transactions: 0, transactionMs: [],
+    serializationConflicts: 0, errorCodes: {}, errorStages: {} };
+  const stop = { done: !measure };
+  if (measure) active = metrics;
+  const sample = measure ? activitySampler(stop) : Promise.resolve(null);
+  const responses = await Promise.all(requests.map((request) => post(request.path, request.body)));
+  stop.done = true;
+  const peak = await sample;
+  await pause(20); // Let Prisma query-log events from the completed wave flush.
+  active = null;
+  const accepted = [];
+  const conflicts = [];
+  for (const [index, response] of responses.entries()) {
+    const expected = requests[index].total;
+    const total = kind === "quote" ? response.body.trustedTotal
+      : kind === "prepare" ? response.body.draft?.totalAmount : response.body.totalAmount;
+    if (response.status === (kind === "create" ? 201 : 200)
+      && total === expected && response.body.orderingEnabled === false) {
+      accepted.push(response);
+    } else if ((kind === "prepare" || kind === "create") && response.status === 409
+      && response.body.error === "NETWORK_ORDER_CONCURRENT_UPDATE"
+      && response.body.orderId === undefined) {
+      conflicts.push(response);
+    } else {
+      throw new Error(`${label}: ${kind} unsafe or unexpected response: HTTP ${response.status}, total ${total}, error ${response.body.error}`);
+    }
+  }
+  const orderCountAfter = await observer.order.count({ where: { source: "NETWORK_TEST" } });
+  if (orderCountAfter - orderCountBefore !== (kind === "create" ? accepted.length : 0)) {
+    throw new Error(`${label}: unexpected number of persisted Orders`);
+  }
+  if (kind === "create") {
+    const ids = accepted.map((response) => response.body.orderId);
+    if (new Set(ids).size !== accepted.length) throw new Error(`${label}: duplicate Order ID`);
+    const saved = await observer.order.findMany({ where: { id: { in: ids }, source: "NETWORK_TEST" },
+      select: { id: true, totalAmount: true, cartSnapshot: true, networkSnapshotSealedAt: true, items: { select: { options: true } } } });
+    const expectedByOrder = new Map(responses.flatMap((response, index) => response.body.orderId
+      ? [[response.body.orderId, requests[index].total]] : []));
+    if (saved.length !== accepted.length || saved.some((order) => order.totalAmount.toString() !== expectedByOrder.get(order.id)
+      || !order.networkSnapshotSealedAt || order.items.length !== (scenario === "fifty" ? 50 : scenario === "ten" ? 10 : 1)
+      || order.cartSnapshot?.totalAmount !== expectedByOrder.get(order.id))) throw new Error(`${label}: saved Snapshot mismatch`);
+    if (scenario === "combo" && saved.some((order) => order.cartSnapshot?.items?.[0]?.canonicalSelection?.groups?.[0]?.instances?.length !== 3)) {
+      throw new Error(`${label}: repeated Linked selections missing from saved Snapshot`);
+    }
+  }
+  if (!measure) return null;
+  const latencies = responses.map((response) => response.duration);
+  const row = { label, kind, scenario, concurrency: count, samples: count, success: accepted.length,
+    latencyMs: summary(latencies), queryCount: metrics.queries, queriesPerRequest: +(metrics.queries / count).toFixed(2),
+    prismaQueryMsTotal: +metrics.queryMs.toFixed(2), forShareQueries: metrics.forShare,
+    transactionAttempts: metrics.transactions, transactionMs: summary(metrics.transactionMs),
+    transactionDurations: metrics.transactionMs,
+    serializationConflicts: metrics.serializationConflicts, httpConflicts: conflicts.length,
+    errorCodes: metrics.errorCodes, errorStages: metrics.errorStages,
+    peakConnections: peak.connections, peakLockWaiting: peak.lockWaiting,
+    peakRssMb: +peak.rssMb.toFixed(1), peakHeapMb: +peak.heapMb.toFixed(1), latencies };
+  if (row.peakRssMb > rssLimitMb || row.latencyMs.max > limitMs * 0.8) {
+    result.stopped = `Resource/latency threshold reached at ${label}: ${row.peakRssMb} MB RSS, ${row.latencyMs.max} ms maximum`;
+  }
+  return row;
+}
+
+async function series(kind, scenario, catalog, concurrency, waves, requestFactory = payload) {
+  await wave(kind, scenario, concurrency, `warmup-${catalog}-${kind}-${scenario}-${concurrency}`, false, requestFactory);
+  const rows = [];
+  for (let index = 0; index < waves && !result.stopped; index += 1) {
+    rows.push(await wave(kind, scenario, concurrency, `${catalog}-${kind}-${scenario}-${concurrency}-${index}`, true, requestFactory));
+  }
+  const all = rows.filter(Boolean);
+  if (!all.length) return null;
+  const combined = { catalog, kind, scenario, concurrency, samples: all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.samples, 0),
+    success: all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.success, 0),
+    httpConflicts: all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.httpConflicts, 0),
+    serializationConflicts: all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.serializationConflicts, 0),
+    errorCodes: Object.fromEntries([...new Set(all.flatMap((row) => Object.keys(row.errorCodes)))].map((code) =>
+      [code, all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.errorCodes[code] ?? 0), 0)])),
+    errorStages: Object.fromEntries([...new Set(all.flatMap((row) => Object.keys(row.errorStages)))].map((stage) =>
+      [stage, all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row.errorStages[stage] ?? 0), 0)])),
+    latencyMs: summary(all.flatMap((row) => row.latencies)),
+    avgQueriesPerRequest: +(all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.queryCount, 0) / all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.samples, 0)).toFixed(2),
+    avgPrismaQueryMsPerRequest: +(all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.prismaQueryMsTotal, 0) / all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.samples, 0)).toFixed(2),
+    avgForShareQueriesPerRequest: +(all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.forShareQueries, 0) / all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.samples, 0)).toFixed(2),
+    transactionMs: summary(all.flatMap((row) => row.transactionDurations)),
+    avgTransactionAttemptsPerRequest: +(all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.transactionAttempts, 0) / all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.samples, 0)).toFixed(2),
+    conflicts: all.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.serializationConflicts + row.httpConflicts, 0),
+    peakConnections: Math.max(...all.map((row) => row.peakConnections)),
+    peakLockWaiting: Math.max(...all.map((row) => row.peakLockWaiting)),
+    peakRssMb: Math.max(...all.map((row) => row.peakRssMb)),
+    peakHeapMb: Math.max(...all.map((row) => row.peakHeapMb)) };
+  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ series: combined })}\n`);
+  return combined;
+}
+
+async function lockTrial(catalog, concurrency) {
+  const baseline = [];
+  for (let index = 0; index < 3; index += 1) {
+    const started = performance.now();
+    await observer.product.update({ where: { id: unrelatedId }, data: { description: `baseline-${catalog}-${index}` } });
+    baseline.push(performance.now() - started);
+  }
+  let arrived;
+  let release;
+  const arrivedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => { arrived = resolve; });
+  const releasePromise = new Promise((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
+  hold = { expected: concurrency, arrivals: 0, arrived, releasePromise };
+  const drafts = Array.from({ length: concurrency }, (_, index) => payload("prepare", "pizza", index));
+  const readers = Promise.all(drafts.map((draft) => post(draft.path, draft.body)));
+  try {
+    await withTimeout(arrivedPromise, 30_000, "Prepare lock acquisition");
+    const writerStart = performance.now();
+    const writer = Promise.resolve(observer.product.update({ where: { id: unrelatedId }, data: { description: `blocked-${catalog}-${concurrency}` } }));
+    await pause(80);
+    const [waitState] = await observer.$queryRaw`SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock')::int AS waiting
+      FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database()`;
+    await pause(170); // Artificial 250-ms hold after the real Prepare callback acquired FOR SHARE.
+    release();
+    await writer;
+    const writerMs = performance.now() - writerStart;
+    const completed = await readers;
+    const failures = completed.filter((entry) => entry.status !== 200 || entry.body.draft?.totalAmount !== cases.pizza.total);
+    if (failures.length) throw new Error(`Lock trial Prepare failed: ${JSON.stringify(failures.map((entry) => entry.status))}`);
+    const row = { catalog, concurrency, artificialHoldMs: 250, baselineWriterMedianMs: median(baseline),
+      blockedWriterMs: +writerMs.toFixed(2), lockWaitersObserved: waitState.waiting,
+      prepareMaxMs: +Math.max(...completed.map((entry) => entry.duration)).toFixed(2) };
+    result.locking.push(row);
+    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ lockTrial: row })}\n`);
+  } finally {
+    release();
+    hold = null;
+    await readers;
+  }
+}
+
+async function correctnessChecks() {
+  const foreign = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/products/s6d3c3-foreign/quote`, { selection: pizzaSelection });
+  if (foreign.status !== 404) throw new Error(`Cross-tenant Quote unexpectedly returned ${foreign.status}`);
+  const invalid = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/prepare`, {
+    locale: "en", items: [{ productId: pizzaId, quantity: 1, selection: { ...pizzaSelection, configurationRevision: 999 } }]
+  });
+  if (invalid.status !== 409) throw new Error(`Stale selection unexpectedly returned ${invalid.status}`);
+  result.correctness.push({ crossTenantQuote: foreign.status, stalePrepare: invalid.status, orderingEnabled: false });
+}
+
+const diagnosticTenants = [restaurantId, otherRestaurant, "s6d3c3-tenant-2", "s6d3c3-tenant-3", "s6d3c3-tenant-4"];
+function tenantSlug(tenantId) { return tenantId === restaurantId ? slug : tenantId === otherRestaurant ? "s6d3c3-other" : tenantId; }
+
+async function seedDiagnosticVariants() {
+  await observer.restaurant.createMany({ data: diagnosticTenants.slice(2).map((id) =>
+    ({ id, slug: id, name: `Diagnostic ${id}`, currency: "EGP" })) });
+  await observer.restaurantSubscription.createMany({ data: diagnosticTenants.slice(1).map((id) =>
+    ({ id: `${id}-sub`, restaurantId: id, planId: "s6d3c3-plan", status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z") })) });
+  await observer.product.createMany({ data: [
+    ...Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, index) => {
+      const id = `s6d3c3-variant-${index}`;
+      return { id, restaurantId, slug: id, name: `Variant ${index}`, currency: "EGP", basePrice: null,
+        configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: { ...pizza, productId: id } };
+    }),
+    ...diagnosticTenants.slice(1).map((tenantId) => {
+      const id = `${tenantId}-pizza`;
+      return { id, restaurantId: tenantId, slug: id, name: `Pizza ${tenantId}`, currency: "EGP", basePrice: null,
+        configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: { ...pizza, productId: id } };
+    })
+  ] });
+}
+
+function diagnosticPayload(kind, scenario, index) {
+  const request = payload(kind, "pizza", index);
+  let ownerId = pizzaId;
+  let restaurantSlug = slug;
+  const selection = structuredClone(pizzaSelection);
+  if (scenario === "different_products") ownerId = `s6d3c3-variant-${index % 25}`;
+  if (scenario === "different_tenants") {
+    const tenantId = diagnosticTenants[index % diagnosticTenants.length];
+    restaurantSlug = tenantSlug(tenantId);
+    ownerId = tenantId === restaurantId ? pizzaId : `${tenantId}-pizza`;
+  }
+  if (scenario === "different_selections") {
+    const size = ["small", "medium", "large"][index % 3];
+    selection.groups[0].sizeChoiceId = size;
+    request.total = { small: "165.000003", medium: "265.000004", large: "365.000003" }[size];
+  }
+  selection.productId = ownerId;
+  request.path = `/public/menus/${restaurantSlug}/orders/network-test/${kind === "prepare" ? "prepare" : ""}`;
+  request.body.items[0] = { productId: ownerId, quantity: 1, selection };
+  return request;
+}
+
+async function idempotencyProbe() {
+  const draftBody = payload("prepare", "pizza", 0).body;
+  const prepared = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/prepare`, draftBody);
+  if (prepared.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Idempotency Prepare failed: ${prepared.status}`);
+  const body = { ...draftBody, acceptanceToken: prepared.body.acceptanceToken,
+    idempotencyKey: randomUUID() };
+  const before = await observer.order.count({ where: { source: "NETWORK_TEST" } });
+  const first = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/`, body);
+  const replay = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/`, body);
+  const after = await observer.order.count({ where: { source: "NETWORK_TEST" } });
+  if (first.status !== 201 || replay.status !== 201 || replay.body.replayed !== true
+    || first.body.orderId !== replay.body.orderId || after - before !== 1) {
+    throw new Error(`Idempotency replay did not preserve a single Order: ${first.status}/${replay.status}`);
+  }
+  const concurrentDraftBody = payload("prepare", "pizza", 1).body;
+  const concurrentPrepared = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/prepare`, concurrentDraftBody);
+  if (concurrentPrepared.status !== 200) throw new Error("Concurrent idempotency Prepare failed");
+  const concurrentBody = { ...concurrentDraftBody, acceptanceToken: concurrentPrepared.body.acceptanceToken,
+    idempotencyKey: randomUUID() };
+  const concurrentBefore = await observer.order.count({ where: { source: "NETWORK_TEST" } });
+  const attempts = await Promise.all([0, 1].map(() => post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/`, concurrentBody)));
+  const settled = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/`, concurrentBody);
+  const reusedToken = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/`, {
+    ...concurrentBody, idempotencyKey: randomUUID()
+  });
+  const concurrentAfter = await observer.order.count({ where: { source: "NETWORK_TEST" } });
+  if (attempts.some((response) => ![201, 409].includes(response.status)) || settled.status !== 201
+    || settled.body.replayed !== true || concurrentAfter - concurrentBefore !== 1
+    || attempts.some((response) => response.status === 201 && response.body.orderId !== settled.body.orderId)
+    || reusedToken.status !== 409 || reusedToken.body.error !== "ACCEPTANCE_TOKEN_ALREADY_USED") {
+    throw new Error(`Concurrent idempotency/token reuse contract failed: ${attempts.map((x) => x.status)}, ${settled.status}, ${reusedToken.status}`);
+  }
+  const row = { first: first.status, replay: replay.status, sameOrder: true, persisted: after - before,
+    concurrentStatuses: attempts.map((response) => response.status), settledReplay: settled.body.replayed,
+    concurrentPersisted: concurrentAfter - concurrentBefore, reusedToken: reusedToken.body.error };
+  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ idempotencyProbe: row })}\n`);
+  return row;
+}
+
+async function staleAcceptanceProbe() {
+  const body = payload("prepare", "pizza", 2).body;
+  const prepared = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/prepare`, body);
+  if (prepared.status !== 200) throw new Error("Stale acceptance Prepare failed");
+  const before = await observer.order.count({ where: { source: "NETWORK_TEST" } });
+  const changed = structuredClone(pizza);
+  changed.revision = 2;
+  changed.groups[0].sizes[1].price = "201.000001";
+  await observer.product.update({ where: { id: pizzaId }, data: {
+    configurationTree: changed, configurationVersion: 2
+  } });
+  const response = await post(`/public/menus/${slug}/orders/network-test/`, {
+    ...body, acceptanceToken: prepared.body.acceptanceToken, idempotencyKey: randomUUID()
+  });
+  const after = await observer.order.count({ where: { source: "NETWORK_TEST" } });
+  if (response.status !== 409 || after !== before || response.body.orderId !== undefined) {
+    throw new Error(`Stale acceptance was not safely rejected: ${response.status}`);
+  }
+  const row = { status: response.status, error: response.body.error, persisted: after - before };
+  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ staleAcceptanceProbe: row })}\n`);
+  return row;
+}
+
+async function storageProbe(kind, concurrency, tenantMode = "same") {
+  const label = `diagnostic-${kind}-${concurrency}-${randomUUID()}`;
+  const responses = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, async (_, index) => {
+    const idempotencyKey = `${label}-${index}`;
+    const probeRestaurantId = tenantMode === "spread" ? diagnosticTenants[index % diagnosticTenants.length] : restaurantId;
+    try {
+      await observer.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
+        if (["read_misses", "read_then_order", "read_idempotency_then_order", "read_then_order_with_item"].includes(kind)) {
+          await transaction.order.findUnique({ where: { restaurantId_idempotencyKey: {
+            restaurantId: probeRestaurantId, idempotencyKey } } });
+        }
+        if (["read_misses", "read_then_order", "read_token_then_order", "read_then_order_with_item"].includes(kind)) {
+          await transaction.order.findUnique({ where: { restaurantId_acceptanceTokenHash: {
+            restaurantId: probeRestaurantId, acceptanceTokenHash: idempotencyKey } } });
+        }
+        if (kind !== "read_misses") {
+          await transaction.order.create({ data: { restaurantId: probeRestaurantId, totalAmount: "0", currency: "EGP",
+            status: "VALIDATED_TEST", source: "DIAGNOSTIC", idempotencyKey,
+            acceptanceTokenHash: idempotencyKey,
+            ...(["order_with_item", "read_then_order_with_item"].includes(kind) ? { items: { create: [{ name: "Diagnostic", quantity: 1,
+              unitPrice: "0", totalPrice: "0" }] } } : {}) } });
+        }
+      }, { isolationLevel: "Serializable", maxWait: 10_000, timeout: 20_000 });
+      return "ok";
+    } catch (error) { return String(error?.code ?? "UNKNOWN"); }
+  }));
+  const codes = Object.fromEntries([...new Set(responses)].map((code) => [code, responses.filter((item) => item === code).length]));
+  const row = { kind, concurrency, tenantMode, codes };
+  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ storageProbe: row })}\n`);
+  return row;
+}
+
+async function predicateLockProbe() {
+  let reached;
+  let release;
+  const reachedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => { reached = resolve; });
+  const releasePromise = new Promise((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
+  const key = `predicate-${randomUUID()}`;
+  const reader = observer.$transaction(async (transaction) => {
+    const [backend] = await transaction.$queryRaw`SELECT pg_backend_pid()::int AS pid`;
+    await transaction.order.findUnique({ where: { restaurantId_idempotencyKey: { restaurantId, idempotencyKey: key } } });
+    await transaction.order.findUnique({ where: { restaurantId_acceptanceTokenHash: {
+      restaurantId, acceptanceTokenHash: key } } });
+    reached(backend.pid);
+    await releasePromise;
+  }, { isolationLevel: "Serializable", maxWait: 10_000, timeout: 20_000 });
+  try {
+    const pid = await withTimeout(reachedPromise, 10_000, "Predicate read");
+    const locks = await observer.$queryRaw`SELECT l.locktype, l.mode, c.relname AS relation,
+      count(*)::int AS count FROM pg_locks l LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = l.relation
+      WHERE l.pid = ${pid} AND l.mode = 'SIReadLock'
+      GROUP BY l.locktype, l.mode, c.relname ORDER BY c.relname`;
+    const row = { locks };
+    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ predicateLockProbe: row })}\n`);
+    return row;
+  } finally { release(); await reader; }
+}
+
+async function probeOnlyRun() {
+  await seedDiagnosticVariants();
+  for (const tenantId of diagnosticTenants) await growCatalog(100, tenantId);
+  await predicateLockProbe();
+  for (const kind of ["read_misses", "order_only", "read_idempotency_then_order",
+    "read_token_then_order", "read_then_order", "order_with_item", "read_then_order_with_item"]) {
+    await storageProbe(kind, 25);
+  }
+  await storageProbe("read_then_order", 5, "spread");
+  await storageProbe("read_then_order", 25, "spread");
+  await idempotencyProbe();
+  await staleAcceptanceProbe();
+}
+
+async function diagnosticRun() {
+  await seedDiagnosticVariants();
+  const diagnostics = { waves: [], storage: [], idempotency: null };
+  for (const size of [100, 1_000]) {
+    for (const tenantId of diagnosticTenants) await growCatalog(size, tenantId);
+    for (const scenario of ["pizza", "different_products", "different_selections", "different_tenants"]) {
+      for (const concurrency of [1, 5, 10, 25]) {
+        for (const kind of ["prepare", "create"]) {
+          const row = await series(kind, scenario, size, concurrency, 1,
+            scenario === "pizza" ? payload : diagnosticPayload);
+          diagnostics.waves.push(row);
+          if (result.stopped) throw new Error(result.stopped);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    if (size === 100) {
+      for (const kind of ["read_misses", "order_only", "read_then_order", "order_with_item"]) {
+        for (const concurrency of [1, 5, 10, 25]) diagnostics.storage.push(await storageProbe(kind, concurrency));
+      }
+      diagnostics.idempotency = await idempotencyProbe();
+    }
+  }
+  diagnostics.staleAcceptance = await staleAcceptanceProbe();
+  process.stdout.write(`STAGE6D3C3B_DIAGNOSTIC=${JSON.stringify(diagnostics)}\n`);
+}
+
+try {
+  await prisma.$connect();
+  await observer.$connect();
+  await verifyTarget();
+  await seedBase();
+  await correctnessChecks();
+  if (process.env.STAGE6D3C3_DIAG === "probe") await probeOnlyRun();
+  else if (diagnosticMode) await diagnosticRun();
+  else for (const size of (onlySize ? [Number(onlySize)] : [10, 100, 1_000, 10_000])) {
+    const fixtureMs = await growCatalog(size);
+    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ catalogReady: size, fixtureMs })}\n`);
+    for (const kind of ["quote", "prepare", "create"]) {
+      const measured = await series(kind, "pizza", size, 1, size === 10_000 ? 5 : 9);
+      if (measured) result.catalog.push({ ...measured, fixtureMsExcluded: fixtureMs });
+      if (result.stopped) break;
+    }
+    if (result.stopped) break;
+    if (size === 100 || size === 1_000) {
+      for (const concurrency of [1, 5, 10, 25]) {
+        for (const kind of ["quote", "prepare", "create"]) {
+          const measured = await series(kind, "pizza", size, concurrency, concurrency === 1 ? 5 : 2);
+          if (measured) result.concurrency.push(measured);
+          if (result.stopped) break;
+        }
+        if (result.stopped) break;
+      }
+      if (result.stopped) break;
+      for (const concurrency of [1, 5]) await lockTrial(size, concurrency);
+    }
+    if (size === 1_000) {
