+/** Manual Stage 6D.3C3E verifier. Never reads .env or an existing database. */
+import { createRequire } from "node:module";
+import { createServer } from "node:http";
+import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
+import { performance } from "node:perf_hooks";
+const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
+const { PrismaClient, Prisma } = require("@prisma/client");
+const { Client } = require("pg");
+const { NetworkOrdersService } = require("../apps/api/dist/modules/orders/network-orders.service.js");
+
+const dbNames = {
+  guard: "ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3e_guard",
+  control: "ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3e_control"
+};
+if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" || process.env.ENABLE_DISPOSABLE_NETWORK_ORDERS !== "1")
+  throw new Error("Refusing non-test environment");
+const urls = { guard: process.env.STAGE6D3C3E_GUARD_URL, control: process.env.STAGE6D3C3E_CONTROL_URL };
+for (const [kind, raw] of Object.entries(urls)) {
+  if (!raw) throw new Error(`Explicit ${kind} disposable URL required`);
+  const url = new URL(raw);
+  if (url.protocol !== "postgresql:" || url.hostname !== "127.0.0.1" || url.port !== "55440"
+    || url.pathname !== `/${dbNames[kind]}`) throw new Error(`Refusing ${kind} non-disposable URL`);
+}
+
+const t = { id: "c3e-restaurant", slug: "c3e-demo", pizza: "c3e-pizza", source: "c3e-source", combo: "c3e-combo" };
+const foreign = { restaurant: "c3e-other-restaurant", product: "c3e-other-product" };
+const pizzaTree = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: t.pizza, revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", id: "sizes", label: "Sizes", sizes: [
+    { id: "small", label: "Small", price: "100" }, { id: "medium", label: "Medium", price: "200.000001" }
+  ] },
+  { type: "OPTIONS", id: "toppings", label: "Toppings", min: 0, max: 3, includedQuantity: 1,
+    options: [{ id: "cheese", label: "Cheese", price: "30.000001", maxQuantity: 3,
+      children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", id: "sauces", label: "Sauces", min: 0, max: 1, includedQuantity: 0,
+        options: [{ id: "bbq", label: "BBQ", price: "5.000001", maxQuantity: 1 }] }] }] }
+] };
+const sourceTree = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: t.source, revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", id: "source-sizes", label: "Source sizes", sizes: [
+    { id: "source-small", label: "Small", price: "100" }, { id: "source-large", label: "Large", price: "200" }
+  ] }
+] };
+const comboTree = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: t.combo, revision: 1, basePrice: "0", groups: [
+  { type: "OPTIONS", id: "slots", label: "Combo", min: 3, max: 3, includedQuantity: 0, options: [
+    { id: "original", label: "Original", price: "10", maxQuantity: 2,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: t.source, mode: "ORIGINAL",
+        originalPriceOverrides: { "source-small": "5", "source-large": "8" } } },
+    { id: "custom", label: "Custom", price: "3", maxQuantity: 1,
+      linkedProduct: { sourceProductId: t.source, mode: "CUSTOM", customConfiguration: {
+        schemaVersion: 1, productId: t.source, revision: 1, basePrice: null, groups: [
+          { type: "SIZE", id: "custom-sizes", label: "Custom sizes", sizes: [
+            { id: "custom-medium", label: "Medium", price: "7" }
+          ] }
+        ] } } }
+  ] }
+] };
+const pizzaSelection = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: t.pizza, configurationRevision: 1, groups: [
+  { type: "SIZE", groupId: "sizes", sizeChoiceId: "medium" },
+  { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "toppings", instances: [
+    { instanceId: "cheese-1", optionId: "cheese", children: [{ type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "sauces", instances: [
+      { instanceId: "sauce-1", optionId: "bbq" }] }] },
+    { instanceId: "cheese-2", optionId: "cheese" }, { instanceId: "cheese-3", optionId: "cheese" }
+  ] }
+] };
+const comboSelection = { schemaVersion: 1, productId: t.combo, configurationRevision: 1, groups: [
+  { type: "OPTIONS", groupId: "slots", instances: [
+    { instanceId: "original-1", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1,
+      productId: t.source, configurationRevision: 1, groups: [
+        { type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-small" }] } },
+    { instanceId: "original-2", optionId: "original", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1,
+      productId: t.source, configurationRevision: 1, groups: [
+        { type: "SIZE", groupId: "source-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "source-large" }] } },
+    { instanceId: "custom-1", optionId: "custom", linkedSelection: { schemaVersion: 1,
+      productId: t.source, configurationRevision: 1, groups: [
+        { type: "SIZE", groupId: "custom-sizes", sizeChoiceId: "custom-medium" }] } }
+  ] }
+] };
+
+const result = { environment: {}, negatives: [], positives: [], prisma: [], legacy: [], performance: [] };
+const dbs = {}, pgClients = {};
+const clone = (value) => structuredClone(value);
+const digest = () => randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
+const summary = (values) => {
+  const ordered = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
+  return { samples: ordered.length, medianMs: +ordered[Math.ceil(ordered.length / 2) - 1].toFixed(3),
+    p95Ms: +ordered[Math.ceil(ordered.length * .95) - 1].toFixed(3) };
+};
+const reason = (error) => `${error?.code ?? "unknown"}:${error?.meta?.code ?? ""}`;
+
+async function connectAndSeed(kind) {
+  const db = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: urls[kind] });
+  await db.$connect();
+  const [identity] = await db.$queryRaw`SELECT current_database() AS name,
+    host(inet_server_addr()) AS host, inet_server_port() AS port, version() AS version`;
+  const [trigger] = await db.$queryRaw`SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM pg_trigger
+    WHERE tgname = 'Order_network_test_completeness_guard'`;
+  if (identity.name !== dbNames[kind] || identity.host !== "127.0.0.1" || identity.port !== 55440
+    || trigger.n !== (kind === "guard" ? 1 : 0)
+    || await db.restaurant.count() !== 0 || await db.order.count() !== 0)
+    throw new Error(`Refusing dirty/wrong ${kind} database`);
+  await db.restaurant.create({ data: { id: t.id, slug: t.slug, name: "Disposable Restaurant", currency: "EGP" } });
+  await db.restaurant.create({ data: { id: foreign.restaurant, slug: "c3e-other", name: "Other Restaurant", currency: "EGP" } });
+  await db.product.createMany({ data: [
+    { id: t.pizza, restaurantId: t.id, slug: "pizza", name: "Pizza", currency: "EGP",
+      basePrice: null, configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: pizzaTree },
+    { id: t.source, restaurantId: t.id, slug: "source", name: "Linked Source", currency: "EGP",
+      basePrice: null, configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: sourceTree },
+    { id: t.combo, restaurantId: t.id, slug: "combo", name: "Combo", currency: "EGP",
+      basePrice: "0", configurationVersion: 1, configurationTree: comboTree },
+    { id: foreign.product, restaurantId: foreign.restaurant, slug: "foreign", name: "Foreign", currency: "EGP",
+      basePrice: "1", configurationVersion: 0 }
+  ] });
+  dbs[kind] = db;
+  const pg = new Client({ connectionString: urls[kind] });
+  await pg.connect();
+  pgClients[kind] = pg;
+  result.environment[kind] = identity;
+  return db;
+}
+
+function makeFixture(db, type, lines = 1) {
+  const selection = type === "combo" ? comboSelection : pizzaSelection;
+  const productId = type === "combo" ? t.combo : t.pizza;
+  const service = new NetworkOrdersService(db);
+  const draft = service.buildDraft({ id: t.id, slug: t.slug, name: "Disposable Restaurant", currency: "EGP" },
+    [{ id: t.pizza, slug: "pizza", name: "Pizza", basePrice: null, configurationTree: pizzaTree,
+      configurationVersion: 1, isActive: true, isAvailable: true, deletedAt: null },
+    { id: t.source, slug: "source", name: "Linked Source", basePrice: null, configurationTree: sourceTree,
+      configurationVersion: 1, isActive: true, isAvailable: true, deletedAt: null },
+    { id: t.combo, slug: "combo", name: "Combo", basePrice: "0", configurationTree: comboTree,
+      configurationVersion: 1, isActive: true, isAvailable: true, deletedAt: null }],
+    { locale: "en", items: Array.from({ length: lines }, () => ({ productId, quantity: 1, selection })) });
+  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
+  const items = draft.items.map((item) => ({ snapshotVersion: 1, mode: "NETWORK", locale: draft.locale,
+    currency: draft.currency, ...item, createdAt }));
+  return { totalAmount: draft.totalAmount, items,
+    snapshot: { snapshotVersion: 1, mode: "NETWORK", locale: draft.locale,
+      orderDetails: draft.orderDetails, totalAmount: draft.totalAmount,
+      currency: draft.currency, items, createdAt } };
+}
+
+function candidate(fixture, key = randomUUID()) {
+  const value = { totalAmount: fixture.totalAmount, snapshot: clone(fixture.snapshot), items: clone(fixture.items) };
+  return { ...value, restaurantId: t.id, currency: "EGP", customerName: null, customerPhone: null,
+    idempotencyKey: key, requestHash: digest(), acceptanceTokenHash: digest() };
+}
+
+async function writePrisma(db, prepared, opts = {}) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const order = await tx.order.create({ data: {
+      restaurantId: prepared.restaurantId, totalAmount: prepared.totalAmount,
+      currency: prepared.currency, customerName: prepared.customerName,
+      customerPhone: prepared.customerPhone, status: "VALIDATED_TEST", source: "NETWORK_TEST",
+      idempotencyKey: prepared.idempotencyKey, requestHash: prepared.requestHash,
+      acceptanceTokenHash: prepared.acceptanceTokenHash,
+      ...(opts.noSnapshot ? {} : { cartSnapshot: prepared.snapshot })
+    } });
+    if (opts.afterOrderReturn) return order.id;
+    if (opts.badItemInsert) await tx.orderItem.create({ data: { orderId: order.id,
+      productId: "missing-product", name: "Broken", quantity: 1, unitPrice: "1", totalPrice: "1" } });
+    if (!opts.noItems) await tx.orderItem.createMany({ data: prepared.items.map((item, index) => ({
+      orderId: order.id, productId: opts.wrongProductId && index === 0 ? t.source : item.productId,
+      name: item.productName, quantity: opts.wrongQuantity && index === 0 ? item.quantity + 1 : item.quantity,
+      ...(opts.wrongOptions && index === 0 ? { name: "Forged label" } : {}),
+      unitPrice: item.unitPrice, totalPrice: item.lineTotal,
+      note: item.note, options: opts.wrongOptions && index === 0
+        ? { ...item, productName: "Forged label" } : item
+    })) });
+    if (opts.failSeal) await tx.order.update({ where: { id: order.id },
+      data: { cartSnapshot: { ...prepared.snapshot, totalAmount: "0" } } });
+    if (!opts.noSeal) await tx.order.update({ where: { id: order.id },
+      data: { networkSnapshotSealedAt: new Date() } });
+    if (opts.namedImmediate) await tx.$executeRawUnsafe('SET CONSTRAINTS "Order_network_test_completeness_guard" IMMEDIATE');
+    return order.id;
+  }, { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.Serializable, maxWait: 10_000, timeout: 20_000 });
+}
+
+async function expectFailed(label, prepared, opts = {}) {
+  const db = dbs.guard;
+  const before = await db.order.count();
+  const beforeItems = await db.orderItem.count();
+  let resolved = false, code = "";
+  try { await writePrisma(db, prepared, opts); resolved = true; }
+  catch (error) { code = reason(error); }
+  const remaining = await db.order.count({ where: { restaurantId: t.id,
+    idempotencyKey: prepared.idempotencyKey } });
+  if (remaining !== 0 || await db.order.count() !== before || await db.orderItem.count() !== beforeItems)
+    throw new Error(`Partial rows committed: ${label}`);
+  result.negatives.push({ case: label, callbackResolved: resolved, error: code || "deferred_commit_rolled_back", partialOrders: 0 });
+}
+
+async function positivesAndNegatives() {
+  const db = dbs.guard;
+  const pizza = makeFixture(db, "pizza");
+  const two = makeFixture(db, "pizza", 2);
+  const combo = makeFixture(db, "combo");
+  if (pizza.totalAmount !== "265.000004" || combo.totalAmount !== "43")
+    throw new Error("Shared-backed pricing fixture changed");
+  if (combo.items[0].canonicalSelection.groups[0].instances.length !== 3)
+    throw new Error("Independent linked instances missing");
+  await expectFailed("no_snapshot", candidate(pizza), { noSnapshot: true });
+  await expectFailed("no_seal", candidate(pizza), { noSeal: true });
+  await expectFailed("no_items", candidate(pizza), { noItems: true });
+  const extraSnapshot = candidate(pizza);
+  extraSnapshot.snapshot.items.push({ ...clone(extraSnapshot.snapshot.items[0]),
+    unitPrice: "0", lineTotal: "0", priceBreakdown: [] });
+  await expectFailed("snapshot_extra_item", extraSnapshot);
+  const missingSnapshot = candidate(two);
+  missingSnapshot.items[1].unitPrice = "0";
+  missingSnapshot.items[1].lineTotal = "0";
+  missingSnapshot.items[1].priceBreakdown = [];
+  missingSnapshot.snapshot.items.pop();
+  missingSnapshot.snapshot.totalAmount = pizza.totalAmount;
+  missingSnapshot.totalAmount = pizza.totalAmount;
+  await expectFailed("snapshot_missing_item", missingSnapshot);
+  const wrongTotal = candidate(pizza);
+  wrongTotal.totalAmount = "999";
+  await expectFailed("total_mismatch", wrongTotal);
+  const wrongCurrency = candidate(pizza);
+  wrongCurrency.snapshot.currency = "USD";
+  await expectFailed("currency_mismatch", wrongCurrency);
+  await expectFailed("options_mismatch", candidate(pizza), { wrongOptions: true });
+  await expectFailed("product_identity_mismatch", candidate(pizza), { wrongProductId: true });
+  const crossTenant = candidate(pizza);
+  crossTenant.snapshot.items[0].productId = foreign.product;
+  crossTenant.snapshot.items[0].configurationTree.productId = foreign.product;
+  crossTenant.snapshot.items[0].canonicalSelection.productId = foreign.product;
+  crossTenant.items[0].productId = foreign.product;
+  crossTenant.items[0].configurationTree.productId = foreign.product;
+  crossTenant.items[0].canonicalSelection.productId = foreign.product;
+  await expectFailed("cross_restaurant_product_identity", crossTenant);
+  await expectFailed("quantity_mismatch", candidate(pizza), { wrongQuantity: true });
+  await expectFailed("item_insert_failure", candidate(pizza), { badItemInsert: true });
+  await expectFailed("seal_update_failure", candidate(pizza), { failSeal: true });
+  await expectFailed("early_callback_return", candidate(pizza), { afterOrderReturn: true });
+  await expectFailed("commit_before_finalization", candidate(pizza), { noSeal: true });
+  const wrongBreakdown = candidate(pizza);
+  wrongBreakdown.snapshot.items[0].priceBreakdown[0].chargedAmount = "0";
+  wrongBreakdown.items[0].priceBreakdown[0].chargedAmount = "0";
+  await expectFailed("breakdown_charge_mismatch", wrongBreakdown);
+  const missingStructural = candidate(pizza);
+  delete missingStructural.snapshot.items[0].canonicalSelection;
+  delete missingStructural.items[0].canonicalSelection;
+  await expectFailed("missing_selection_structure", missingStructural);
+  const wrongVersion = candidate(pizza);
+  wrongVersion.snapshot.snapshotVersion = 2;
+  await expectFailed("invalid_snapshot_version", wrongVersion);
+  const wrongMoney = candidate(pizza);
+  wrongMoney.snapshot.items[0].unitPrice = "265.0000004";
+  wrongMoney.items[0].unitPrice = "265.0000004";
+  await expectFailed("over_precision_money", wrongMoney);
+  const missingLocale = candidate(pizza);
+  delete missingLocale.snapshot.locale;
+  delete missingLocale.snapshot.items[0].locale;
+  delete missingLocale.items[0].locale;
+  await expectFailed("missing_locale", missingLocale);
+  const invalidHash = candidate(pizza);
+  invalidHash.acceptanceTokenHash = "short";
+  await expectFailed("invalid_acceptance_hash_envelope", invalidHash);
+  const sameKey = candidate(pizza);
+  await expectFailed("rollback_before_retry", sameKey, { noSeal: true });
+  const retryId = await writePrisma(db, sameKey);
+  if (!await db.order.findFirst({ where: { id: retryId, networkSnapshotSealedAt: { not: null } } }))
+    throw new Error("Retry after rollback did not commit");
+  result.positives.push({ case: "retry_after_rollback", orderIdVerified: true });
+  for (const [label, fixture] of [["pizza_nested_included", pizza], ["combo_repeated_original_custom", combo],
+    ["ten_lines", makeFixture(db, "pizza", 10)], ["fifty_lines", makeFixture(db, "pizza", 50)]]) {
+    const id = await writePrisma(db, candidate(fixture));
+    const saved = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { items: true } });
+    if (!saved?.networkSnapshotSealedAt || saved.items.length !== fixture.items.length
+      || saved.totalAmount.toString() !== fixture.totalAmount) throw new Error(`Invalid positive ${label}`);
+    result.positives.push({ case: label, lines: saved.items.length, total: fixture.totalAmount });
+  }
+  const sealed = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id: retryId }, include: { items: true } });
+  for (const [label, operation] of [
+    ["post_seal_update", () => db.orderItem.update({ where: { id: sealed.items[0].id }, data: { name: "Changed" } })],
+    ["post_seal_delete", () => db.orderItem.delete({ where: { id: sealed.items[0].id } })],
+    ["post_seal_insert", () => db.orderItem.create({ data: { orderId: retryId, productId: t.pizza,
+      name: "Extra", quantity: 1, unitPrice: "1", totalPrice: "1", options: {} } })]
+  ]) {
+    let rejected = false;
+    try { await operation(); } catch { rejected = true; }
+    if (!rejected) throw new Error(`Stage 6C immutability failed: ${label}`);
+    result.negatives.push({ case: label, rejected: true, partialOrders: 0 });
+  }
+  const legacy = await db.order.create({ data: { restaurantId: t.id, totalAmount: "10.000001",
+    currency: "EGP", source: "WHATSAPP", status: "PENDING_WHATSAPP",
+    items: { create: [{ productId: t.pizza, name: "Legacy Pizza", quantity: 1,
+      unitPrice: "10.000001", totalPrice: "10.000001" }] } }, include: { items: true } });
+  if (legacy.cartSnapshot !== null || legacy.items.length !== 1) throw new Error("Legacy changed");
+  result.legacy.push({ case: "legacy_without_network_snapshot", saved: true });
+  let conversionRejected = false;
+  try { await db.order.update({ where: { id: legacy.id }, data: { source: "NETWORK_TEST",
+    idempotencyKey: randomUUID(), requestHash: digest(), acceptanceTokenHash: digest() } }); }
+  catch { conversionRejected = true; }
+  const stillLegacy = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id: legacy.id } });
+  if (!conversionRejected && stillLegacy?.source !== "WHATSAPP")
+    throw new Error("Legacy Order converted without Network evidence");
+  result.legacy.push({ case: "unsealed_legacy_to_network_transition", callbackRejected: conversionRejected,
+    persistedSource: stillLegacy?.source });
+}
+
+async function prismaSemantics() {
+  const db = dbs.guard, pizza = makeFixture(db, "pizza");
+  const bad = candidate(pizza);
+  let callbackResolved = false, code = "";
+  try { await writePrisma(db, bad, { noItems: true }); callbackResolved = true; }
+  catch (error) { code = reason(error); }
+  if (await db.order.count({ where: { idempotencyKey: bad.idempotencyKey } }) !== 0)
+    throw new Error("Deferred failure committed bad Order");
+  result.prisma.push({ case: "deferred_commit_without_immediate", callbackResolved,
+    code: code || "callback_resolved_but_commit_rolled_back", persisted: false });
+  const immediateBad = candidate(pizza);
+  let immediateError = "";
+  try { await writePrisma(db, immediateBad, { noItems: true, namedImmediate: true }); }
+  catch (error) { immediateError = reason(error); }
+  if (!immediateError || await db.order.count({ where: { idempotencyKey: immediateBad.idempotencyKey } }) !== 0)
+    throw new Error("Named IMMEDIATE did not surface invalid finalization");
+  result.prisma.push({ case: "named_constraint_immediate_failure", code: immediateError, persisted: false });
+  const good = candidate(pizza);
+  const id = await writePrisma(db, good, { namedImmediate: true });
+  if (!await db.order.findFirst({ where: { id, networkSnapshotSealedAt: { not: null } } }))
+    throw new Error("Named IMMEDIATE rejected valid Order");
+  result.prisma.push({ case: "named_constraint_immediate_success", persisted: true });
+
+  const server = createServer(async (request, response) => {
+    if (request.socket.remoteAddress !== "127.0.0.1" || request.url !== "/test-commit") {
+      response.writeHead(403).end(); return;
+    }
+    const prepared = candidate(pizza);
+    try {
+      const orderId = await writePrisma(db, prepared, { namedImmediate: true,
+        ...(request.method === "POST" ? {} : { noItems: true }) });
+      const saved = await db.order.findFirst({ where: { id: orderId, restaurantId: t.id,
+        idempotencyKey: prepared.idempotencyKey, requestHash: prepared.requestHash,
+        acceptanceTokenHash: prepared.acceptanceTokenHash,
+        source: "NETWORK_TEST", networkSnapshotSealedAt: { not: null } } });
+      if (!saved) throw new Error("Commit not confirmed");
+      response.writeHead(201).end(JSON.stringify({ orderId }));
+    } catch { response.writeHead(409).end(JSON.stringify({ error: "ORDER_COMMIT_FAILED" })); }
+  });
+  await new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
+  try {
+    const origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
+    const denied = await fetch(`${origin}/test-commit`, { method: "GET" });
+    const accepted = await fetch(`${origin}/test-commit`, { method: "POST" });
+    if (denied.status !== 409 || accepted.status !== 201) throw new Error("False HTTP 201 after failed commit");
+  result.prisma.push({ case: "loopback_http_commit_confirmation", failedStatus: denied.status,
+      successStatus: accepted.status });
+  } finally { await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve)); }
+
+  const pg = pgClients.guard, rawId = randomUUID();
+  await pg.query("BEGIN");
+  await pg.query(`INSERT INTO "Order" ("id","restaurantId","totalAmount","currency","status","source",
+    "idempotencyKey","requestHash","acceptanceTokenHash","cartSnapshot","networkSnapshotSealedAt")
+    VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'EGP','VALIDATED_TEST','NETWORK_TEST',$4,$5,$6,$7::jsonb,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)`,
+  [rawId, t.id, pizza.totalAmount, randomUUID(), digest(), digest(), JSON.stringify(pizza.snapshot)]);
+  let commitCode = "";
+  try { await pg.query("COMMIT"); } catch (error) { commitCode = error.code ?? "unknown"; }
+  if (commitCode !== "23514" || await db.order.count({ where: { id: rawId } }) !== 0)
+    throw new Error("PostgreSQL did not reject incomplete COMMIT directly");
+  result.prisma.push({ case: "direct_postgresql_commit_rejection", sqlstate: commitCode, persisted: false });
+}
+
+async function pgWrite(client, prepared) {
+  const orderId = randomUUID();
+  await client.query("BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE");
+  try {
+    await client.query(`INSERT INTO "Order" ("id","restaurantId","totalAmount","currency","status","source",
+      "idempotencyKey","requestHash","acceptanceTokenHash","cartSnapshot")
+      VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'VALIDATED_TEST','NETWORK_TEST',$5,$6,$7,$8::jsonb)`,
+    [orderId, t.id, prepared.totalAmount, prepared.currency, randomUUID(), digest(), digest(),
+      JSON.stringify(prepared.snapshot)]);
+    const args = [];
+    const tuples = prepared.items.map((item, index) => {
+      const base = index * 9;
+      args.push(randomUUID(), orderId, item.productId, item.productName, item.quantity,
+        item.unitPrice, item.lineTotal, JSON.stringify(item), item.note ?? null);
+      return `(${Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, n) => `$${base + n + 1}`).join(",")})`;
+    });
+    await client.query(`INSERT INTO "OrderItem" ("id","orderId","productId","name","quantity",
+      "unitPrice","totalPrice","options","note") VALUES ${tuples.join(",")}`, args);
+    await client.query('UPDATE "Order" SET "networkSnapshotSealedAt"=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "id"=$1', [orderId]);
+    const start = performance.now();
+    await client.query("COMMIT");
+    return performance.now() - start;
+  } catch (error) {
+    await client.query("ROLLBACK");
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+async function benchmark() {
+  const cases = [
+    ["one_line", "pizza", 1], ["ten_lines", "pizza", 10],
+    ["fifty_lines", "pizza", 50], ["linked_combo", "combo", 1]
+  ];
+  for (const [label, type, lines] of cases) {
+    const fixture = makeFixture(dbs.guard, type, lines);
+    const samples = { guard: [], control: [] };
+    for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
+      for (const kind of i % 2 ? ["guard", "control"] : ["control", "guard"]) {
+        const ms = await pgWrite(pgClients[kind], candidate(fixture));
+        if (i >= 5) samples[kind].push(ms);
+      }
+    }
+    result.performance.push({ case: label, lines: fixture.items.length, warmupsPerDb: 5,
+      guard: summary(samples.guard), control: summary(samples.control) });
+    process.stdout.write(`PERF ${JSON.stringify(result.performance.at(-1))}\n`);
+  }
+}
+
+try {
+  for (const kind of ["guard", "control"]) await connectAndSeed(kind);
+  await positivesAndNegatives();
+  await prismaSemantics();
+  await benchmark();
+  const db = dbs.guard;
+  const [audit] = await db.$queryRaw`SELECT count(*)::int AS incomplete FROM "Order"
+    WHERE "source"='NETWORK_TEST' AND ("networkSnapshotSealedAt" IS NULL OR "cartSnapshot" IS NULL)`;
+  if (audit.incomplete !== 0) throw new Error("Committed incomplete Network Order");
+  result.finalAudit = { incompleteNetworkOrders: audit.incomplete,
+    guardOrders: await db.order.count(), controlOrders: await dbs.control.order.count() };
+  process.stdout.write(`STAGE6D3C3E_RESULT=${JSON.stringify(result)}\n`);
+} finally {
+  for (const client of Object.values(pgClients)) await client.end();
+  for (const db of Object.values(dbs)) await db.$disconnect();
+}
diff --git a/scripts/stage6d3c3e-network-order-completeness-candidate.sql b/scripts/stage6d3c3e-network-order-completeness-candidate.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5c76084
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/stage6d3c3e-network-order-completeness-candidate.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,192 @@
+-- Stage 6D.3C3E candidate only. NOT an operational migration.
+-- Apply only to a fresh, isolated PostgreSQL 16 disposable DB after the test baseline + Stage 6C SQL.
+-- Future adoption requires migration-history audit, an approved migration, and a fresh compatibility review.
+DO $$ BEGIN
+  IF current_database() NOT IN ('ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3e_guard',
+    'ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3e_integration',
+    'ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c2_conflict',
+    'ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3f_atomic',
+    'ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3f_fake_guard',
+    'ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3f_bench',
+    'ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3c3f_bench2',
+    'ordersawa_stage3_stage6c_stage6d3a_demo')
+    OR host(inet_server_addr()) <> '127.0.0.1' OR inet_server_port() <> 55440
+    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."Order") THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Refusing non-empty or non-disposable Stage 6D.3C3E database';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- Exact non-negative decimal text compatible with DECIMAL(24,6). NULL means invalid.
+-- This validates stored evidence only; it does not calculate the commercial price.
+CREATE FUNCTION public.network_order_guard_money(value jsonb) RETURNS numeric
+  LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
+  SET search_path = pg_catalog
+AS $$
+  SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'
+    AND value #>> '{}' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,17})(\.[0-9]{1,6})?$'
+    THEN (value #>> '{}')::numeric ELSE NULL END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION public.require_complete_network_test_order() RETURNS trigger
+  LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+  saved public."Order"%ROWTYPE;
+  snap jsonb;
+  item jsonb;
+  price_line jsonb;
+  stored public."OrderItem"%ROWTYPE;
+  total numeric := 0;
+  line_total numeric;
+  unit_price numeric;
+  line_charges numeric;
+  amount numeric;
+  charge numeric;
+  item_count bigint;
+  units bigint := 0;
+  stored_sum numeric;
+  multiset_diff boolean;
+BEGIN
+  -- A deferred INSERT event reads the final state after OrderItems and seal in this transaction.
+  SELECT * INTO saved FROM public."Order" WHERE "id" = NEW."id";
+  IF NOT FOUND OR saved."source" <> 'NETWORK_TEST' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
+  snap := saved."cartSnapshot"::jsonb;
+  IF saved."networkSnapshotSealedAt" IS NULL OR snap IS NULL
+    OR jsonb_typeof(snap) <> 'object'
+    OR snap->'snapshotVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
+    OR snap->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NETWORK'
+    OR snap->>'locale' IS NULL OR snap->>'locale' NOT IN ('ar', 'en')
+    OR jsonb_typeof(snap->'orderDetails') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
+    OR nullif(btrim(snap#>>'{orderDetails,restaurantName}'), '') IS NULL
+    OR (snap#>'{orderDetails,customerName}' IS NOT NULL
+      AND jsonb_typeof(snap#>'{orderDetails,customerName}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string')
+    OR (snap#>'{orderDetails,customerPhone}' IS NOT NULL
+      AND jsonb_typeof(snap#>'{orderDetails,customerPhone}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string')
+    OR snap#>>'{orderDetails,customerName}' IS DISTINCT FROM saved."customerName"
+    OR snap#>>'{orderDetails,customerPhone}' IS DISTINCT FROM saved."customerPhone"
+    OR jsonb_typeof(snap->'currency') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+    OR nullif(btrim(saved."currency"), '') IS NULL
+    OR saved."currency" !~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
+    OR snap->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM saved."currency"
+    OR public.network_order_guard_money(snap->'totalAmount') IS NULL
+    OR public.network_order_guard_money(snap->'totalAmount') IS DISTINCT FROM saved."totalAmount"
+    OR saved."totalAmount" < 0
+    OR jsonb_typeof(snap->'items') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
+    OR saved."idempotencyKey" IS NULL OR saved."idempotencyKey" !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$'
+    OR saved."requestHash" IS NULL OR saved."requestHash" !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
+    OR saved."acceptanceTokenHash" IS NULL OR saved."acceptanceTokenHash" !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Incomplete Network Order envelope' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  IF jsonb_array_length(snap->'items') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Network Order line count' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+
+  FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(snap->'items') AS value LOOP
+    IF jsonb_typeof(item) <> 'object'
+      OR item->'snapshotVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
+      OR item->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NETWORK'
+      OR item->>'locale' IS DISTINCT FROM snap->>'locale'
+      OR item->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM saved."currency"
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'productId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+      OR nullif(btrim(item->>'productId'), '') IS NULL
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'productName') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
+      OR nullif(btrim(item->>'productName'), '') IS NULL
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
+      OR item->>'quantity' !~ '^([1-9][0-9]?|100)$'
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'configurationTree') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'canonicalSelection') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
+      OR item#>>'{configurationTree,productId}' IS DISTINCT FROM item->>'productId'
+      OR item#>>'{canonicalSelection,productId}' IS DISTINCT FROM item->>'productId'
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'configurationRevision') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item#>'{configurationTree,revision}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item#>'{canonicalSelection,configurationRevision}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
+      OR item->>'configurationRevision' !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
+      OR item#>>'{configurationTree,revision}' IS DISTINCT FROM item->>'configurationRevision'
+      OR item#>>'{canonicalSelection,configurationRevision}' IS DISTINCT FROM item->>'configurationRevision'
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'linkedSources') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
+      OR jsonb_typeof(item->'priceBreakdown') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
+      OR public.network_order_guard_money(item->'unitPrice') IS NULL
+      OR public.network_order_guard_money(item->'lineTotal') IS NULL THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Network Order line evidence' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+    unit_price := public.network_order_guard_money(item->'unitPrice');
+    line_total := public.network_order_guard_money(item->'lineTotal');
+    units := units + (item->>'quantity')::bigint;
+    IF unit_price * (item->>'quantity')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM line_total THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Network Order line amount mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+    total := total + line_total;
+    line_charges := 0;
+    FOR price_line IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(item->'priceBreakdown') AS value LOOP
+      IF jsonb_typeof(price_line) <> 'object'
+        OR jsonb_typeof(price_line->'included') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
+        OR public.network_order_guard_money(price_line->'amount') IS NULL
+        OR public.network_order_guard_money(price_line->'chargedAmount') IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Network Order price evidence' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+      END IF;
+      amount := public.network_order_guard_money(price_line->'amount');
+      charge := public.network_order_guard_money(price_line->'chargedAmount');
+      IF (price_line->'included' = 'true'::jsonb AND charge <> 0)
+        OR (price_line->'included' = 'false'::jsonb AND charge <> amount) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Inconsistent included Network Order price' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+      END IF;
+      line_charges := line_charges + charge;
+    END LOOP;
+    IF line_charges IS DISTINCT FROM unit_price THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Network Order price breakdown mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+  IF units > 100 OR total IS DISTINCT FROM saved."totalAmount" THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Network Order total mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+
+  SELECT count(*), coalesce(sum("totalPrice"), 0)
+    INTO item_count, stored_sum FROM public."OrderItem" WHERE "orderId" = saved."id";
+  IF item_count <> jsonb_array_length(snap->'items') OR stored_sum IS DISTINCT FROM saved."totalAmount" THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Network Order items missing or extra' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  FOR stored IN SELECT * FROM public."OrderItem" WHERE "orderId" = saved."id" LOOP
+    item := stored."options"::jsonb;
+    IF item IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(item) <> 'object'
+      OR stored."productId" IS NULL
+      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."Product" p WHERE p."id" = stored."productId"
+        AND p."restaurantId" = saved."restaurantId")
+      OR item->>'productId' IS DISTINCT FROM stored."productId"
+      OR item->>'productName' IS DISTINCT FROM stored."name"
+      OR item->>'note' IS DISTINCT FROM stored."note"
+      OR item->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM saved."currency"
+      OR item->>'quantity' IS DISTINCT FROM stored."quantity"::text
+      OR public.network_order_guard_money(item->'unitPrice') IS DISTINCT FROM stored."unitPrice"
+      OR public.network_order_guard_money(item->'lineTotal') IS DISTINCT FROM stored."totalPrice"
+      OR stored."quantity" NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
+      OR stored."unitPrice" < 0 OR stored."totalPrice" < 0
+      OR stored."unitPrice" * stored."quantity" IS DISTINCT FROM stored."totalPrice" THEN
+      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Network OrderItem differs from sealed evidence' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+  END LOOP;
+
+  -- OrderItem has no persisted ordinal. Compare exact JSONB multisets, retaining duplicates.
+  WITH snapshot_counts AS (
+    SELECT value AS evidence, count(*) AS n
+      FROM jsonb_array_elements(snap->'items') AS value GROUP BY value
+  ), stored_counts AS (
+    SELECT "options"::jsonb AS evidence, count(*) AS n
+      FROM public."OrderItem" WHERE "orderId" = saved."id" GROUP BY "options"::jsonb
+  )
+  SELECT EXISTS (
+    SELECT 1 FROM snapshot_counts s FULL JOIN stored_counts d USING (evidence)
+      WHERE s.n IS DISTINCT FROM d.n
+  ) INTO multiset_diff;
+  IF multiset_diff THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Network OrderItem evidence multiset mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+  END IF;
+  RETURN NULL;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- A single deferred INSERT event validates final state at COMMIT; source transitions are covered.
+-- Existing Stage 6C immutability triggers block post-seal evidence mutation and deletion.
+CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER "Order_network_test_completeness_guard"
+  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF "source" ON public."Order"
+  DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW
+  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.require_complete_network_test_order();
diff --git a/scripts/stage6e1-dashboard-browser-e2e.mjs b/scripts/stage6e1-dashboard-browser-e2e.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a5b782e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/stage6e1-dashboard-browser-e2e.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,186 @@
+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { mkdtemp, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { resolve } from "node:path";
+import { setTimeout as pause } from "node:timers/promises";
+import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
+import { JwtService } from "@nestjs/jwt";
+
+const url = process.env.DATABASE_URL ? new URL(process.env.DATABASE_URL) : null;
+if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" || !url || url.hostname !== "127.0.0.1"
+  || url.port !== "55440" || url.pathname !== "/ordersawa_stage3_stage6e1a_browser"
+  || !process.env.JWT_SECRET || process.env.JWT_SECRET.length < 16) {
+  throw new Error("Stage 6E.1 browser test requires its exact disposable loopback DB and a local JWT secret.");
+}
+
+const db = new PrismaClient({ datasourceUrl: process.env.DATABASE_URL });
+const browserProfile = await mkdtemp(resolve(process.cwd(), "../work/stage6e1-chrome-"));
+const chrome = spawn(process.env.CHROME_PATH ?? "C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe", [
+  "--headless=new", "--disable-gpu", "--disable-software-rasterizer", "--no-sandbox", "--no-first-run",
+  "--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1", "--remote-debugging-port=9224", "--remote-allow-origins=*",
+  `--user-data-dir=${browserProfile}`, "about:blank"
+], { windowsHide: true, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] });
+let chromeError = "";
+chrome.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => { chromeError = (chromeError + String(chunk)).slice(-2000); });
+let socket;
+const results = [];
+function check(value, message) { if (!value) throw new Error(message); }
+
+async function debuggerJson(path) {
+  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 60; attempt += 1) {
+    for (const host of ["127.0.0.1", "[::1]"]) {
+      try {
+        const response = await fetch(`http://${host}:9224${path}`);
+        if (response.ok) return response.json();
+      } catch { /* debugger starting */ }
+    }
+    await pause(200);
+  }
+  throw new Error(`Chrome debugger unavailable: ${chromeError}`);
+}
+
+try {
+  await db.$connect();
+  await db.restaurant.upsert({ where: { id: "s6e1-r1" }, update: {}, create: {
+    id: "s6e1-r1", name: "Stage 6E.1 Demo", slug: "s6e1-demo", currency: "EGP"
+  } });
+  await db.subscriptionPlan.upsert({ where: { id: "s6e1-plan" }, update: {}, create: {
+    id: "s6e1-plan", key: "STAGE6E1", name: "Stage 6E.1 Test Plan"
+  } });
+  await db.subscriptionFeature.upsert({ where: { id: "s6e1-capability" }, update: { enabled: true }, create: {
+    id: "s6e1-capability", planId: "s6e1-plan", key: "PRODUCT_CONFIGURATION", enabled: true
+  } });
+  await db.restaurantSubscription.upsert({ where: { restaurantId: "s6e1-r1" }, update: { planId: "s6e1-plan" }, create: {
+    id: "s6e1-subscription", restaurantId: "s6e1-r1", planId: "s6e1-plan", status: "ACTIVE", startsAt: new Date("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")
+  } });
+  await db.user.upsert({ where: { id: "s6e1-user" }, update: {}, create: {
+    id: "s6e1-user", email: "stage6e1@example.test", passwordHash: "not-used", role: "USER"
+  } });
+  await db.restaurantMember.upsert({ where: { id: "s6e1-membership" }, update: {}, create: {
+    id: "s6e1-membership", restaurantId: "s6e1-r1", userId: "s6e1-user", role: "OWNER"
+  } });
+
+  const token = new JwtService({ secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET }).sign({
+    sub: "s6e1-user", email: "stage6e1@example.test", role: "USER"
+  });
+  const session = { accessToken: token, user: { id: "s6e1-user", email: "stage6e1@example.test", role: "USER" },
+    memberships: [{ role: "OWNER", restaurant: { id: "s6e1-r1", name: "Stage 6E.1 Demo", slug: "s6e1-demo" } }] };
+
+  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 60; attempt += 1) {
+    try { if ((await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:3000/dashboard/products/new")).ok) break; }
+    catch { /* Next.js starting */ }
+    await pause(250);
+  }
+  const tabs = await debuggerJson("/json/list");
+  const tab = tabs.find((entry) => entry.type === "page");
+  check(tab, "No Chrome page target");
+  socket = new WebSocket(tab.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
+  await new Promise((ok, fail) => {
+    socket.addEventListener("open", ok, { once: true });
+    socket.addEventListener("error", fail, { once: true });
+  });
+  let sequence = 0;
+  const pending = new Map();
+  socket.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
+    const packet = JSON.parse(String(event.data));
+    const request = pending.get(packet.id);
+    if (!request) return;
+    pending.delete(packet.id);
+    if (packet.error) request.reject(new Error(JSON.stringify(packet.error)));
+    else request.resolve(packet.result);
+  });
+  const cdp = (method, params = {}) => new Promise((ok, fail) => {
+    const id = ++sequence;
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => { pending.delete(id); fail(new Error(`CDP timeout: ${method}`)); }, 15000);
+    pending.set(id, { resolve: (value) => { clearTimeout(timer); ok(value); }, reject: (error) => { clearTimeout(timer); fail(error); } });
+    socket.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
+  });
+  const evaluate = async (expression) => {
+    const packet = await cdp("Runtime.evaluate", { expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true });
+    if (packet.exceptionDetails) throw new Error(packet.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ?? packet.exceptionDetails.text);
+    return packet.result.value;
+  };
+  const until = async (expression, description) => {
+    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt += 1) {
+      if (await evaluate(expression)) return;
+      await pause(200);
+    }
+    throw new Error(`Timed out: ${description}; page=${await evaluate("document.body.innerText.slice(0,900)")}`);
+  };
+  await cdp("Page.enable");
+  await cdp("Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument", { source: `
+    if (location.hostname === '127.0.0.1') {
+      localStorage.setItem('menu-builder-session', ${JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(session))});
+      localStorage.setItem('menu-builder-restaurant', ${JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(session.memberships[0].restaurant))});
+      window.confirm = () => true;
+    }
+  ` });
+  await cdp("Page.navigate", { url: "http://127.0.0.1:3000/dashboard/products/new" });
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('.product-creation-mode')", "creation mode picker");
+  check(await evaluate("document.querySelector('.product-form-page')?.getAttribute('dir') || document.documentElement.getAttribute('dir')") === "rtl", "Dashboard is not RTL");
+  await evaluate("document.querySelectorAll('input[name=creation-mode]')[1].click()");
+  await until("document.body.innerText.includes('شبكة فارغة')", "Network setup explanation");
+  const fill = async (label, value) => {
+    const changed = await evaluate(`(() => { const field=[...document.querySelectorAll('.product-form-card label')].find(x=>x.innerText.trim().startsWith(${JSON.stringify(label)}))?.querySelector('input'); if(!field)return false; Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(field,${JSON.stringify(value)}); field.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()`);
+    check(changed, `Missing field: ${label}`);
+  };
+  await fill("اسم المنتج", `Stage 6E.1 Browser Pizza ${Date.now()}`);
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('.product-form-card input[readonly]')?.value", "restaurant context");
+  const validity = await evaluate("({valid:document.querySelector('.product-form-page').checkValidity(), invalid:[...document.querySelector('.product-form-page').elements].filter(x=>!x.validity?.valid).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:x.value}))})");
+  check(validity.valid, `Form is invalid before submit: ${JSON.stringify(validity.invalid)}`);
+  await evaluate("document.querySelector('.product-form-page button[type=submit]').click()");
+  await until("location.pathname.includes('/edit') && !!document.querySelector('.pc-shell') || !!document.querySelector('.form-message:not(.success)')", "created product editor or submit error");
+  check(await evaluate("location.pathname.includes('/edit')"), `Create failed: ${await evaluate("document.querySelector('.form-message')?.innerText ?? ''")}`);
+  results.push("create setup and navigate to editor");
+  const productId = new URL(await evaluate("location.href")).pathname.split("/").at(-2);
+  const before = await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } });
+  check(before.isAvailable === false && before.configurationVersion === 1 && before.basePrice === null
+    && before.configurationTree?.schemaVersion === 1 && before.configurationTree?.productId === productId
+    && before.configurationTree?.revision === 1 && before.configurationTree?.basePrice === null
+    && Array.isArray(before.configurationTree?.groups) && before.configurationTree.groups.length === 0,
+  "Setup product was not an unpriced Network tree");
+  const premature = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:5000/dashboard/products/${productId}/toggle-availability`, {
+    method: "PATCH", headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "x-restaurant-id": "s6e1-r1" }
+  });
+  check(premature.status === 409, `Premature activation was not blocked: ${premature.status}`);
+  const hidden = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:5000/public/menus/s6e1-demo/products/${productId}/configuration`);
+  check(hidden.status === 404, `Incomplete setup leaked to Public Menu: ${hidden.status}`);
+  results.push("incomplete setup activation and public access blocked");
+  await until("document.querySelector('.pc-demo-bar') !== null", "configuration editor ready");
+  await evaluate("[...document.querySelectorAll('.pc-demo-bar button')].find(x=>x.innerText.includes('Pizza Margherita')).click()");
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('.pc-dirty')", "unsaved demo changes");
+  await evaluate("document.querySelector('.pc-save-actions button.primary').click()");
+  await until("document.querySelector('.pc-main-header')?.innerText.includes('النسخة الحالية 2')", "saved configuration revision");
+  const saved = await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } });
+  check(saved.configurationVersion === 2 && saved.basePrice === null && saved.configurationTree !== null && !saved.isAvailable, "Network tree did not persist with null Base");
+  results.push("save Pizza demo through existing editor and atomic API");
+  await cdp("Page.reload", { ignoreCache: true });
+  await until("document.querySelector('.pc-main-header')?.innerText.includes('النسخة الحالية 2')", "reloaded saved tree");
+  check(await evaluate("document.querySelector('.pc-shell')?.innerText.includes('Small') || document.querySelector('.pc-shell')?.innerText.includes('صغير')"), "Saved sizes were lost after reload");
+  results.push("reload and preserve configuration");
+  await cdp("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", { width: 390, height: 844, deviceScaleFactor: 1, mobile: true });
+  await pause(400);
+  check(await evaluate("document.querySelector('.pc-shell')?.getAttribute('dir')") === "rtl", "Editor lost RTL on mobile");
+  await evaluate("document.querySelector('.pc-shell').scrollIntoView({block:'start'})");
+  await pause(300);
+  const editorWidth = await evaluate("document.querySelector('.pc-shell').getBoundingClientRect().width");
+  check(editorWidth <= 390, `Editor exceeds 390px viewport: ${editorWidth}`);
+  const screenshot = await cdp("Page.captureScreenshot", { format: "png", captureBeyondViewport: false });
+  await writeFile(resolve(process.cwd(), "../work/stage6e1a-dashboard-mobile.png"), Buffer.from(screenshot.data, "base64"));
+  results.push("RTL and 390px mobile screenshot");
+  await cdp("Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride");
+  await cdp("Page.navigate", { url: "http://127.0.0.1:3000/dashboard/products/new" });
+  await until("!!document.querySelector('.product-creation-mode')", "Legacy product form");
+  const legacyName = `Stage 6E.1 Legacy Zero ${Date.now()}`;
+  await fill("اسم المنتج", legacyName);
+  await fill("السعر", "0");
+  await evaluate("document.querySelector('.product-form-page button[type=submit]').click()");
+  await until("location.pathname==='/dashboard/products'", "Legacy product list navigation");
+  const legacy = await db.product.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { restaurantId: "s6e1-r1", name: legacyName } });
+  check(legacy.basePrice?.toString() === "0" && legacy.isAvailable && legacy.configurationTree === null, "Legacy creation behavior changed");
+  results.push("Legacy product creation and zero-price regression");
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ results, productId, screenshot: resolve(process.cwd(), "../work/stage6e1a-dashboard-mobile.png") }, null, 2));
+} finally {
+  socket?.close();
+  chrome.kill();
+  await db.$disconnect();
+}

diff --git a/scripts/stage6f3-disposable-assertions.sql b/scripts/stage6f3-disposable-assertions.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..64c2606
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/stage6f3-disposable-assertions.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+-- Stage 6F.3: synthetic checks against a NEW disposable DB after Stage 2C + 6C SQL.
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "id" IN ('s6f3-r1','s6f3-r2')) <> 2
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "Category" WHERE "id" IN ('s6f3-c1','s6f3-c2')) <> 2
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "ProductOptionGroup" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-group') <> 1
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "ProductOption" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-option' AND "priceDelta" = 500) <> 1
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "Order" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-order' AND "totalAmount" = 13000 AND "source" = 'WHATSAPP') <> 1
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "OrderItem" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-item' AND "totalPrice" = 13000) <> 1
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "AnalyticsEvent" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-analytics') <> 1
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "Product" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-legacy' AND "basePrice" = 12500 AND "configurationTree" IS NULL AND "configurationVersion" = 0) <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'synthetic legacy preservation failed';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+
+INSERT INTO "Product" ("id", "restaurantId", "categoryId", "name", "slug", "basePrice", "configurationTree", "configurationVersion", "currency", "updatedAt") VALUES
+  ('s6f3-network-null', 's6f3-r1', 's6f3-c1', 'Network Null', 'network-null', NULL,
+   '{"schemaVersion":1,"productId":"s6f3-network-null","revision":1,"basePrice":null,"groups":[]}'::jsonb, 1, 'SYP', now()),
+  ('s6f3-network-zero', 's6f3-r1', 's6f3-c1', 'Network Zero', 'network-zero', 0,
+   '{"schemaVersion":1,"productId":"s6f3-network-zero","revision":1,"basePrice":"0","groups":[]}'::jsonb, 1, 'SYP', now());
+
+INSERT INTO "ProductConfigurationDependency"
+  ("id", "restaurantId", "productId", "sourceProductId", "optionId", "path", "mode", "configurationVersion")
+VALUES
+  ('s6f3-dep', 's6f3-r1', 's6f3-network-null', 's6f3-source', 'option-1', 'groups/0/options/0', 'ORIGINAL', 1);
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO "ProductConfigurationDependency"
+      ("id", "restaurantId", "productId", "sourceProductId", "optionId", "path", "mode", "configurationVersion")
+    VALUES ('s6f3-cross', 's6f3-r1', 's6f3-network-null', 's6f3-other', 'option-2', 'groups/0/options/1', 'CUSTOM', 1);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'cross-restaurant dependency unexpectedly accepted';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN foreign_key_violation THEN NULL;
+  END;
+  BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO "ProductConfigurationDependency"
+      ("id", "restaurantId", "productId", "sourceProductId", "optionId", "path", "mode", "configurationVersion")
+    VALUES ('s6f3-self', 's6f3-r1', 's6f3-network-null', 's6f3-network-null', 'option-3', 'groups/0/options/2', 'ORIGINAL', 1);
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'self-link unexpectedly accepted';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation THEN NULL;
+  END;
+  BEGIN
+    UPDATE "Product" SET "basePrice" = 1 WHERE "id" = 's6f3-network-null';
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'basePrice/tree mismatch unexpectedly accepted';
+  EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation THEN NULL;
+  END;
+  IF (SELECT "basePrice" FROM "Product" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-network-null') IS NOT NULL
+     OR (SELECT "basePrice" FROM "Product" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-network-zero') <> 0
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "ProductConfigurationDependency" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-dep') <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'network fixture assertions failed';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- Legacy checkout remains writable after Stage 6C; new nullable fields stay NULL.
+INSERT INTO "Order" ("id", "restaurantId", "totalAmount", "currency", "status", "source")
+VALUES ('s6f3-order-after', 's6f3-r1', 12500, 'SYP', 'PENDING_WHATSAPP', 'WHATSAPP');
+INSERT INTO "OrderItem" ("id", "orderId", "productId", "name", "quantity", "unitPrice", "totalPrice")
+VALUES ('s6f3-item-after', 's6f3-order-after', 's6f3-legacy', 'Legacy Pizza', 1, 12500, 12500);
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM "Order" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-order-after' AND "idempotencyKey" IS NULL AND "requestHash" IS NULL AND "acceptanceTokenHash" IS NULL AND "networkSnapshotSealedAt" IS NULL) <> 1
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM "OrderItem" WHERE "id" = 's6f3-item-after') <> 1 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy order after migration failed';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+
+SELECT 'STAGE6F3_SYNTHETIC_ASSERTIONS_PASS' AS result;
diff --git a/scripts/stage6f3-disposable-fixtures.sql b/scripts/stage6f3-disposable-fixtures.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e9eeea1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/stage6f3-disposable-fixtures.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+-- Stage 6F.3: synthetic, disposable PostgreSQL only. Never run on an existing database.
+-- Baseline is generated from the Stage 0 Prisma schema, not a Production dump.
+CREATE TABLE "_prisma_migrations" (
+  "id" VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
+  "checksum" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
+  "finished_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
+  "migration_name" VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
+  "logs" TEXT,
+  "rolled_back_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
+  "started_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

+-- Stage 6F.4 REVIEW CANDIDATE / disposable PostgreSQL 18.6 ONLY.
+-- This psql orchestration is deliberately locked to one synthetic database.
+-- It is NOT a Production migration, not a Prisma history resolution, and does
+-- not authorize running official SQL against an existing database.
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  expected_count integer;
+BEGIN
+  IF current_database() <> 'ordersawa_stage6f4_candidate'
+     OR host(inet_server_addr()) <> '127.0.0.1'
+     OR current_setting('server_version_num')::integer < 180000 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOP: Stage 6F.4 candidate accepts only the named loopback PG18 disposable database';
+  END IF;
+  IF to_regclass('public."ProductConfigurationDependency"') IS NOT NULL
+     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='Product'
+                  AND column_name IN ('configurationTree','configurationVersion'))
+     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='Order'
+                  AND column_name IN ('idempotencyKey','requestHash','acceptanceTokenHash','networkSnapshotSealedAt')) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOP: baseline is not the expected pre-Stage-2C/pre-Stage-6C schema';
+  END IF;
+  IF (SELECT format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)
+      FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid
+      WHERE c.relname='Product' AND a.attname='basePrice' AND a.attnum>0) <> 'numeric(10,2)' THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOP: basePrice typmod differs from the synthetic baseline; investigate before DDL';
+  END IF;
+  IF to_regclass('public."_prisma_migrations"') IS NULL THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOP: migration history table missing';
+  END IF;
+  SELECT count(*) INTO expected_count FROM "_prisma_migrations";
+  IF expected_count <> 5 OR EXISTS (
+    WITH expected(name, hash) AS (VALUES
+      ('20260719000000_add_category_visual_settings','A5BBCB330F71578EE49750E0C15D79DD6088500C1248359EEC432BC6713FBC1B'),
+      ('20260721000000_add_product_mood_key','4A085CEE7B45F7E46F9BC9F24E903D1F7BBE46EC412BEEE9DD2654B7A3C61EE1'),
+      ('20260721001000_add_category_icon_dimensions','A27E49CB39595C5D98CB6EEAF4E2D79D6A0AD921A665598E78B5BEEBBA2F4565'),
+      ('20260807000000_add_product_libraries','579D7AEB52CFF91C99756482BD44AB1749B099EF8C15624D3FBE146F74BA18D9'),
+      ('20260815000000_global_product_libraries','4544E53CE71008FE157B97B4D1D7883E0C532BAAD7C40CDDE2B4514FCC15C92C'))
+    SELECT 1 FROM expected e LEFT JOIN "_prisma_migrations" m ON m.migration_name=e.name
+    GROUP BY e.name,e.hash
+    HAVING count(m.id) <> 1 OR bool_or(upper(m.checksum) <> e.hash
+      OR m.finished_at IS NULL OR m.rolled_back_at IS NOT NULL)
+  ) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOP: synthetic migration history does not match the five Git SQL files';
+  END IF;
+  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Product" WHERE "basePrice" < 0
+      OR "basePrice" <> round("basePrice",6)
+      OR abs(round("basePrice",6)) >= 1000000000000000000::numeric
+      OR ("currency" IN ('SYP','ل.س') AND "basePrice" <> trunc("basePrice")))
+    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Order" WHERE "totalAmount" < 0
+      OR "totalAmount" <> round("totalAmount",6)
+      OR abs(round("totalAmount",6)) >= 1000000000000000000::numeric
+      OR ("currency" IN ('SYP','ل.س') AND "totalAmount" <> trunc("totalAmount")))
+    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "OrderItem" WHERE "unitPrice" <> round("unitPrice",6)
+      OR "totalPrice" <> round("totalPrice",6)
+      OR abs(round("unitPrice",6)) >= 1000000000000000000::numeric
+      OR abs(round("totalPrice",6)) >= 1000000000000000000::numeric)
+    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ProductOption" o
+      JOIN "ProductOptionGroup" g ON g.id=o."groupId"
+      JOIN "Product" p ON p.id=g."productId"
+      WHERE p."currency" IN ('SYP','ل.س')
+        AND o."priceDelta" <> trunc(o."priceDelta")) THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOP: synthetic historical prices require review; no implicit rounding/repair';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- Official Git migrations are included unchanged; no db push/migrate deploy.
+\ir ../apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261012000000_product_configuration_network/migration.sql
+
+-- Stage 6C has no explicit transaction in its source file. The disposable
+-- candidate wraps it atomically; this does not alter the official file.
+BEGIN;
+\ir ../apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261013000000_network_order_test_snapshot/migration.sql
+COMMIT;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid
+      WHERE c.relname='Product' AND k.contype='c' AND k.convalidated
+        AND k.conname LIKE 'Product_%_check') <> 5
+     OR to_regclass('public."ProductConfigurationDependency"') IS NULL
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public'
+         AND table_name='Order' AND column_name IN
+           ('idempotencyKey','requestHash','acceptanceTokenHash','networkSnapshotSealedAt')) <> 4
+     OR (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid
+         WHERE c.relname IN ('Order','OrderItem') AND NOT t.tgisinternal) <> 6 THEN
+    RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOP: post-migration schema checks failed';
+  END IF;
+END $$;
+
+SELECT 'STAGE6F4_DISPOSABLE_CANDIDATE_PASS' AS result;
